Kwakungasiyo injongo yakhe ukuthi azibeke njengomuntu owayehlamukela amandla eRoma. Kodwa ukuthanda kwakhe iqiniso kwabangela ukuthi azithole esilwa lemfundiso yamanga. Nxa wayeqhubeka enanzelela imfundiso yamanga eyayifundiswa ngupapa, wazithola esefundisa ngamandla iqiniso elitholakala eBhayibhilini. Wananzelela ukuthi ibandla leRoma lalilahle ilizwi likaNkulunkulu laphakamisa endaweni yalo amasiko abantu, wabeka icala phezu kwabapristi engelakho ukwesaba ngenxa yezenzo zabo zokulahla iBhayibhili, wabatshela ukuthi kwakumele iBhayibhili libiselwe ezandleni zabantu lokuthi amandla walo kwakumele abiselwe ebandleni. Wayelesipho sokutshumayela lokufundisa njalo impilo ayeyiphila yayihambelana lamaqiniso ayewatshumayela. Ulwazi lwakhe loMbhalo, lamandla okuchasisa kwakhe, lokuhlambuluka kwempilo yakhe, lesibindi sakhe, kwabangela ukuthi abantu bamthembe njalo bamncome. Abantu abanengi babengasuthiseki ngokholo lwabo ngoba babebona ububi obabugcwele ebandleni laseRoma, njalo bajabula kakhulu nxa babesizwa imfundiso kaWycliffe, kodwa abaphathi bebandla bagcwala ulaka, nxa babenanzelela ukuthi uMvuseleli lowu wayeselendonsela edlula eyabo. {GC 81.2}

UWycliffe wayelesipho sokunanzelela imfundiso zamanga, njalo walwisa ngesibindi esikhulu konke ukuncindezela okwakuvunyelwa libandla leRoma. Ngesikhathi lapho esebenza njengomfundisi esigodlweni senkosi, wathatha inyathela lokuphikisa imali eyayibhadalwa yisizwe sakibo eyayisiya kupapa, wabonisa ukuthi amandla upapa ayezinika wona ayephikisana lomcabango njalo lesambulelo. Izinto ezazifunwa ngupapa zazicunula abantu abanengi, okwabangela ukuthi imfundiso kaWycliffe yamukelwe ngababusi abanengi. Amakhosi lababusi babambana balwisana lemfundiso yokuthi upapa wayelamandla phezu kwesizwe sabo njalo bayala ukumthumela imali ayeyifuna. Ngale indlela amandla kapapa elizweni laseNgilandi axegiswa kakhulu. {GC 82.1}

Eyinye yemfundiso ezimbi alwisana layo, ngeyabantu ababengaphansi kwebandla leRoma ababekhetha ukutshiya imisebenzi yabo bephile ngeminikelo yabantu balapho ababehlala khona. Abantu laba babegcwele elizweni laseNgilandi njalo babengumthwalo onzima emnothweni welizwe. Indonsela yabo yayizwakala endaweni zonke zelizwe. Impilo yabo yokungasebenzi yayingasongxaki kuphela emnothweni welizwe kodwa yayisenza abantu bebone sengathi ukusebenza kwakungaqakathekanga. Abantu abatsha labo babengasafuni ukusebenza. Inengi labo ngenxa yomzekeliso wabantu laba ababesithi basebenzela ibandla, lalikhetha impilo leyi bengatshelanga abazali babo njalo bengalayo lemvumo. Omunye wabathungameli bebandla leRoma nxa wayefundisa abantu abatsha ukuthi bakhethe umsebenzi lowu wokusebenzela ibandla wathi: “Loba uyihlo engalala emnyango ekhala ekuncenga, kumbe unyoko ekubonisa ukuthi wakuthwala esiswini sakhe aphinde akubonise lamabele akumunyisa ngawo, bona ukuthi uyabanyathela uhambe phezu kwabo, uqhubekele phambili usiyasebenzela uKrestu.” Ngamazwi amabi kangaka, ngendlela uLuther akuchaza ngayo, “ayesenza umuntu abeyinyamazana kulokuba yindoda esebenzela uKrestu”, inhliziyo zabantwana zaphendulwa ngale indlela bahlamukela abazali babo. — (Barnas Sears, The Life of Luther, pages 69, 70). Ngale indlela abathungameli bakapapa benza njengabafarisi basendulo, ngokwenza ukuthi umthetho kaNkulunkulu ungabi lamandla ngenxa yamasiko abo. Ngokwenza njalo imizi yadilika, abazali bathathelwa ubudlelwane phakathi kwabo lamadodana kanye lamadodakazi abo. {GC 82.2}

Labantu abatsha ezikolweni badukiswa ngabathungameli bebandla ababebonisa abantu isimilo samanga, abafundi balingeka ukuthi bahlanganele enhlanganisweni zabo. Inengi labo lalinanzelela ngemva kwesikhathi ukuthi babeyenze iphutha ngoba basebehlukaniswe lemuli zabo, kodwa kwakusiba nzima ukuphuma nxa basebezihlanganise lenhlanganiso leyi. Abazali abanengi ngokwesaba indonsela yabaphathi laba, bakhetha ukungathumeli abantwana babo ezikolo eziphezulu. Inani labantwana elalisiya ezikolweni eziphezulu lalisehla izikhathi zonke. Izikolo zazingasela bafundi njalo lolwazi elizweni lwehla kakhulu. {GC 83.1}

Upapa wayenike abaphathi laba amandla okuthi abantu bevume izono zabo phambi kwabo njalo lawokuzithethelela. Lokhu kwaba yimbangela yobubi obalandelayo. Ngenxa yokuthanda imali, abaphathi laba babesebenzisana lezigebenga ezinkulu ezazihamba ziyekwenza ububi zithembe ukuthi zizathethelelwa kungabikhona ukujeziswa okwabangela ukuthi ububi bande elizweni. Abagulayo labaswelayo batshiywa ekuhluphekeni kwabo, ngoba izipho okwakumele zinikwe bona zaziphiwa abaphathi laba ababesethusela abantu bebatshela ukuthi babezakwehlelwa yibubi nxa bengalethanga iminikelo yabo kibo. Loba babeziveza njengabantu abaswelayo ngoba besithi batshiya konke ngesizatho sokuthi babefuna ukusebenzela uKrestu, kwasekusobala ukuthi abaphathi laba, babezithandela inotho ebuya ebantwini, isizwe sonke saqala ukuswela ngenxa yeminikelo eyayikhitshwa. Nxa babeqhubeka bephila impilo yenjabulo ngenxa yenotho abasebelayo, babethumela abantu abangelalwazi ukuthi bayefundisa abantu besenzela ukuthi bebadukise becabange ukuthi babengabantu abaswelayo abasebenzela uNkulunkulu. Loba kwakunjalo abaphathi laba baqhubeka bedukisa abantu bebafundisa ukuthi abantu bonke kwakumele bakhonze upapa, njalo banikele izipho zabo kubaphathi bebandla, njalo lokuthi ngokwenza konke lokhu babezangena ezulwini. {GC 83.2}

Amadoda amanengi aqeqetshileyo ayezamile njalo ehluleka ukuveza imfundiso zamanga ezazifundiswa abantu, kodwa uWycliffe ngokunanzelela okukhulu, wabeka ihloka empandeni yobubi bonke, waveza ukuthi umbuso njalo lamandla ibandla elalizinika wona ayengaveli eBhayibhilini njalo kwakumele aqedwe. Abantu baqala ukukhulumisana ngodaba lolu esizweni sonke. Nxa abaphathi bebandla babeqhubeka befundisa abantu ukuthi kwakumele bathenge intethelelo, abantu abanengi basebeqala ukuzibuza ukuthi ngabe kwakumele bacele ukuthethelelwa kuNkulunkulu manqamu kumbe kupapa weRoma. Abantu abanengi baqala ukunanzelela ukuthi abaphathi laba babethanda imali njalo babengasuthiseki. Bathi bona: “ Abaphathi labapristi, bayasidla njengemvukuzane, uNkulunkulu kumele asikhulule, nxa kungenjalo abantu bazabhubha.”- (D’ Aubigne, b.17, ch.7). Nxa babezama ukuvala ububi babo, abaphathi laba babefundisa abantu ukuthi babelandela isibonelo sikaKrestu labafundi bakhe ngoba labo babephila ngeminikelo yabalandeli babo. Isizatho lesi senza ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ulimale, ngoba abantu abanengi baqala ukuzibalela ukuthi iBhayibhili lalifundisani, isiphetho esasingafunwa libandla leRoma. Ingqondo zabantu zathunganyelwa emthonjeni weqiniso ababeyenze imizamo yonke ukuthi ufihlwe. {GC 84.1}

UWycliffe waqala ukubhala incwadi ezaziveza imfundiso zamanga ezazifundiswa ngabaphathi bebandla, hatshi ngoba wayefuna ukulwisana labo kodwa wayefuna ukudonsela inhliziyo zabantu eqinisweni elitholakala eBhayibhilini likaNkulunkulu onguye umlobi walo. Wafundisa ukuthi amandla kapapa wokuthethelela lokukhipha abantu ebandleni ayelingana lawomuntu wonke ngoba kwakungekho umuntu olamandla okukwenza konke lokhu ngaphandle kukaNkulunkulu. Yayingekho indlela edlula leyi eyokukhulula abantu emandleni ayefakwe ngupapa phezu kwabantu, ayebangela ukuthi izigidi zabantu zibeyizigqili ngaphansi kwebandla leRoma. {GC 84.2}

UWycliffe wakhethwa ukuthi amele ilizwe lakhe ekulweni lamandla eRoma ayephezu kwesizwe sakibo, waqeda iminyaka emibili elizweni laseNetherlands elwisana labameli bakapapa emihlanganweni. Lapha waqala ukukhulumisana lababusi basemazweni aseFrance, laseSpain njalo labaseItaly, njalo wenelisa ukubona izinto ezazisenzeka ensitha ayengeke azibone nxa wayeseNgilandi. Wafunda izinto ezinengi ezazizaxhasa umsebenzi wakhe. Ebamelini bakapapa wafunda injongo yababusi baseRoma ngokuphelela kwayo. Wabuyela elizweni lakibo waqhubeka ngemfundiso yakhe ngomfutho omkhulu, eveza ukuthi ukunxwanela, lokuziphakamisa, lokudukisa kwakungabonkulunkulu baseRoma. {GC 84.3}

Kweyinye yezincwadi zakhe, nxa wayebhala ngopapa labaphathi bakhe wathi: “Bayakhipha elizweni lethu umnotho wabantu abaswelayo, bathathe njalo inkulungwane zemali ezandleni zamakhosi, besithi yiminikelo yokuhambisa ivangeli, khona okuyimfundiso yamanga, njalo benza wonke amaKrestu amukele njalo akhulise limfundiso yamanga. Njalo loba ilizwe lethu belilentaba zegolide, kungekho omunye umuntu olembayo ngaphandle kwezithunywa zikapapa, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi igolide kuzamele liphele, ngoba uhlala ethatha imali elizweni lethu, njalo uthumela kuphela iziqalekiso zikaNkulunkulu ngenxa yezenzo zakhe.” —John Lewis, History of the Life and Sufferings of J. Wycliffe, page. 37. {GC 85.1}

Ngemva kokubuyela kwakhe eNgilandi, inkosi yamnika esinye isikhundla sokuba ngumkhulu wedolobho laseLutterworth. Lokhu kwakuyibufakazi bokuthi inkosi yayithakazelela amaqiniso ayewakhuluma. Indonsela kaWycliffe yayisiqala ukubumba indlela okwakubuswa ngayo kanye lenkolo yesizwe sonke. {GC 85.2}

Izikhali zikapapa zaqala ukujikelwa kuye. Kwathunyelwa izincwadi eNgilandi, lasezikolweni eziphezulu, lasenkosini, lakubaphathi bebandla, zonke zisitsho ukuthi kwakumele bathathe amanyathelo aqinileyo okuthulisa umtshumayeli lowu owayesenza okuphambene lentando kapapa. (Augustus Neander, General History of the Christian Religion and Church, period 6, sec.2, pt.1, par.8). Incwadi lezi zingakafiki amabhishopi ngenxa yamadlabuzane abo babizela uWycliffe phambi kwenkantolo yabo. Kodwa ababusi abakhulu ababili bahamba laye enkantolo, njalo labantu ababekhonapho lababengaphandle benza ukuthi abehluleli besabe, okwabangela ukuthi bamkhulule okwesikhatshana wahamba ngokuthula. Ngemva kwesikhatshana inkosi uEdward III (Wesithathu) onguye abaphathi bebandla ababezame ukuthi bamenze aphendukele uWyclffe esikhathini esasedlule wafa, kwabusa omunye walabo owayevikele uWycliffe endaweni yakhe. {GC 85.3}

Kodwa ngemva kokufika kwezincwadi ezazivela kupapa eNgilandi, kwenziwa isinqumo sokuthi kwakumele kubotshwe wonke umuntu owayefundisa lokhu okwakuphambene lemfundiso yebandla leRoma. Isigwebo sakhona kwakuyikutshiswa kwabantu ababesenza lokhu. Kwabonakala sobala ukuthi ngesikhatshana uWycliffe wayezahlangana lochuku lweRoma. Kodwa lowo ofanayo endulo owathi, “Ungesabi...ngiyisihlangu sakho” (Genesis 15:1), waphinda njalo welula isandla sakhe wavikela inceku yakhe. Ukufa kwafika hatshi kuMvuseleli kodwa kupapa lowu owayefake umthetho lowu. UGregory XI (Wetshumi lanye) wafa, njalo bonke abaphathi ababebuthene bemele ukugwetshwa kukaWycliffe behlukana. {GC 86.1}

Umusa kaNkulunkulu wabamba imimoya wavumela ithuba lokuthi umsebenzi weMvuselelo uqhubekele phambili. Ukufa kukaGregory kwalandelwa yikukhethwa kwabopapa ababili ababephikisana. Kwasekulababusi ababili ababephikisana futhi bonke babefuna ukukhonzwa. Omunye lomunye wayecela ukuthi amalunga ebandla amxhase emizameni yakhe yokulwisa omunye, esebenzisa uchuku kulabo ababemelana laye, njalo ngakolunye uhlangothi ethembisa umbuso wezulu kulabo ababezamsekela. Ukulwisana lokhu kwehlisa amandla ombuso waseRoma. Ukuqhubeka kokulwisana lokhu kwenza ukuthi uWycliffe athole ukuphumula okwesikhatshana. Ububi banda ebandleni nxa abopapa laba babeqhubeka besilwa. UWycliffe yena waqhubeka ngomsebenzi wakhe wokudonsela abantu kuJesu, yena oyiNkosi yokuthula, wabenza ukuthi basuse amehlo abo kubopapa. {GC 86.2}

Ingxabano leyi eyayikhona lobubi obalandelayo yalungisa indlela yokuthi umsebenzi weMvuselelo uqhubekele phambili ngoba abantu basebethole ithuba lokubona umoya njalo lesimo sikapapa. Encwadini ayibhalayo ayibiza ngokuthi, Ingxabano yaboPapa, uWycliffe wakhuthaza abantu ukuthi bazibuze ukuthi abaphathi laba babengakhulumi iqiniso na nxa babenikana icala lokuthi omunye wayengumphikiKrestu. “ UNkulunkulu kavumanga ukuthi umkhohlisi abonakale kupapa oyedwa, kodwa...waletha ukwehlukana phakathi kwabo bobabili, esenzela ukuthi abantu benyama ngegama likaJesu bebanqobe bobabili.” — (R. Vaughan, Life and Opinions of John de Wycliffe, vol. 2, p.6). {GC 86.3}

UWycliffe njengeNkosi yakhe uJesu Kristu watshumayela ivangeli ebantwini abaswelayo. Kazange asuthiseke ngokuthi ivangeli lifinyelele abantu ababehlala esigabeni sakhe kuphela kodwa wazimisela ukuthi lifenyelele umuntu wonke waseNgilandi. Ukufeza injongo yakhe, wakhetha iqula labatshumayeli, elalibunjwe ngabantu ababelokuzehlisa, lokuzidela, lababethanda iqiniso njalo ababengafuni lutho kuphela ukuhambisa ivangeli endaweni zonke. Amadoda lawa ayehamba efundisa endaweni zokuthengisa, emigwaqweni yamadolobho amakhulu, lasemaphandleni. Babedinga bonke abagulayo, abagugileyo, labaswelayo, bebavulela indaba ezimnandi mayelana lomusa kaNkulunkulu. {GC 87.1}

Njengombalisi omkhulu kwezokholo esikolweni saseOxford, uWycliffe watshumayela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ezikolweni eziphezulu. Wayechaza ngokwethembeka amaqiniso phambi kwabafundi bakhe okwaze kwabangela ukuthi bamnike ibizo elithi “udokotela wevangeli.” Kodwa umsebenzi wakhe owedlula yonke ayenzayo waba ngowokuloba iBhayibhili ngolimi lwesikhiwa. Encwadini yakhe ayibiza ngokuthi, Iqiniso leNgcazelo yeBhayibhili, wabhala ngesifiso sakhe sokuloba iBhayibhili ngolimi lwakibo, ukwenzela ukuthi umuntu wonke eNgilandi enelise ukuzibalela ngolimi lokuzalwa kwakhe, imisebenzi emihle kaNkulunkulu. {GC 87.2}

Kodwa ngokuphazima kwelihlo umsebenzi wakhe wamiswa. Loba nje wayengakafiki iminyaka engamatshumi ayisithupha yokuzalwa, ukusebenza kwakhe nzima, lokulwa kanye lokuhlukunyezwa yisitha kwabangela ukuthi aguge masinyane. Wahlaselwa ngumkhuhlane oyingozi kakhulu. Umbiko wokugula kwakhe waletha intokozo enkulu enhliziyweni zabaphathi bebandla. Bacabanga ukuthi isikhathi sasesifikile esokuthi avume izono zakhe ayezenze phezu kwebandla, ngokunjalo bagijimela eceleni kombheda wakhe becabanga ukuthi babezamuzwa evuma izono lezi. Abaphathi bebandla, lababusi bomhlaba babuthana eceleni kwendoda leyi ababecabanga ukuthi igulela ukufa. “Ulokufa endebeni zakho” batsho kuye, “vumela ukuthi amaphutha akho athinte inhliziyo yakho, njalo uphike amazwi akho owawatshoyo ngathi asizwisa ubuhlungu.” UMvuseleli wabalalela ngokuthula, wasecela umongikazi owayemsiza ukuthi amvuse embhedeni, wabakhangela emehlweni, bona babemelele ukuzwa amazwi akhe wokuphika konke ayekufundisile, kodwa ngelizwi elilamandla, elalihlala libenza ukuthi baqhaqhazele wathi: “Ngeke ngife, kodwa ngizaphila, ngiphinde ngiveze ububi obenziwa ngabathungameli bebandla.” - (D’Aubigne, b. 17, ch. 7). Ngokumangala okukhulu bonke abathungameli bebandla baphuma belandelana endlini. {GC 87.3}

Amazwi kaWycliffe agcwaliseka. Waphila waze wafaka ezandleni zabantu bakibo isikhali esilamandla okwedlula zonke ezazizalwisa amandla eRoma, lokhu wakwenza ngokubanika iBhayibhili, isithunywa esikhethwe lizulu ukukhulula abantu, lokukhanyisela njalo lokuvangela abantu bonke. Kwakukhona imigoqo eminengi eyayizabakhona engakenelisi ukuwuqeda umsebenzi lowu. UWycliffe wehlelwa yimikhuhlane eminengi kwabasobala kuye ukuthi wayelensuku ezinganganani ezokusebenza ezasezisele empilweni yakhe, wakhangela izitha okwakumele amelane lazo, kodwa ngokuqiniswa yizithembiso eziselizwini likaNkulunkulu waqhubekela phambili ngesibindi. Ngamandla ayenikwe ingqondo yakhe, lokujula kolwazi lwakhe ngenxa yohambo ayeseluhambile, wayegcinwe yisandla sikaNkulunkulu elungiselelwa umsebenzi lowu omkhulu owedlula yonke ayeyenzile. Nxa inkolo yonke yamaKrestu yayizungezwe yikulwisana, uMvuseleli endaweni yakhe yaseLutterworth, engelandaba lesiphepho esasivunguza ngaphandle, wazinikela emsebenzini ayewukhethelwe. {GC 88.1}

Ekucineni umsebenzi lowu waphela, iBhayibhili lakuqala ngolimi lwesikhiwa laseliphelile. Ilizwi likaNkulunkulu laqala ukuvulwa elizweni laseNgilandi. UMvuseleli wayengasayesabi intolongo lokutshiswa ngomlilo. Wayesefake ezandleni zabantu bakibo isibane esasingasoke siphinde sicitshe. Ngokunika isizwe sakibo iBhayibhili, waseyenze umsebenzi omkhulu wokuqamula amaketane wokungazi lobubi, okwakuzaletha uzibuse ebantwini bakibo okwakusedlula zonke izimpi zenkululeko ababeke bazinqoba. {GC 88.2}

Imitshina yokwenza amabhuku yayingakabi khona, lokhu kwenza ukuthi umsebenzi wokwenza amaBhayibhili uthathe isikhathi eside njalo ubenzima. Isifiso sokuthola iBhayibhili sasisikhulu kakhulu okwabangela ukuthi, abantu abanengi bahlanganele emsebenzini wokulenza, kodwa kwakunzima ukusuthisa inani labantu ababelifuna. Abanye balabo ababenothile babefuna ukuthenga iBhayibhili lonke elipheleleyo. Abanye babethenga ingxenye yalo. Endaweni ezinengi imuli zazihlanganyela ukuthenga iBhayibhili elilodwa. Ngale indlela iBhayibhili likaWycliffe laqala ukungena emizini yabantu. {GC 88.3}

Ingqondo zabo zavuleka kwasuswa ukwethembela kupapa okwakubekwe kibo ngenxa yemfundiso yebandla. UWycliffe waqala ukufundisa imfundiso zesiKrestu, wafundisa ngosindiso oluvela kuKrestu kuphela ngokukholwa, njalo lokuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu yilolodwa elingaguqukiyo. Abatshumayeli ayebathumele endaweni zonke, benza umsebenzi wokuthengisa iBhayibhili, kanye lemibhalo yoMvuseleli ngokuphumelela okukhulu okwabangela ukuthi phose ingxenye yelizwe laseNgilandi yamukele iqiniso. {GC 89.1}

Ukwanda kwamaBhayibhili kwahlupha abaphathi bebandla leRoma kakhulu. Manje basebemelane lebutho eledlula uWycliffe, ibutho ababengeke balehlule ngezikhali zabo zonke. Kwakungekho umthetho eNgilandi owawusenqabela ukuthengiswa kweBhayibhili ngoba lalingakaze libekhona ngolimi lwesikhiwa. Imithetho leyi yafakwa ngemva kwalesi isikhathi. Loba kwakunjalo, iBhayibhili laqhubeka lingena emizini yabantu loba nje abapristi babesenza yonke imizamo yokulenqabela. {GC 89.2}

Abathungameli bakapapa, bazama futhi ukuthulisa ilizwi loMvuseleli. Wabizwa phambi kwenkantolo ezintathu ukuthi azokwahlulelwa, kodwa kwehlula ukuthi bamgwebe. Amabhishopi abeka umthetho wokuthi imibhalo yakhe yayiphambene lemfundiso zebandla leRoma, ngakho ngemva kokuhugela uRichard II (Wesibili) owayeyinkosi entsha ehlangothini lwabo, babeka umthetho wokuthi wonke umuntu owayekholelwa emfundisweni kaWycliffe kwakumele afakwe ejele. {GC 89.3}

UWycliffe wadlulisela indaba leyi phambi kwephalamende, waveza ukuthi kwakumele kube lenguquko kususwe uchuku ibandla elalilwenza phezu kwesizwe sakibo. Ngamandla amakhulu waveza bonke ububi obabusenziwa ngupapa labaphathi bakhe. Lokhu kwabangela ukuthi izitha zakhe zidideke. Abangane bakaWycliffe babebanjwe ngamandla ukuthi bavume lokhu okwakukhulunywe ngabaphathi bebandla, njalo kwakulomcabango wokuthi uMvuseleli laye, njengoba wayesegugile, futhi engasela bangane wayezalahla imbeleko akhothamele amandla kapapa. Kodwa kulokuthi bathole lokhu abaphathi bebandla bazithola sebenqotshiwe. Iphalamende ngemva kokulalela amazwi kaWycliffe, yavotela ukuthi umthetho lowu owawufakwe ngamabhishopi ukhitshwe, uMvuseleli wathola inkululeko futhi. {GC 89.4}

Ngokwesithathu walethwa futhi emthethwandaba, khathesi wayeselethwe enkantolo ephezu kwazozonke elizweni. Lapha kwakungekho usizi olwaluzaboniswa kulabo ababefundisa lokhu okwakuphambene lemfundiso zebandla. Lapha ngokokucina ibandla leRoma lalizanqoba, njalo umsebenzi woMvuseleli umiswe. Yikho abathungameli bebandla ababekucabanga. Nxa kwakungenzeka behluleke ukufeza injongo yabo, uWycliffe wayezabanjwa ngamandla ukuthi aphike imfundiso yakhe, bamthathe bayemtshisa emlilweni. {GC 90.1}

Kodwa uWycliffe kazange akhiphe kumbe aphike lokhu ayekukholwa. Wabambelela ngamandla emfundisweni yakhe, wabeka icala kulabo ababemthonisisa. Wazikhohlwa yena, lalapho ayekhona, wabeka izitha zakhe phambi kwenkantolo engcwele, waveza zonke imfundiso zabo ezimbi eziqathanisa leqiniso lasezulwini. Amandla oMoya oyiNgcwele abonakala emhlanganweni lowu. Amandla kaNkulunkulu ehliselwa kubo bonke ababelalele. Kwakungathi babengaselawo amandla wokusuka kule indawo. Nxa imitshoko yamazwi eqiniso yayiphuma emlonyeni woMvuseleli ingena enhliziyweni zabo. Icala lokufundisa amanga ababelifake phezu kwakhe waliphendula ngamandla walibeka emakhanda abo. Wababuza ukuthi kwakungani beqhubeka befundisa amanga abo? Ngokufuna imali babezaqhubeka bethengisa umusa kaNkulunkulu na? {GC 90.2}

“Licabanga ukuthi lilwisana lobani,” wababuza, “lilwisana lexhegu leli eselizazifela? Hatshi! Lilwisana leqiniso, iqiniso elilamandla okwedlula lina, njalo elizalehlula.”- (Wylie, b.2, ch.13). Ngemva kokutsho amazwi lawa waphuma enkantolo njalo kakho owabalesibindi sokumvimbela. {GC 90.3}

Umsebenzi kaWycliffe wawusuzaphela, isibane seqiniso ayesithwale okwesikhathi eside esingaka, sasesiza phuma ezandleni zakhe, kodwa kwakusafanele ukuthi aqhubeke efakazela ivangeli. Iqiniso kwakufanele ukuthi litshunyayelwe esigodlweni semfundiso yamanga. UWycliffe wabizwa ukuthi azokuma enkantolweni kapapa ngokwakhe edolobheni laseRoma elalisaziwa ngegazi labangcwele elalichithwe kulo. Wayinanzelela ingozi eyayiphambi kwakhe, njalo wayezahamba kodwa wahlaselwa ngumkhuhlane engakahambi. Loba ilizwi lakhe lalingeke lifike eRoma, wakhetha ukubhala incwadi. Esendaweni yakibo uMvuseleli wabhalelela upapa incwadi, loba nje yayibhalwe ngomoya ohloniphayo wesiKrestu, yayigcwele amazwi alukhuni ayechaza ukuziphakamisa kukapapa. {GC 90.4}

“Ngiyathokoza kakhulu,” wabhala, “ukuvulela njalo lokufundisa wonke umuntu ngenkolo engibambelele kuyo, ikakhulu upapa weRoma, engicabanga ukuthi ulolwazi njalo leqiniso, ngilethemba uzavumelana lalokho engikutshoyo kumbe nxa kungamanga uzakutsho njalo futhi. {GC 91.1}

“Ngokokuqala, ngiyakholwa ukuthi ivangeli likaKrestu lingumzimba opheleleyo womlayo kaNkulunkulu...Ngibeka upapa weRoma, njengoba engumeli kaKrestu lapha emhlabeni, ukuthi kumele kube nguye okwedlula wonke umuntu olandela ivangeli likaKrestu. Ngokuba ukubamkhulu phakathi kwabalandeli bakaKrestu kwakungatsho inotho lezikhundla zomhlaba, kodwa ukulandela ngeqiniso impilo lesimo sikaKrestu...uKrestu ngesikhathi elapha emhlabeni, wayengumuntu ompofu okwedlula bonke, waphika njalo walahla konke ukubusa komhlaba kanye lenotho yawo... {GC 91.2}

“Akekho umuntu okholwayo okufanele alandele amanyathelo kapapa kumbe loba yiwaphi amadoda angcwele, kodwa kumele alandele iNkosi uJesu Krestu, ngokuba uPetro lamadodana kaZebedee, ngokufisa ukuphakanyiswa kwasemhlabeni, okwakuphambene lokulandela amanyathelo kaKrestu, balahleka, ngakhoke emanyathelweni lawa wokwenza iphutha akumelanga balandelwe... {GC 91.3}

“Upapa kumele atshiye amandla okubusa ezandleni zababusi basemhlabeni, njalo atshele bonke abaphathi bebandla ukuthi benze ngokufanayo, ngoba yikho uKrestu akwenzayo, ikakhulu esebenzisa abafundi bakhe. Ngakhoke nxa kusenzeka ukuthi ngenze iphutha ngalokhu esengikuvezile, ngizazehlisa ngamukele ukuqondiswa, langokufa nxa isidingo salokho sikhona, njalo nxa bekungenziwa ngokwentando yami bengizazibuyela ngime phambi kapapa weRoma, kodwa iNkosi ingethekelele ngenye indlela, njalo ingifundisile ukuthi kumele ngihloniphe uNkulunkulu okwedlula abantu.” {GC 91.4}

Emaphethelweni wathi: “Asithandazeni kuNkulunkulu wethu, ukuthi ahole uPapa wethu uUrban VI (Wesithupha), njengoba eqala umsebenzi, ukuthi yena labaphathi bakhe bebandla balandele iNkosi uJesu Krestu ngokwempilo langokwezenzo, njalo lokuthi bengafundisa abantu ngokuthembeka, lokuthi labantu bengabalandela ngendlela efanayo.” — (John Foxe, Acts and Monuments, vol.3, pp 49,50). {GC 92.1}

Ngale indlela uWycliffe wabeka phambi kapapa labaphathi bebandla, ukuzehlisa lokuzithoba kukaKrestu, wabeka sobala hatshi phambi kwabo kuphela kodwa laphambi kwamaKrestu wonke umehluko phakathi kaKrestu lalaba ababesithi bangabameli bakhe emhlabeni. {GC 92.2}

UWycliffe wayelethemba eligcweleyo lokuthi umphefumulo wakhe wawuzaba yintengo yokuthembeka kwakhe. Inkosi lopapa kanye lababhishopi babemoya munye ngokufuna ukuthatha umphefumulo wakhe, njalo kwakusobala ukuthi kwakungeke kudlule inyanga ezimbalwa engatshiswanga. Kodwa isibindi sakhe sasinganyikinyezwanga. “Kungani likhuluma ngokuthola umqhele wokufela iqiniso okhatshana? “Tshumayelani ivangeli likaKrestu phambi kwabapristi, njalo ukufela iqiniso ngeke kulikhuthe. Lithini! Kumele ngiphile njalo ngithule? ... Ngeke! Okuzayo akuze, ngikulindele ukuza kwakho.”- (D’ Aubigne, b. 17, ch.8). {GC 92.3}

Kodwa isandla sikaNkulunkulu saqhubeka sivikela inceku yakhe. Indoda leyi okwempilo yayo yonke eyayimele iqiniso ngesibindi, loba wayefake impilo yakhe engozini nsuku zonke, wayengeke awele phakathi kwenzondo yezitha zakhe. UWycliffe wayengakaze enze imizamo yokuzivikela yena, kodwa uNkulunkulu wayemvikelile, njalo kathesi, nxa izitha zakhe zasezicabanga ukuthi sezimtholile, isandla sikaNkulunkulu samsusa samfaka lapho ababengeke bamfinyelele khona. Ebandleni lakhe endaweni yaseLutterworth, nxa wayeselungiselela ukunika isidlo, wahlaselwa ngumkhuhlane, ngemva kwesikhathi esifitshane wafa. {GC 92.4}

UNkulunkulu wayemkhethile uWycliffe ukuthi ayenze umsebenzi wakhe. Wayefakile ilizwi lakhe emlonyeni wakhe, njalo wafaka uthango eduze kwakhe ukwenzela ukuthi ilizwi leli lifinyelele abantu. Impilo yakhe yayivikelekile, lomsebenzi wakhe welulwa, kwaze kwafika isikhathi lapho isisekelo somsebenzi omkhulu weMvuselelo esasesibekwe khona. {GC 92.5}

UWycliffe wayephume phakathi kwesikhathi sobunyama obukhulu. Kwakungekho ababehambe phambi kwakhe ayenga funda kibo indlela okwakumele aqhube ngayo umsebenzi wakhe wemvuselelo. Wayevuswe njengoJohane umbhabhathizi ukuthi afeze umsebenzi oqakathekileyo, wayengumsunguli wesikhathi esitsha. Loba kwakunjalo emaqinisweni wonke awafundisayo kwakulokuvumelana lokuphelela okwabangela ukuthi abaVuseleli abalandelayo bengenelisi ukufika ezingeni leli ayefike kulo. Isisekelo sasibekwe satshona futhi sababanzi, njalo insika yakhona yayakhiwe yaqina kangaka, okwabangela ukuthi kungabilendingeko yokuthi yakhiwe futhi yilabo abeza ngamuva kwakhe. {GC 93.1}

Inkolo enkulu eyaqalwa nguWycliffe, eyayizakhulula umzwangedwa wabantu njalo lemicabango yabo, njalo eyayizakhulula izizwe ezazingaphansi kombuso weRoma, yayiphume eBhayibhilini. Lapha yikho okwakulomthombo wesifula sezibusiso, njengamanzi eqiniso esigelezayo kuze kube lalamuhla kusukela endulo. UWycliffe wamukela iMbhalo eNgcwele ngokukholwa okukhulu njengelizwi eliphefumulelweyo eliveza intando kaNkulunkulu, njalo walenza umgomo opheleleyo wokukholwa njalo lokuphila. Ekukhuleni kwakhe wayefundisiwe ukuthi kwakumele alandele ibandla leRoma njegebandla elingcwele njalo elalingeke lenze amaphutha, njalo lokuthi kwakufanele amukele kungekho imbuzo imfundiso lamasiko ayebekhona okwenkulungwane zeminyaka, kodwa wakufulathela konke lokhu walalela ilizwi elingcwele likaNkulunkulu. Lawa kwakuyiwo amandla afundisa abantu ukuthi bewalalele. Kulokuthi balalele ibandla elalikhuluma ngomlomo kapapa, wafundisa ukuthi ilizwi okwakumele lilalelwe njalo eliveza intando kaNkulunkulu yilelo elaliphuma eBhayibhilini. Njalo kafundisanga kuphela ukuthi iBhayibhili yilo kuphela eliveza intando kaNkulunkulu, wafundisa futhi ukuthi uMoya oNgcwele yiwo kuphela ochasisela abantu ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, njalo wonke umuntu kwakufanele azifundele yedwa alizwisise ngokuthunganyelwa nguMoya. Ngale indlela wenelisa ukususa ingqondo zabantu kupapa lasebandleni leRoma wabakhomba elizwini likaNkulunkulu. {GC 93.2}

UWycliffe wayengomunye wabaVuseleli abakhulu. Ngokujula kolwazi, langokucaca kwemicabango yakhe, langesibindi sokumela iqiniso, lesokulivikela, balutshwana abafika ezingeni lakhe kulabo abamlandelayo. Ukubamsulwa kwempilo, lokujula kokubala lokusebenza kwakhe, lobuqotho obungayekethisiyo, lothando olufana lolukaKrestu, lokuthembeka ekwenzeni umsebenzi wakhe, konke lokhu kwakubumba isimo soMvuseleli wakuqala. Konke lokhu wakwenza ngesikhathi sobunyama kwezenkolo lakwezemfundo ayekhule phakathi kwakho. {GC 94.1}

Isimilo sikaWycliffe siyibufakazi bendlela uMbhalo oNgcwele ofundisa ngayo njalo oguqula ngayo isimilo somuntu. IBhayibhili yilo elamenza ukuthi abeyilokhu abayikho khona. Imizamo yokuzwisisa amaqiniso esiwambulelweyo, iletha ubutsha lamandla kuzo zonke izigaba zempilo. IBhayibhili lenza ukuthi ingqondo ibebanzi, lokuqedisisa kuyalolongwa njalo lijulisa lamandla wokwenza izinqumo. Ukufundwa kweBhayibhili kulolonga yonke imicabango, lemizwa kanye lenjongo okwedlula konke okufundwayo. Linika ukuhlaliseka kwenjongo, lokubekezela, lesibindi, lokubambelela, liyalolonga isimilo njalo lingcwelise umphefumulo. Ukubalwa kweBhayibhili ngokuzimisela lokuzithoba, okusondeza ingqondo yalowo obalayo duze lengqondo engelamkhawulo, bekuzanika umhlaba amadoda alokuqedisisa, lokuzithoba, okwedlula konke okukekwalethwa yimfundo yasemhlabeni. “Ukwambulwa kwamazwi akho kuyakhanyisa, kuyahlakaniphisa abayizithutha.” (Amahubo 119: 130). {GC 94.2}

Imfundiso ezazilethwe nguWycliffe zaqhubeka zisabalala okwesikhathi eside, abalandeli bakhe, ababesaziwa njengamaWycliffites lamaLollards, batshumayela phakathi kwelizwe lakibo njalo baphumela ngaphandle kweNgilandi behambisa ivangeli leqiniso kwezinye indawo. Nxa abatshumayeli babenanzelela ukuthi umthungameli wabo wayesebatshiyile, batshumayela ngamandla ayedlula wonke ababeke bawasebenzisa, njalo abantu abanengi babesiza bezolalela lokhu ababekufundisa. Abantu abanye abasendlini yesikhosini okwakugoqela indlovukazi labo baphenduka babangamakholwa. Endaweni ezinengi kwabalemvuselelo enkulu ekuziphatheni kwabantu, izithixo zaseRoma zasuswa emabandleni. Kodwa masinyane isiphepho sokuhlukumeza sehlela labo ababekhethe ukwamukela iBhayibhili njengomholi wabo. Ababusi belizwe laseNgilandi, ngokufuna kwabo ukuqinisa ubudlelwano babo lombuso waseRoma, abazange bathandabuze ukunikela abaVuseleli. Ngokokuqala embalini yelizwe laseNgilandi isigwebo sokutshiswa ngomlilo sabekwa phezu kwalabo ababengabafundi bevangeli. Ukubulawa kwabantu bebulawelwa iqiniso kwabayinjwayelo. Bonke ababemela iqiniso bahlukunyezwa bazwiswa ubuhlungu, into eyodwa ababengayenza yikukhala endlebeni zikaNkulunkulu. Loba nje babezingelwa njengabahlamuki ebandleni njalo labathengisi besizwe, baqhubeka betshumayela endaweni ezifihlakeleyo, bathola ukuphepha emizini yabantu abaswelayo, njalo kwezinye izikhathi babecatsha embalwini lasezixukwini. {GC 94.3}

Loba nje ukuhlukunyezwa lokubulawa kwabantu kwakukhona, ukuphikiswa kwemfundiso yeRoma kwaqhubeka ngokubekezela langokuzehlisa okweminyaka eminengi. AmaKrestu ayephila ngalesi isikhathi ayelokuzwisisa okuncane mayelana leqiniso, kodwa babefundile ukuthanda njalo lokulandela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, njalo ngokubekezela bazimisela ukulihluphekela. Njengabalandeli bakaJesu ngezikhathi zabafundi, inengi labo ladela inotho yomhlaba ngenxa yokuthanda kwabo uJesu. Labo ababevunyelwe ukuhlala emizini yabo bathokozelela ukuvula iminyango yabo banika abazalwane babo indawo yokuhlala ababethathelwe imizi yabo, kwathi nxa kwakufika isikhathi sokuthi labo bathathelwe eyabo imizi, bajabulela ukuthi basebezaphila impilo yomhambuma ngenxa yegama likaJesu. Kuliqiniso ukuthi inkulungwane zabantu ngenxa yokwesaba ukuhlukunyezwa lokufuna ukuthola inotho, badela ukholo lwabo bakhululwa entolongweni, benziwa ukuthi bahambe ezindaweni ezitshiyeneyo begqoke izembatho zasentolongweni betshela abantu ukuthi babexolisa ngalokhu ababekufundisile okwakuphambene lemfundiso yebandla. Nomakunjalo, lalingekho lincane iqula lalabo abama ngesibindi balwela iqiniso, kwakugoqela ababusi labesikhosini, abazimisela ukuthi loba babephoselwe emigodini abanye betshiswa ngomlilo, bakuthatha njengokuphakanyiswa ukuthi bahluphekele ivangeli likaKrestu. {GC 95.1}

Abathungameli bebandla babehlulekile ukwenza intando yabo phezukaWycliffe nxa wayesaphila, njalo inzondo yabo ayizange isuthiseke nxa wayeselele ethuneni. Kwabekwa umthetho emhlanganweni owenziwa endaweni yaseConstance, ngemva kweminyaka engamatshumi amane efile, kwathiwa amathambo akhe kwakumele atshiswe phambi komuntu wonke, ngemva kwalokho baphosela umlotha wawo esifuleni esasiseduze. Nxa omunye umlobi omdala ebhala uthi, “isifula lesi, sasigelezela emfuleni uAvon, uAvon wayehlangana lomfula uSevern, yena echithela olwandle oluncane, olwaluchithela olwandle olukhulu. Ngale indlela umlotha wamathambo kaWycliffe angumfanekiso wemfundiso yakhe, esigcwele umhlaba wonke. — (T. Fuller, Church History of Britain, b. 4, sec. 2, par.54). Izitha zakhe azizange zinanzelele ukuthi izenzo zabo ezimbi zazilomutsho omkhulu. {GC 95.2}

Kwakungenxa yemimbhalo kaWycliffe okwabangela ukuthi abantu abafana labo John Huss waseBohemia bakhethe ukumelana lemfundiso zamanga ezazivela ebandleni leRoma bangena labo emsebenzini wokuvuselela. Ngokunjalo emazweni lawa omabili ayekude nakude inhlanyelo yeqiniso yamila. Kusukela elizweni laseBohemia umsebenzi wokuvuselela wangena kwezinye indawo. Inqondo zabantu zathunganyelwa elizwini likaNkulunkulu okwasekukade lakhohlakala. Isandla esingcwele sasilungisa indlela yeMvuselelo eNkulu eyayizalandela. {GC 96.1}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 6 — Imbali kaHuss loJerome.

Ngomnyaka ka A.D 800, ivangeli laselivele selihlanyeliwe elizweni laseBohemia. IBhayibhili laselihumutshelwe elimini lwabantu bakule indawo, njalo basebesenelisa ukukhonza ngolimi lwakibo. Kodwa lapho amandla kapapa ayelokhe ekhula, ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lalo laqala ukufihlelwa abantu. Upapa uGregory wesikhombisa, owayezinike isikhundla sokwehlisa ukuziphakamisa kwababusi, wakhetha njalo ukufaka umthetho owawusenqabela ukuthi abantu baseBohemia bakhonze ngolimi lwakibo. Upapa wanika isizatho sokuthi “kwakumjabulisa uNkulunkulu ukuthi ukukhonzwa kwakhe kwenziwe ngolimi olungaziwayo, njalo lokuthi imfundiso ezimbi zasezingene ebandleni ngenxa yokungalandeli umthetho lowu.” — (Wylie, b,3 ch, 1). Ngokufaka umthetho lowu upapa weRoma wenza ukuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lisuswe ezandleni zabantu okwabangela ukuthi babesemnyameni. Kodwa izulu lalivule eyinye indlela yokuvikela iqiniso. Abantu abanengi bohlanga lwamaWaldensi lamaAlbigenses, nxa babebalekela ukuhlukunyezwa emazweni aseItaly laseFrance bangena elizweni laseBohemia. Loba nje bengakhethenga ukufundisa egcekeni, basebenza nzima ensitha. Ngale indlela ukholo lweqiniso lwaqhubeka luhlambulukile okweminyaka eminengi. {GC 97.1}

Kungakafiki insuku zikaHuss kwakulamadoda elizweni laseBohemia aphakamela ukuphikisa imfundiso zamanga ezazisebandleni ndawonye lokuncindezelwa kwabantu. Imizamo yabo yenza ukuthi abantu balangazelele ukwazi ngokujulileyo lokhu ababekufundisa. Abathungameli bebandla besaba umphumela owawuzalethwa yimfundiso yabo baqala ukuhlukumeza njalo lokubulala abalandeli bevangeli leqiniso. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi babalekele ezintabeni lapho abavula khona amabandla abo, babehlala bezingelwa ngamabutho njalo abanengi babo babulawa. Ngemva kwesikhathi kwabekwa umthetho wokuthi bonke ababetshiye imfundiso yebandla leRoma kwakufanele babulawe ngokutshiswa. Kodwa loba amaKrestu ayezimisela ukunikela impilo zabo, babelalo ithemba lokuthi umsebenzi wabo wawuzanqoba kwelizayo. Omunye walabo owayefundisa ukuthi “usindiso lufunyanwa kuphela ngokukholwa kuMsindisi owabethelwayo,” watsho lawa mazwi nxa wayesifa: “Ulaka lwezitha zemfundiso yeqiniso manje luyasehlula, kodwa kakusoke kube kokuphela, kuzavuka omunye phakathi kwabantukazana, ozabe engelankemba futhi lamandla asemhlabeni, njalo abasoze benelise ukumehlula.” (Ibid, b, 3, ch, 1). Isikhathi sikaLuther sasisesekhatshana, kodwa ukhona omunye owayesephakama, ubufakazi bakhe obabuzaphikisa imfundiso zebandla leRoma njalo buhlokomise izizwe. {GC 97.2}

UJohn Huss wayezelwe emulini ethobekileyo, wasala eyintandane ngemva kokufa kukayise. Unina ngokukholwa kwakhe ukuthi imfundo lokwesaba uNkulunkulu kwakulilifa elalifanele ukutshiyelwa usapho lwakhe, wazimisela ukuthi indodana yakhe ikuthole konke lokhu. UHuss wafunda esikolo sedolobheni lakibo, wasuka waya esikolo esiphezulu esasePrague, wathola indawo ngaphansi kwabafundi abaswelayo. Waphelekezelwa ehambeni lwakhe lokuya ePrague ngunina, oweyengumfelokazi njalo engoswelayo, wayengelazo izipho zasemhlabeni ayengazinika indodana yakhe, kodwa nxa babesondela edolobheni elikhulu, waguqa eduze kwendodana yakhe, wacela izibusiso kuBaba osezulwini. Kazange ananzelele unina ukuthi umthandazo wakhe wawuzaphendulwa ngayiphi indlela. {GC 98.1}

Esikolo esiphezulu uHuss wazehlukanisa kwabanye njengomfundi owayesebenza nzima njalo owayelengqondo ebukhali ezifundweni zakhe, njalo ukuzehlisa lokuzithoba kwakhe kwenza ukuthi athandwe ngabantu ayephila labo. Wayengumlandeli wemfundiso yebandla leRoma oqinileyo, njalo wayezimisele ukuthola izibusiso ibandla elalizithembisa. Ngensuku zokuthethelelwa wayehamba laye ayevuma izono zakhe, anikele ngemadlana encane ayesele layo, ukwenzela ukuthi laye athole intethelelo eyayithenjisiwe. Ngemva kokuqeda kwakhe ukuqeqetsha emfundweni ephezulu, wangena emsebenzini wokuba ngumpristi, waqhubeka ekhwela eleleni, wacina esesebenzela esigodlweni senkosi. Waphinda waphiwa isikhundla sokuba ngumbalisi esikolo esiphezulu wacina sengumphathi wesikolo lesi ayefunde kuso. Eminyakeni embalwa umfundi owayekhule eswela wayeseligugu lelizwe lakibo, ibizo lakhe laseli sazakala emazweni amanengi. {GC 98.2}

Kodwa kwakukweyinye insimu yokusebenza lapho uHuss aqala khona umsebenzi weMvuselelo. Ngemva kweminyaka embalwa emukele umsebenzi wokubangumpristi, waphiwa isikhundla sokuba ngumtshumayeli ebandleni laseBethlehema. Lowo owayesungule ibandla leli wayekhethe ukuthi ilizwi kwakumele litshunyayelwe ngolimi lwabantu bakule indawo. Loba nje ibandla leRoma lalikuvalile lokhu, kule indawo babelokhe beqhubeka besebenzisa ulimi lwabo enkozweni. Kodwa kwakulokukhulu ukungazi iBhayibhili ebantwini, okwabangela ukuthi ububi bande ebantwini bonke. UHuss wazimisela ukuthi uzabuveza bonke ububi lobu, esebenzisa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu njengomgomo weqiniso lokulunga okwakumele ulandelwe. {GC 99.1}

Omunye owayedabuka edolobheni lasePrague uJerome, owacina esebenzisana loHuss, wayebuye lemibhalo kaWycliffe nxa wayevela elizweni laseNgilandi. Inkosikazi yaseNgilande eyayiphendulwe yimfundiso kaWycliffe yayizalwa elizweni lase Bohemia, njalo ngenxa yesikhundla sakhe imibhalo kaWycliffe yayifinyelele abantu bakibo. UHuss wayifunda ngokukhulu ukunanzelela, ngoba wayekholwa ukuthi umlobi wayo wayengumKrestu weqiniso, lokhu kwabangela ukuthi amukele imfundiso yakhe. Ngalesi isikhathi loba uHuss wayengakwazi, indlela ayeseyingenile yayizamthatha imuse khatshana lebandla leRoma. {GC 99.2}

Ngalesi isikhathi kwafika abahambi ababili ababevela elizweni laseNgilandi, amadoda ayefundile, ayeze ukuzotshumayela ivangeli elizweni laseBohemia. Baqala ngokuveza ububi bukapapa ebantwini kodwa abathungameli babathulisa okwabangela ukuthi basebenzise ezinye indlela zokuhambisa iqiniso. Ngenxa yokuthi babelezipho zokudweba ngezandla lokutshumayela, bakhetha ukusebenzisa izipho zabo. Endaweni eyayivulekile okwakudlula khona abantu badweba imfanekiso emibili. Omunye wawuveza usuku uJesu angena ngalo eJerusalema, “ngokuzithoba ehleli phezu kukababhemi” (Mathewu 21:5), njalo elandelwa ngabafundi bakhe ababelezembatho ezidabukileyo bengagqokanga lutho enyaweni. Omunye umfanekiso wawuveza lapho okwakuhamba khona upapa weRoma, upapa egqoke impahla ezidulayo, lomqhele wakhe ekhanda, ehleli phezu kwebhiza elicecisiweyo, ehanqwe ngabantu abathwele amachacho, elandelwa ngabapristi labaphathi bebandla abacecileyo. {GC 99.3}

Imifanekiso leyi yaba yintshumayelo eyathinta abantu abanengi ababesedlula. Abantu abanengi babesiza bezobona imfanekiso leyi. Kakho owayengazwisisi isifundo esasivezwa yimifanekiso leyi, njalo abantu abanengi bananzelela ukuzehlisa kukaKrestu iNkosi lokuziphakamisa kukapapa, owayezibiza inceku kaKrestu. Kwaba lesixhobexhobe ePrague, amadoda lawa ananzelela ukuthi kwasekufanele ukuthi basuke ukuze baphephe ngemva kwesikhathi. Kodwa isifundo ababesifakile sasingeke sikhohlakale ebantwini. Umfanekiso lowu wangena wajula engqondweni kaHuss okwabangela ukuthi afunde imbhalo kaWycliffe ngamandla. Loba nje wayengakazimiseli ukwamukela yonke imfundiso kaWycliffe, wabona ngokucacileyo isimo sombuso kapapa, ngokuzimisela okukhulu wakhetha ukuphikisa konke ukuziphakamisa lobubi obabusenziwa ngupapa labaphathi bakhe. {GC 100.1}

Kusukela eBohemia ukukhanya kwaqhubeka kwaze kwayangena elizweni laseGermany, ngoba umvukela owabakhona esikolweni sasePrague, wabangela ukuthi abafundi abanengi ababevela elizweni laseGermany babuyele kibo. Abanengi babo babetholile kuHuss, imfundiso zeBhayibhili, njalo ekubuyeleni kwabo bafundisa abanye elizweni lakibo. {GC 100.2}

Umbiko womsebenzi owawusenzakala ePrague wathwalelwa edolobheni laseRoma, masinyane uHuss wabizelwa phambi kukapapa. INkosi lenkosikazi yaseBohemia, lesikolo esiphezulu, labaphathi besizwe, bathumela incwadi eyayisiya kupapa becela ukuthi uHuss angazihambeli yena kodwa kuthunyelwe umeli esikhundleni sakhe. Kulokuthi upapa abanike isicelo sabo, waqhubeka ngokwahlulela wethesa uHuss icala, njalo wafaka umthetho wokuthi idolobho lonke lasePrague laselingaphansi kwesiqalekiso sebandla. {GC 100.3}

Ngalezo nsuku isigwebo lesi nxa sasibekwe phezu kwedolobho, sasiletha ukwesaba okukhulu ebantwini. Inkonzo lezehlakalo ezazilandela isigwebo lesi zazenzelwe ukwethusa abantu, ababekhangele upapa njengomeli kaNkulunkulu emhlabeni, futhi owayelamakhiye asezulwini lawasegehena, njalo owayelamandla okwehlisela izigwebo zasemhlabeni lezasezulwini. Kwakukholelwa ukuthi amasango ezulu ayevalelwa idolobho elalithola isigwebo lesi, njalo lokuthi nxa kwakungenziwanga imizamo yokuthokozisa upapa ukuthi ehlise lesi sigwebo, izihlobo zabo ezifileyo zazikhitshwa ezulwini ziyetshiswa okunaphakade. Ngemva kwesigwebo lesi zonke inkonzo zazivalwa edolobheni lonke. Imitshado yayisenziwa ngaphandle kwethempeli. Abafileyo babengangcwatshwa endaweni ezazibekelwe ukungcwatshwa kodwa babengcwatshwa egcekeni nje. Ngenxa yokusebenzisa amaqhinga ayedalelwe ukwesabisa abantu ibandla leRoma lalibusa ingqondo lemzwangedwa yabantu. {GC 101.1}

Idolobho lasePrague laba phakathi komvukela. Abantu abanengi babeka icala kuHuss njengembangela yalokho okwasekwehlele idolobho labo, baletha isicelo sokuthi uHuss ahanjiswe edolobheni leRoma. Ngokufisa kwakhe ukuthi athulise isiphepho lesi, uHuss wasuka wayahlala ngaphandle kwedolobho lapho ayezalwa khona. Nxa wayebhalela abangane bakhe ayebatshiye edolobheni lasePrague wathi: “Nxa ngisukile phakathi kwenu, ngizama ukulandela isibonelo sikaJesu Krestu, ukwenzela ukuthi nginganiki ithuba labo abalengqondo yokwenza okubi ukuthi bengaziletheli icala, njalo lokuthi ngingabi yisizatho sokuhlukunyezwa ezandleni zalabo abaziphakamisayo. Ngisukile njalo ngenxa yokunanzelela ukuthi abapristi bazaqhubeka okwesikhathi eside besenza imizamo yokumisa ukutshunyayelwa kwelizwi likaNkulunkulu phakathi kwenu, kodwa angisukanga kini ukwenzela ukuthi ngiphike iqiniso lezulu, ngomusa kaNkulunkulu, engizimisele ukulifela.” — (Bonnechose, The Reformers Before the Reformation, vol. 1, p. 87). UHuss kazange ame ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe, kodwa waqhubeka evakatshela indawo ezaziseduze, etshumayela phambi kwabantu ababethokozelela ukuzwa iqiniso. Ngokunjalo amaqhinga ayesetshenziswe ngupapa okumisa ukuhamba kwevangeli, abangela ukuthi lihambe ngamandla kwezinye indawo. “Ngoba kasilamandla okwenza ulutho olumelana leqiniso, kodwa silamandla uba simela iqiniso. (2 Korinte 13:8). {GC 101.2}

“Ingqondo kaHuss kulelibanga lomsebenzi wakhe, yayingathi ngeyomuntu ophakathi kokulwisana lemicabango ebuhlungu. Loba nje ibandla lalizama ukumkhulela ngokusebenzisa amaqhinga abo afana lombani wezulu, wayengakaphikisi amandla alo ngalesi isikhathi. Ibandla laseRoma lalilokhe lingumlobokazi kaKrestu emehlweni akhe, njalo upapa wayelokhu engumeli kaNkulunkulu. UHuss wayelwela indlela amandla ayesetshenziswa ngayo hatshi imfundiso yebandla. Lokhu kwaletha ukuphikisana emoyeni wakhe phakathi kokuzwisisa kwakhe lalokhu umzwangedwa owawumtshela khona. Nxa amandla ebandla ayelungile njalo emsulwa, kungani umoya wakhe wawumtshela ukuthi angawalandeli? Wananzelela ukuthi ukuvuma njalo lokulandela amandla ebandla kwakuyisono, manje yindaba ukulandela amandla ebandla kwakuthungamela ekoneni nxa ibandla laliqotho? Leyi kwakuyingxaki ayekuyo ayezama ukuyixakulula nsuku zonke. Impendulo eyayiseduze kuye kwakuyikuthi njengesikhathi uMsindisi esaphila lapha emhlabeni abaphathi bebandla lamapristi basebephume endleleni eqotho baqala ukusebenzisa amandla abo ukuphambula lokhu okwakulungile ekuqaleni. Lokhu kuzwisisa kwenza ukuthi afundise abantu ukuthi iBhayibhili laliyinsika yeqiniso lokuthi abantu kwakumele balandele lokhu uNkulunkulu abavezela khona eMbhalweni kuphela hatshi lokhu okutshiwo ngabaphathi bebandla.”- (Wylie, b. 3, ch. 2). {GC 102.1}

Ngemva kwesikhatshana nxa umvukela owawusePrague wasuphelile, uHuss wabuyela ebandleni lakhe laseBethlehem, waqala ukutshumayela ngamandla amakhulu. Izitha zakhe zazinengi njalo zifuna ukumthulisa, kodwa inkosikazi labanye ababusi babengabangane bakhe njalo labantu abanengi babesehlangothini lwakhe. Nxa babeqathanisa ukulunga lokuzithoba kwakhe lendlela abaphathi bebandla ababeziphakamisa ngayo, abantu abanengi bajabulela ukuthi bebesehlangothini lwakhe. {GC 102.2}

Kuso sonke lesi isikhathi uHuss wayesebenze yedwa, kodwa manje uJerome, owayeyamukele imfundiso kaWycliffe ngesikhathi eseNgilandi, wahlanganyela emsebenzini wemvuselelo. Laba bobabili kusukela lapha babambana empilweni zabo, njalo lasekufeni babengeke bahlukaniswe. Ubungcitshi bengqondo, lesipho sokukhuluma, lezipho ezenza ukuthi umuntu amukeleke ebantwini, zonke lezi zazikuJerome, kodwa kulezi izipho ezibumba isimo esiqotho emuntwini uHuss wayehamba phambili. Ukuqedisisa kwakhe lokuzithoba, kwakuvimba umoya wokungacabangisisi izinto owawukuJerome, owayezimisele ukunanzelela amaphutha akhe, njalo walalela izixwayiso zakhe. Ngaphansi kokubambisana kwabo, umsebenzi wemvuselelo wahamba endaweni ezinengi ngokuphangisa. {GC 102.3}

UNkulunkulu wavumela ukuthi ukukhanya okukhulu kungene engqondweni zamadoda lawa ayekhethekile, wabavulela amaphutha amanengi ayesebandleni leRoma, kodwa abatholanga konke ukukhanya okwakuzanikwa umhlaba. Ngokusebenzisa inceku zakhe lezi, uNkulunkulu wayethungamela abantu bakhe phandle kobunyama benkolo yamaRoma, kodwa kwakulemigoqo eminengi ababezahlangana layo, ngakho wabahola kancane kancane ngokuzwisisa kwabo. Babengakafiki esigabeni sokuzwisisa wonke amaqiniso ngesikhathi esisodwa. Njengokukhanya kwelanga emini kulabo abaphuma endaweni emnyama, kwakuzabenza baphindele emuva nxa bebengakuphiwa. Ngakhoke wabavezela kancane kancane ngendlela elingana lalokho abantu ababezakwamukela. Kusukela ngalesi isikhathi ezinye izisebenzi ezithembekileyo zazizalandela, zithungamele abantu kwamanye amaqiniso emvuselelo. {GC 103.1}

Ukulwisana ebandleni kwakulokhe kuqhubeka. Opapa abathathu ngalesi isikhathi babelwisana befuna ukubusa umhlaba wonke, lokhu ukulwisana kwabo kwagcwalisa umhlaba wonke ngobubi njalo lokuvukelana. Abasuthisekanga ngokuthumelana amazwi wokwethuselana, kodwa bacina besebenzisa izikhali zempi. Bonke bazimisela ukuthenga izikhali lokubumba amabutho. Konke lokhu kwakudinga imali, njalo basebenzisa amaqhinga okuthi izibusiso lezikhundla zebandla zithengiselwe abantu. Abapristi labo ngenxa yesifiso sokulingisela abathungameli babo, baqala ukulwisa bonke ababengavumelani labo bezama ukuqinisa amandla abo. Ngesibindi esikhulu esasikhula nsuku zonke, uHuss waveza ububi bonke obabusenziwa ebandleni, wabeka icala lomvukela lobubi obabugcwele enkolweni yesiKrestu phezu kwabaphathi beRoma. {GC 103.2}

Ngokwesibili idolobho lasePrague laseliseduze kwempi enkulu. Njengalokhu okwenzakala endulo inceku kaNkulunkulu yabekwa icala njengalowo “owayehlukumeza isizwe sakoIsrayeli.” (1 Amakhosi 18:17). Idolobho lafakwa ngaphansi kwesigwebo esifanayo, uHuss wabuyela endaweni yokuzalwa kwakhe ngaphandle kwedolobho. Ubufakazi ayebunika abantu ngokwethembeka ethempelini laseBethelehema bamiswa. Wayezakhuluma phambi kwabantu abanengi kakhulu engakabeki phansi impilo yakhe njengofakazi weqiniso. {GC 104.1}

Ngemizamo yabo yokuqeda ububi obasebuzungeze izwekazi laseEurope, kwabizwa umhlangano esigodlweni saseConstance. Umhlangano lowu wabizwa ngaphansi kombusi uSigismund, ngomunye wabopapa abathathu uJohn XXIII. Ukubizwa kwalo umhlangano kwakungamukelekanga komunye wabopapa uJohn, owayesazi ukuthi isimo sakhe sasizahlaziywa phambi komuntu wonke kodwa wayengalawo amandla okwala ukuhamba. {GC 104.2}

Injongo yomhlangano lowu kwakuyikuqeda ukulwisana ebandleni lokuqeda labo ababephikisa imfundiso yebandla. Opapa laba ababephikisana babizwa kanye lalowo owayefundisa lokhu okwakuphambene lemfundiso yebandla uJohn Huss. Opapa ababili ngokwesaba ukuthi babengeke baphephe bathumela abameli babo abazibuyelanga bona. UPapa uJohn loba wayeyimbangela yomhlangano lowu, weza kuwo elokusola ukuthi umbusi wayefuna ukuthi akhitshwe esikhundleni sakhe, njalo wayesesaba ukuthi amacala akhe azavezwa phambi komuntu wonke. Loba kwakunjalo wangena edolobheni laseConstance ngokukhulu ukuziphakamisa, ehanqwe ngumthimba omkhulu. Abaphathi abanengi lababusi bedolobho, labantu abanengi baphuma bayamhlangabeza. Phezu kwekhanda lakhe kwakule sivala langa segolide esasibanjwe ngamadoda amane. Udondolo lokubusa kwakhe lwaluthwele ngomunye phambi kwakhe, lezembatho ezidulayo zabaphathi bakhe zenza ukuthi umthimba wakhe wethuse labo ababebukele. {GC 104.3}

Ngesikhathi esifananayo, omunye umhambi wayesezafika edolobheni leConstance. UHuss wayenanzelela ingozi eyayingamehlela kulo umhlangano. Wahlukana labangane bakhe sengathi wayengeke aphinde ababone futhi, waqala uhambo lwakhe ayekholelwa ukuthi lwaluzaphelela esilotheni. Loba nje wayethole isiqiniseko sokuthi uzavikeleka enkosini yaseBohemia, lesinye asithola kuSigismund kodwa endleleni wenza umsebenzi wakhe ekholelwa ukuthi wayengeke aphenduke ephila. {GC 104.4}

Nxa wayebhalela abangane bakhe ababesePrague incwadi wathi: “Bazalwane... ngisuka ngilesiqiniseko sokuphepha engisiphiwe yinkosi lapho engizahlangana khona lezitha zami ezinkulu... Ngibeka konke esandleni sikaNkulunkulu ophakemeyo, lakuMsindisi wami, ngiyakholwa ukuthi uzaphendula imithandazo yenu, lokuthi uzafaka ukuhlakanipha kwakhe emlonyeni wami, ukwenzela ukuthi ngimelane labo, njalo lokuthi uzanginika uMoya wakhe oNgcwele ukuthi angiqinise eqinisweni lakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi ngime ngesibindi nxa ngihlangana lezilingo, njalo nxa kudingeka ngife ukufa okulochuku. UJesu wahluphekela labo abathandayo, njalo kumele simangale yini ukuthi wasitshiyela isibonelo sakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi lathi simelane lakho konke ngokubekezela ukuze sithole usindiso na? UnguNkulunkulu, thina siyizidalwa zakhe; uyiNkosi, njalo thina sizinceku zakhe; uyiNkosi yomhlaba wonke, njalo thina siyizidalwa ezibhubhayo kodwa lobakunjalo wahlupheka! Kungani ke, thina singahlupheki njengaye, ikakhulu nxa ukuhlupheka kuzabangela ukuthi sihlanjululwe? Ngakhoke bathandekayo, nxa ukufa kwami kuzaletha udumo kuye, thandazelani ukuthi kuze masinyane, njalo lokuthi anginike amandla okumelana lokuhlupheka kwami ngingathandabuzi. Kodwa nxa kulungile ukuthi ngiphenduke kini futhi, asithandazeni kuNkulunkulu ukuthi ngize ngingelasici ngitsho ukuthi, nginganyathezeli loba ngelilodwa iqiniso levangeli, ukwenzela ukuthi ngitshiye isibonelo esihle kubazalwane abazalandela. Kungenzeka, ukuthi lingaboni futhi ubuso bami edolobheni lePrague, kodwa nxa kungenzeka kube yintando kaNkulunkulu olamandla ukuthi sibuye sibonane, asiqhubekeni ngenhliziyo elesibindi ekwazini lasekuthandeni umlayo wakhe.” (Bonnechose, vol.1, pp, 147, 148). {GC 105.1}

Kweyinye incwadi ayeyibhalele omunye umpristi oweyephenduke wabangumlandeli kaKrestu, uHuss wakhuluma ngokuzehlisa okukhulu evuma amaphutha akhe, ezibeka icala “lokujabulela ukugqoka impahla ezidulayo njalo lokuthi wayechithe isikhathi ezijabulisa.” Waqhubeka ngamazwi okukhuza athinta inhliziyo: “Sengathi udumo lukaNkulunkulu lokusindiswa kwemphefumulo kungahlala engqondweni yakho, hatshi ukuba lenotho yasemhlabeni. Unanzelele ukuthi awucecisi indlu yakho okwedlula inhliziyo yakho, njalo, phezukwakho konke, beka amandla akho ekukhuleni kwakho kokwakomoya. Yiba lobuqotho lokuzehlisa kwabaswelayo, ungachithi inotho yakho ekuzijabuliseni. Nxa kungenzeka ungaguquli indlela zakho utshiye impilo yokuzithokozisa, ngilokwesaba ukuthi lawe uzajeziswa kabuhlungu, ngendlela engijeziswa ngayo mina...Uyayazi imfundiso yami, ngoba utholile imfundiso yami kusukela ebutsheni bakho, kuzabayize ukuthi ngikubhalele okwedlula lapha. Kodwa ngiyakuxwayisa, ngomusa kaNkulunkulu, ukuthi ungalandeli amanyathelo ami, okuzithokozisa ongibone ngiwela kuwo.” Ngaphandle kwencwadi wangezelela wathi: “Ngiyakuxwayisa mngane wami, ukuthi ungayivuli lincwadi ngaphandle nxa usukwazi ngokweqiniso ukuthi sengifile.” — (Ibid, vol. 1, pp. 148,149). {GC 105.2}

Endleleni yakhe, uHuss wananzelela ukuthi imfundiso yakhe yasifinyelele indawo ezinengi, wabona njalo indlela abantu ababeyamukela ngayo ngentokozo. Abantu babefuqana bezama ukumbona lokumhlangabeza, njalo kwezinye indawo omantshi babehamba phambi kwakhe bemdlulisa emigwaqweni yabo. {GC 106.1}

Ekufikeni kwakhe edolobheni laseConstance uHuss wanikwa ukukhululeka. Phezu kwesiqiniseko sokuphepha ayesinikwe ngumbusi, kwabekwa esinye esasivela kupapa. Kodwa kungakadluli isikhathi eside uMvuseleli wabotshwa bephula izithembiso zabo, ilizwi lokuthi abotshwe lalinikwe ngupapa labathungameli bebandla, wafakwa emgodini omnyama njalo ongcolileyo. Ngemva kwesikhathi wathuthiselwa entolongweni watshiywa lapho njengesibotshwa. Upapa laye ngemva kwesikhatshana waphoselwa entolongweni efanayo. Wayetholakale elamacala awesabekayo emhlanganweni lowu. Wathathelwa isikhundla sakhe, labanye opapa laba ababili ababephikasana laye bakhitshwa esikhundleni kwakhethwa upapa omutsha. {GC 106.2}

Loba nje upapa lowu wayelamacala amakhulu ayesedlula lawo uHuss ayewabeke phezu kwabapristi beRoma, umhlangano ofanayo waqhubeka wabeka phezu kaHuss icala elikhulu. Ukubotshwa kukaHuss kwaletha intukuthelo elizweni lakibo eBohemia. Ababusi abanengi bakhuluma emhlanganweni bephikisa lesigwebo esasinikwe uHuss. Umbusi uSigismund owayengathandi ukwephulwa kwesithembiso sokuphepha esasinikwa umuntu, laye waphikisana lesigwebo ababemnike sona. Kodwa izitha zakhe zazizimisele kulokhu ababefuna ukukwenza. Basebenzisa amacebo okuthi umbusi akhethe ukuthula njalo abambelele ekuthandeni kwakhe ibandla. Basebenzisa amazwi amanengi ayechaza ukuthi “ukukholwa kwakungamelanga kuhlanganyele lalabo ababefundisa imfundiso ephambene leyebandla, kanye labantu ababecatshangelwa ukuthi bafundisa amanga, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bebelesiqiniseko sokuphepha esivela kumongameli welizwe kumbe enkosini.”- (Jacques Lenfant, History of the Council of Constance, vol, 1, p 516). Ngokwenza njalo banqoba. {GC 107.1}

Esephelelwe ngamandla ngenxa yokugula okwaphosa kwathatha umphefumulo wakhe lokuphoselwa kwakhe emgodini owawulephunga elibi, uHuss ekucineni wabizelwa phambi kwabahluleli. Wema phambi kaSigismund ebotshwe ngamaketane onguye owayethembise ukuthi wayezamvikela. Phakathi kokwahlulelwa kwakhe okwathatha isikhathi eside, wema ebambelele eqinisweni, njalo phambi kwabaphathi bebandla waveza bonke ububi obabusenziwa ebandleni. Nxa wayenikwa ithuba lokuthi akhethe ukuphika imfundiso yakhe lokufa wakhetha ukufela iqiniso. {GC 107.2}

Umusa kaNkulunkulu wamqinisa. Phakathi kwamaviki enhlupheko ayedlulile usuku lokugwetshwa kwakhe lungakafiki, ukuthula kwasezulwini kwagcwala enhliziyweni yakhe. “ Ngibhala lincwadi,” watshela umngane wakhe, “ngisentolongweni ngesandla esibotshiweyo, ngimelele ukugwetshelwa ukufa kusasa... Ngokuphathiswa nguJesu Krestu sizahlangana njalo entokozweni yempilo ezayo, uzafunda indlela iNkosi ebonise ngayo umusa empilweni yami, indlela angisingathe ngayo nxa bengidibana lezilingo lokuhlupheka.” — (Bonnechose, vol. 2, p. 67). {GC 107.3}

Phakathi kobunyama bomgodi ayekuwo wabona ngelihlo lenqondo ukunqoba kokholo lweqiniso. Nxa wayebuyela ngamaphupho ethempelini lasePrague lapho ayetshumayele khona, wabona upapa labathungameli bakhe bebandla bekhipha njalo besesula imfanekiso kaKrestu ayeyidwebe emdulini. “Iphupho leli langephula umoya”, kodwa ngosuku olulandelayo wabona abantu abanengi bebuyisela imifanekiso leyi njalo ngembala ekhanya kakhulu. Nxa basebeqedile ukuyibisela abantu laba bathi, ‘Manje ababuye opapa lababhishopi, ngeke besayesula imifanekiso leyi!’” Nxa wayesitsho iphupho lakhe wathi: “Ngimi emcabangweni lowu ngokukholwa, ukuthi umfanekiso kaKrestu ngekewesulwe emhlabeni. Balesifiso sokuwesula, kodwa uzadwetshwa kakutsha enhliziyweni zabantu, ngabatshumayeli abangcono khatshana kulami.” (D’Aubigne, b.1, ch.6). {GC 108.1}

Ngokokucina uHuss wabizelwa phambi kwabathonisisi. Kwakulabantu abanengi, umongameli, lababusi bezizwe zonke, labasekeli babo, labaphathi bebandla leRoma, labantu nje abanengi ababefuna ukubona izehlakalo zosuku. Kusukela endaweni zonke okwakulenkolo yesiKrestu kwakuze abantu ababezobona umnikelo wakuqala wokuzidela owawuzaletha inkululeko kwezokholo emhlabeni wonke. {GC 108.2}

Nxa wayebizwa ukuthi ayenze isinqumo sakhe sokucina, uHuss wakhuluma amazwi akhe ayechaza ukuthi wayengeke atshintshe inqondo, nxa wayebhekisa amehlo akhe kumbusi owayephule isithembiso sakhe, wathi: “Ngazimisela ngokuthanda kwami, ukuzokuma phambi komhlangano lowu, ngaphansi kwesiqiniseko sokuphepha engasiphiwa ngumbusi okhona phakathi kwethu lamhlanje.” (Bonnechose, vol, 2, p. 84). Ubuso bukaSigismund banyukubala nxa amehlo abantu bonke ayesekhangele kuye. {GC 108.3}

Isigwebo sesibekiwe, inkozo yokwehlisa isithunzi sesibotshwa sabo yaqala. Amabhishopi agqokisa isibotshwa sabo ngezembatho zabapristi, nxa wayethatha isembhatho lesi uHuss wathi: “Inkosi yethu uJesu Krestu yagqokiswa layo ngesambatho esimhlophe, ngesizatho sokumthuka, nxa uHerodi wayesemthumela kuPilathu.” (Ibid, vol. 2, p. 86). Nxa babemtshela futhi ukuthi aguqule amazwi akhe waphendula ekhangele ebantwini wathi: “Ngizakhangela ngabuphi ubuso izulu na? Ngibakhangele njani laba abantu engibatshumayeze ivangeli leqiniso na? Hatshi, ngikhetha ukuphakamisa usindiso lwabo okwedlula umzimba lowu, osumiselwe ukufa.” Izembatho lezi zasuswa sinye ngasinye, ababhishopi bemthethisa nxa babesenza inkonzo yabo njengenjwayelo. Ekucineni bafaka umqhele owenziwe ngephepha ekhanda lakhe, owawulemfanekiso yamadimoni phambili ulombhalo othi ‘Umhlamuki Omkhulu’. UHuss waphendula wathi: “Ngentokozo enkulu, ngizawugqoka lumqhele wehlazo, ngegama lakho Nkosi Jesu, wena owagqoka umqhele wameva ngenxa yami.” {GC 108.4}

Nxa wayesegqokisiwe, abapristi bathi: “Manje sinikela umphefumulo wakho kuSathane.’ “UHuss waphakamisa amehlo akhe wabheka ezulwini, wathi “Khepha mina, ngibeka umphefumulo wami ezandleni zakho, Nkosi Jesu, ngoba wena ungihlengile.” — (Wylie, b.3, ch. 7). {GC 109.1}

Ngemva kwalokho wabekwa ezandleni zabaphathi bedolobho bamqhuba bemusa endaweni yokubulawa. Ixuku labantu elikhulu lalilandela, kwakulamakhulu amabutho, labapristi kanye lababhishopi ngezembatho zabo ezidulayo, lezakhamizi zaseConstance. Nxa wayesebotshelwe endaweni yokutshiswa, sekusele ukuthi umlilo ubaswe, wanikwa njalo ithuba lokucina lokuthi aphike wonke amaphutha akhe. “Amaphutha aphi” watsho uHuss, “okumele ngiwaphike? Ngiyazi ukuthi angilacala lelilodwa. Ngicela ukuthi uNkulunkulu abengumfakazi walokho engikubhalileyo lalokho engikutshumayelileyo, ngenjongo yokuhlenga imphefumulo esonweni lasekufeni, ngokunjalo ngizafakaza ngegazi lami ngenkulu intokozo, ukuthi kuliqiniso lokhu engikubhalileyo ngabuya ngakutshumayela.” (Ibid., b. 3, ch.7). Nxa amalangabi ayesekhula indawo yonke, waqala ukuhlabelela, “Jesu, Ndodana kaDavida, ibalesihawu kimi,” waqhubeka ngalawa amazwi ilizwi lakhe laze lacina lingasezwakali. {GC 109.2}

Izitha zakhe lazo zamangaliswa yisibindi ayelaso. Omunye wabapristi nxa wayechaza ukufa kukaHuss, njalo lokukaJerome, owabulawayo laye ngemva kaHuss wathi: “Bonke bobabili babonisa isibindi nxa ihola labo lokucina lalisondela. Balungiselela ukutshiswa ngomlilo sengathi babesiya edilini lomtshado. Abazange bakhale ngobuhlungu. Nxa amalangabi ayephakama, baqala ukuhlabela ingoma, njalo amandla omlilo ehluleka ukuthulisa ukuhlabela kwabo.” — (Ibid, b.3, ch.7). {GC 109.3}

Nxa umzimba kaHuss wasewutshe waphela, umlotha wakhe, lenhlabathi lapho owawukhona, bawubutha bawuphosela emfuleni uRhine, wagelezela elwandle. Ababulali bakhe banakana ngeze ukuthi basebe suse impande zeqiniso ayekade elitshumayela. Kabazange bacabange ukuthi umlotha lowu ababewuphosele emfuleni wawuzakuba yinhlanyelo ephoselwe emazweni wonke omhlaba, lokuthi endaweni ezazingakazakali izithelo ezinengi zazizathela njengabofakazi beqiniso. Ilizwi elalikhulumile phambi komhlangano eConstance lalivuse abantu abanengi ababezamela iqiniso esikhathini esizayo. UHuss wayesedlulile kodwa iqiniso ayelifele lalingeke life. Isibonelo sakhe sokukholwa lokunganyikinyeki sasizaqinisa abanye ukuthi labo bamele iqiniso, phambi kochuku njalo lokufa uqobo lwakho. Ukubulawa kwakhe kwakubonise uchuku lobubi beRoma phambi komhlaba wonke. Izitha zeqiniso loba nje zazingazi, zazihambise ivangeli elifanayo ababezama ngeze ukulitshabalalisa. {GC 110.1}

Khepha kwakukhona omunye owayezabulawa ngokutshiswa edolobheni laseConstance kungekhatshana nje. Igazi lomunye umfakazi kwakumele lifakazele iqiniso. UJerome nxa wayeqeda ukuvalelisa uHuss, ekusukeni kwakhe esiya emhlanganweni wamnika amandla wamthembisa ukuthi nxa kwakungenzeka abesengozini yena ngokwakhe wayezakuza ezomsiza. Nxa wayesizwa ngokubotshwa kukaHuss, uJerome wazimisela ukugcwalisa isithembiso sakhe. Engatholanga isiqiniseko sokuvikelwa wasuka walubhekisa eConstance ehamba lomunye owayemqhuba. Wathi efika wananzelela ukuthi wayesezifake engozini njalo kwakungela ndlela ayengakhulula ngayo uHuss. Wazama ukubaleka ebuyela ekhaya kodwa wabotshwa endleleni wabiselwa emuva ebotshwe ngamaketane njalo ehanqwe lixuku lamabutho. Ekumeni kwakhe kwakuqala phambi komhlangano, imizamo yakhe yonke yokuphendula amacala ayewethesiwe, yayihlangana lamazwi abantu ayesithi, “Kayetshiswa laye! Akayetshiswa!”- (Bonnechose, vol. 1, p. 234). Waphoselwa emgodini, ebotshwe ngamaketane okwabangela ukuthi abesebuhlungwini obukhulu, njalo wayephiwa isinkwa lamanzi kuphela. Ngemva kwezinyanga ebotshiwe, uchuku lwasejele lwaletha umkhuhlane owaphosa wathatha impilo yakhe, izitha zakhe ngokwesaba ukuthi wayezabaphunyuka, bamgcina ngcono, kodwa bamekela entolongweni okomnyaka wonke. {GC 110.2}

Ukufa kukaHuss kwakungalethanga umphumela abathungameli bebandla ababekade bewukhangelele. Indlela okwakwephulwe ngayo isithembiso sokuthi wayezaphepha kwavusa ulaka olukhulu ebantwini abanengi, okwabangela ukuthi bakhethe ukuthi bengatshisi uJerome kodwa bezame imizamo yokuthi aphike konke ayekufundisa okwakuphikisana lemfundiso zebandla. Wabizwa ukuthi azothonisiswa, wanikwa ithuba lokuthi akhethe ukufa kumbe ukuphika konke ayekholelwa kikho. Ukufa ekuqaleni kokubotshwa kwakhe kwakuzabonakala njengo zwelo kuye, nxa kwakuqathaniswa lobuhlungu njalo lochuku ayedlule kulo ejele, kodwa ngalesi isikhathi engasela mandla ngenxa yomkhuhlane, lokuhlupheka kwasejele, lobuhlungu bokungazi okwakuzamehlela kusasa, lokwehlukana kwakhe labangane, njalo lokwephulwa kwenhliziyo yakhe ngenxa yokufa kukaHuss, isibindi sika Jerome saphela, wavuma ukulandela lokhu okwakutshiwo ngamalunga omhlangano lowu. Wazinikela ukuthi wayezalandela imfundiso yebandla laseRoma, wamukela isinqumo somhlangano sokuthi imfundiso kaWyciffe njalo lekaHuss yayingalunganga “ngaphandle kwamaqiniso angcwele” ababewafundisile. - (Ibid, vol. 2, p. 141). {GC 111.1}

Ngesinqumo lesi uJerome wayezama ukuthulisa umzwangedwa wakhe esenzela ukuthi akhululwe njalo anganathi inkezo yobuhlungu. Kodwa ekuthuleni komgodi ayefakwe kiwo wabona sobala ukuthi wayeseyenzeni. Wacabanga isibindi esasiboniswe nguHuss, wasiqathanisa lesinqumo sakhe sokuphika iqiniso. Wacabanga njalo ngeNkosi ayezinikele ukuthi uzayisebenzela, eyakhetha ukufa esiphambanweni ngenxa yakhe. Ngaphambi kokuphika kwakhe iqiniso, wayethole ukududuzwa ekuhluphekeni kwakhe, ngoba wayelesiqiniseko sokuthi uNkulunkulu wayekuthokozelela ukumela kwakhe iqiniso ayekwenzile, kodwa manje ukuzisola lokuthandabuza kwasekuhlukumeza umphefumulo wakhe. Wayekwazi ukuthi kwakusekhona okunye okwakumele akuphike ukuze kubelokuthula phakathi kwakhe labathungameli bebandla. Indlela ayeseyingenile yayizaphelela kuphela ekuphikeni lonke iqiniso. Isinqumo sakhe saba sinye, ukuthi abalekele ukuhlukunyezwa okwesikhatshana wayengasoke akwenze nxa kwakusitsho ukuthi aphike iNkosi yakhe. {GC 111.2}

Masinyane wabizelwa phambi komthethwandaba njalo. Ukuphika kwakhe iqiniso kwakungasuthisanga abathungameli bebandla. Ukomela kwabo igazi, okwakuthanjiswe yikubulawa kukaHuss, kwabenza ukuthi bafune ukuqhubeka bebulala. Kuphela ngokuphika lonke iqiniso uJerome wayezathola inkululeko. Kodwa wayesenqume ukuthi wayezamela iqiniso njalo alandele umfowabo emalangabini. {GC 112.1}

Waphika konke ayekutshilo nxa wayephike iqiniso, njengomuntu owayesesifa, wakhetha ukuthi anikwe ithuba lokuzimela. Ngokwesaba indosela yamazwi akhe, abaphathi bebandla bamtshela ukuthi atsho ukuthi wayevuma kumbe esala isigwebo ababemnike sona. UJerome wala ukuvuma ukuhlukunyezwa okunje. “Lingivalele entolongweni eyesabekayo okwamalanga angamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amane, phakathi kwengcekeza, lephunga, endaweni umuntu angeke afune lutho, manje selingiletha phambi kwenu, ngokufuna ukuvikela izitha zami lifuna ukwala ukuthi ngikhulume...Nxa lingamadoda akhaliphileyo njengokutsho kwenu, njalo liyikukhanya kwezwe, nanzelelani ukuthi alicini lisonela ukulunga. Njengami, ngingumuntu ofayo kuphela, impilo yami ayiqakathekanga, nxa ngisithi kumele lingabeki isigwebo esingafanelanga, angizikhulumeli mina kodwa ngikhulumela lina.” — (Ibid, vol.2, pp146,147). {GC 112.2}

Isicelo sakhe sacina siphiwe ekucineni. Phambi kwabahluleli, uJerome waguqa phansi, wakhulekela ukuthi uMoya oyiNgcwele athungamele imicabango kanye lamazwi wakhe, lokuthi angakhulumi lutho oluphambene leqiniso kumbe olungafani leNkosi yakhe. Kuye kwagcwaliseka isithembiso sikaNkulunkulu kubafundi bakhe bakuqala esithi: “Lizakuholelwa phambi kwababusi lamakhosi ngenxa yami...Nxa belinikela, lingakhathaleli ukuthi lizakhuluma kanjani lokuthi lizakuthini, ngoba lizakunikwa ngalesosikhathi lokho elizakukhuluma. Ngoba kakusini elikhulumayo, kodwa nguMoya KaYihlo okhuluma kini.” (Mathewu 10: 18-20). {GC 112.3}

Amazwi kaJerome aletha ukwethuka lokumangala, njalo lokwamukelwa ebantwini ngitsho lasezitheni zakhe. Umnyaka wonke wayelahlelwe emgodini, lapho ayengenelisi khona ukubala loba ukubona, esebebuhlungwini bomzimba lengqondo. Loba kwakunjalo impendulo yakhe yaphuma ngokucaca okukhulu kwangathi kazange alahlekelwe ngamathuba okubala. Wakhumbuza bonke ababelalele ngamadoda angcwele ayegwetshwe yizitha zabo bengelacala. Kusukela endulo bakhona abantu ababebotshwa ngenxa yokuzama ukukhulula abantu bakibo, ababehlukunyezwa njalo bebulawa, ngemva kwesikhathi kwabasobala ukuthi babengelacala. UKrestu uqobo lwakhe wayefakwe icala ngaphansi kwenkantolo eyayithunganyelwa ngabantu abangalunganga. {GC 112.4}

Ngaphambilini nxa uJerome wayephike inkolo yakhe, wayevumelane labaphathi bebandla ukuthi isigwebo esasibekwe kuHuss sasilungile, kodwa manje wavuma ukuthi wayeyenze iphutha, wakhetha ukuveza ukuthi uHuss wayemsulwa njalo engelacala. “Ngimaze kusukela ebuntwaneni bakhe, ubeyindoda eqotho, elungileyo njalo engcwele, wetheswa icala wagwetshwa kunganakwanga ukuthi wayengelacala ... Lami njalo ngikulindele ukufa, angisoke ngibune phambi kochuku engilulungiselwe yizitha zami labafakazi bamanga, okuzadingeka ukuthi ngolunye usuku bamephambi kaNkulunkulu baphe ubufakazi besenzo sabo, yena ongadukiswayo.” (Bonnechose, vol. 2, p.151). {GC 113.1}

Nxa wayezikhuza ngesenzo sakhe sokuphika iqiniso, uJerome waqhubeka wathi: “Kuzozonke izono engizenzileyo kusukela ebutsheni bami, asikho esingisinda okwedlula lesi engisenze kule indawo, njalo esingizwisa ubuhlungu, njengalapho engavumelana khona lesigwebo esehliselwa amadoda angcwele afana loWycliffe kanye lo John Huss umngane wami. Yebo! Ngiyasivuma ngenhliziyo yami yonke, njalo ngitsho ngamazwi okwesaba ukuthi ngenza into eyangisayo ngokuvuma ukuthi imfundiso yabo yayingeyamanga ngoba ngangisesaba ukufa. Ngakhoke ngiyacela uNkulunkulu olamandla ukuthi angithethelele izono zami, lesi ikakhulu, esibi okwedlula zonke.” Nxa wayekhomba abehluleli, watsho lamazwi ngesibindi esikhulu: “Lagweba uWycliffe loJohn Huss, hatshi ngenxa yokuthi babephambanise imfundiso yebandla, kodwa ngokuba baveza sobala ububi obenziwa ngabathungameli bebandla, lokuziphakamisa kwabo, labo bonke ububi obenziwa ngabapristi labanye abasebenzisana labo. Zonke izinto abazivezayo, ezingeke ziphikiswe ngumuntu, lami ngithanda ukuziveza ngime labo.” {GC 113.2}

Inkulumo yakhe yaqunywa esakhuluma. Abaphathi bebandla basebeqhuqha ngolaka bakhala besithi: “Sidinga ubufakazi obunganani na? Siyazibonela ngawethu amehlo umhlamuki owedlula bonke!” {GC 114.1}

UJerome kazange ayethuswe lulaka lwabo kodwa waphendula wathi: “Licabanga ukuthi ngiyesaba ukufa? Lingivalele ejele okomnyaka wonke, endaweni esabeka okwedlula ukufa uqobo lwakho. Lingiphathe ngochuku okwedlula wonke umuntu, umzimba wami wabola kusukela emathanjeni, kodwa loba kunjalo angikhononi, ngilesimanga sokuthi yiyo indlela eliphatha ngayo umKrestu.” (Ibid, vol.2, pp. 151-153). {GC 114.2}

Isiphepho sentukuthelo saqala futhi, bamthatha uJerome bambisela entolongweni. Loba kunjalo kwakukhona abantu abanengi emthethwandaba ababethintwe ngamazwi akhe ababefisa ukuthi bamkhulule. Wavakatshelwa ngabameli bebandla bamcela ukuthi azehlise phambi kwebandla. Bamthembisa izipho ezinengi ayezazithola nxa wayevuma ukulandela imfundiso yebandla leRoma. Kodwa laye njenge Nkosi yakhe nxa yayithenjiswa inotho yomhlaba, wabambelela eqinisweni. {GC 114.3}

“Ngiboniseni eMbhalweni oNgcwele ukuthi ngenza iphutha, emva kwalokho ngizaphika yonke imfundiso yami,” wabaphendula. {GC 114.4}

Omunye wabalingi waphendula wathi, “UMbhalo oNgcwele! Ngubani ongenelisa ukuwuzwisisa ngaphandle kokuthi ibandla liwuchasise?” {GC 114.5}

“Kambe amasiko abantu alungele na ukuthi afakwe phezu kwenkolo yevangeli loMsindisi?” waphendula uJerome. “UPawuli kazange atshele labo ayebabhalela incwadi ukuthi kwakumele balalele imfundiso yamasiko abantu kodwa wathi kubo, ‘Hlolisisani iMbhalo.’” {GC 114.6}

Impendulo eyaphumayo yayingethi ‘Mhlamuki!’, “Ngiyazisola ukuthi ngikuncengile kangaka, kusobala ukuthi uqhutshwa ngumoya kaSathane.” — (Wylie, b.3, ch.10). {GC 114.7}

Ngemva kwalokhu isigwebo sokufa sabekwa phezu kwakhe. Waseqhutshwa esiya endaweni efananayo lapho uHuss ayenikele khona impilo yakhe. Wahamba indlela yonke ehlabela, ubuso bakhe bukhazimula ngentokozo njalo lokuthula. Ubuso bakhe babubhekiswe kuKrestu, njalo wayengasakwesabi ukufa. Nxa lowu owayezaqala umlilo, wayesebhoda ngamuva kwakhe elungiselela ukuwulumathisa, uJerome wathi kuye: “Woza phambili ngesibindi, qala umlilo phambi kobuso bami. Ngabe bengisesaba bengingeke ngibe lapha.” {GC 114.8}

Amazwi akhe awakhulumayo nxa amalangabi ayekhula kwabangamazwi omthandazo. “Nkosi, Baba Somandla,” wakhala, “iba lesihawu kimi, ungithethelele izono zami, ngoba uyazi ukuthi bengilithanda iqiniso lakho ngazo zonke izikhathi.” — (Bonnechose, vol. 2, p. 168). Ilizwi lakhe lathula kodwa indebe zakhe zaqhubeka emthandazweni. Nxa umlilo wawusuyenzile umsebenzi wawo, umlotha wakhe, kanye lenhlabathi owawukuyo, wabuthwa njengokaHuss waphoselwa emfuleni uRhine. {GC 115.1}

Ngale indlela inceku zikaNkukunkulu ezazithwele isibane seqiniso zabulawa. Kodwa isibane seqiniso ababelitshumayele, kanye lesibane sesibonelo ababesitshiyile, sasingeke sibulawe. Loba nje amadoda ayezamile ukumisa ilanga endleleni yalo elaselilungele ukuletha ukusa emhlabeni wonke. {GC 115.2}

Ukubulawa kukaHuss kwakuvuse ilangabi lolaka elizweni laseBohemia. Kwakuvele sobala ebantwini bonke ukuthi wayewele ochukwini lwabaphathi bebandla engelacala. Waphakanyiswa njengomfundisi weqiniso njalo umhlangano lowu owamnika isigwebo sokufa babeka kuwo icala lokubulawa kwakhe. Imfundiso zakhe zathola inhliziyo lendlebe ezivumayo okwedlula esaphila. Ngenxa yemithetho eyayifakwe ngupapa imibhalo kaWycliffe yayitshisiwe. Kodwa yonke imibhalo eyayiphephile nxa eminye yayitshisiwe, yakhitshwa yanikwa abantu abayifundayo kanye leBhayibhili, abantu abanengi ngale indlela bamukela ukholo lweqiniso. {GC 115.3}

Ababulali bakaHuss abazange bame ngokuthula nxa babebona ukuphumelela komsebenzi wakhe. Upapa loSigismund babambana, bathumela amabutho kaSigismund ukuthi abhidlize ilizwe laseBohemia. {GC 115.4}

Kodwa umhlengi wesizwe saseBohemia waphakama. Igama lakhe kwakungu Ziska, okwathi nxa impi iqala waba yisiphofu, kodwa loba kwakunjalo wayengumthungameli webutho omkhulu, njalo engumkhokheli wabantu baseBohemia. Ngokwethemba kwabo ukuthi uNkulunkulu wayehamba labo, benelisa ukumelana lamabutho wonke ayethunyelwa kibo. Kwathunyelwa amabutho izikhathi ezehlukeneyo kodwa wonke ehluleka ukubanqoba. Abantu ababeyamukele inkolo kaHuss, babekhuliswe ngendlela yokuthi bengakwesabi ukufa, okwabangela ukuthi kungabi khona owayesenelisa ukuma phambi kwabo. Ngemva kweminyaka impi iqalile, omkhulu webutho uZiska watshona, kodwa indawo yakhe yathathwa nguProcopius, owayelesibindi esifananayo njalo eyingcitshi kwezokulwa. {GC 116.1}

Izitha zelizwe laseBohemia, nxa zazisizwa ukuthi uZiska wayesefile, zacabanga ukuthi kwasekulithuba lokuphindisela ukunqotshwa kwabo. Upapa wakhetha ukuthumela ibutho lakhe ukuthi liyethumba ilizwe laseBohemia kodwa ibutho lakhe lehlulwa kakhulu. Kwenziwa njalo imizamo yokuhlasela, kuwo wonke amazwe ayebuswa ngupapa, amadoda aqoqwa kanye lemali, njalo lezikhali. Abantu abanengi babuthana ngaphansi kwebutho likapapa belethemba lokuthi ngokokucina babezaqeda umzila wabahlamuki. Ngenxa yokuba lesibindi sokuthi babezanqoba, ibutho leli elikhulu langena elizweni laseBohemia. Abantu baselizweni leBohemia bazimisela ukumelana lalo. Amabutho lawa womabili aqondana aze ahlukaniswa ngumfula. “Ibutho likapapa lalilikhulu kakhulu, langezikhali, kodwa kulokuthi bachaphe umfula behlasele ibutho labantu ababelandela imfundiso kaHuss bema babakhangela bethule.” (Wylie, b.3, ch.17). Ngokuphazima kweso ibutho likapapa lehlelwa yikwesaba. Bengakahlaseli lakanye, ibutho leli elikhulu laqala ukubaleka kwangathi lalihlaselwe libutho elingabonwayo. Inani elikhulu labulawa ngabalandeli bakaHuss, okwabangela ukuthi impi eyayihlelwe ukuthi itshabalalise ilizwe laseBohemia iliqinise ekucineni. {GC 116.2}

Ngemva kweminyaka ethile ngaphansi kukapapa omutsha, eyinye impi yahlelwa futhi. Njengasekuqaleni, amadoda kanye lemali yaqoqwa, emazweni wonke ayengaphansi kombuso kapapa. Bonke abavumayo ukungena ebuthweni leli bathenjiswa izipho ezinengi kakhulu. Bathenjiswa lokuthi izono zabo zonke zazizathethelelwa. Bonke ababezakufa empini leyi, bathenjiswa ukuthi babezathola umvuzo wabo ezulwini, njalo labo ababezaphepha bathenjiswa inotho lezikhundla eziphakemeyo. Ngokwesibili ibutho elikhulu laqoqwa langena elizweni laseBohemia. Ibutho labalandeli bakaHuss laqala ukubuyela emuva labenza ukuthi bacabange ukuthi babehlehlela emuva ngenxa yokwesaba, bakholwa ukuthi basebenqobile. Ekucineni ibutho likaProcopius lama, laphendukela izitha zabo bababonisa ukuthi kwasekuzaliwa. Ibutho likapapa laselinanzelela iphutha abasebelenzile, bazama ukucatsha emagodini bemelele ukuthi impi iqale. Nxa babesizwa umsindo webutho elalibalanda, loba nje abalandeli bakaHuss babengakafiki, behlelwa yikwesaba. Abakhokheli bebutho, lamabutho wonke alahla izikhali baqala ukubaleka. Omunye wabaphathi bebandla wazama ngeze ukuqinisa ibutho lakhe ukuthi lilwe. Loba nje wayezamile ibutho lakhe kanye laye labulawa empini leyi. Impi yaphela ngokwesibili ibutho likapapa lehlulwa. {GC 116.3}

Ngale indlela ngokwesibili, ibutho elikhulu, elalibunjwe ngamazwe amakhulu kuzwekazi laseEurope, elalilolongwe kakhulu kwezempi, labaleka lingahlaselwanga phambi kwebutho elincane elalizama ukuvikela ilizwe lakibo. Kwabasobala ukuthi amandla ezulu ayebonakalisiwe. Ibutho likapapa lalehlulwe yisandla esingabonwayo. Lowo owehlula amabutho kaFaro elwandle olubomvu, owabalekisa amabutho aseMidian phambi kaGideon lebutho lakhe, yena ngobusuku obubodwa owatshabalalisa ibutho elaliziphakamisa elaseAssyria, wayephinde njalo welula isandla sakhe wanqoba amandla esitha. “Nampo betshaywa luvalo olukhulu, uvalo olungazange lubekhona, ngoba uNkulunkulu uzakuchitha amathambo abo abakuhlaselayo, bazakuchithwa ngoba uNkulunkulu ubalahlile.” (Amahubo 53:5). {GC 117.1}

Upapa labathungameli bakhe, sebenanzelele ukuthi ukusebenzisa udlame kwasekwehlule bazama ukusebenzisa ukukhulumisana. Isivumelwano sabakhona, loba nje sasibonakala sengathi sasiyindlela yokunika abantu baseBohemia amandla wokuzibusa kwezenkolo, basebethengiswe ngaphansi kwamandla aseRoma. Abantu baseBohemia babefake imigca emine okwakumele ilandelwe bengakamukeli ukuthula phakathi kwabo lebandla laseRoma: Owokuqala kwakuyikuthi banikwe imvumo yokutshumayela okulotshwe eBhayibhilini bekhululekile, okwesibili kwakuyikuthi ibandla lonke libelemvumo yokudla isithebe lokuthi benelise ukusebenzisa ulimi lwabo enkonzweni; okwesithathu kwakuyikuthi kungavunyelwa abaphathi bebandla ukuthi babesezikhundleni zombusazwe njalo okwesine abaphathi bebandla babengavunyelwa ukuba sezikhundleni zokwahlulela abantu. Upapa labaphathi bakhe ekucineni “bavuma ukuthi izicelo zabalandeli bakaHuss zazizakwamukelwa, kodwa amandla wokuzichasisa, lokuqedisisa ukuthi zazisitshoni ayezabekwa phezu komhlangano wabo, ngamanye amazwi, okwakusitsho ukuthi kwakusemandleni kapapa lombusi waseEurope.”- (Wylie, b.3, ch. 18). Ngaphansi kwesivumelwano lesi kwabalokubambana, ibandla leRoma lenelisa ukuthola lokhu elalehluleke ukukuthola ngodlame, ngoba ngokuba lamandla wokuchasisa lokhu okwakulotshwe ngabalandeli bakaHuss babelamandla wokudukisa ngendlela ababekhohlise ngayo ngokuguqula imfundiso yeBhayibhili. {GC 118.1}

Ixuku labantu abanengi eBohemia, selinanzelele ukuthi ukuzibusa kwabo kwasekuthengisiwe, bayala ukwamukela isivumelwano lesi. Kwabakhona ukuvukelana elizweni okwabangela ukuthi igazi elinengi lichetheke. Ekulweni lokhu uProcopius laye wabulawa, ukuzibusa kwabantu baseBohemia lakho kwatshabalala. {GC 118.2}

USigismund ofanayo owayethengise uHuss, wabekwa waba yinkosi yaseBohemia, loba nje wayefungile ukuthi wayezavikela amalungelo abantu baseBohemia waqhubeka ngomsebenzi wakhe wokunika upapa amandla elizweni. Okweminyaka engamatshumi amabili, impilo yakhe yayigcwele impi lokuhlupheka. Ibutho lakhe laliphelile, lomnotho welizwe wawuphelile ezimpini ababeziqalile bezama ukutshabalalisa abalandeli bakaHuss, manje ngemva kokubusa okomnyaka owodwa, watshona laye, watshiya umbuso wakhe useduze kokuvukelana, watshiya ibizo lomuntu owayengumthengisi emuva. {GC 118.3}

Ngokwesithathu amabutho angaphandle ahlasela ilizwe laseBohemia, kwabalomvukela laphakathi kwesizwe okwaqhubeka okwesikhathi kwaqeda isizwe seBohemia amandla. Labo abakhetha ukuma bebambelele eqinisweni bahlukunyezwa njalo abanye babulawa. {GC 118.4}

Njengoba amalunga ebandla ayengene phakathi kwesivumelwano lebandla leRoma, imfundiso zamanga zaqala ukungena enkolweni yabo, labo ababezimisele ukulandela iqiniso, bahlangana babumba ibandla balinika ibizo elithi “Abazalwane Ababambeneyo.” Isinqumo sabo senza ukuthi bazondwe yilizwe lonke, kodwa abazange banyikinyeke. Bacina bephoqelwa ukuthi bayehlala ezintabeni, kodwa baqhubeka behlangana ezinkozweni zokufunda iBhayibhili lokukhonza uNkulunkulu. {GC 119.1}

Bathumela izithunywa emazweni atshiyeneyo, bafunda ukuthi endaweni ezitshiyeneyo kwakulabantu ababekholwa inkolo yeqiniso, loba nje babebalutshwana emadolobheni ahlukeneyo, bafunda njalo ukuthi kwakulebandla elidala ezintabeni zaseAlps elalisebenzisa iBhayibhili njengensika yenkolo yalo, njalo elalimelana lemfundiso zamanga ezaziphuma eRoma. (Wylie, b.3, ch.19). Ulwazi lolu lwamukelwa ngentokozo enkulu, baqala ukukhulumisana lamaKrestu wohlanga lwamaWaldensi. {GC 119.2}
