Ngenxa yokwesaba uNkulunkulu babefunde iBhayibhili ukuba bafunde iqiniso, njalo babeyenze konke okwakusemandleni wabo ukuthi bathole ukuhlambuluka enhliziyweni lasempilweni zabo. Laba babelohambo, njalo lokukholwa kuNkulunkulu njalo laselizwini lakhe, okwakungeke kususwe yikudangala kumbe ukuphuza. “Abanye bathatha izibane kodwa bangathathi amafutha.” Laba babesukume ngenxa yokufuna ukulandela abanye. Ukwesaba kwabo kwakuvuswe ngokuzwa ngodaba lolu, kodwa babeyame ekukholweni kwabazalwane babo, belokusuthiseka ngesibane esincane semizwa yabo, bengelakuqedisisa okupheleleyo kumbe ukuguquka kweqiniso enhliziyweni zabo. Laba babephumile labo ukuthi beyehlangabeza umnyeni, begcwele ithemba lokuthola umvuzo owawuzakuza masinyane, kodwa babengalungelanga ukuphuza lokudangala. Nxa inhlupho zasezisiza, ukukholwa kwabo kwehluleka, lezibane zabo zaqala ukufiphala. {GC 393.4}

“Kwathi umnyeni esephuzile, zawozela zonke zalala ubuthongo.” Ngokuphuza komnyeni kuchazwa ukudlula kwesikhathi lapho ababelindele ukuthi iNkosi yayizakuza ngaso, ukudangala kwabo, njalo lokuphuza kwakhe. Ngalesi isikhathi sokungaqedisisi, ukukholwa kwalabo ababengaphendukanga kwaqala ukuphela, njalo lemizamo yabo yaqala ukuhlehlela emuva; kodwa labo ababelokukholwa okuvela ekwazini iBhayibhili ngokwabo, babeledwala ngaphansi kwenyawo zabo, okwakungeke kukhukhulwe ngamagagasi okudangala. “Bonke bawozela balala ubuthongo;” elinye iqembu laselilahle ithemba lalo, kodwa elinye lalinda ngokubekezela limelele ukuthi bambulelwe ukukhanya okutsha. Loba kwakunjalo phakathi kobusuku bokuhlolwa lokudangala lentombi ezihlakaniphileyo zabonakala sengathi lazo zasezilahlekelwa lithemba. Labo ababengaphendukanga ngenhliziyo zabo zonke babengasenelisi ukweyama ekukholweni kwabazalwane babo. Umuntu lomuntu kwakumele ame kumbe aziwele yedwa. {GC 394.1}

Ngalesi isikhathi kwaqala ukubonakala labo abathathela izinto phezulu abaqala ukufundisa lokho okungekho eBhayibhilini. Abanye ababeqale besithi bakholwa udaba lokuza kweNkosi, baqala ukuphika ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, bazenza abantu ababeholwa nguMoya kaNkulunkulu, bazinikela ekuthungameleni kwemizwa, lembono yabo. Kwakulabanye ababonisa ithemba elingalunganga, abaqala ukuphikisa bonke ababengavumelani lendlela abasebeyikhethile. Imbono yabo ayizange iphambanise abazalwane beqiniso kodwa yangcolisa ibizo lamaKrestu ayelindele ukuza kweNkosi. {GC 395.1}

USathane wayefisa ukusebenzisa indlela leyi ukubhidliza umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu. Abantu babevuselelwe kakhulu ngenxa yodaba lokuza kweNkosi, inkulungwane zezoni zaseziphendukile, njalo amadoda athembekileyo ayezinikele ukutshumayela iqiniso, langaphakathi kokudangala kwabo. USathane wayeselahlekelwe ngabalandeli bakhe, njalo ukwenzela ukuthi angcolise umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, wazama ukudukisa abanye ababesithi balindele ukuza kwakhe wabenza ukuthi bathathele izinto phezulu. Ngemva kwalokho izisebenzi zakhe lezi zaqala ukugxila emangeni, lakikho konke okwakubonakala sengathi akugcwalisekanga, bakuletha phambi kwabantu bezama ukubonisa abantu ukuthi labo ababemelele ukuza kweNkosi kwakungabantu abangaphelelelanga engqondweni. Ngale indlela wenelisa ukusebenzisa labo ababecabanga ukuthi bangabanye babazalwane ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi kodwa belenhliziyo ezazithunganyelwa nguSathane, wabenza ukuthi bengcolise igama lalabo ababekholwa ngokweqiniso ngoba abantu ababekhangele ngaphandle bacabanga ukuthi kwakungumoya wabo bonke ababefundisa ngokuza kweNkosi. {GC 395.2}

USathane “uhlala ebeka icala phezu kwabazalwane,” njalo ngumoya wakhe othungamela abantu ukuthi bahlale bedinga amaphutha empilweni zabantwana bakaNkulunkulu, njalo lokubalulaza, ngesikhathi esifanayo izenzo zabo ezinhle bayabe bengakhulumi ngazo. Uhlala esebenza zonke izikhathi lapho uNkulunkulu asebenza khona ukuhlenga imphefumulo yabantu. Nxa amadodana kaNkulunkulu esiza phambi kweNkosi, uSathane laye uyeza phakathi kwabo. Kuyo yonke imvuselelo uhlala elungele ukuletha labo abalenhliziyo ezingaguqukanga njalo labalengqondo ezingazothanga. Nxa laba sebamukele amanye amaqiniso, njalo sebeqala ukubalelwa kwabakholwayo, uyaqala ukusebenza ngabo ukuletha imfundiso ezihlelelwe ukuthi zidukise abangananzeleliyo. Akulamuntu obizwa ngokuthi ungumKrestu ngoba etholakala ephakathi kwamaKrestu, ngitsho lasendlini yokukhonza, kumbe etafuleni yeNkosi. USathane laye uhlala ekhona phakathi kwenkonzo ezicolekileyo esesimeni salabo angabasebenzisa njengezisebenzi zakhe. {GC 395.3}

USathane uhlala elwisa ukuphambanisa abantu bakaNkulunkulu abahamba endleleni yokuya emzini wasezulwini. Kuyo yonke imbali yebandla akulamvuselelo esike yenzakala yangahlangani lemigoqo eminengi. Kwakunjalo lasensukwini zikaPhawuli. Kuzo zonke indawo uPhawuli asungula khona ibandla, kwakulabanye ababesithi bamukele iqiniso, kodwa abaletha imfundiso zamanga, okokuthi ngabe zazamukelwe, zazizasusa uthando lweqiniso. ULuther laye wadlula ebunzimeni obukhulu ngenxa yabantu abathathela izinto phezulu ababesithi uNkulunkulu wayekhulume labo, njalo abaqala ukufaka imbono yabo phezu kobufakazi beBhayibhili. Abanengi ababengela kukholwa okujulileyo, kodwa ababezithemba bona, njalo ababethanda ukuzwa lokukhuluma izinto ezintsha, badukiswa yimfundiso yabantu laba, bahlanganyela lezisebenzi zikaSathane emsebenzini wabo wokuwisela phansi lokho uNkulunkulu ayesebenzise uLuther ukuthi akwakhe. Njalo labantu abafana labo Wesley, labanye ababusisa umhlaba ngenxa yendonsela yabo lokukholwa kwabo, bahlangana lemijibila kaSathane eyayisenza labo ababengajulanga eqinisweni ukuthi baphikise iqiniso. {GC 396.1}

UWilliam Miller kazange anake labo ababethathela izinto phezulu. Wakhuluma njengo Luther ukuthi wonke umoya kwakumele uhlolwe ngelizwi likaNkulunkulu. “USathane, ulamandla amakhulu phezu kwengqondo zabanye ensukwini zalamuhla. Njalo sizakwazi njani ukuthi bafuqwa ngumoya bani na? IBhayibhili liyasiphendula: “Ngezithelo zabo lizabazi.” ...Minengi imimoya ekhona emhlabeni, njalo sixwayisiwe ukuthi sihlolisise yonke imimoya. Umoya ongabangeli ukuthi siphile impilo yokulunga, leyobungcwele, njalo engabonisiyo ukuthi singabalandeli bakaNkulunkulu, emhlabeni lowu, asiwo Moya kaKrestu. Ngilesiqiniseko sokuthi uSathane nguye othungamela amaqembu wonke lawa... Banengi phakathi kwethu abathi baphenduke ngokuphelela, abalandela imfundiso zabantu, njalo abawazi amaqiniso njengalabo abangalandeli iqiniso.” (Bliss, pages 236, 237). “Umoya wokulandela amaphutha uzasenza sisuke eqinisweni, njalo uMoya kaNkulunkulu uzasithungamela eqinisweni. Kodwa liyatsho lani ukuthi umuntu sengabe elandela imfundiso yamanga kodwa ecabanga ukuthi uhamba ngendlela yeqiniso. Kuthiwani ke nxa kunjalo? Siyaphendula sithi, Umoya njalo lelizwi kuyavumelana. Nxa umuntu ezahlulela ngelizwi likaNkulunkulu, njalo ethola ukuvumelana phakathi kwelizwi lonke, kumele akholwe ukuthi uthole iqiniso, kodwa nxa ethola ukuthi umoya omthungamelayo awuvumelani leqiniso lonke elitholakala elizwini likaNkulunkulu, kumele ahambe ngokunanzelela, hlezi abanjwe yimijibila kaSathane.”- (The Advent Herald and Signs of the Times Reporter, vol. 8, No. 23 Jan 15, 1845). “Sengike ngathola ubufakazi bokulunga emehlweni ahlengezela inyembezi, lasesihlathini esimanzi, njalo lasekuqhaqhazeleni kwamazwi, okwedlula emsindweni wonke owenziwa ngamaKrestu amanengi.” (Bliss, page 282). {GC 396.2}

Ngezinsuku zeMvuselelo izitha zomsebenzi lowu zabeka amacala wabantu ababethathela izinto phezulu phezu kwalabo ababesebenza nzima bezama ukuqeda umoya lowu. Amacebo afananayo asetshenziswa yilabo ababephikisa iqula leli elalitshumayela ngokuza kukaKrestu. Njalo ngenxa yokuthi babengasuthiseki ngokuphakamisa amaphutha alabo ababethathela izinto phezulu ababengasomaKrestu weqiniso, baqala ukuhambisa imbiko yamanga bezama ukungcolisa ibizo lamakholwa eqiniso. Abantu laba babefuqwa ngumoya wenzondo lomona. Ukuthula kwabo kwakuphanjaniswa yikumemezelwa kokuthi uKrestu wayesesemnyango. Babelokwesaba ukuthi kwasekungenzeka kube liqiniso, kodwa babefisa ukuthi kungabi liqiniso, njalo kwakuyisizatho esenza ukuthi balwisane lalabo ababekholwa ukuthi ukuza kukaJesu kwasekusondele. {GC 397.1}

Ngenxa yokuthi abazenzisi abambalwa bangena equleni lalabo ababemelele ukuza kweNkosi asiso isizatho esifaneleyo esingenza ukuthi sicabange ukuthi umsebenzi lowu wawungasiwo kaNkulunkulu ngokufanayo lokuthi abantu abafanayo babekhona ebandleni ngensuku zikaPhawuli kumbe ezikaLuther lokhu ngeke sikwenze kube yisizatho sokuphika umsebenzi wabo. Abantu bakaNkulunkulu abavuke, baqale umsebenzi wokuvuma izono njalo lemvuselelo. Kabahlolisise iMbhalo ukuze bafunde iqiniso ngendlela elitholakala ngayo kuJesu; kabazinikele ngokuphelela kuNkulunkulu, njalo bazazibonela ubufakazi bokuthi uSathane lokhe ekhona njalo usebenza nzima. Ngayo yonke imizamo yokudukisa uzabonisa amandla wakhe, esebenzisa zonke ingilosi ezingaphansi kwakhe. {GC 398.1}

Kwakungasikho ukutshumayelwa kodaba lokuza kukaKrestu kwesibili okwabangela ukuthi kube labantu abathathela izinto phezulu njalo lokwahlukana phakathi. Lokhu kwenzeka ngomyaka ka1844 nxa abazalwane babephakathi kokudangala lokudideka mayelana lalokho ababekukholwa. Ukutshunyayelwa kodaba lwengilosi yakuqala lokusondela koMsindisi kwakulamandla wokuqeda yonke imimoya engalunganga. Labo abaphatheka emsebenzini wokutshumayela udaba lolu babebambene, inhliziyo zabo zazigcwele uthando phakathi kwabo lolukaJesu, ababethemba ukuthi babezambona ngemva kwesikhatshana. Ukholo olulodwa, lethemba elilodwa, lwabaphakamisela phezu kwendonsela yabantu njalo kwabayisihawu esabavikela kuyo yonke imitshoko kaSathane. {GC 398.2}

“Kwathi umnyeni esephuzile, zawozela zonke zalala ubuthongo. Kodwa phakathi kobusuku kwamenyezwa kwathiwa: Khangelani, nangu umyeni phumani limhlangabeze. Zasezivuka lezontombi zonke, zalungisa izibane zazo.” (Mathewu 25: 5-7). Ehlobo lomnyaka ka1844, phakathi kwesikhathi lapho ababecabanga ukuthi insuku ezingu2300 zaziphelela khona, lasebusika bomnyaka ofanayo, lapho abacina benanzelela ukuthi insuku lezi zazizaphelela khona, udaba lwamenyezelwa ngamazwi afanayo athi: “Khangelani umnyeni uyeza.” {GC 398.3}

Lokho okwasungula iqula leli lamakholwa eqiniso ekuqaleni kwakuyikuzwisisa ukuthi umthetho owabekwa yinkosi uArtaxerxes owokuthi umuzi waseJerusalema uvuselelwe, okuyikho lapho isikhathi sensuku ezingu2300 esaqala khona, kwenzeka ekwindla ngomnyaka ka457 B.C njalo hatshi ekuqaleni komnyaka, ngendlela ababeqale bakholwa ukuthi kwakwenzeke ngaleso isikhathi. Bathi beqala ukubala kusukela ekwindla yomnyaka ka457, iminyaka engu2300 yayizaphela ekwindla ngomnyaka ka1844. {GC 398.4}

Ubufakazi obutholakala ethestamentini elidala labo babukhomba ukuthi inkonzo yokuhlambulula ithempeli yayizakwenzeka ekwindla ngomnyaka ka1844. Lokhu kwabonakala ngemva kokuhlolisisa zonke inkonzo ezazikhomba ukuza kukaKrestu kwakuqala ezazigcwaliseke ngayo. {GC 399.1}

Ukubulawa kwewundlu lePhasika kwakuyisithunzi sokufa kukaKrestu. UPhawuli uthi: “UKrestu iPhasika lethu wabulawelwa thina.” (1 Corinte 5:7). Ingatsha zezithelo zakuqala ezaziphakanyiselwe phezulu phambi kweNkosi, zazimele ukuvuka kukaKrestu. uPhawuli nxa ekhuluma ngokuvuka kweNkosi lokwabo bonke abantu bakhe uthi: “UKrestu isithelo sakuqala, besekusiba ngabakaKrestu ekubuyeni kwakhe.” (1 Corinte 15:23). Njengokolibo okwakuyizithelo zakuqala ezazivunwa ngaphambi kwesivuno, uKrestu uyisivuno sokuqala esiza phambi kwesivuno esikhulu sabantu abangasoke baphinde bakwazi ukufa abasindisiwe abazabuthelwa ezulwini evukweni lwakuqala nxa esiza. {GC 399.2}

Zonke lezi izinto ezazimele ukuza kukaKrestu zagcwaliseka hatshi ngezehlakalo ezazikhomba ukuza kwazo kodwa ngesikhathi esifaneleyo. Ngosuku lwetshumi lane lwenyanga yakuqala eyamaJuda, ngosuku njalo lengenyanga eqondileyo emnyakeni eyinkulungwane lamakhulu amahlanu lapho imvu yePhasika eyayihlatshwe khona eGibhithe uKrestu wabulawa, ngemva kokudla iPhasika labafundi bakhe “njengeMvu kaNkulunkulu, esusa izono zomhlaba.” Ngobusuku obufanayo wathathwa yizandla zabantu ababi ukuthi ayebethelwa njalo abulawe. Njalo njengesithelo seqiniso iNkosi yavuswa kwabafileyo ngosuku lwesithathu, “isithelo sakuqala kulabo abaleleyo,” njengesibonelo salabo abalungileyo abazakuvuswa, “abazaguqulwa imizimba efayo” njalo banikwe “umzimba wakhe olenkazimulo.” (KwabaseFiliphi 3: 20, 21). {GC 399.3}

Ngendlela efanayo zonke izithunzi ezazimele ukuza kukaKrestu kwesibili kwakumele zigcwaliseke ngesikhathi esifanayo esivezwe enkonzweni zasendulo. Ngaphansi kwenkonzo ezabekwa nguMose inkonzo yokuhlambulula ithempeli, kumbe uSuku lokuBuyisana, lwalusenzeka ngosuku lwetshumi ngenyanga yesikhombisa yomnyaka wamaJuda (Levi 16:29-34), lapho umpristi omkhulu, nxa wayeseqeda ukwenza umnikelo wesizwe sako Israyeli, njalo ngokwenza njalo esesuse izono zabo ethempelini, wayephuma njalo abusise abantu. Ngendlela efananayo babekholwa ukuthi uKrestu, uMpristi wethu oMkhulu, wayezakuza ezohlambulula umhlaba ngokubhubhisa izono kanye lezoni, njalo lokubusisa abantu bakhe ababemlindele ngokubanika impilo enaphakade. Usuku lwetshumi lwenyanga yesikhombisa, uSuku Lokubuyisana, lapho ithempeli elalihlanjululwa khona, ngomnyaka ka1844 lalizaba mhlaka 22 ngenyanga kaMfumfu, usuku ababekholwa ukuthi wayezakuza ngalo. Lokhu kwakuvumelana lobufakazi ababebuvezile obokuthi insuku ezingu2300 zazizaphela ekwindla, lokhu kwabangela ukuthi isiphetho sabo sibe lamandla. {GC 399.4}

Endatshananeni kaMathewu 25 isikhathi sokulinda lesokulala silandelwa yikuza komyeni. Lokhu kwakuhambelana lamazwi ababewatshumayela, ababewathatha emazwini wesiprofethi lasenkonzweni ezaziyisithunzi salokho okwakuzayenzeka. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi bakholwe ngamandla ukuthi kwakuliqiniso njalo amazwi wokuthi umyeni wayesefikile amenyezelwa zinkulungwane zabantu. {GC 400.1}

Njengegagasi elilamandla udaba lolu lwakhukhula endaweni zonke. Kusukela emadolobheni kusiya emaphandleni, njalo lasendaweni ezicatshileyo lwahamba, kwaze kwavuselelwa bonke abantu ababelindile. Umoya wokuthathela izinto phezulu wanyamalala phambi kweqiniso leli njengamazolo phambi kokuphuma kwelanga. Abazalwane bonke babona ukudideka kwabo kususwa, njalo ithemba lesibindi lagcwala enhliziyweni zabo. Umsebenzi wawungaselawo umoya wokuthathela izinto phezulu ohlala ukhona lapho imizwa yabantu ephakama khona nxa uMoya kaNkulunkulu onqandayo ungekho. Kwakulesimo esifana lezikhathi lapho abantwana bakaIsrayeli ababezehlisa khona baphenduke phambi kaNkulunkulu ngemva kokutshunyayezwa ngumprofethi othile endulo. Kwakulesimo esiveza uphawu lomsebenzi kaNkulunkulu kusukela endulo. Kwakungekho ukujabula okungela mkhawulo, kodwa ukuzihlola okujulileyo, lokuvuma izono, njalo lokutshiya umhlaba. Ukulungiselela ukuhlangabeza iNkosi kwakungumlandu wemphefumulo yabo eyayigcwele ukububula. Kwakugcwele imithandazo yokuzidela lokuzinikela phambi kaNkulunkulu. {GC 400.2}

Nxa uMiller wayechaza umsebenzi lowu wathi: “Akukho eyinye indlela yokubonisa intokozo, okubonakala sengathi kunyathezelwe, lapho izulu lonke lomhlaba elizathokoza ndawonye ngentokozo engakhulumekiyo njalo begcwele inkazimulo. Akukho ukuklabalala, lokho lakho kubekelwe ukuthokoza kwasezulwini. Abahlabeleli labo bathule, balindele ukuhlanganyela lengilosi zasezulwini, abahlabeleli basezulwini... Akukho ukuphikisana bonke abantu banhliziyo yinye.” (Bliss, pages 270, 271). {GC 401.1}

Omunye owayephakathi kwequla leli wafakaza wathi: “Kwaletha endaweni zonke ukuzihlola kwenhliziyo njalo lokuzehlisa phambi kaNkulunkulu osezulwini. Kwabangela ukuthi abantu bazehlukanise lezinto zasemhlabeni, lokuphela kwenzondo lokuphikisana, kwaletha ukuvuma iziphambeko, lokudabuka phambi kaNkulunkulu, njalo lokububula kwenhliziyo ezidabukileyo ezazicela ukuthethelewa phambi kwakhe njalo lokwamukelwa. Kwaletha ukuzidela lokudabuka kwenhliziyo okungakaze kubonakale futhi. Njengoba uNkulunkulu wakhuluma ngoJoweli, ukuthi nxa usuku olukhulu lukaNkulunkulu selufikile, lwabangela ukudabuka kwenhliziyo hatshi okwezembatho, njalo lokubuyela kuNkulunkulu ngokuzila ukudla, lokububula, njalo lokukhala. Njengoba uNkulunkulu watsho ngomprofethi uZekariya, umoya womusa lokuncengela wathelwa phezu kwabantwana bakhe, bakhangela kuye yena abamgwazayo, kwaba lokukhala okukhulu endaweni zonke...njalo bonke ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi bazehlisa phambi kwakhe ngokububula.” (Bliss, in Advent Shield and Review, vol. 1, p. 271, January 1845). {GC 401.2}

Kuwo wonke amaqula wemvuselelo kusukela ensukwini zabafundi bakaJesu, akukho abanye asebeke bakhululwa ebubini boluntu lasenkohlisweni kaSathane okwedlula laba abaphila ekwindla yomnyaka ka1844. Lakathesi, ngemva kokudlula kweminyaka eminengi, bonke ababephakathi kwequla leli, njalo abama ngokuzimisela eqinisweni lokhe besizwa indonsela engcwele yomsebenzi lowu njalo lokhe befakaza ukuthi umsebenzi lowu wawungokaNkulunkulu. {GC 401.3}

Nxa ubizo lokuthi,” Umyeni uyeza, phumani limhlangabeze,” lwaselufikile bonke ababelindile “baphuma lezibani zabo;” bafunda ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ngendlela eyayingakaze yenziwe. Ingilosi zathunyelwa zivela ezulwini ukuthi zizovuselela labo abasebeqala ukulahla ithemba ukuthi zibavuse balungiselele ukwamukela udaba lolu. Umsebenzi lowu kawuzange ume phezu kokuhlakanipha komuntu kodwa phezu kwamandla kaNkulunkulu. Kwakungasibo abalezipho ezimangalisayo, kodwa labo ababelokuzehlisa okukhulu njalo ababezimisele ababebengabokuqala ukuzwa njalo lokulalela ubizo. Abalimi batshiya izilimo zabo emasimini zingavunwanga, abomakanika labo batshiya imisebenzi yabo njalo ngenyembezi lokuthokoza baphuma bayanika isimemezelo lesi. Labo ababengabathungameli ekuqaleni babangabokucina ukuhlanganyela ekutshumayeleni lokhu. Amabandla amanengi avala imnyango yawo ukuthi udaba lolu lungatshunyayelwa kiwo, njalo inengi lalabo abamukela udaba lolu bazehlukanisa lawo. Ngokusebenza kukaNkulunkulu ubizo lolu lwahlangana lodaba lwengilosi yesibili lwanika umsebenzi lowu amandla. {GC 402.1}

Udaba lokuthi, “Khangela umyeni uyeza!” kwakungasilo udaba lokuphikisana ngalo, njengoba ubufakazi boMbhalo babusobala. Udaba lolu lwaluhamba lamandla okwabangela ukuthi luthinte inhliziyo zabantu abanengi. Kwakungekho ukuthandabuza, lokubuza imbuzo. Nxa uJesu wayengena eJerusalema okokucina abantu ababebuthene bevela endaweni zonke zomhlaba bezokhonza babuthana entabeni yaseOlivethi, njalo nxa babehlanganyela ndawonye lexuku elalihamba loJesu babambana ndawonye labo baqala ukumemeza: “Ubusisiwe yena ozangegama leNkosi!” (Mathewu 21:9). Benza ngendlela efanayo abantu ababesiza emihlanganweni yequla leli elalilindele ukuza kweNkosi, abanye babengaqedisisi, abanye njalo babefuna ukwenza inhlekisa ngabo, kodwa bezwa amandla ayehamba lodaba lolu lokuthi: “Khangela umyeni uyeza.” {GC 402.2}

Ngalesi isikhathi kwakulokukholwa okwakuletha impendulo emthandazweni yabantu, lokukholwa okwakusazi ukuthi kwakulomvuzo ozayo. Njengamathonsi ezulu emhlabeni owomileyo, uMoya womusa wehlela phezu kwabo bonke ababewudinga ngokuzimisela. Labo ababekhangelele ukuma bekhangelene loMsindisi wabo kungekhatshana bezwa intokozo ecolekileyo ababengeke bayichaze. Amandla woMoya oNgcwele athinta inhliziyo zabo zababuthakathaka nxa izibusiso zakhe zasezithelwe phezu kwabo bonke ababekholwa njalo bethembekile. {GC 402.3}

Ngokunanzelela njalo lokucoleka bonke ababeyamukele udaba lolu bafika esikhathini lapho ababekholwa ukuthi babezabona iNkosi yabo. Nsuku zonke ekuseni bezwa kungumlandu wabo ukudingisisa ubufakazi bokuthi babeyamukelekile phambi kaNkulunkulu. Babenhliziyo yinye njalo babethandaza ndawonye futhi bethandazelana. Esikhathini esinengi babehlangana endaweni ezisitheleyo bezokhulumisana loNkulunkulu, njalo amazwi wokucengela ayesenyuka esiya ezulwini esuka emasimini lasezixukwini. Isiqiniseko sokwamukelwa nguMsindisi sasiqakathekile kibo okwedlula ukudla kwenyama, njalo nxa kwakuleyezi elalisembesa ingqondo zabo, babengaphumuli lize lisuswe. Nxa babesizwa ubufakazi bomusa wokuthethelelwa, babesiba lesifiso sokubona lowo ababemthanda ngenhliziyo zabo zonke. {GC 403.1}

Kodwa lakathesi babemelelwe yikudangala futhi. Isikhathi ababesilindele sadlula, njalo uMsindisi wabo kazange abuye. Ngesibindi esikhulu babekade bekhangelele ukuza kwakhe, manje basebesizwa njengoMaria nxa wayefika engcwabeni loMsindisi emthola engekho phakathi, lapho akhala khona wathi: “Bayithethe iNkosi yami, kangazi lapho bayibeke khona.” (Johane 20:13). {GC 403.2}

Imizwa yokumangala, njalo lokwesaba ukuthi udaba lolu kwakungezeka lube luqinisekile, kwakubangele ukuthi abangakholwayo bazibambe. Kodwa ngemva kokudlula kwesikhathi lokhu akuzange kuhle kunyamalale, ekuqaleni abazange bafise ukuchothoza labo ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi, kodwa nxa kwakungekho ubufakazi bolaka lukaNkulunkulu olwaluzabehlela, ukwesaba kwabo kwasuka baqala ukubaklolodela lokubahleka. Abantu abanengi ababesequleni lalabo ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi, baqala ukulahla ukholo lwabo. Abanye ababeke babangabathungameli njalo ababelethemba elikhulu balimala kakhulu ngoba babelobumina bafisa ukuthi babengatshiya umhlaba. NjengoJona baqala ukukhonona phambi kaNkulunkulu, bafisa ukufa kulokuphila.

Labo ababeyamise ukukholwa kwabo phezu kwembono yabanye hatshi elizwini likaNkulunkulu, manje basebelungele ukutshintsha imbono yabo. Izitha zabo zenelisa ukunqobela abanye engxenyeni yabo ikakhulu labo ababebuthakathaka, njalo bonke laba babambana labo betshela abantu ukuthi kwakungasela sizatho sokuthi besabe njalo belindele ukuza kukaKrestu. Isikhathi sasesidlulile njalo iNkosi yayingabuyanga, futhi kwakungenzeka ukuthi umhlaba uhlale unjalo okwenkulungwane zeminyaka. {GC 403.3}

Abazalwane ababekholwe ngenhliziyo zabo zonke babetshiye konke ngenxa kaKrestu njalo babezwile ubukhona bakhe okwedlula zonke izikhathi empilweni yabo. Njengokukholwa kwabo babenike isixwayiso sokucina emhlabeni, njalo babekhangelele ukuthi babuthwe bayephila leNkosi yabo lengilosi zasezulwini, babezehlukanise lobudlelwano balabo ababeyale ukwamukela udaba lolu. Ngesifiso esikhulu babekhuleke bathi: “Woza Nkosi Jesu, njalo woza masinyane.” Kodwa wayengabuyanga. Njalo manje ukubuyelela imisebenzi yasemhlabani, njalo lokuzwa ukuhlekwa ngumhlaba kwakungumhloliso omkhulu empilweni zabo wokukholwa njalo lokubekezela. {GC 404.1}

Loba kwakunjalo ukudangala kwabo kwakungalingani lalokho abafundi abadlula kikho ngemva kokubethelwa kukaKrestu. Nxa uJesu wayengena eJerusalema njengeNkosi, abalandeli bakhe babekholwa ukuthi wayeseza kwenyukela phezu kwesihlalo sikaDavida njalo akhulule isizwe sakoIsrayeli ezandleni zalabo ababebahlukumeza. Ngethemba eliphakemeyo njalo langentokozo yokumelela lokhu babambana bebonisa ukuhlonipha iNkosi yabo. Abanengi basebenzisa izembatho zabo endleleni yakhe, abanye bafaka ingatsha phambi kwakhe. Phakathi kwenjabulo yabo baqala ukuhlabela besithi: “Hosana eNdodaneni kaDavida!” Nxa abaFarisi basebezondiswe yikuzwa intokozo leyi, bafisa ukuthi uJesu athulise abafundi bakhe kodwa waphendula wathi: “Ngithi kini: Uba bethula laba, amatshe uqobo lwawo azakumemeza.” (Luka 19:40). Amazwi esiprofethi kwakumele agcwaliseke. Abafundi babefeza intando kaNkulunkulu, kodwa babezadlula phakathi kokudangala okukhulu. Ngemva kwamalanga ambalwa babona uMsindisi ebulawa ngochuku, njalo ebekwa ethuneni lakhe. Lokho ababekhangelele ukuthi kwenzeke kwakungayenzekanga, njalo amathemba wabo afa ndawonye loJesu. Abazange bananzelele kwaze kwaba ngemva kokuvuka kwakhe ukuthi konke lokhu kwakuveziwe emazwini esiprofethi njalo lokuthi “uKrestu kwakufanele abulawe, njalo avuke futhi kwabafileyo.” (Imisebenzi 17:3). {GC 404.2}

Emakhulwini amahlanu eminyaka kungakayenzeki lokhu iNkosi yayikhulume ngomprofethi uZekariya yathi: “Thokoza kakhulu, wena Ziyone! Memeza kakhulu, Jerusalema, Khangela iNkosi yakho iyeza kuwe, inqobile yehlula, imnene, ikhwele ubabhemi, ithole, inkonyane kababhemi.” (Zekariya 9:9). Ngabe abafundi babenanzelele ukuthi uKrestu wayezadlula phakathi kokwahlulelwa njalo lokufa, babengeke bagcwalise isiprofethi lesi. {GC 405.1}

Ngokufanayo uMiller labanye bakhe bagcwalisa isiprofethi bahambisa udaba amazwi esiprofethi ayechaze ukuthi kwakumele lunikwe umhlaba, kodwa ababengeke bawahambise ngabe babezwisisile, amazwi esiprofethi ayeveza ukuthi babezadlula phakathi kokudangala, njalo ayeveza olunye udaba okwakufanele lutshunyayelwe emhlabeni wonke ngaphambi kokuza kweNkosi. Udaba lwengilosi yakuqala leyesibili lwanikwa ngesikhathi esifaneleyo njalo zonke zombili zafeza umsebenzi uNkulunkulu ayefuna ukuthi ufezwe. {GC 405.2}

Umhlaba wawukhangelele ukuthi nxa isikhathi ababesilindele sesidlulile inkolo yokuza kukaJesu yayizatshabalala. Kodwa loba abanengi ngaphansi kwezilingo ezinkulu batshiya ukholo lwabo, kwakukhona abanye ababambelela ekholweni lwabo. Izithelo zequla leli elalilindele ukuza kwesibili, lomoya wokuzehlisa njalo lokuhlolisisa inhliziyo, lowo kudela umhlaba njalo lokuguquka kwempilo, okwakuhambe lomsebenzi wabo, kwafakaza ukuthi umsebenzi lowu wawuholwa nguNkulunkulu. Abazange bathande ukuphika ukuthi amandla woMoya oyiNgcwele yiwo ayenike ukutshumayela kwabo amandla, njalo abazange bathole iphutha ekuchazeni kwabo amazwi esiprofethi ayekhuluma ngesikhathi ababekwenzile. Labantu labo ababebaphikisa labo babengazange benelise ukubonisa ukuthi ingcazelo yabo yayingaqondanga. Babengeke bavume kungela bufakazi obuvela eBhayibhilini, ukuthi balahle lokho ababekukholwa ngoba kwakuthethe ukuzimisela lokuthandaza, okwakwenziwe zingqondo zabantu ababekhanyiselwe nguMoya kaNkulunkulu njalo lenhliziyo ezazitshiseka ngenxa yamandla wayo; kwakungamaqiniso ayemelane labantu ababezame yonke imizamo yokuthi babaphikise, ababephuma ezikolo lasemabandleni amakhulu, njalo ayeme aqina phambi kokuhlakanipha kwabantu njalo lokuhlaselwa ngabantu bonke. {GC 405.3}

Kwakuliqiniso ukuthi lokho ababekhangelele ukuthi kwenzeke kwakungenzakalanga, kodwa lakho lokhu akuzange kunyikinye ukukholwa kwabo okwakuselizwini likaNkulunkulu. Nxa uJonah wayetshumayele emigwaqweni yaseNiniva esithi ngemva kwamalanga angamatshumi amane, idolobho lalizabhidlizwa, iNkosi yamukela ukuzehlisa kwabantu baseNiniva, yengeza isikhathi somusa, kodwa loba kwakunjalo udaba lukaJonah lwaluvela kuNkulunkulu, njalo idolobho laseNiniva lahlolwa ngokwentando yakhe. Labo ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi labo babekholwa ngokufanayo ukuthi uNkulunkulu wayebathungamele ukuthi banike isixwayiso sokuza kokwahlulela. “Udaba lolu luhlole inhliziyo zabo bonke abaluzwileyo, njalo lwavuselela ukuthanda ukuza kweNkosi, kumbe lulethe inzondo, eyaziwa nguNkulunkulu mayelana lokuza kwakhe. Ludwebe umzila...ukwenzela ukuthi labo abazahlolisisa inhliziyo zabo, babekwazi ukuthi bebezatholakala bekuluphi uhlangothi, ngabe iNkosi yayibuyile, ukuthi kambe bebezathi: Khangela, leyi yiNkosi yethu, besiyilindile, izasihlenga;” kumbe bebezacela amadwala lezintaba kuthi zibawele zibafihle phambi kwakhe ohleli esihlalweni, njalo laphambi kolaka lweWundlu. Siyakholwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu uhlole abantu bakhe ngale indlela, walinganisa ukukholwa kwabo, wabahlolisisa, njalo wabona ukuthi bebezabuna, ngesikhathi sobunzima, lokuthi bebezadela umhlaba lowu bathembele ngenhliziyo zabo zonke elizwini likaNkulunkulu.” — (The Advent Herald and Signs of the Times Reporter, vol. 8, No. 14, Nov. 13, 1844). {GC 406.1}

Imizwa yalabo ababelokhe bekholwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu wayebathungamele kukho konke ababedlule kikho ivezwe sobala emazwini kaWilliam Miller: “Ngabe bengizaphila impilo yami okwesibili, ngilokhe ngilobufakazi obufananayo engangilabo, eqinisweni phambi kukaNkulunkulu labantu, bengizakwenza ngendlela efana laleyo engayenza ngayo.” “Ngiyathemba ukuthi sengigezile izembatho angilacala lemphefumulo. Ngiyakholwa ukuthi konke okwakusemandleni wami ngikwenzile, ngazikhulula emacaleni wonke abazawetheswa ngosuku lokwahlulela.” “Loba nje sengikengadangala kabili, angikapheli ithemba... Ithemba lami lokuza kukaKrestu liqine okwedlula izikhathi zonke. Ngiyenze kuphela lokho ngemva kweminyaka eminengi yokufunda engezwa ukuthi kwakumele ngikwenze. Nxa kuyikuthi ngenze iphutha, bekungenxa yokuthanda kwami abantu, njalo lokulandela umlandu ebengiwunikwe nguNkulunkulu.” “Into engiyaziyo iyodwa, angitshumayelanga lutho kuphela lokhu engikukholwayo, njalo uNkulunkulu ubelami, amandla wakhe abonakele emsebenzini lowu, njalo kunengi okuhle okuzuzakeleyo.” “Inkulungwane ezinengi zabantu zenzwe ukuthi ziqale ukufunda iBhayibhili ngenxa yokutshunyayelwa kwesikhathi sokuza kukaKrestu, lokhu kubangele ukuthi abantu abanengi babuyisane loKrestu.” (Bliss, pages 256, 255, 277, 280, 281). “Angikaze ngidinge ukumomotheka kwalabo abaziphakamisayo kumbe ngibune phambi kwalabo abahwaqayo emhlabeni. Angisoke ngithenge uthando lwabo manje, kumbe ngenze lutho oluzabangela ukuthi ngilinge inzondo yabo. Angisoke ngifune impilo yami ezandleni zabo, kumbe ngesabe, ngilethemba loba ingangilahlekela, nxa uNkulunkulu ebona kufanele ukuthi kubenjalo.” (J. White, Life of Wm. Miller, page 315). {GC 406.2}

UNkulunkulu kazange alahle abantu bakhe, uMoya wakhe wawulokhe uthungamela labo abangazange bagijimele ukulahla ukukhanya ababekuzuzile, njalo baphike inkolo yabo. Encwadini yamaHebheru kulamazwi aqinisayo, njalo axwayisa labo abalindileyo phakathi kokuhlupheka: “Ngakhoke lingalahlekelwa yisibindi senu esilomvuzo omkhulu. Ngoba lifanele ukubekezela, ukuze kuthi seliyenzile intando kaNkulunkulu lamukeliswe okwathenjiswayo. Kunjengokulotshiweyo ukuthi: Ngoba kuseyisikhatshana nje, ozayo uzakufika, kazikulibala; olungileyo wami uzakuphila ngokukholwa, kodwa uba ehlehlela emuva, umphefumulo wami kawulakuthokoza ngaye. Kodwa thina kasisibo abahlehlela emuva babhujiswe, singabokukholwa, ukuze kusiliswe imiphefumulo yethu.” (Amahebheru 10:35-39). {GC 407.1}

Ubufakazi bokuthi amazwi lawa anikwe ibandla ngezinsuku zokucina buveziwe emazwini akhuluma ngokusondela kosuku lokuza kweNkosi: “Ngoba kuseyisikhatshana nje, ozayo uzakufika kazukulibala.” Njalo kuveziwe ukuthi kuzabonakala sengathi kulokuphuza njalo lokuthi iNkosi izabonakala sengathi isithethe isikhathi ukubuya. Isixwayiso esinikiweyo lapha sasilungele ukunikwa laba ababelindele ukuza kwesibili. Abantu abaveziweyo lapha babesengozini yokulahla ukholo lwabo. Babeyenze intando kaNkulunkulu ngokulandela ukuthungamela kukaMoya oyiNgcwele njalo lelizwi lakhe, kodwa loba kwakunjalo abazange bazwisise injongo yakhe phakathi kwesehlakalo ababedlule kiso, futhi abazange bazwisise indlela eyayiphambi kwabo, okwabangela ukuthi balingeke ukuthi bathandabuze ukuthi ngempela uNkulunkulu nguye owayekade ebathungamela. Ngalesi isikhathi amazwi lawa ayefanele athi: “Abalungileyo bazakuphila ngokukholwa.” Nxa ukukhanya kokumemeza kwabo phakathi kobusuku kwakukhanyise phambi kwendlela yabo, njalo babebonile amazwi esiprofethi evuleka njalo lezibonakaliso zigcwaliseka ezazikhomba ukuthi ukuza kukaKrestu kwasekusondele, babehambe ngokubona ngamehlo. Kodwa manje, sebegobise amakhanda ngenxa yokudangala, babezakuma kuphela ngokukholwa kuNkulunkulu laselizwini lakhe. Abangakholwayo babebahleka besithi: “Lidukisiwe. Lahlani ukholo lwenu, litsho ukuthi umsebenzi lowu wawu ngokaSathane.” Kodwa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lalisithi: “Kodwa nxa ehlehlela emuva umphefumulo wami kawulakuthokoza ngaye.” Ukulahla ukholo lwabo manje, njalo lokuphika amandla woMoya oyiNgcwele ayethungamele udaba lolu, kwakusitsho ukubuyela emuva besiya ekulahlweni. Baqiniswa bema ngenxa yamazwi kaPhawuli: “Ngakhoke lingalahlekelwa yisibindi senu;” “ngoba lifanele ukubekezela,” ngoba kuseyisikhatshana nje, ozayo uzakufika, kazikulibala.” Indlela yabo eyodwa eyayiphephile kwakuyikulandela ukukhanya ababekuthole kuNkulunkulu, lokubambelela ezithembisweni zakhe, njalo lokuthi baqhubeke behlolisisa iMbhalo, njalo balindele ukwamukela okunye ukukhanya. {GC 408.1}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 23 — Liyini iThempeli?

Umugca oseBhayibhilini owawuphezu kwayo yonke njalo owawuyinsika yenkolo yabantu ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi kwesibili yilowu otholakala kuDanyeli 8:14 othi: “Kuzakwedlula insuku eziyinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu amathathu, ngemva kwalokho ithempeli lizakuhlanjululwa.” Amazwi lawa ayesaziwa ngumuntu wonke owayephakathi kwequla labantu ababetshumayela ngokuza kweNkosi kwesibili. Indebe zabantu abadlula inkulungwane zazihlala ziphinda phinda amazwi lawa njengengoma yokholo lwabo. Bonke bananzelela ukuthi amathemba wabo ayeyame phezu kwezehlakalo ezazichazwe emazwini lawa. Isikhathi lesi sasivezwe ukuthi sasizaphela enkwindla ngomnyaka ka1844. Njengamanye amaKrestu ayekhona emhlabeni, iqula leli lalo lalikholwa ukuthi umhlaba kumbe ingxenye yawo wawulithempeli elalichazwe lapha. Babecabanga ukuthi ukuhlanjululwa kwethempeli kwakusitsho ukuhlanjululwa komhlaba ngomlilo, njalo lokuthi lokhu kwakuzakwenzakala nxa uJesu esiza ngokwesibili. Lokhu yikho okwabangela ukuthi bakholwe ukuthi uKrestu wayezakuza ngomnyaka ka1844. {GC 409.1}

Kodwa isikhathi lesi ababesibekile sasesidlulile, njalo iNkosi yayingabuyanga. Abazalwane laba babesazi ukuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lalingeke lehluleke, banakana ukuthi ingcazelo yabo yiyo eyayingaqondanga, kodwa lalingaphi iphutha na? Abanengi bagijimela ukuphika ukuthi isikhathi sensuku ezingu 2300 sasingapheleli emnyakeni ka1844. Kwakungekho isizatho ababengasipha ukusekela amazwi wabo ngaphandle kokuthi uKrestu wayengazanga ngesikhathi ababemkhangelele ngaso. Basebenzisa amazwi wokuthi ngabe isikhathi lesi saphele ngomnyaka ka1844, uKrestu wayezabe ebuyile ukuthi azohlambulula ithempeli ngokuhlambulula umhlaba ngomlilo, njalo lokuthi njengoba wayengazanga, insuku lezi zazingeke zibe ziphelile. {GC 409.2}

Ukuvuma ingcazelo leyi kwakusitsho ukuthi kwakumele baphike yonke indlela ababeyisebenzisile ukuchaza amazwi wesiprofethi. Insuku lezi eziyi2300 kwakutholakele ukuthi zaziqale lapho inkosi uArtaxerxes eyabeka khona umthetho wokuthi kuvuselelwe umuzi waseJerusalema okwenzakala enkwindla ngomnyaka ka457 B.C. Nxa basebethethe umnyaka lowu njengendawo yokuqala ukubala, kwakulokuvumelana lokugcwaliseka kwezinye izehlakalo ezitholakala kuDanyeli 9:25-27. Amaviki angamatshumi ayisithupha lesitshiya galo lunye, okwakuyiminyaka engu483 yakuqala phakathi kweminyaka engu2300, yayizafika kuMesiya, okutsho oGcotshiweyo; njalo umbhabhathizo kaKrestu lokugcotshwa kwakhe nguMoya oyiNgcwele okwenzakala ngomnyaka ka A.D 27, kwagcwaliseka xathu ngendlela okwakubhalwe ngayo nguDanyeli. Phakathi kweviki lesi70, uMesiya wayezabulawa. Ngemva kweminyaka emithathu lelengxenye ngemva kokubhabhathizwa kwakhe uKrestu wabethelwa esiphambanweni, ehlobo ngomnyaka ka A. D 31. Amaviki ayi70 kumbe iminyaka engu490, yayibekelwe isizwe sakoJuda. Ekupheleni kweminyaka leyi isizwe lesi sabonisa ukuphika kwaso uKrestu ngokokucina ngesenzo sokubulala abafundi bakhe, njalo abafundi baqala ukutshumayeza abantu bezizwe kusukela ngomnyaka ka A.D 34. Iminyaka engu490 yokuqala ephakathi kweminyaka leyi engu2300 isidlulile, kwasekusele iminyaka engu1810. Kusukela ngomyaka ka A.D 34, ungafaka iminyaka engu1810 ufika emnyakeni ka1844. Ingilosi yayithe: “Ngemva kwalokho ithempeli lizahlanjululwa.” Zonke izinto ezivezwe phakathi kwesiprofethi lesi zazigcwaliseke ngesikhathi esasibekiwe. {GC 410.1}

Ngenxa yokuzwisisa lokhu, konke kwakusobala njalo kuvumelana, ngaphandle kokuthi babengananzelelanga ukuthi isehlakalo esasimele ukuhlanjululwa kwethempeli sasenzakele ngomnyaka ka1844. Imizamo yonke yokuphika ukuthi amalanga lawa ayephele ngoluwu umnyaka yayizabangela ukuthi baphike bonke ubufakazi obabusobala mayelana lezehlakalo zonke zesiprofethi lesi ezazigcwaliseke ngokuphelela kwazo. {GC 410.2}

Kodwa uNkulunkulu nguye owayethungamele abantu bakhe, inkazimulo lamandla wakhe yiwo ayehambise umsebenzi lowu, njalo wayengeke avumele ukuthi uphelele ebunyameni lasekudangaleni, lokuthi uchothozwe njengomsebenzi wamanga njalo lowokuthathela izinto phezulu. Wayengeke atshiye ilizwi lakhe liphakathi kokuthandabuza lokungaqedisisi. Loba nje abantu abanengi batshiya indlela ababechaza ngayo isiprofethi njalo baphika ukuqiniseka kwendlela ababeyisebenzisile ngaphambilini, abanye abazange bafise ukuphika amaqiniso ayegxile eBhayibhilini ayesekelwe nguMoya kaNkulunkulu. Babekholwa ukuthi babesebenzise indlela eqinisekileyo eyokuchasisa amazwi wesiprofethi, njalo lokuthi kwakungumlandu wabo ukubambelela emaqinisweni abasebewatholile, njalo baqhubeke ngendlela efananayo eyokuhlolisisa iBhayibhili. Ngomkhuleko baqala ukuhlolisisa inkolo yabo njalo bafundisisa iBhayibhili befuna ukuthola iphutha labo. Nxa babengatholi phutha endleleni ababechaze ngayo ukugcwaliseka kwesikhathi, baqala ukuhlolisisa indaba yethempeli. {GC 410.3}

Ekucubunguleni kwabo bafunda ukuthi kwakungekho ubufakazi eBhayibhilini obabusekela imfundiso eyayigcwele emabandleni wonke eyokuthi umhlaba wawulithempeli, kodwa bathola eBhayibhilini ingcazelo epheleleyo mayelana lodaba lwethempeli, isimo salo, lalapho elikhona, njalo lenkonzo ezenzeka kilo, ubufakazi beBhayibhili babusobala njalo bubunengi okwabangela ukuthi kungabi khona ukuthandabuza. Umpostoli uPhawuli encwadini yamaHebheru uthi: “Lesivumelwano sakuqala sasilezimiso zenkonzo lethempeli lasemhlabeni. Ngoba kwakhiwa ithente elokuqala elibizwa ngokuthi yithempeli, okwakukhona kulo uluthi lwesibane letafula lezinkwa lelathi legolide lokutshisela impepha. Ngasemuva kweveli lesibili kwakukhona ithente elibizwa ngokuthi yindawo engcwele ngcwele, eyayilomtshokotsho wesivumelwano obhadwe ngegolide inxa zonke, okwakukhona kuwo inqayi yegolide elemana phakathi, lenduku kaAroni eyahlumayo, lamatshe esivumelwano, phezu kwawo kwakukhona amakherubi enkazimulo engamele isihlalo somusa.” (Amahebheru 9:1-5). {GC 411.1}

Ithempeli uPhawuli akhuluma ngalo lapha kwakulithente elalakhiwe nguMose ngemva kokutshelwa nguNkulunkulu elalizakuba yindawo kaJehova yokuhlala emhlabeni. “Abangenzele ithempeli, ukwenzela ukuthi ngihlale phakathi kwabo” (Exodusi 25:8), kwakungamazwi anikwa uMose nxa wayephezu kwentaba loNkulunkulu. Abantwana bakaIsrayeli babephakathi kohambo lwabo enkangala, njalo ithabanekeli lalakhiwe ngendlela yokuthi babelikhipha balithwale nxa babehamba, loba nje kwakuyisakhiwo esasibaluleke kakhulu. Imiduli yaso yayakhiwe ngamaplanka amileyo ayebhadwe ngegolide, uphahla lona lwalwenziwe ngamakhetheni, eyelemfanekiso yamakherubi emihle. Ngaphandle kwendawo eyayingaphandle eyayile lathi leminikelo, ithabanekeli ngokwalo lalilezindlu ezimbili ezazibizwa ngokuthi yindawo engcwele lendawo engcwele ngcwele, ezazihlukaniswe liveyili kumbe ikhetheni, iveyili efananayo yayivale umnyango wokungena endlini yakuqala. {GC 411.2}

Endaweni engcwele kwakulo luthi lwezibane ngaseningizimu olwalulezibane eziyisikhombisa ezazikhanyisa ebusuku lasemini, ngasenyakatho kwakuletafula lesinkwa, njalo phambi kweveyili elalisehlukanisa indawo engcwele lengcwele ngcwele kwakulelathilegolide lapho okwakutshiswa khona impepha, lapho iyezi lephunga, ndawonye lemithandazo yako Israyeli, eyayiphakama nsuku zonke phambi kaNkulunkulu. {GC 412.1}

Endaweni engcwele ngcwele kwakumi umtshokotsho wesivumelwano, owawulibhokisi elalenziwe ngamaplanka aligugu njalo abhadwe ngegolide, lapho okwakulamatshe amabili lapho uNkulunkulu ayebhale khona imithetho yakhe elitshumi. Phezu komtshokotsho wesivumelwano, njalo okwakuyisivalo sebhokisi leli kwakulesihlalo somusa, esasisihle kakhulu, esasilengilosi ezimbili, ezazibazwe ngegolide. Endlini leyi ubukhona bukaNkulunkulu babubonakala ngeyezi lenkazimulo elaliphakathi laphakathi kwengilosi lezi zamakherubi. {GC 412.2}

Ngemva kokwakha kwabantwana baka iSrayeli elizweni laseKhenani, indawo yethabanekeli yathathwa yithempeli likaSolomoni, loba nje lona kwasekuyisakhiwo esingasuphunekiyo, ukwakhiwa kwaso kwakufanana lethabanekeli lakuqala. Ithempeli lahlala linje izikhathi zonke ngaphandle kwesikhathi lapho eladilizwe khona ngesikhathi sikaDanyeli, kwazekwayafika isikhathi lapho elabhidlizwa khona ngamabutho eRoma ngomnyaka ka A.D 70. {GC 412.3}

Leli yilo lodwa ithempeli elake labakhona emhlabeni elichazwe ngokupheleleyo eBhayibhilini. Leli yilo elachazwa nguPhawuli njengethempeli lesivumelwano sakuqala. Kodwa isivumelwano esitsha asilathempeli na? {GC 412.4}

Bathi bekhangela encwadini kamaHeberu futhi, abantu laba ababedinga iqiniso bathola ukuthi kwakulethempeli lesibili kumbe ithabanekeli lesivumelwano esitsha, elalichazwe emazwini kaPhawuli ababewafundile: “Lesivumelwano sokuqala laso sasilezimiso zenkonzo, njalo lethempeli lasemhlabeni.” (Amahebheru 9:1). Njalo ukusetshenziswa kwebala elithi “laso” kutshengisa ukuthi uPhawuli sekewakhuluma ngalo leli thempeli kwenye indawo. Bathi bebuyela esahlukweni esisemuva babala ukuthi: “Isiqokoqela salokho esikutshoyo yilesi; silaye umpristi omkhulu onjalo osewahlala ngakwesokunene sesihlalo sobukhosi soMkhulu sezulwini, isisebenzi sethempeli, lesethabanekeli eliqotho, elamiswa yiNkosi hatshi ngumuntu.” (Amahebheru 8:1,2). {GC 413.1}

Lapha kuvezwe ithempeli lesivumelwano esitsha. Ithempeli lesivumelwano sakuqala lalimiswe ngabantu, lalakhiwe nguMose, leli lona limiswe yiNkosi, hatshi ngumuntu. Ethempelini leli abapristi basemhlabeni benza imisebenzi yabo, kuloleli uKrestu, uMpristi wethu oMkhulu, uyasebenza ngasesandleni sokudla sikaNkulunkulu. Ithempeli elilodwa lalisemhlabeni, elinye lisezulwini. {GC 413.2}

Okunye njalo yikuthi, ithabanekeli elakhiwa nguMose lalenziwe ngendlela uMose ayeyibonisiwe. INkosi yamtshela yathi: “Ngakho yenzani lindlu lempahla yayo yonke njengesifanekiso engikutshengise sona.” (Eksodusi 25:9). Waphinda waphiwa njalo amanye amazwi: “Nanzelela ukuthi uzenze zibe njengesifanekiso sazo owatshengiswa sona entabeni.” (Eksodusi 25:40). Njalo uPhawuli uthi ithabanekeli lakuqala “lalingumfanekiso waleso sikhathi, lapho okwakunikelwa izipho leminikelo,” lokuthi izindlu zalo ezingcwele “zazingumfanekiso wezinto ezisezulwini;’ lokuthi abapristi ababenikela izipho ngokomthetho babelandela “isibonelo njalo lesithunzi salokho okwenzeka ezulwini,” njalo lokuthi “uKrestu kangenanga endaweni engcwele eyenzwe ngezandla, ezingumfanekiso waleyo eqotho, kodwa ungene ezulwini uqobo lwalo, ukuthi asimele phambi kaNkulunkulu.” (Amahebheru 9:9, 23; 8:5; 9:24). {GC 413.3}

Ithempeli elisezulwini lapho uJesu asebenza khona endaweni yethu, yilo elalikhona kusukela ekuqaleni, njalo leli elakhiwa nguMose lalingumfanekiso walo. UNkulunkulu wafaka uMoya wakhe kulabo ababesakha ithempeli lasemhlabeni. Ubungcitshi obaboniswa ekwakhiweni kwalo kwakuyikuboniswa kokuhlakanipha okuvela ezulwini. Imiduli yalo yayibhadwe ngegolide, njalo yayibonisa ukukhanya kwezibane endaweni zonke. Itafula lesinkwa njalo lelathi lempepha kwakukhazimula njengegolide. Ikhetheni elalisephahleni lalikhazimula, lilemfanekiso yengilosi kusetshenziswe umbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (blue), loyibubende, lobomvu okwenza ukuthi libe lihle kakhulu. Njalo ngale kweveyili lesibili kwakulenkazimulo yeShekinah, ubukhona benkazimulo kaNkulunkulu, lapho okwakusenelisa ukungena umpristi omkhulu kuphela aphume elokhe ephila. {GC 414.1}

Ubuhle bethempeli lasemhlabeni babubonisa abantu bonke inkazimulo yethempeli lasezulwini lapho uKrestu owahamba phambi kwethu asincengela khona phambi kwesihlalo sikaNkulunkulu. Indawo yokuhlala yeNkosi yamaKhosi, lapho inkulungwane zengilosi ezikhonza phambi kwakhe njalo lezinkulungwane zezinkulungwane ezihleli zimi phambi kwakhe (Danyeli 7:10); ithempeli leli, eligcwele inkazimulo yesihlalo sobukhosi, lapho okulama serafimu, abalindi balo abakhazimulayo, abahlala bevale ubuso babo ngenxa yokuhlonipha kwabo, kuyisimanga ukuthi esakhiweni esihle okwedlula zonke esezike zakhiwa emhlabeni kibo kwakungumfanekiso nje wenkazimulo yethempeli elisezulwini. Loba kwakunjalo amaqiniso amqoka mayelana lethempeli lasezulwini njalo lomsebenzi omkhulu owenziwa lapha ophathelane losindiso lwabantu, afundiswa ethempelini lasemhlabeni njalo lenkonzo ezazisenziwa lapha. {GC 414.2}

Indawo ezingcwele ezazisethempelini lasezulwini zimelwe yizindlu ezimbili ezazitholakala ethempelini lasemhlabeni. Njengasembonweni umpostoli uJohane waboniswa ithempeli likaNkulunkulu ezulwini, wabona lapho “izibane eziyisikhombisa ezazibhebha phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi.” (Isambulo 4:5). Wabona ingilosi “ithwele umganu wegolide wokutshisela impepha, yanikwa impepha enengi ukuba iyinikele kanye lemikhuleko yabo bonke abangcwele phezu kwelathi legolide eliphambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi.” (Isambulo 8:3). Lapha umprofethi wanikwa ithuba lokukhangela indlu yokuqala yethempeli elisezulwini, njalo wabona kilo “izibane eziyikhombisa zomlilo” njalo “lelathi legolide” elalimelwe yizibane zegolide njalo lelathi lokutshisa impepha ethempelini lasemhlabeni. Futhi, “ithempeli likaNkulunkulu lavulwa” (Isambulo 11:19), njalo wakhangela phakathi kweveyili, wabona indawo engcwele ngcwele. Lapha wabona “umtshokotsho wesivumelwano,” owawumelwe libhokisi elalakhiwe nguMose elalilemthetho kaNkulunkulu phakathi. {GC 414.3}

Ngale indlela labo ababefunda ngendaba leyi bathola ubufakazi obungaphikisekiyo bokuthi kwakulethempeli ezulwini. UMose wakha ithempeli ngemva komfanekiso ayewubonisiwe. UPhawuli ufundisa ukuthi umfanekiso lowu wawumele ithempeli leqiniso elitholakala ezulwini. Njalo uJohane laye uyafakaza ukuthi wabona ithempeli ezulwini. {GC 415.1}

Phakathi kwethempeli lasezulwini, eliyindawo kaNkulunkulu yokuhlala, isihlalo sakhe sakhiwe phezu kokulunga njalo lokwahlulela. Endaweni engcwele ngcwele kulomthetho wakhe ongcwele, oyiwo umgomo wokulunga osetshenziswa ukuhlola wonke umuntu. Umtshokotsho oyiwo ovalele umthetho lowu uvalwe ngesihlalo somusa, phambi kwalapho uKrestu asincengela ngegazi lakhe. Ngale indlela kuvezwe ukuhlangana komusa njalo lokulunga ecebeni lokuhlengwa kwabantu. Ukuhlangana lokhu kwakungasungulwa kuphela yikuhlakanipha kukaNkulunkulu njalo kwakungafezwa kuphela ngamandla kaNkulunkulu, lokhu kuyikubambana okumangalisa izulu lonke. Amakherubi ayesethempelini lasemhlabeni, ayekhangele ngokuzotha esihlalweni somusa, amele indlela ingilosi zezulu ezikhangele ngayo njalo ezicabanga ngayo ngecebo lokusindiswa komuntu. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yomusa ingilosi ezihlala zifuna ukukhangela kuyo, ukuthi uNkulunkulu engaba elungile ngesikhathi esifanayo ekhangela isoni esivuma izono zaso njengomuntu olungileyo phambi kwezulu njalo avuselele ubudlelwano bakhe lezoni, lokuthi uKrestu wayengazehlisa kangaka ukuthi aphakamise ixuku elingela kubalwa ekufeni okunaphakade, njalo abagqokise ngezembatho ezingela sici ezokulunga kwakhe ukuba bahlanganyele lengilosi ezingazenge zone lokuthi bahlale inaphakade phambi kaNkulukulu. {GC 415.2}

Umsebenzi kaKrestu njengomeli wabantu uvezwe kuhle encwadini kaZekariya “olegama lakhe okuthiwa nguHlumela.” Umprofethi uthi: “Nguye ozakwakha ithempeli leNkosi, abe lobukhosi, uzahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi, abuse. Kuzakuba khona umpristi ngakwesokunene sakhe, bazakuzwana bobabili.” (Zekariya 6:12, 13). {GC 415.3}

“Uzakwakha ithempeli leNkosi.” Ngenxa yomnikelo wakhe njalo lomsebenzi wakhe wokusincengela uKrestu uyinsika njalo lomakhi webandla likaNkulunkulu. Umpostoli uPhawuli umchaza “njengelitshe lengonsi, okuhlanganiselwe kuye isakhiwo sonke, sikhule sibe lithempeli elingcwele eNkosini. Lani futhi lakhelwa ndawonye kuye ukuze libe yindawo yokuhlala uNkulunkulu ahlala kuyo ngoMoya wakhe.” (Efesu 2:20-22). {GC 416.1}

“Uzakuthwala ubukhosi.” Ubukhosi bonke bokuhlenga inzalo eyawayo bungobuka Krestu. Phakathi kwesikhathi esingela mkhawulo, ingoma yabahlengiweyo izakuba yile ethi: “Kuye osithandayo lowasikhulula ezonweni zethu ngegazi lakhe...kakube kuye ubukhosi lamandla kuze kube ninini. Amen.” (Isambulo 1:5,6). {GC 416.2}

“Uzakuhlala njalo abuse esihlalweni sakhe, njalo uzakuba ngumpristi esihlalweni sakhe.” Hatshi manje “esihlalweni sobukhosi bakhe;” umbuso wobukhosi awukabi khona manje. Kuphela nxa umsebenzi wakhe wokuncengela usuphelile uNkulunkulu “uzamnika isihlalo sikayise uDavida,” umbuso ongasoke “ubelomkhawulo.” (Luka 1:32,33). Njengompristi, uKrestu manje uhleli loBaba esihlalweni sakhe. (Isambulo 3:21). Esihlalweni sobukhosi loSimakade, kukhona lowo “owathwala insizi zethu, njalo wathwala inhlupho zethu,” yena “owalingwa njengathi, kodwa ongelasono,” ukwenzela ukuthi “enelise ukuqinisa labo abasezilingweni.” “Nxa kukhona owonayo, silomeli phambi kaBaba.” (Isaya 53:4; Amahebheru 4:15; 2:18; 1 Johane 2:1). Ukuncengela kwakhe yilokho okomzimba owagwazwayo njalo wephulwa, njalo okwempilo emsulwa. Izandla ezalinyazwayo. Umgogodla owagwazwayo, lenyawo ezabethelwayo, ziyancengela inzalo eyawayo, usindiso lwabo olwathengwa ngentengo enkulu kangaka. {GC 416.3}

“Njalo ukubambana ngokuthula kuzakuba phakathi kwabo bobabili.” Uthando lukaBaba, ngokulingana lolweNdodana, lungumthombo wosindiso lwenzalo elahlekileyo. UJesu wathi kubafundi bakhe ngaphambi kokuhamba kwakhe: “Kangitsho kini ukuthi ngizalicelela mina kuBaba, ngoba uBaba uqobo uyalithanda.” (Johane 16:26,27). UNkulunkulu “wayekuKrestu, ebuyisana lomhlaba.” (2 Korinte 5:19). Njalo lasemsebenzini wakhe ethempelini lasezulwini, “ukubambana kokuthula kuzabaphakathi kwabo bobabili.” “UNkulunkulu walithanda ilizwe kangaka, waze wakhetha ukunikela ngeNdodana yakhe eyodwa, ukuthi ilowo lalowo okholwa kuye angabhubhi kodwa abelempilo enaphakade.” (Johane 3:16). {GC 416.4}

Umbuzo wokuthi, “Liyini ithempeli? Uphendulwe sobala eBhayibhilini. Ibizo elithi “ithempeli,” ngendlela elisetshenziswe ngayo eBhayibhilini, lichaza ngokwakuqala ithabanekeli elakhiwa nguMose, njengomfanekiso walelo elisezulwini; njalo ngokwesibili, lichaza “ithabanekeli leqiniso” elisezulwini, elalimelwe yithempeli lasemhlabeni. Ekufeni kukaKrestu inkonzo zonke ezaziyisithunzi sokufa kwakhe zaphela. “Ithabanekeli leqiniso” elisezulwini lilithempeli lesivumelwano esitsha. Njalo njengoba amazwi wesiprofethi atholakala kuDanyeli 8:14 egcwalisekile, ithempeli okumele abe ekhuluma ngalo kumele kube lithempeli lesivumelwano esitsha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka engu2300 ngomnyaka ka1844, kwakungasela thempeli lasemhlabeni okweminyaka eminengi. Ngakhoke isiprofethi esithi: “Kuzadlula iminyaka ezinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu amathathu, ngemva kwalokho ithempeli lizakuhlanjululwa,” kungela kuthandabuza likhuluma ngethempeli elisezulwini. {GC 417.1}

Kodwa umbuzo oqakatheke kakhulu lokhe ungakaphendulwa: “Kutshoni ukuhlanjululwa kwethempeli? Ukuthi kwakulenkonzo enjalo ethempelini lase mhlabeni kuvezwe sobala ethestamentini elidala. Kodwa sekungaba khona izinto ezidinga ukuhlanjululwa ezulwini na? KumaHebheru ngu9 ukuhlanjululwa kwethempeli lasemhlabeni lelasezuluni kuvezwe kwacaca: “Impela phose zonke izinto zihlanjululwa ngegazi ngokomthetho, ngaphandle kokuchitheka kwegazi kakukho ukuthethelelwa kwezono. Ngokunjalo kwakudingeka ukuba imifanekiso yezinto zasezulwini ihlanjululwe ngalokho, kodwa izinto zasezulwini uqobo zidinga ukuhlanjululwa ngeminikelo emihle kulale” (Amahebheru 9:22,23), ngitsho legazi likaKrestu elihle. {GC 417.2}

Ukuhlanjululwa, enkonzweni eyayiyisithunzi lasenkonzweni yeqiniso, kumele kwenziwe ngegazi: enkonzweni yakuqala ngegazi lenyamazana, enkonzweni yeqiniso, ngegazi likaKrestu. UPhawuli uyachaza isizatho sokuthi kungani ukuhlambulula lokhu kumele kwenziwe ngegazi, ngokuthi nxa kungachithekanga igazi ngeke kube lokuthethelelwa kwezono. Ukuthethelelwa loba ukususwa kwezono kungumsebenzi okumele wenzakale. Kodwa kwakuzaba lesono njani esibambene lethempeli, emhlabeni lasezulwini na? Lokhu kungazwisiseka ngokubuyela enkonzweni eyayiyisithunzi endulo, ngoba abapristi ababesebenza emhlabeni, babesenza “lokho okwakuyisithunzi salokho okusezulwini.” (Amahebheru 8:5). {GC 417.3}

Ukusebenza okwakusenziwa ethempelini lasemhlabeni kwakukabili; abapristi babesebenza nsuku zonke endaweni engcwele, kuthi kanye ngomnyaka umpristi omkhulu wayesenza umsebenzi oqakathekileyo wokubuyisana endaweni engcwele ngcwele, lapho ayehlambulula ithempeli. Nsuku zonke isoni esasivuma izono zaso sasiletha umnikelo waso emnyango wethabanekeli, njalo abeke izandla zakhe phezu kwekhanda lomnikelo wakhe, avume izono zakhe, ngale indlela lokhu kwakumele isenzo sokususa izono zakhe zisiya emnikelweni wakhe owawungelacala. Inyamazana leyi ngemva kwalokho yayibulawa. “Nxa kungekho ukuchitheka kwegazi,” umpostoli uthi ngeke kube lokuthethelelwa kwezono. “Ngoba ukuphila komzimba kusegazini.” (Levi 17:11). Umthetho kaNkulunkulu owawephuliwe wawudinga impilo yalowo owayewephulile. Igazi elalimele impilo yesoni eyaseyilahliwe, icala lakhe elaselibekwe emnikelweni wakhe, lalithwalwa ngumpristi engene lalo endaweni engcwele afike alichele phambi kweveyili, ngamuva kwalo okwakulomtshokotsho owawulomthetho owawephulwe yisoni lesi. Ngenxa yenkonzo leyi isono, ngokusetshenziswa kwegazi sasisuswa emuntwini sibekwe ethempelini. Kwezinye izikhathi igazi lalingahanjiswa endaweni engcwele, kodwa inyama yakhona yayidliwa ngabapristi, njengoba uMose wayetshele abantwana bakaAroni wathi: “UNkulunkulu ukubeke phezu kwenu ukuthi lithwale ububi bebandla.” (Levi 10:17). Inkonzo lezi zombili ngokufana zazimele umfanekiso wokususwa kwezono zalabo ababezivuma zisiya ethempelini. {GC 418.1}

Wawunjalo umsebenzi owawusenzakala nsuku zonke, umnyaka uze uyephela. Izono zako Israyeli zazithwalelwa ethempelini, njalo umsebenzi oqakathekileyo wawudingeka ukuthi zisuswe. UNkulunkulu wayebalayile ukuthi kwakumele kube lokuhlanjululwa okwenziwayo kuzo zonke izindlu zombili. “Ngalokho uzakwenzela indawo engcwele indlela yokubuyisana, ngenxa yokungcola kwabantu bakoIsrayeli, langenxa yeziphambeko zabo, lezono zabo zonke. Futhi uzakulenzela ithabanekeli lokuhlangana, elihlala labo phakathi kokungcola kwabo.” Kwakumele njalo kuhlanjwe ilathi “ekungcoleni kwabantu bakoIsrayeli.” (Levi 16:16, 19). {GC 418.2}

Kanye ngomnyaka ngosuku olukhulu Lokubuyisana, umpristi wayengena endaweni engcwele ngcwele ukuba ahlanze ithempeli. Umsebenzi owawusenziwa ngosuku lolu wawugqiba inkonzo zonke zomnyaka. Ngosuku Lokubuyisana amazinyane embuzi amabili ayelethwa emnyango wethabanekeli, kwenziwe inkatho phakathi kwawo, “enye inkatho ibe ngeyeNkosi eyinye ibe ngeka Azazeli.” (Levi 16:8). Imbuzi okwakuwela kiyo inkatho yeNkosi yayibulawa njengomnikelo wezono zabantu bonke. Njalo umpristi wayethatha igazi layo angene endaweni engcwele ngcwele alichele phezu kwesihlalo somusa laphambi kwesihlalo somusa. Igazi leli lalichelwa futhi phezu kwelathi lempepha elaliphambi kweveyili endaweni engcwele. {GC 419.1}

“UAroni abeke izandla zakhe enhlokweni yembuzi ephilayo, avume bonke ububi babantu bakoIsrayeli, leziphambeko zabo, lezono zabo zonke, azibeke enhlokweni yembuzi, ayithumele ngomuntu olungiselwe lokho, iye enkangala. Imbuzi izakuthwala bonke ububi babo, iye endaweni elugwadule.” (Levi 16:21,22). Imbuzi leyi eka Azazeli yayingaphenduki futhi ekamu lako Israyeli, njalo indoda leyi eyayiyithwalela enkangala kwakumele igeze umzimba lempahla zakhe ngamanzi engakaphenduki ekamu. {GC 419.2}

Inkonzo yonke leyi yayihlelelwe ukuthi ibonise abantu bakoIsrayeli ubungcwele bukaNkulunkulu njalo lendlela azonda ngayo isono, njalo lokubabonisa ukuthi babengeke bahlanganyele lesono besuke bengangcoliswanga. Wonke umuntu kwakumele azidele abubule ngaphandle evuma izono nxa umsebenzi wokubuyisana wawuqhubeka ethempelini. Yonke imisebenzi yayisima, njalo ibandla lonke lakoIsrayeli kwakumele lichithe usuku lonke lizehlisa ngokucolekileyo phambi kaNkulunkulu, ngemikhuleko, langokuzila ukudla, njalo lokuhlolisisa inhliziyo zabo ngokujulileyo. {GC 419.3}

Amaqiniso amqoka mayelana lokubuyisana ayefundiswa yinkonzo leyi. Umnikelo wawusamukelwa endaweni yesoni, kodwa isono sakhe sasingasuswa ngegazi lomnikelo wakhe. Indlela yayenziwe eyokuthi isono sakhe sithwalelwe ethempelini. Ngokunikela igazi isoni sasivuma amandla womthetho, njalo wayevuma icala lakhe, njalo wayebonisa isifiso sokuthethelelwa ngokukholwa kuMsindisi owayezakuza, kodwa wayengakakhululwa ngokupheleleyo esigwebeni esilethwa ngumthetho. Ngosuku Lokubuyisana umpristi omkhulu, ngemva kokwenza umnikelo webandla lonke, wayehamba endaweni engcwele ngcwele, ethwele igazi lomnikelo lowu, alichele phezu kwesihlalo somusa, phezu kwalapho okwakulomthetho khona, ukwenzela ukuthi asuthise lokho okutshiwo ngumthetho. Ngemva kwalokho emsebenzini wakhe wokuba ngumeli, wayethatha izono emzimbeni wakhe aphume lazo ethempelini. Wayefika abeke izandla zakhe ekhanda lembuzi kaAzazeli, avume phezu kwayo izono zonke lezi, ngakho ngomfanekiso wayezisusa kuye ezisa embuzini leyi. Imbuzi leyi yiyo eyayizithwalela khatshana, njalo kwakusaziwa ukuthi zasezihlukaniswe labantu kokuphela. {GC 420.1}

Yayisenziwa ngale indlela inkonzo “eyayingumfanekiso wezinto ezenzakala ezulwini.” Njalo lokho okwakusenzakala njengesithunzi ethempelini lasemhlabeni kwenzakala ngokweqiniso emsebenzini owenzakala ethempelini elisezulwini. Ngemva kokwenyuka kwakhe uMsindisi wethu waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengompristi wethu omkhulu. uPhawuli uthi: “UKrestu kangenanga endaweni engcwele eyenziwe ngezandla, okungumfanekiso wezinto eziliqiniso, kodwa ezulwini ngokwalo, ukuba ame phambi kaNkulunkulu emele thina.” (Amahebheru 9:24). {GC 420.2}

Ukusebenza kompristi phakathi komyaka wonke endaweni engcwele ethempelini, “ngamuva kweveyili” elalingumnyango njalo elalisehlukanisa indawo engcwele langaphandle lapho okwakulelathi lomnikelo khona, limele umsebenzi owawusenziwa nguKrestu ngemva kokwenyuka kwakhe esuka emhlabeni. Kwakungumsebenzi wompristi emsebenzini wakhe wansuku zonke ukuletha phambi kaNkulunkulu igazi lomnikelo wesono, njalo lempepha eyayiphakama lemithandazo yabantu bakoIsrayeli. UKrestu laye wancenga ngokunjalo ngegazi lakhe phambi kaBaba encengela izoni, njalo waletha phambi kwakhe, ngephunga elimnandi lokulunga kwakhe, imithandazo yonke yalabo abakholwa ngenhliziyo zabo zonke. Wawunjalo umsebenzi owawusenziwa endaweni engcwele yethempeli lasezulwini. {GC 420.3}

Yikho lapha ukukholwa kwabafundi bakhe okwamlandela khona nxa wayesenyuka phambi kwamehlo wabo. Lapha yikho amathemba wabo ayegxile khona, “Lelothemba silalo njengesikhonkwane esiqinileyo somphefumulo, ligxilile, lingena endaweni engcwele ngemva kweveyili, lapho uJesu angena khona engumanduleli, esiyakuba ngumpristi omkhulu ngokungapheliyo...” “Wangena kwaba kanye kuphela endaweni engcwele engaphathanga igazi lembuzi lelamathole, kodwa ephethe igazi lakhe, ngalokho wazuza ukukhululwa okungapheliyo.” (Amaheberu 6:19,20; 9:12). {GC 421.1}

Okweminyaka engamakhulu alitshumi lesitshiyagalo mbili umsebenzi lowu waqhubeka endaweni engcwele usenziwa nguKrestu ethempelini lasezulwini. Igazi likaKrestu lalincengela izoni ezazivuma izono zazo, njalo lathola intethelelo njalo lokwamukelwa ngubaba, kodwa loba kunjalo izono zabo zazilokhe ziphakathi kwamabhuku wasezulwini. Njengasenkonzweni eyayingumfanekiso lesithunzi saleyo eyeqiniso, kwakulomsebenzi wokubuyisana ekupheleni komnyaka, ngokunjalo umsebenzi kaKrestu wokuhlenga abantu ungakapheleliswa, kulomsebenzi wokubuyisana ukwenzela ukuthi izono zisuswe ethempelini. Leyi yiyo inkonzo eyaqala nxa insuku ezingu2300 zaziphela ngomnyaka ka1844. Ngalesi isikhathi ngendlela okwakuvezwe ngayo nguDanyeli umprofethi, uMpristi wethu oMkhulu, wangena endaweni engcwele ngcwele, ukuba ayenze ingxenye yokucina yomsebenzi wakhe, ukuba ahlambulule ithempeli. {GC 421.2}

Njengasendulo izono zabantu zazibekwa ngokukholwa phezu komnikelo wesono njalo ngegazi lomnikelo zisuswe, ziye ethabanekelini lasemhlabeni, kunjalo ngasesivumelwaneni esitsha, izono zabakholwa ngokweqiniso ngokukholwa ziyabekwa phezu kaKrestu njalo zithwalelwe ethempelini lasezulwini. Njalo njengoba ukuhlanjululwa kwethempeli endulo kwakusenziwa ngokususwa kwezono ezazilingcolisile, ngokunjalo ukuhlanjululwa kweqiniso kwethempeli lasezulwini kuzakwenzakala ngokukhitshwa, kumbe ukucitshwa, kwezono zonke ezibhalwe lapho. Kodwa lokhu kungakayenzakali, kumele kube lokucubungulwa kwamabhuku, ukwenzela ukuthi kwazakale ukuthi ngobani ngenxa yokuvuma izono lokukholwa kuKrestu, abafanele ukuthola isipho somnikelo wakhe. Ngokunjalo ukuhlanjululwa kwethempeli kugoqela umsebenzi wokuphenya, lomsebenzi wokwahlulela. Umsebenzi lowu kumele wenzakale ngaphambi kokuza kukaKrestu ezohlenga abantu bakhe, ngoba nxa esiza, umvuzo wakhe ulawo, owokunika wonke umuntu ngemisebenzi yakhe. (Isambulo 22:12). {GC 421.3}

Ngale indlela labo abalandela ukukhanya kwamazwi wesiprofethi babona ukuthi, kulokuthi abuye emhlabeni ekupheleni kwamalanga ayi2300 ngomnyaka ka1844, uKrestu wangena endaweni engcwele ngcwele ethempelini lasezulwini, ukuba ayenze umsebenzi wokucina wokubuyisana elungiselela ukuza kwakhe. {GC 422.1}

Kwabonakala njalo ukuthi loba nje umnikelo wesono wawukhomba kuKrestu njengomnikelo, njalo umpristi omkhulu wayemele uKrestu njengomeli, imbuzi yokulahlwa yayimele uSathane, umsunguli wesono, lapho izono zalabo abavumayo ngokukholwa ezizabekwa khona ekucineni. Nxa umpristi omkhulu, ngokusebenzisa igazi lomnikelo wayesusa izono ethabanekelini, wayefika azibeke embuzini yokulahlwa. Nxa uKrestu ngenxa yamandla wegazi lakhe, esesuse izono zabantu bakhe ethempelini lasezulwini emaphethelweni womsebenzi wakhe, uzazibeka zonke phezu kaSathane, onguye ngemva kokwahlulela, ofanele athole isijeziso sokucina. Imbuzi yokulahlwa yayithunyelwa khatshana enkangala, lapho eyayingasoke iphinde ibuye ekamu lako Israyeli. Ngokunjalo uSathane uzasuswa emehlweni kaNkulunkulu lawabantu bakhe kokuphela, njalo uzasuswa emhlabeni ebhujiswe ndawonye lesono njalo lezoni zonke. {GC 422.2}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 24 — Endaweni Engcwele Ngcwele

Udaba lwethempeli yilo olwaba yikukhanya okwaveza imfihlakalo yokudangala okwehlela abalandeli bakaKrestu ngomnyaka ka1844. Udaba lolu lwavula amanye amaqiniso ababengakaze bahlangane lawo, amaqiniso lawa ayebambene njalo evumelana. Ayebonisa ukuthi isandla sikaNkulunkulu sasithungamele iqula labantu laba ababetshumayele ngokuza kukaKrestu njalo ababonisa umsebenzi okwakumele bawenze manje njengoba kwakuveziwe umsebenzi wabantu bakhe. Njengabafundi bakaKrestu ngemva kobusuku bobuhlungu lokudangala, “abathokoza nxa babebona iNkosi,” kwaba njalo lakulabo ababekhangele ngokukholwa belindele ukuza kwakhe kwesibili. Babekhangelele ukuthi abuye ngobukhosi bakhe ukuba azonika inceku zakhe umzuzo. Ngemva kokufiphala kwamathemba wabo, basebelahlekelwe ngumfanekiso kaJesu, ndawonye loMaria ethuneni bakhala besithi: “Bathethe iNkosi yami, njalo angazi ukuthi bambeke ngaphi.” Khathesi endaweni engcwele ngcwele baqala ukumbona futhi, uMpristi wabo oMkhulu olozwelo, owayezakuza masinyane njengenkosi lomkhululi wabo. Ukukhanya kwasethempelini kwakhanyisa izehlakalo zendulo, lezesikhathi ababephila kuso njalo lalokho okwakungaphambili. Babesazi ukuthi uNkulunkulu wayebathungamele ngesandla sakhe esingehlulekiyo. Loba njengabafundi bakuqala, labo ngokwabo babehlulekile ukuzwisisa udaba ababeluthwele, loba kwakunjalo udaba lolu lwaluqondile njalo luqinisekile. Ngokuluhambisa udaba lolu babephelelise injongo kaNkulunkulu, njalo umsebenzi wabo wawungazange ube yize phambi kweNkosi. Sebevusiwe njalo lethemba labo selivuselelwe, bathokoza ngentokozo engachazekiyo. {GC 423.1}

Amazwi wesiprophethi atholakala kuDanyeli 8:14 athi, “Kuzakwedlula insuku eziyinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu amathathu, ngemva kwalokho ithempeli lizakuhlanjululwa,” lodaba lwengilosi yakuqala oluthi, “Mesabeni uNkulunkulu, limdumise, ngoba isikhathi sokuthonisisa kwakhe sesifikile,” ayekhomba emsebenzini kaKrestu endaweni engcwele ngcwele, ekwahluleleni okwenziwa ngemva kokuphenya, njalo ayengakhulumi ngokuza kukaKrestu ezolanda abantu bakhe njalo lokubhujiswa kwababi. Iphutha labo lalingabanga khona ekuzwisiseni isikhathi, kodwa ekuzwisiseni isehlakalo esasizakwenzakala ekupheleni kwamalanga ayi2300. Ngenxa yephutha leli babedlule phakathi kokudangala okukhulu, kodwa loba kwakunjalo konke lokhu kwakuveziwe emazwini esiprofethi, njalo konke ababelobufakazi beBhayibhili ukuthi kwakuzakwenzakala kwasekwenzakele. Ngesikhathi lapho ababekhala ngoba amathemba wabo ayesehlulekile, isehlakalo sasesenzakele esasichazwe ludaba lwabo, okwakumele sigwaliseke ngaphambi kokuthi iNkosi ibuye izonika inceku zayo umvuzo. {GC 424.1}

UKrestu wayebuyile, hatshi emhlabeni, ngendlela ababekhangelele ngayo, kodwa ngendlela okwakuchazwe ngayo enkonzweni eyayiyisithunzi endulo,wayengene endaweni engcwele ngcwele yethempeli likaNkulunkulu ezulwini. Uvezwe ngumprofethi uDanyeli ngokuthi wayesiza phambi koMdala weziNsuku: “Ngabona emibonweni ebusuku kufika lamayezi aphezulu ofanana lendodana yomuntu, wafika koyisimakade, wasondezwa phambi kwakhe.” (Danyeli 7:13). {GC 424.2}

Ukuza lokhu kuveziwe futhi ngumprofethi uMalakhi: “INkosi eliyidingayo izafika masinyane ethempelini layo, isithunywa sesivumelwano elithokoza ngaso siyeza, bheka uyeza kutsho iNkosi yaMabandla.” (Malaki 3:1). Ukuza kweNkosi ethempelini layo kweza masinyane, kungakhangelelwanga ngabantu bakhe. Babengamkhangelelanga lapho. Babekhangelele ukuthi abuye emhlabeni, “ukuphindisela kwabangamaziyo uNkulunkulu lakwabangalaleli ivangeli leNkosi yethu uJesu.” (2 Thesalonika 1:8). {GC 424.3}

Kodwa abantu babengalungelanga ukuhlangana leNkosi yabo. Kwakulokhe kuselomsebenzi wokulungiselela okwakumele wenzelwe bona. Ukukhanya kwakuzalethwa, okwakuzathungamela ingqondo zabo ethempelini likaNkulunkulu ezulwini, njalo kwakumele ngokukholwa balandele uMpristi wabo oMkhulu emsebenzini wakhe, ngemva kwalokho babezavezelwa umlandu wabo omutsha. Olunye udaba lokuxwayisa njalo lokulaya lwaluzanikwa ibandla. {GC 424.4}

Umprofethi uthi: “Kodwa ngubani ongalumela usuku lokufika kwakhe, longema ekubonakaleni kwakhe na? Ngoba unjengomlilo wompheki wensimbi, lanjengesepa yomgezisi. Uzahlala esihlalweni sakhe ancibilikise ahlambulule isiliva, ahlambulule amadodana kaLevi, awancibilikise njengegolide lanjengesiliva, aze anikele iminikelo efaneleyo eNkosini.” (Malaki 3:2,3). Labo abazabe bephila emhlabeni lapho umsebenzi kaKrestu wokuncengela ozaphela khona ethempelini lasezulwini kuzamele bame phambi kaNkulunkulu ongcwele bengela muntu obancengelayo. Ingubo zabo kumele zibemsulwa, izimo zabo kumele zibezihlanjululiwe ezonweni zonke ngegazi lakhe. Ngokuxhaswa ngumusa kaNkulunkulu langemizabo yabo yokuzimisela kumele babe ngabanqobi empini yokulwisana lesono. Nxa ukwahlulela okugxile emsebenzini wokuphenya kulokhe kuqhubeka ezulwini, nxa izono zabakholwa ngokweqiniso zisesulwa ethempelini, kumele kube lomsebenzi oqakathekileyo wokuhlanjululwa, owokulahla isono phakathi kwabantu bakaNkulunkulu emhlabeni. Umsebenzi lowu uvezwe sobala endabeni ezitholakala kuSambulo 14. {GC 425.1}

Nxa umsebenzi lowu usuphelile, abalandeli bakaKrestu bazabe sebelungele ukuza kwakhe. “Kung’khona iminikelo yakoJuda leyaseJerusalema izakuyithokozisa iNkosi njengasensukwini zasendulo laseminyakeni yakuqala.” (Malaki 3:4). Ngaleso isikhathi ibandla lelo iNkosi ekubuyeni kwayo azalamukela kuye lizaba “libandla elilenkazimulo, elingelacwatshana, lomxhele loba okunye nje.” (Efesu 5:27). Ngemva kwalokho lizabonakala njengowesifazane “omuhle njengenyanga, okhanya njengelanga, oqathanisa inkevane njengempi ephethe izimpawu.” (Ingoma yezingoma 6:10). {GC 425.2}

Ngaphandle kokuza kweNkosi ethempelini layo, uMalaki uyachaza njalo ngokuza kwakhe kwesibili, lapho ayabe esesiza ukuzonika umvuzo wokwahlulela kwakhe, esebenzisa amazwi lawa: “Besengifika kini ukulithonisisa, ngizakuba ngufakazi okhutheleyo mayelana lezangoma, lezifebe, lokufungela amanga, lokuncindezela abaqatshiweyo ngamaholo abo, lokuncindezela abafelwakazi, lezintandane, lalabo abasunduzela eceleni abezizweni, bengangesabi mina.” (Malachi 3:5). UJuda laye uchaza isehlakalo esifananayo nxa esithi, “Khangelani iNkosi iyeza kanye labangcwele bayo abayizigidi, ukuthonisisa bonke, ibalahle bonke abeyisa uNkulunkulu ngenxa yezenzo zonke zokungamhloniphi abazenzayo, langawo wonke amazwi anzima izoni ezeyisa uNkulunkulu eziwakhuluma ngaye. (Juda 14,15). Ukuza lokhu njalo lokuza kweNkosi ethempelini layo, yizehlakalo ezehlukeneyo. {GC 425.3}

Ukuza kukaKrestu njengoMpristi wethu oMkhulu endaweni engcwele ngcwele, ukuzohlambulula ithempeli, okuvezwe kuDanyeli 8:14; lokuza kweNdodana yomuntu phambi koMdala weziNsuku, okuvezwe kuDanyeli 7:13; njalo lokuza kweNkosi ethempelini layo, okuvezwe nguMalaki, ngamazwi achaza isehlakalo esifanayo, njalo isihlakalo lesi sivezwe ngomfanekiso womyeni owachazwa nguKrestu endatshaneni yentombi ezilitshumi, kuMathewu 25. {GC 426.1}

Ngesikhathi sehlobo njalo lesekwindla ngomyaka ka1844 amazwi athi, “Khangelani umyeni uyeza,” atshunyayelwa. Amaqembu amabili ayemelwe zintombi ezihlakaniphileyo njalo leziyiziwula abonakala sobala ngalesi isikhathi, iqembu elilodwa lalimelele ukuza kweNkosi ngentokozo, njalo laliyenze yonke imizamo yokulungiselela ukumhlangabeza, elinye iqembu, ngenxa yokwesaba njalo lokuthathela izinto phezulu, lalisuthiseke ngamazwi weqiniso kuphela, kodwa lalingalawo umusa kaNkulunkulu. Endatshaneni, nxa umyeni wayesebuyile,” labo ababemlungele bangena laye emthimbeni.” Ukuza komyeni okuvezwe lapha, kwenzakala ngaphambi kokufika komtshado. Umtshado umele ukwamukela kukaKrestu umbuso wakhe. UMuzi oNgcwele, iJerusalema eLitsha, eliyilo idolobho elikhulu elimele umbuso wakhe, libizwa “njengomlobokazi, umfazi weWundlu.” Ingilosi yathi kuJohane: “Woza lapha ngikutshengise umlobokazi, umkaWundlu. Sahamba lami ngiseMoyeni, saya entabeni ende, sangitshengisa umuzi ongcwele waseJerusalema usehlela phansi uvela ezulwini kuNkulunkulu. (Isambulo 21:9,10). Kusobala lapha ukuthi umlobokazi umele iDolobho eliNgcwele, njalo intombi lezi eziphuma zisiyahlangabeza umyeni zimele ibandla. Encwadini kaSambulo abantu bakaNkulunkulu bachazwe njengezethekeli edilini lomthimba. (Isambulo 19:9). Nxa beyizethekeli ngeke bachazwe futhi njengomlobokazi. UKrestu njengoba kuvezwe ngumprofethi uDanyeli, uzakwamukela kuMdala weziNsuku ezulwini, “amandla, lobukhosi njalo lombuso;” uzakwamukela iJerusalema eLitsha, eliyisigodlo sombuso wakhe, “elilungiswe njengomlobokazi ocecele umkakhe.” (Danyeli 7:14, Isambulo 21:2). Nxa eseyamukele umbuso, uzakuza ngobukhosi, njengeNkosi yamakhosi, ezohlenga abantu bakhe, “abazahlala phansi loAbrahama, loIsaka njalo loJacobe,” etafuleni lakhe embusweni wakhe ukuba babelengxenye edilini lomthimba weWundlu. (Mathewu 8:11; Luka 22:30). {GC 426.2}

Ukutshunyayelwa kwamazwi athi, “Khangelani, umyeni uyeza,” ehlobo ngomnyaka ka1844 kwabangela ukuthi inkulungwane zabantu zikhangelele ukuza kweNkosi masinyane. Ngesikhathi esasibekiwe uMyeni weza, hatshi emhlabeni, njengoba abantu babekhangelele, kodwa phambi koMdala weziNsuku ezulwini, emthimbeni, ekusungulweni kombuso wakhe. “Labo ababemlungele bangena ndawonye laye emthimbeni, umyango wavalwa.” Babengasoke babekhona ngokwenyama emthimbeni, ngoba umthimba lowu wenzakala ezulwini, bona besemhlabeni. Abalandeli bakaKrestu “kumele balindele iNkosi yabo, lapho izaphenduka isivela emthimbeni.” (Luka 12:36). Kodwa kumele bazwisise umsebenzi wakhe, njalo bamlandele ngokukholwa nxa engena phambi kaNkulunkulu. Kungale indlela ukuthi bavezwe ngokuthi bayangena emthimbeni. {GC 427.1}

Kuleyi indatshana kwakuyilabo ababelamafutha ezibaneni zabo abangena emthimbeni. Labo ababelolwazi lweqiniso elitholakala eMbhalweni, babeloMoya njalo lomusa kaNkulunkulu, njalo labo phakathi kobusuku bosizi lwabo, ababelinde ngokubekezela, behlolisisa iBhayibhili befuna ukukhanya okunye, laba yibo ababona iqiniso elimayelana lethempeli elisezulwini, njalo lokutshintsha umsebenzi uMsindisi akwenzayo, njalo ngokukholwa abamlandela emsebenzini wakhe ethempelini eliphezulu. Njalo bonke ngenxa yobufakazi beBhayibhili abamukela amaqiniso afanayo, abalandela uKrestu ngokukholwa nxa wayengena phambi kaNkulunkulu esiyakwenza umsebenzi wakhe wokucina wokuncengela, njalo emaphethelweni omsenbenzi lowu, lapho azamukela khona umbuso wakhe, bonke labo bafananiswe labantu abangena emthimbeni. {GC 427.2}

Kundatshana engumfanekiso etholakala kuMathewu 22 isibonelo esifananayo somthimba sisetshenzisiwe ngokwakuqala, njalo ukwahlulela okwenziwa ngemva kokuphenya kuvezwe njengokuthi kwenzakala ngaphambi kokufika komthimba. Umthimba ungakayenzakali inkosi iyeza ukuthi izohlola izethekeli, ngenhloso yokufuna ukubona ukuthi bonke bagqoke ingubo yomthimba, okuyingubo ehlambulukileyo emele isimilo esigezwe njalo saba mhlophe egazini leWundlu. (Mathewu 22:11; Isambulo 7:14). Lowo otholakala engekho esimeni esifaneleyo uxotshelwa ngaphandle, kodwa bonke ngemva kokucubungulwa abatholakala begqoke ingubo yomtshado bayamukelwa nguNkulunkulu njalo bayabalelwa kwabafanele ukuba lesabelo embusweni wakhe njalo lendawo yokuhlala esihlalweni sakhe. Umsebenzi lowu wokuphenya izimilo zabantu, owokuhlolisisa ukuthi ngobani abalungele umbuso kaNkulunkulu, yiwo owokwahlulela ngemva kokuphenya, okuyiwo umsebenzi wokucina ethempelini lase zulwini. {GC 428.1}

Nxa umsebenzi wokuphenya usuphelile, nxa indaba zalabo kusukela ekudabukeni komhlaba abakade bezibiza njengabalandeli bakaKrestu sezihlolisisiwe njalo zagoqwa, kulapho kuphela, ithuba lokulungiselela elizavalwa khona, njalo lomnyango womusa ozakuvalwa khona. Ngakhoke emugceni owodwa, “Bonke ababemlungele bangena laye emthimbeni; unyango wavalwa,” sithwalwa size siyefika emaphethelweni womsebenzi kaKrestu, sisiyafika esikhathini lapho umsebenzi omkhulu wokusindiswa kwabantu ozabe usuphelile khona. {GC 428.2}

Enkonzweni yasethempelini lasemhlabeni, esesiyibonile, sesinanzelele ukuthi ingumfanekiso wenkonzo yasezulwini, nxa umpristi omkhulu wayengena endaweni engcwele ngcwele ngosuku lokubuyisana, umsebenzi owawusenziwa endaweni engcwele wawusima. UNkulunkulu wabatshela wathi: “Kakungabi khona umuntu ethabanekeleni lokuhlangana, kusukela ekungeneni kwakhe endaweni engcwele ngcwele ukwenza indlela yokubuyisana aze aphume.” (Levi 16:17). Ngokunjalo nxa uKrestu wayengena endaweni engcwele ngcwele ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe wokucina wokubuyisana, waphela umsebenzi wakhe endlini yakuqala. Kodwa nxa umsebenzi ayewenza endlini yakuqala wawusuphelile, umsebenzi wendlu yesibili wawuqala. Nxa enkonzweni yasendulo umpristi wayesuka endaweni engcwele ngosuku lokubuyisana, wayehamba phambi kaNkulunkulu ukuyaletha igazi lomnikelo wesono emele abantwana bakoIsrayeli ababevume izono zabo ngokweqiniso. UKrestu yena wayeseqede ingxenye eyodwa yomsebenzi wakhe njengalowo osincengelayo, esesiyaqala eyinye ingxenye yomsebenzi wakhe, njalo waqhubeka encenga ngegazi lakhe phambi kaBaba encengela izoni. {GC 428.3}

Udaba lolu aluzange luzwisiswe yilabo ababelindele ukuza kweNkosi ngomnyaka ka1844. Ngemva kokudlula kwesikhathi lapho uMsindisi ayekhangelelwe ukuthi abuye khona, babelokhe bekholwa ukuthi ukuza kwakhe kwakuseduze, babambelela ekuthini babefike ebunzimeni obukhulu, njalo lokuthi umsebenzi kaKrestu njengomeli wabantu phambi kaNkulunkulu wasewumile. Kwabonakala kibo sengathi kwakuyimfundiso yeBhayibhili ukuthi umusa wawuzavalwa kusasele isikhatshana ukuthi uKrestu abuye emayezini wezulu. Lokhu kwabonakala kusobala nxa babesebenzisa amavesi lawa achaza ukuthi abantu bazafuna, baqoqode, njalo bakhale phambi komnyango womusa njalo ungavulwa. Njalo kwakungumbuzo kibo ukuthi kambe isikhathi lesi ababecabanga ukuthi wayezakuza ngaso sasingasiso yini isikhathi esiqala isehlakalo lesi esasizakuza ngaphambi kokuza kwakhe. Ngemva kokunika isimemezelo sokwahlulela okwasekusondele, bacabanga ukuthi umsebenzi wabo emhlabeni wasewuphelile, njalo balahlekelwa ngumlandu wemphefumulo yabantu, ngesikhathi esifananayo ukukloloda lokuhleka kwabangakholwayo kwabonakala kibo njengobufakazi bokuthi uMoya kaNkulunkulu wasewususiwe kulabo ababephike umusa wakhe. Konke lokhu kwabaqinisa ekukholweni ukuthi umusa wasewuvaliwe, kumbe ngendlela ababekubeke ngayo, “umnyango womusa wasewuvaliwe.” {GC 429.1}

Kodwa ukukhanya okucacileyo kwabuya ngemva kokucubungula umbuzo wethempeli. Bananzelela manje ukuthi babeqondile ngokukholwa ukuthi insuku eziyi2300 zaziphele ngomnyaka ka1844 njalo zazikhomba isehlakalo esibalulekileyo. Kodwa lobanje kwakuliqiniso ukuthi umnyango wethemba njalo lomusa abantu ababefumene ngawo uNkulunkulu okweminyaka eyinkulungwane lamakhulu ayisitshiya galo mbili wasewuvaliwe, omunye umnyango wasewuvuliwe, njalo ukuthethelelwa kwezono kwasekuvulelwe abantu ngenxa yokuncenga kukaKrestu endaweni engcwele ngcwele. Eyinye ingxenye yomsebenzi wakhe yaseyivaliwe, ukwenzela ukuthi ivulele indawo eyinye. Kwakulokhe kulomnyango ovuliweyo owokungena ethempelini lasezulwini, lapho uKrestu ayesebenzela izoni khona. {GC 429.2}

Manje benelisa ukuzwisisa amazwi kaKrestu encwadini kaSambulo, ayeqondiswe ebandleni elaliphila esikhathini lesi: “Nanku akutshoyo ongcwele loqotho, olekhiye kaDavida, ovula kungavali muntu, lovala kungavuli muntu, ngiyayazi imisebenzi yakho khangela ngimisa phambi kwakho umnyango ovuliweyo, ongela kuvalwa muntu.” (Sambulo 3:7,8). {GC 430.1}

Yilabo abalandela uKrestu ngokukholwa emsebenzini omkhulu wokubuyisana abathola inzuzo yokubancengela kwakhe, kuthi labo abaphika ukukhanya okuveza umsebenzi lowu abatholi inzuzo leyi okumele bayithole. AmaJuda aphika ukukhanya okwanikwa ekubuyeni kukaKrestu kwakuqala, njalo abayala ukumkholwa njengoMsindisi womhlaba, abazange benelise ukuthola ukuthethelelwa ngaye. Nxa uJesu ngemva kokwenyuka kwakhe wayengena ngegazi lakhe ethempelini lasezulwini esiyanika abalandeli bakhe izibusiso zokusincengela kwakhe, amaJuda asala esebunyameni njalo baqhubeka ngeminikelo yabo eyayingasela msebenzi. Imisebenzi yezithunzi lemfanekiso yaseyidlulile. Umnyango abantu ababewusebenzisile ngokusemthethweni ukufumana uNkulunkulu wawungasavulwanga. AmaJuda ayekwalile ukumdinga ngendlela eyodwa eyaseyivuliwe ababengamthola kuyo, ngomsebenzi owasewusenzakala ethempelini lasezulwini. Ngakhoke abatholanga ukukhulumisana loNkulunkulu. Kibo umnyango wasewuvaliwe. Babengelalwazi lukaKrestu njengomnikelo weqiniso njalo lomeli phambi kaNkulunkulu, ngakhoke babengeke bathole izibusiso zokusincengela kwakhe. {GC 430.2}

Isimo samaJuda ayengalakho ukukholwa siveza isimo salabo abangakholwayo phakathi kwalabo abazibiza ngokuthi bangamaKrestu, abangazihluphi ngokwazi ngomsebenzi woMpristi wethu oMkhulu. Enkonzweni eyayisenzeka endulo, nxa umpristi omkhulu wayengena endaweni engcwele ngcwele, uIsrayeli wonke kwakumele abuthane ngaphandle kwethabanekeli njalo ngokuzehlisa okukhulu phambi kaNkulunkulu, ukwenzela ukuthi bathole intethelelo yezono zabo njalo bangabulawa basuswe ebandleni. Kukangakanani pho ukuqakatheka kwakhona phakathi kosuku lolu lokubuyisana esiphila kilo manje, ukuba sizwisise umsebenzi woMpristi wethu oMkhulu njalo sazi lokho okumele sikwenze. {GC 430.3}

Abantu ngeke beyekele ukuba lecala nxa bephika isixwayiso uNkulunkulu asithumelayo ngenxa yomusa wakhe. Udaba lwathunyelwa luvela ezulwini lusiya emhlabeni ngezinsuku zikaNoah, njalo usindiso lwabo lwalweyame endleleni abamukela ngayo udaba lolu. Ngenxa yokuba baphika isixwayiso lesi, uMoya kaNkulunkulu wasuswa phakathi kwabo, njalo babhujiswa emanzini kazaMcolo. Ngesikhathi sika Abrahama, umusa wama ukuncenga izakhamizi zase Sodoma, njalo bonke kuphela uLothi lomkakhe lamadodakazi wakhe, babhujiswa ngomlilo owathunyelwa uvela ezulwini. Kwakunjalo ngezinsuku zikaKrestu. Indodana kaNkulunkulu yakhuluma amazwi alandelayo phambi kwamaJuda ayengakholwa ngensuku zakhe: “Khangelani indlu yenu isele ilunxiwa.” (Mathewu 23:38). Nxa wayekhangela ezinsukwini zokucina, amandla afananayo anguNaphakade, aveza ngale indlela labo “abangamukelanga iqiniso, ukuthi basindiswe”: “Ngakhoke uNkulunkulu ubathumele okudukisayo, ukuze bakholwe amanga, ukuba bonke abangakholwanga iqiniso kodwa bethokiziswa yikungalungi balahlwe.” (2 Thesalonika 2:10-12). Nxa bephika imfundiso zelizwi lakhe, uNkulunkulu uyasusa uMoya wakhe njalo uyabatshiya phakathi kwezinto ezibadukisayo abazithandayo. {GC 431.1}

Kodwa uKrestu lokhe esancengela abantu bonke, njalo ukukhanya kuzanikwa labo abakudingayo. Loba nje lokhu kwakungazwisiswanga yilabo ababelindele ukuza kwakhe ekuqaliseni, kwenziwa kwabasobala ngemva kwesikhatshana nxa iMbhalo eyiyo eyayichaza lokho ababekukholwa yayilokhe ivuleka phambi kwabo. {GC 431.2}

Ukudlula kwesikhathi ngomnyaka ka1844 kwalandelwa yisikhathi sokuhlukumezeka okukhulu kulabo ababelokhe bebambelele enkolweni yokuza kweNkosi.
