Induduzo yabo ababelayo eyodwa eyayiqinisa ukholo lwabo, yayeyame ekukhanyeni okwakuthungamela ingqondo zabo ethempelini eliphezulu. Abanye baphika ukholo lwabo olwalweyame ekuzwisiseni ababekusebenzisile ukuchaza amazwi wesiprofethi njalo bakhetha ukuba bakholwe ukuthi amandla kaMoya oyiNgcwele ayethungamele umsebenzi wokulimukisa abantu ayevele kuSathane lasezithunyweni zakhe. Elinye iqembu labambelela eqinisweni lokuthi iNkosi yayibathungamele endleleni yabo, nxa babelindile njalo bekhulekela ukuthi bazi intando kaNkulunkulu, babona ukuthi uMpristi wabo oMkhulu wayengene emsebenzini omunye wokubamela, njalo bathi bemlandela ngokukholwa, bathunganyelwa ukuthi babone futhi umsebenzi wokucina onikwe ibandla. Baqala ukuzwisisa sobala udaba lwengilosi yokuqala leyesibili, njalo basebezilungiselele ukwamukela njalo lokunika umhlaba isimemezelo ezicolekileyo sengilosi yesithathu esitholakala kuSambulo 14. {GC 431.3}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 25 — Umthetho kaNkulunkulu Awuguquki

“Kwasekuvulwa ithempeli likaNkulunkulu elisezulwini, kwabonakala umtshokotsho wesivumelwano sakhe ethempelini.” (Isambulo 11:19). Umtshokotsho wesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu usendaweni engcwele ngcwele, endlini yesibili ethempelini. Emsebenzini owawusenziwa ethabanekelini lasemhlabeni, lona elaliyisibonelo njalo lesithunzi salokho okwenzeka ezulwini, indlu leyi eyesibili yayivulwa kuphela ngoSuku lokuBuyisana nxa kwakuhlanjululwa ithempeli. Ngakhoke ukumemezela ukuthi ithempeli likaNkulunkulu lavulwa ezulwini njalo umtshokotsho wesivumelwano wabonakala kukhomba ukuvulwa kwendawo engcwele ngcwele yasethempelini lasezulwini ngomnyaka ka1844 nxa uKrestu wayengena khona ukuba ayenze umsebenzi wakhe wokucina wokubuyisana. Labo ngokukholwa abalandela uMpristi wabo oMkhulu nxa wayengena emsebenzini wakhe endaweni engcwele ngcwele, babona umtshokotsho wesivumelwano sakhe. Njengoba babefundile ngendaba yethempeli basebeyenelise ukuzwisisa ukuthi uMsindisi wayetshintshe umsebenzi wakhe, njalo babona ukuthi khathesi wayesesebenzela phambi komtshokotsho wesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu, encengela izoni ngegazi lakhe. {GC 433.1}

Umtshokotsho owawusethabanekelini lasemhlabeni wawulamatshe amabili lapho okwakubhalwe khona umthetho kaNkulunkulu. Umtshokotsho wawulibhokisi lapho amatshe lawa ayehlala khona, njalo ukubakhona kwamatshe lawa kwabangela ukuthi ibhokisi leli lihlonipheke njalo libengcwele. Nxa ithempeli likaNkulunkulu laselivuliwe ezulwini, umtshokotsho wesivumelwano wabonakala. Phakathi kwendawo engcwele ngcwele, ethempelini lasezulwini, imithetho elitshumi iqakathekisiwe, yona eyakhulunywa nguNkulunkulu uqobo lwakhe phakathi kwemidumo entabeni yaseSinai njalo eyalotshwa ngesandla sakhe phezu kwamatshe amabili. {GC 433.2}

Umthetho kaNkulunkulu osethempelini lasezulwini yiwo owawukhona kusukela ekuqaleni, ngoba leyana eyabhalwa ematsheni yaphinda njalo yabhalwa futhi nguMose encwadini zeBhayibhili yayingumfanekiso yaleyo esezulwini. Labo abafinyelela ekuzwisiseni iqiniso leli bathunganyelwa ukuthi babona ubungcwele njalo lesimo somthetho esingaguqukiyo. Babona okwedlula izikhathi ezazedlule, amandla wamazwi kaKrestu: “Kuze kudlule izulu lomhlaba kakusoze kudlule ibadlana libe linye ingabe lecwatshana libe linye lomlayo, kuze kwenzakale konke.” (Mathewu 5:17). Umthetho kaNkulunkulu ngokuba uyisambulo sentando yakhe, lamazwi aveza isimo sakhe, kumele uhlale kuze kubephakade, “njengofakazi othembekileyo ezulwini.” Akula lowodwa umthetho osewasuswayo, kumbe lebala kumbe icwatshana eselaguqulwayo. Encwadini kamahubo kulamazwi athi: “Nkosi ilizwi lakho limi ezulwini kuze kube nininini.” (Amahubo 119:89). “Lemithetho yayo yonke ithembekile. Imiswe kuze kube ninini.” (Amahubo 111:7,8). {GC 434.1}

Phakathi laphakathi kwemithetho elitshumi kumi umthetho wesine, ngendlela owakhulunywa ngayo: “Khumbula usuku lweSabatha ulwenze lubengcwele. Uzakusebenza insuku eziyisithupha uwenze wonke umsebenzi wakho, kodwa usuku lwesikhombisa luliSabatha leNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, ungasebenzi ngalo wena lendodana yakho, lendodakazi yakho lenceku yakho lencekukazi yakho lenkomo zakho lowemzini osemzini wakho. Ngoba ngensuku eziyisithupha, iNkosi yenza izulu lomhlaba lolwandle lakho konke okukukho, yaphumula ngosuku lwesikhombisa, ngalokhu iNkosi yalubusisa usuku lwesikhombisa, yalwenza lwaba ngcwele.” (Eksodusi 20:8-11). {GC 434.2}

UMoya kaNkulunkulu wathungamela inhliziyo zalabo ababefunda ilizwi lakhe. Bananzelela ukuthi babephila impilo yokwephula umthetho wesine bengazi ngenxa yokungalandeli usuku lokuphumula olwabekwa nguMdali. Baqala ukucubungula izizatho zokugcina usuku lwakuqala lweviki endaweni yosuku uNkulunkulu alubusisayo. Abazange bathole ubufakazi eBhayibhilini bokuthi umthetho wesine wawususiwe, kumbe ukuthi iSabatha laliguquliwe, isibusiso esasibangele ukuthi usuku lwesikhombisa lubengcwele sasingasuswanga. Babefise ukwazi njalo lokwenza intando kaNkulunkulu, khathesi nxa babezibona njengabantu ababesephula umthetho kaNkulunkulu, usizi lwagcwala enhliziyweni zabo, njalo babonisa ukuhlonipha uNkulunkulu ngokugcina usuku lwakhe lweSabatha ngcwele. {GC 434.3}

Kwabakhona imizamo eminengi eyenziwayo eyokubhidliza ukholo lwabo. Akulamuntu owayesehluleka ukunanzelela ukuthi ithabanekeli lasemhlabeni lalingumfanekiso wethempeli lasezulwini, umthetho owawubekwe emtshokotshweni wesivumelwano emhlabeni wawufana xathu lalowo osezulwini, njalo lokuthi ukwamukela iqiniso elimayelana lethempeli lasezulwini kwakugoqela ukuvuma lokho okutshiwo ngumthetho kaNkulunkulu njalo lomlandu wokugcina usuku lweSabatha njengoba lichazwe emthethweni wesine. Lapha yikho okwakulokulwiswa okukhulu ngenxa yokuchazwa kwemiBhalo eyakwenza kwacaca ukuthi uKrestu wayesenza wuphi umsebenzi ethempelini lasezulwini. Abantu bazama ukuvala umnyango uNkulunkulu ayewuvulile, njalo lokuvula umnyango uNkulunkulu ayewuvalile. Kodwa “yena ovula kungavali muntu, lovala kungavuli muntu,” wayetshilo ukuthi: “Khangela ngimisa phambi kwakho umnyango ovuliweyo, ongelakuvalwa muntu.” (Isambulo 3:7,8). UKrestu wayesevulile umnyango kumbe umsebenzi wakhe, endaweni engcwele ngcwele, ukukhanya kwakukhanyisa kuphuma emyango lowu owasewuvuliwe ethempelini lasezulwini, njalo umthetho wesine waboniswa ukuthi lawo wawuphakathi kwemithetho elitshumi kilo, lokho uNkulunkulu ayekwakhile akula muntu owayengakubhidliza. {GC 435.1}

Labo ababeyamukele ukukhanya okumayelana lomsebenzi kaKrestu wokusincengela njalo lokuthi umthetho umi kuze kube nininini bananzelela ukuthi lawa kwakungamaqiniso avezwe kuSambulo 14. Indaba ezitholakala esahlukweni lesi zimumethe izixwayiso ezintathu ezibambeneyo ezifanele ukulungiselela izakhamizi zomhlaba ukuza kweNkosi kwesibili. Isimemezelo esithi, “Ihola lokwahlulela kwakhe selifikile,” siveza umsebenzi kaKrestu wokuncengela abantu ngokokucina. Siletha iqiniso okumele lihanjiswe kuzekuyefika isikhathi lapho ukuncengela kukaKrestu okuzaphela khona njalo lapho azabuya khona emhlabeni ezothatha abantu bakhe. Umsebenzi wokwahlulela owaqala ngomnyaka ka1844 kumele uqhubeke kuzekuyefika lapho indaba zomuntu wonke ezizabe sezihlolisiswe zaphela, kwabaphilayo labafileyo, ngakhoke kuzaqhubeka kuze kuyefika ukuvalwa komusa. Ukwenzela ukuthi abantu benelise ukuma ekwahluleleni, udaba lolu lubatshela ukuthi “mesabeni uNkulunkulu, njalo limdumise,” “limkhonze yena owadala izulu, lomhlaba, lolwandle, kanye lemithombo yamanzi.” Umphumela wokwamukela izixwayiso lezi uveziwe eMbhalweni othi: “Nampa labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu lokukholwa kukaJesu.” Ukwenzela ukuthi silungele ukwahlulela, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bagcine imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Umthetho lowu uzaba ngumgomo wokulinganisa izimilo ngosuku lokwahlulela. Umpostoli uPhawuli uthi: “Abonileyo belomlayo bazakuthonisiswa ngomlayo, ... ngosuku uNkulunkulu azathonisisa ngalo imfihlakalo zenhliziyo zabantu ngoKrestu Jesu, litsho njalo ivangeli lami.” Uyatsho njalo ukuthi labo abagcina imilayo bazakwamukelwa. (Roma 2:12-16). Ukukholwa kuqakatheke kakhulu ekugcineni imilayo kaNkulunkulu, ngoba “ngaphandle kokukholwa kakwenzeki ukumthokozisa.” Njalo “konke okungasikho kokukholwa kuyisono.” (Amaheberu 11:6; Roma 14:23). {GC 435.2}

Emazwini wodaba lwengilosi yakuqala abantu bayatshelwa ukuthi “besabe uNkulunkulu njalo bamdumise” njalo bamkhonze njengoMdali wezulu lomhlaba. Ukwenzela ukuthi bakwenze lokhu, kumele balandele umlayo wakhe. Indoda ekhaliphileyo ithi: “Mesabeni uNkulunkulu ligcine imilayo yakhe, ngoba lokhu kungumlandu womuntu wonke.” (Umtshumayeli 12:13). Nxa kungekho ukulandela imilayo yakhe, akukho ukukhonza okungamthokozisa. “Lokhu kuyikuthanda uNkulunkulu, ukuthi sigcine imilayo yakhe.” “Uba umuntu engawulaleli umlayo, lemikhuleko yakhe izakuba yisinengiso.” (1 Johane 5:3; Zaga 28:9). {GC 436.1}

Umlandu wokukhonza uNkulunkulu weyame eqinisweni lokuthi nguye uMdali njalo lokuthi zonke izinto zikhona emhlabeni ngenxa yakhe. Njalo kuyoyonke indawo eBhayibhilini, lapho esitshelwa ngokuthi kumele simkhonze phezu kwabonkulunkulu babahedeni, kuveziwe, ubufakazi bamandla wakhe wokuba nguMdali. “Ngoba bonke onkulunkulu bezizwe bayizithombe, kodwa iNkosi yenza amazulu.” (Amahubo 96:5). “Pho lizangilinganisa lobani, lizangifananisa lobani na? Kutsho oNgcwele. Phakamiselani amehlo enu phezulu libone, ngubani owenza inkanyezi leziyana na?” “Ngoba iNkosi eyadala iphezulu, yona enguNkulunkulu eyabumba umhlaba yawenza...ithi ngiyiNkosi kakho omunye.” (Isaya 40:25,26; 45:18). “Yazini ukuthi iNkosi inguNkulunkulu. Yiyo eyasenzayo, singabayo, singabantu bayo lezimvu zedlelo layo.” “Wozani simkhonze sikhothame, siguqe phambi kweNkosi, uMenzi wethu.” (Amahubo 100:3; 95:6). Njalo lezidalwa ezingcwele ezikhonza uNkulunkulu ezulwini ziyatsho isizatho sokuthi simkhonze: “Ufanele wena Nkosi yethu loNkulunkulu wethu, ukwamukela ubukhosi lodumo lamandla, ngoba nguwe owadala izinto zonke, langenxa yentando yakho zabakhona zadalwa.” (Isambulo 4:11). {GC 436.2}

Kusambulo 14, abantu bayatshelwa ukuthi kumele bakhonze uMdali, njalo isiprofethi siyaveza iqula lalabo, ngenxa yendaba yengilosi lezi ezintathu, abagcina imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Omunye wemithetho leyi uveza sobala uNkulunkulu njengoMdali. Umthetho wesine uthi: “Usuku lwesikhombisa luliSabatha lweNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu...ngoba ngensuku eziyisithupha iNkosi yenza izulu lomhlaba lolwandle lakho konke okukukho, yaphumula ngosuku lwesikhombisa, ngalokho iNkosi yalubusisa usuku lwesikhombisa, yalwenza lwabangcwele.” (Eksodusi 20:8-11). Mayelana leSabatha iNkosi iyaqhubeka isithi, “luphawu...ukwenzela ukuthi lazi ukuthi ngiyiNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.” (Hezekeli 20:20). Njalo isizatho esinikiweyo yikuthi: “Ngoba ngensuku eziyisithupha iNkosi yenza izulu lomhlaba, kodwa ngosuku lwesikhombisa yaphumula, yatshaphuluka.” (Eksodusi 31:17). {GC 437.1}

“Ukuqakatheka kweSabatha njengesikhumbuzo sokudala yikuthi lihlala lisikhumbuza isizatho sokuba sikhonze uNkulunkulu kuphela” ngoba unguMdali, njalo siyizidalwa zakhe. “Isabatha ngakhoke limi njengensika yokukhonza, ngoba lisifundisa iqiniso leli ngendlela edlula zonke, njalo akula eyinye into eyenza njalo. Isizatho seqiniso sokukhonza, hatshi kuphela ngosuku lwesikhombisa kodwa esokukhonza konke, sitholakala ekwahlukaniseni phakathi koMdali lezidalwa zakhe. Iqiniso leli ngeke lidlule, njalo akumelanga likhohlakale.” (J.N. Andrews, History of the Sabbath, chapter 27.) Kwakungenxa yesizatho sokuthi lokhu kuhlale kusengqondweni zabantu, okwabangela ukuthi uNkulunkulu abanike usuku lweSabatha ensimini yaseEdeni, njalo nxa ulwazi lokuthi nguye uMdali luqhubeka lusiba yisizatho sokuthi simkhonze, usuku lweSabatha luzaqhubeka lusiba luphawu njalo lesikhumbuzo. Ngabe iSabatha laligcinwe ngumuntu wonke emhlabeni, imicabango yabantu lezifiso zabo zazizaholelwa kuMdali njengeNkosi okumele siyikhonze njalo siyidumise, njalo kwakungeke kube labakhonza izithombe, labangakholwayo njalo labahlamuki. Ukugcinwa kweSabatha kuluphawu lokulalendela uNkulunkulu weqiniso, “Yena owadala izulu lomhlaba, lolwandle, njalo lemithombo yamanzi.” Kusobala ukuthi udaba olubizela abantu ukuthi bakhonze uNkulunkulu njalo bagcine imilayo yakhe luzababizela ikakhulu ukuthi balandele umthetho wesine. {GC 437.2}

Nxa kuqathaniswa labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu njalo abalokukholwa kukaJesu, udaba lwengilosi yesithathu luveza iqula, njalo kulezixwayiso ezesabekayo ezizakwehlela abantu ngenxa yamaphutha wabo: “Uba kukhona okhonza isilo lomfanekiso waso, obekwe uphawu ebunzini lakhe, kumbe esandleni sakhe, laye uzakunatha iwayini lolaka lukaNkulunkulu.” (Isambulo 14:9,10). Ingcazelo eqondileyo yemfanekiso esetshenzisiweyo ibalulekile ekuluzwisiseni udaba lolu. Kuyini okumelwe yisilo, umfanekiso waso isilo lesi, njalo lophawu lwesilo? {GC 438.1}

Amazwi esiprofethi esithola khona izibonelo lezi aqala kuSambulo 12, lapho esivezelwe umgobho owazama ukubulala uKrestu nxa wayezalwa. Umgobho uchazwe ngokuthi umele uSathane (Isambulo 12:9); nguye owafuqa uHerodi ukuthi abulale uMsindisi. Kodwa isandla uSathane asisebenzisayo ukulwisana loKrestu njalo labantu bakhe kwakungumbuso weRoma, lapho inkolo yokukhonza izithixo eyayihamba phambili khona. Ngale indlela nxa umgobho umele uSathane, nxa sikhangele isehlakalo lesi umele njalo umbuso waseRoma owawubusa ngalesi isikhathi. {GC 438.2}

KuSambulo 13:1-10 kuvezwe esinye isilo, “esifana lengwe,” esivezwe ngokuthi umgobho wasinika “amandla wawo, lesihlalo sawo sobukhosi, lokubusa okukhulu.” Umfanekiso lowu njengoba abavuseleli abanengi bebekukholwa, umele umbuso wabopapa, oyiwo owaphakama wathola amandla ayengaphansi kombuso weRoma. Nxa kuchazwa isilo lesi esifana lengwenya kuthiwa: “Isilo sanikwa umlomo wokukhuluma okuzincoma lenhlamba...Savula umlomo waso ukuhlambaza uNkulunkulu, lokuhlambaza ibizo lakhe lendawo ahlala kiyo kanye labahlala laye. Sanikwa futhi ukuba silwe labangcwele, sibahlule, sanikwa lamandla phezu kwemihlobo yonke, labantu, lezindimi, lezizwe.” Isiprofethi lesi esiphosa sifane xathu lendlela okuchazwe ngayo uphondo oluncane kuDanyeli 7, sikhomba embusweni wabopapa kungela kuthandabuza. {GC 439.1}

“Sanikwa amandla ukuthi siqhubeke sibusa okwenyanga ezingamatshumi amane lambili.” Njalo umprofethi uthi, “Ngabona elinye lamakhanda walo lingathi lilenxeba elibangela ukufa.” Futhi: “Lowo othumbayo laye uzakuthunjwa, lowo obulala ngenkemba laye kumele abulawe ngenkemba.” Inyanga lezi ezingamatshumi amane lambili achaza isikhathi esifanayo leminyaka emithathu elengxenye etholakala kuDanyeli 7 kumbe amalanga angu1260, okuyisikhathi lapho amandla wabopapa ayezahlukumeza abantu bakaNkulunkulu. Isikhathi lesi ngendlela esichazwe ngayo ezahlukweni ezisemuva yaqala ngomnyaka ka A.D 538 yaphela ngomnyaka ka1798. Ngalesi isikhathi upapa wathunjwa ngamabutho welizwe laseFrance, okwabangela ukuthi umbuso wabopapa uthole inxeba lokufa, njalo amazwi athi, “lowo othumbayo laye uzakuthunjwa” agcwaliseka. {GC 439.2}

Ngemva kwamazwi lawa kuyavezwa futhi omunye umfanekiso. Umprofethi uthi: “Ngasengibona esinye isilo siphuma emhlabeni silempondo ezimbili ezinjengezewundlu.” (Isambulo 13:11). Ukuphakama kwesilo lesi njalo lesimo saso kuyabonisa ukuthi ilizwe leli elichazwa lapha alifani lamanye avezwe phambi kwalo. Izizwe ezinkulu esezike zabusa umhlaba zavezwa kumprofethi uDanyeli njengezilo ezidla ezinye, ezaziphume “nxa imimoya evela inxa zonke, yayiqubula ulwandle olokhulu.” (Danyeli 7:2). KuSambulo 17 ingilosi yachaza ukuthi amanzi amele “abantu, lamaxuku, lezizwe njalo lezindimi.” (Sambulo 17:15). Imimoya imele ukulwisana lezimpi. Imimoya emine yezulu ehlokomisa ulwandle olukhulu imele izehlakalo ezimbi zokulwisana kwezizwe nxa zazithatha umbuso kwezinye. {GC 439.3}

Kodwa isilo esilempondo ezingathi ngezewundlu sabonakala “siphuma emhlabathini.” Kulokuthi sehlule eminye imbuso ukuba sithole amandla waso, isizwe lesi esichaziweyo kumele siphume endaweni eyayingela bantu abanengi sikhule kancane kancane ngokuthula. Sasingeke siphume phakathi kwamazwe omhlaba wasendulo, lapho okwakulolwandle “lwabantu, lamaxuku, lezizwe njalo lendimi.” Kumele litholakale emazweni asentshonalanga. {GC 440.1}

Yiliphi ilizwe emhlabeni omutsha elaliphakama ngomnyaka ka1798, elalibonisa ithemba lokuba lamandla njalo lodumo, njalo elalikhangelwe ngumhlaba wonke? Ukusetshenziswa komfanekiso lowu kwenza kubesobala. Kulelizwe elilodwa kuphela, elisuthisa lokhu okuchazwe yisiprofethi lesi, amazwi lawa akhomba ngokungathandabuzi elizweni lase America. Ezikhathini ezinengi amazwi kamambuleli alokusetshenziswa ngabalobi bembali nxa bechaza indlela ilizwe leli elaphakama ngayo. Isilo lesi sabonakala “siphuma emhlabeni;” njalo nxa silandela amazwi walabo abatolikayo, ibala elisetshenziswe lapha elithi “siphuma” limele ukuthi “ukuhluma njengesihlahlakazana.” Njalo njengoba sesibonile, ilizwe leli kumele liphakame endaweni eyayingela bantu ngaphambilini. Omunye wabalobi abadumileyo nxa ebhala ngembali yelizwe laseAmerica uthi: “imfihlo yokuphakama kwalo endaweni engela bantu” njalo uthi “njengentanga ensitha sakhula saba lilizwe elikhulu.” — (G.A. Townsend, The New World Compared with the Old, page 462). Elinye lamaphephandaba laseEurope ngomnyaka ka1850 labhala ngelizwe laseAmerica njengombuso oligugu, owawu “phakama” njalo “ngaphansi kokuthula komhlaba nsuku zonke lisengeza amandla walo.” (The Dublin Nation). UEdward Everett, nxa wayebhala encoma labo abasungula ilizwe leli wathi: “Badinga yini indawo ethuleyo, eyayingahlukuluzi muntu ngokucatsha kwayo, njalo eyayiphephile ekufihlakaleni kwayo, lapho ibandla elincane laseLeyden elalizakholisa ukukhululeka komzwangedwa? Khangela indawo ezinkulu, ngokunqoba okuthuleyo...abathwalele khona iziphambano! - (Speech delivered at Plymouth, Massachusetts, Dec. 22, 1824, page 11). {GC 440.2}

“Njalo lalilempondo ezimbili ezingathi ngezewundlu.” Impondo lezi ezingathi ngezewundlu zibonisa ubutsha, lokubamsulwa njalo lokulunga, okuchaza ngokufaneleyo isimo selizwe laseAmerica elavezwa ngumprofethi njengokuthi laliphuma ngomnyaka ka1798. Phakathi kweziphepheli zamaKrestu ezabalekela elizweni laseAmerica njalo abadinga ukuthula ngokuphuma ekuhlukunyuzweni phakathi kwezandla zababusi njalo lochuku lwamapristi kwakulabanengi abazimisela ukusungula umbuso owaweyame phezu kwensika yokukhululeka kwezombuso njalo lakwezokholo. Imibono yabo yafakwa phakathi kwencwadi ekhomba ukukhululwa kwabo, echaza sobala ukuthi “bonke abantu badalwe ngokulingana” njalo balelungelo “lokuphila, lokukhululeka, njalo lelungelo lokudinga injabulo yabo.” Njalo isisekelo selizwe siyanika abantu ilungelo lokuzibusa, ngokubeka ukuthi abathungameli ababezakhethwa ngabantu yibo ababezabeka imithetho. Ukukhululeka kwezokukholwa lakho kwamiswa, wonke umuntu wanikwa imvumo yokukhonza uNkulunkulu ngendlela ayeholwa ngayo ngumzwangedwa wakhe. Ukukhululeka kwezombusazwe lakwezokholo kwaba yinsika yelizwe leli. Izinto lezi yizo eziyimfihlo yamandla welizwe leli njalo lokuphumelela kwalo. Bonke abahlukumezekileyo emazweni amanengi amaKrestu benelisa ukuthola indawo yokuphephela lapha. Izigidi zabantu sezidinge ukuphepha lapha, njalo ilizwe laseAmerica selikhule lathola indawo phakathi kwamazwe alamandla emhlabeni wonke. {GC 441.1}

Kodwa isilo esilempondo ezinjengezewundlu “sakhuluma njengomgobho.” Njalo sasebenzisa wonke amandla wesilo sakuqala, njalo senza umhlaba kanye labo bonke abaphila kuwo ukuthi bakhonze isilo sakuqala, esilenxeba lokufa elapholayo; ...lisithi kibo bonke abaphila emhlabeni, ukuthi kufanele benze umfanekiso wesilo, esasithole inxeba ngenkemba, njalo saphila.” (Sambulo 13:11-14). {GC 441.2}

Impondo lezi ezifana lezewundlu njalo lelizwi lomgobho kuveza ukwehlukana phakathi kwalokho ilizwe leli elasungulwa ukuthi likuvikele lalokho elizaqala ukukwenza. Lokho okuchazwe “njengokukhuluma” kwelizwe leli kuchaza izenzo zababusi balo ngokubeka kwabo imithetho njalo lemithethwandaba yabo. Ngokwenza izenzo lezi kuzabangela ukuthi imfundiso lezi ezasetshenziswa ukwakha ilizwe lile zibonakale njengamanga. Amazwi wokuthi lizakhuluma njengomgobho njalo lisebenzise wonke amandla wesilo sakuqala aveza sobala inguquko ezabakhona lapho okuzavuka khona umoya wokungamukelani njalo lokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu okwakusemazweni lawa amelwe ngumgobho njalo lesilo lesi esifana lengwe. Njalo lamazwi athi isilo lesi esilempondo ezimbili “senza ukuthi umhlaba labo bonke abahlala kuwo ukuthi bakhonze isilo sakuqala” aveza ukuthi amandla welizwe leli azasetshenziswa ukuletha indlela yokukhonza ezabe iphakamisa upapa. {GC 442.1}

Isenzo esinjalo sizabe siphikisana lemithetho yelizwe leli, njalo lenhlanganiso zalo ezikhululekileyo, njalo lamazwi acolekileyo asencwadini yokukhululeka kwelizwe leli. Labo abasungula ilizwe leli benza ngokuhlakanipha imizamo yokwenqabela ibandla ukuthi lisebenzise amandla welizwe, ngoba babesazi ukuthi umphumela wokuvumela lokhu uba yikuhlukumeza labo abangavumelani lebandla. Isisekelo selizwe sithi” iphalamende ayisoke ihlahle umthetho osekela ukwakhiwa kwenkolo, kumbe evimbela ukukhululeka kwabantu ekukhonzeni kwabo,” njalo lokuthi “akusoke kube lemihloliso esetshenziswayo ephathelene lenkolo ezadinga ukuthi abantu badlule kiyo ukuba bathole izikhundla kwezombusazwe phakathi kwelizwe laseAmerica.” Kuphela ngokwephula yonke leyi imithetho, kuzakwenzeka ukuthi abantu babanjwe ngamandla ukuthi balandele inkolo ethile. Kodwa inguquko leyi ilingana lomfanekiso osetshenzisiweyo. Isilo lesi silempondo ezifana lezewundlu, ngokubunjwa kwalo ilizwe leli lilesimo esimsulwa, lithobekile njalo alilangozi, kodwa lizakhuluma njengomgobho. {GC 442.2}

“Lisithi kulabo abakhileyo emhlabeni, ukuthi kumele bayenze umfanekiso wesilo.” Lapha kuvezwe sobala indlela yokubusa elizweni lapho amandla wokubeka imithetho asezandleni zabantu khona, okuyindlela esobala echaza ukuthi ilizwe elivezwe lapha ngelaseAmerica. {GC 442.3}

Kodwa uyini “umfanekiso wesilo”? njalo uzakwenziwa njani? Umfanekiso lowu uzakwenziwa yisilo lesi esilempondo ezimbili, njalo ungumfanekiso owenzelwe isilo sakuqala. Ubizwa njalo ngokuthi ngumfanekiso wesilo. Kutsho ukuthi nxa sifuna ukwazi ukuthi umfanekiso lowu uyini njalo lokuthi uzabunjwa njani kumele sihlolisise isimo sesilo sakuqala okungumbuso wabo papa. {GC 443.1}

Nxa ibandla lakuqala laseliphambuke eqinisweni leBhayibhili, ngokwamukela amasiko alabo abakhonza izithombe, uMoya kaNkulunkulu wasuswa phakathi kwalo, njalo ukwenzela ukuthi lilawule imizwangedwa yabantu, laqala ukudinga amandla kubabusi. Umphumela wakhona waba yikubunjwa kwesihlalo sikapapa, lapho kwasekulebandla elalilawula amandla welizwe njalo elalisebenzisa amandla lawa ukujezisa labo ababengavumelani lalo. Ukwenzela ukuthi ilizwe laseAmerica libumbe umfanekiso wesilo, amandla webandla kumele alawule amandla wezombusazwe, ukwenzela ukuthi amandla welizwe asetshenziswe libandla ukwenza lokho elikufisayo. {GC 443.2}

Kuzo zonke izikhathi lapho ibandla elithole khona amandla welizwe, liwasebenzise ukujezisa labo abangavumelani lemfundiso yalo. Amabandla asungulwa ngabaVuseleli aqhubeke emanyathelweni ebandla leRoma awokudinga ubungane lababusi bomhlaba njalo lawo asebonisile izifiso ezifananayo ezizanyathezela amalungelo wabantu wokukhonza uNkulunkulu ngendlela abafuna ngayo. Isibonelo salokhu sitholakala kulokhu okwenziwa libandla laseNgilandi kulabo ababengavumelani lemfundiso yebandla leli. Okweminyaka eminengi kusiyafika emnyakeni ka1700 abantu abanengi babanjwa ngamandla ukuthi babaleke emabandleni wabo, njalo abanengi okugoqela abafundisi lamalunga ebandla, badlula phakathi kobunzima abanye baphoselwa emajele njalo abanye babulawa ngenxa yokuthi babekhethe ukulandela umzwangedwa wabo. {GC 443.3}

Kwakungenxa yokuyekethisa okwabangela ukuthi ibandla lakuqala lifune ukuxhaswa ngababusi, njalo lokhu kwavula indlela yokuthi kwakhiwe isihlalo sikapapa, okuyiso isilo. UPhawuli wathi: “Kuzaba lokwehlukana kuqala...njalo kwambulwe omubi indodana yokulahlwa.” (2 Thesalonika 2:3). Ngakhoke ukuyekethisa kwebandla kuzaphendla indlela yokuthi kwenziwe umfanekiso wesilo. {GC 443.4}

IBhayibhili liyaveza ukuthi uKrestu engakezi kuzabakhona umumo kwezenkolo ofana lalowo owawukhona endulo ngaphansi kombuso webandla leRoma. “Yazi lokhu ukuthi ensukwini zokucina kuzafika izikhathi ezinzima. Ngoba abantu bazakuba ngabazithandayo, labathanda imali, labazigqajayo, labaziqakisayo, labathukayo, labangalaleli abazali babo, labangabongiyo, lababi, labangelathando, labanhliziyo zilukhuni, labahlebayo, labangazikhuziyo, labalolaka, labazonda okuhle. Labanikela abanye, labalamawala, labagcwele ukuzikhukhumeza, labathanda ukuzithokozisa kulokuthanda uNkulunkulu, labalesimo sokukholwa kodwa amandla akho bewaphika. Baxwaye abanjalo.” (2 Timothi 3:1-5). “UMoya utsho ngokusobala ukuba ngezikhathi zokucina abanye bazakumonyuka ekukholweni, balalele omoya abaduhisayo lezifundiso zabomoya ababi.” (1 Timothi 4:1). USathane uzasebenza “ngawo wonke amandla, lezibonakaliso lezimangaliso zamanga, langayo yonke inkohliso yokungalungi kulabo abamiselwe ukubhubha ngenxa yokuba bengavumanga ukuthanda iqiniso ukuze basiliswe. Ngakhoke uNkulunkulu ubathumele okudukisayo, ukuze bakholwe amanga.” (2 Thesalonika 2:9-11). Nxa isimo lesi sobubi sesifinyelelwe, umphumela ofanayo uzalandela njengasendulo. {GC 444.1}

Ukwehlukana kwenkolo yamabandla alamuhla kubonakala emehlweni wabantu abanengi njengobufakazi bokuthi ngeke kwenzakale ukuthi amabandla lawa abambane. Kodwa okweminyaka eminengi emabandleni lawa sekube lesifiso esilokhe sikhula esokuwabambanisa phezu kwemfundiso abavumelana kizo. Ukwenzela ukuthi bathole ukubambana lokhu, inkulumo ezimayelana lemigca leyi abangavumelani kuyo, kumele ibekwe eceleni kungakhathelekile ukuthi iphuma eBhayibhilini. {GC 444.2}

UCharles Beecher, nxa wayetshumayela ngomnyaka ka1846, watsho ukuthi umsebenzi “wamabandla asungulwa ngabaVuseleli, awubunjwangwa kuphela ngaphansi kokwesaba kwabantu, kodwa amabandla lawa aphila njalo ahamba ngaphansi kwesimo esingalunganga, njalo bahlezi belandela imizwa yabo emibi ukwenzela ukuthi bafihle iqiniso, njalo bakhothamele amandla wokuyekethisa iqiniso. Kwakungasiyo yini indlela izinto ezayenzakala ngayo ebandleni leRoma? Asiphili impilo efananayo yini lamuhla? Njalo sibonani okuzayo phambi kwethu? Omunye umhlangano wokubambana! Lapho umhlaba wonke ozabuthana khona! Ukubambana kwamabandla, njalo lemfundiso eyodwa!” (Sermon on The Bible a Sufficient Creed,” delivered at Fort Wayne, Indiana, Feb. 22, 1846.) Nxa lokhu sekwenzakele, ukwenzela ukuthi kube lokukholwa okufananayo emabandleni, kuzabe sekuseduze lokuthi basebenzise udlame. {GC 444.3}

Nxa amabandla amakhulu aselizweni laseAmerica, esebambene ngaphansi kwemfundiso lezi abalazo ezihambelanayo, bezadonsela ababusi ukuthi bafake imithetho yabo njalo lokuthi baqinise amabandla wabo, kulapho ke ilizwe laseAmerica elakhiwe phezu kwenkolo yabaVuseleli elizabe selibumbe umfanekiso wabathungameli beRoma, njalo ukuhlukunyezwa kwalabo abayala ukukulandela lokhu kuzaba ngumphumela wakhona ozalandela. {GC 445.1}

Isilo esilempondo ezimbili “senza futhi ukuthi bonke, abancinyane labakhulu, abanothileyo labayanga, abakhululekileyo lezigqili, bathole uphawu esandleni sokunene loba ebunzini, ukuba kungabi khona othengayo loba othengisayo, uba engelalo uphawu olulibizo lesilo, loba isibalo sebizo laso.” (Isambulo 13:16,17). Isixwayiso sengilosi yesithathu sithi: “Uba kukhona okhonza isilo lomfanekiso waso, obekwe uphawu ebunzini lakhe kumbe esandleni sakhe, laye uzakunatha iwayini lolaka lukaNkulunkulu elilungisiweyo enkezweni yolaka lwakhe.” “Isilo” esichazwe edabeni lolu, esiyenzwa ukuthi sikhonzwe ngumuntu wonke ngenxa yamandla wesilo esilempondo ezimbili, yisilo sakuqala kumbe isilo esingathi yingwe esichazwa kuSambulo 13, okuveza isihlalo sabopapa. “Umfanekiso wesilo” umele isimo senkolo yebandla esizakwakhiwa ngamabandla lawa asungulwa ngabaVuseleli lapho amabandla lawa azadinga ubungane bombuso welizwe ukwenzela ukuthi benelise ukufaka imithetho elizweni esekela imfundiso yabo. “Uphawu lwesilo” khona sizaluchaza ukuthi luyini. {GC 445.2}

Ngemva kwesixwayiso sokuthi abantu bangakhonzi isilo njalo lomfanekiso waso isiprofethi siyaqhubeka sisithi: “Nanti ithuba lokubekezela kwabangcwele, labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu lokukholwa kukaJesu.” (Sambulo 14:12). Njengoba labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu beqathaniswe lalabo abakhonza isilo lomfanekiso waso njalo abathola uphawu lwaso, kuyalandelake ukuthi ukugcina umthetho kaNkulunkulu ngakolunye uhlangothi, njalo lokuwephula ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuzabangumehluko phakathi kwalabo abakhonza uNkulunkulu njalo lalabo abakhonza isilo. {GC 445.3}

Isimo esimqoka esibumba isilo, njalo lomfanekiso waso, yikwephula imilayo kaNkulunkulu. UDanyeli, nxa ekhuluma ngophondo oluncane olumele isihlalo sikapapa weRoma: “Uzacabanga ukuguqula izikhathi lomthetho.” (Danyeli 7:25). Njalo uPhawuli wachaza amandla afananayo ngokuthi “yindoda yesono,” owayezaziphakamisa phezu kaNkulunkulu. Amazwi esiprofethi endaweni ezitshiyeneyo alotshelwe ukuxhasa amanye. Kuphela ngokuguqula umthetho kaNkulunkulu umbuso wabopapa yikho lapho owawungenelisa ukuziphakamisa phezu kaNkulunkulu; njalo bonke ngemva kokwazi iqiniso abazimisela ukugcina umthetho lowu osuguquliwe bazabe benika udumo emandleni lawa awuguqulayo. Isenzo esinjalo esokulandela imithetho kapapa sizabe siluphawu lokuhlonipha upapa endaweni kaNkulunkulu. {GC 446.1}

Opapa sebeke bazama ukuguqula umthetho kaNkulunkulu. Umlayo wesibili owenqabela abantu ukuthi bakhonze izithombe, sebawukhipha emilayweni esetshenziswa libandla leRoma, njalo lomthetho wesine sewaguqulwa ukwenzela ukuthi benelise ukugcina usuku lwakuqala lweviki endaweni yosoku lwesine njengosuku lweSabatha. Kodwa abathungameli bebandla leRoma bayatsho ukuthi isizatho sokukhipha umthetho wesibili yikuthi awulamsebenzi, ngoba uphakathi kowokuqala, njalo lokuthi bona bafaka umthetho ngendlela uNkulunkulu ayefuna ukuthi uzwisiseke ngayo. Lokhu ngeke kube lutshintsho oluvezwe emazwini esiprofethi. Kumele kube lutshintsho abaluhlosileyo, njalo olwenziwa ngamabomo: “Uzacabanga ukutshintsha izikhathi njalo lomthetho.” Utshintsho abalwenza emthethweni wesine lugcwalisa isiprofethi lesi. Ngoba isizatho abasinikayo kulokhu yikuthi ibandla lilamandla wokukwenza lokhu. Lapha babonisa ukuthi bacabanga ukuthi amandla kapapa aphezu kwakaNkulunkulu. {GC 446.2}

Nxa labo abakhonza uNkulunkulu bezabonakala ngenxa yokugcina umthetho wesine, njengoba lokhu kuluphawu lwamandla wakhe wokudala njalo lobufakazi bokuthi kumele akhonzwe ngabantu bonke, ngakolunye uhlangothi labo abakhonza isilo bazabonakala ngemizamo yabo yokunyathezela isikhumbuzo soMdali, ukwenzela ukuthi baphakamise usuku olwafakwa libandla leRoma. Kwakungenxa yokufuna ukuphakamisa usuku lweSonto okwenza ukuthi upapa aqale ukuletha imfundiso yakhe yokuziphakamisa, njalo isenzo sakuqala ngemva kokuthola amandla welizwe kwakuyikubamba ngamandla umuntu wonke ukuthi agcine usuku lweSonto “njengosuku lweNkosi.” Kodwa IBhayibhili likhomba usuku lwesikhombisa, hatshi olwakuqala njengosuku lweNkosi. UKrestu wathi: “iNdodana yomuntu iyiNkosi futhi yeSabatha.” Umthetho wesine uthi: “Usuku lwesikhombisa luliSabatha leNkosi.” Njalo iNkosi nxa ikhuluma ngomprofethi uIsaya ithi: “Usuku lwami olungcwele.” (Marko 2:28; Isaya 58:13). {GC 446.3}

Isizatho esivame ukusetshenziswa esokuthi uKrestu watshintsha usuku lweSabatha siphikiswa ngamazwi wakhe. Nxa wayetshumayela entabeni uKrestu wathi: “Lingathi ngize ukuchitha umlayo ingabe abaprofethi, angizanga ukuchitha, kodwa ngize ukugcwalisa. Ngoba ngiqinisile ngithi kini, Kuze kudlule izulu lomhlaba kakusoze kudlule ibadlana libe linye ingabe lecwatshana libe linye lomlayo, kuze kwenzakale konke. Ngakho lowo owephula owodwa kulimilayo emincinyane, afundise abantu njalo, uzakuthiwa ngomncinyane embusweni wezulu, kodwa oyenzayo ayifundise, lowo uzakuthiwa mkhulu embusweni wezulu.” (Mathewu 5:17-19). {GC 447.1}

Kuliqiniso elivame ukuvunywa ngabantu abanengi abasemabandleni akhonza ngosuku lweSonto ukuthi iBhayibhili aliniki imvumo yokuguqulwa kweSabatha. Lokhu kubhalwe kwacaca encwadini ezibhalwa yinhlanganiso yeAmerican Tract Society njalo leye American Sunday School Union. Eyinye yencwadi lezi iveza ukuthi “iThestamente eLitsha alilangitsho ibala elilodwa elitshela abantu ukuthi bagcine usuku lweSonto, kumbe imithetho emayelana lokuthi ligcinwe njani.”- (George Elliott, The Abiding Sabbath, page 184). {GC 447.2}

Eyinye incwadi ithi: “Kuze kuyefika isikhathi lapho uKrestu afa khona, akulanguquko eyayiyenziwe esukwini lolu, njalo nxa silandela imbhalo, abafundi bakhe abazange balutshintshe...njalo abanikanga ilizwi lokuthi kumele balahle usuku lwesikhombisa bagcine usuku lwakuqala njengosuku lweSabatha.” — (A.E. Waffle, The Lord’s Day, pages 186-188). {GC 447.3}

Abathungameli bebandla leRoma bayavuma ukuthi inguquko eyenziwa ngosuku lweSabatha yenziwa libandla labo, njalo bayatsho ukuthi amabandla lawa asungulwa ngabaVuseleli ngokugcina usuku lweSonto, baphakamisa amandla webandla labo. Encwadini yebandla leRoma ebizwa ngokuthi yiCatholic Catechism of Christian Religion, nxa babephendula umbuzo mayelana losuku okumele luhlonitshwe oluchazwa ngumthetho wesine, kubhalwe amazwi alandelayo: “Ngaphansi komthetho wakudala, usuku lwangeSabatha yilo olwalubusisiwe, kodwa ibandla, ngemva kokutshelwa nguJesu, njalo ngenxa yokuthunganyelwa nguMoya oyiNgcwele, selafaka usuku lweSonto endaweni yosuku lwangeSabatha, ngaleso sizatho khathesi sigcina usuku lwakuqala lweviki hatshi olwesikhombisa. Usuku lweSonto lutsho ukuthi njalo manje lusuku lweNkosi.” {GC 447.4}

Njengesibonelo samandla webandla leRoma, abalobi baleli bandla basebenzisa “isenzo lesi sokuguqula usuku lweSabatha lusiyakuba ngeSonto, okuvunyelwa ngamabandla wonke; ... ngoba ngokukhonza ngeSonto, bayakhothamela amandla webandla wokugcoba inkonzo njalo lokubathungamela ngaphansi kwesono.” (Henry Tuberville, An Abridgment of the Christian Doctrine, page 58). Kuyine ke ukuguqulwa kosuku lweSabatha, kuluphawu olubonisa amandla webandla leRoma- “okuyilo uphawu lwesilo”? {GC 448.1}

Ibandla leRoma alikami ukukholwa ukuthi yilo elilamandla emhlabeni; njalo nxa umhlaba wonke wamabandla asungulwa ngabaVuseleli usamukela usuku lwesabatha abazibumbela lona, bona bephika iSabatha elivezwe eBhayibhilini, ngamanye amazwi bayavuma lokhu okukholwa libandla leRoma. Sebengathi basebenzisa amandla wamasiko njalo labokhokho bebandla awokwenza utshintsho lolu, kodwa ngokwenza njalo bayakhohlwa isizatho esisodwa esibahlukanisa leRoma, okuyikuthi “iBhayibhili njalo iBhayibhili kuphela, yilo inkolo yabaVuseleli.” Abathungameli bebandla leRoma bayananzelela ukuthi bayazikhohlisa, bayazinikela ukuthi bavale amehlo wabo bengaboni ubufakazi bokuthi lokhu abakukholwayo akukho eBhayibhilini. Nxa usuku lweSonto lulokhe lusamukelwa njengosuku lweSabatha abathungameli bebandla bayathokoza ngoba balesiqiniseko sokuthi ekuzineni amabandla wonke azakuba ngaphansi kwebandla leRoma. {GC 448.2}

Abathungameli bebandla leRoma bayatsho ukuthi “ukukhonza ngosuku lweSonto okwenziwa ngamabandla lawa yindlela abahlonipha ngayo, loba bengathandi amandla webandla leRoma.” (Mgr. Segur, Plain Talk About the Protestantism of Today, page 213). Ukubekwa komthetho wokuthi abantu bakhonze ngeSonto okuzakwenziwa ngamabandla lawa, kuyikubeka umthetho wokuthi abantu bakhonze isihlalo sikapapa, okutsho ukukhonza isilo. Labo abathi ngokuzwisisa iqiniso lomthetho wesine, abakhetha ukugcina iSabatha lamanga kulokugcina eleqiniso ngale indlela bakhonza amandla ayiwo aletha inguquko leyi. Kodwa esenzweni lesi sokubeka umthetho wokukhonza besebenzisa ababusi, amabandla ngokwawo azabumba umfanekiso wesilo, ngakhoke ukubekwa komthetho wokukhonza ngeSonto elizweni laseAmerica kuzabe kuyikubeka umthetho wokukhonza isilo lomfanekiso waso. {GC 448.3}

Kodwa amaKrestu asendulo ayegcina usuku lwangeSonto ngoba babecabanga ukuthi ngokwenza njalo babegcina usuku lweSabatha oluvezwe eBhayibhilini, njalo kukhona amaKrestu aqotho manje emabandleni wonke, okugoqela ibandla leRoma, abakholwa ngokwethembeka ukuthi usuku lweSonto luliSabatha elitholakala eBhayibhilini. UNkulunkulu uyamukela ukungazi kwabo njalo lokuzimisela kwabo phambi kwakhe. Kodwa nxa usuku lweSonto selufakwe ngokomthetho ukuthi sekulusuku lokukhonza njalo umhlaba sewazisiwe ngeSabatha leqiniso, ngaleso isikhathi wonke umuntu ozakwephula umlayo kaNkulunkulu, ukwenzela ukuthi alandele usuku olungabekwanga ngamanye amandla kodwa amandla webandla leRoma, ngokwenza njalo uzakhonza upapa endaweni kaNkulunkulu. Lowo muntu uzabe ekhonza iRoma, njalo lamandla abeka njalo agcoba usuku lolu olubekwe libandla leRoma. Lowo muntu uzabe ekhonza isilo njalo lomfanekiso waso. Nxa abantu ngalesi isikhathi bephika usuku uNkulunkulu alubiza ngokuthi luphawu lwamandla wakhe, njalo behlonipha endaweni yalo lokho okukhethwe libandla leRoma njengophawu lwamandla walo, ngale indlela bazakwamukela uphawu lokukhothamela iRoma, “okuyilo uphawu lwesilo.” Njalo akusoke kwenzakale kuzekuyefika isikhathi lapho abantu bonke abazachazelwa khona, njalo abazafika esikhathini lapho okuzamele bakhethe khona phakathi kwemithetho kaNkulunkulu lemithetho yabantu, yikho lapho bonke abantu abazaqhubeka besephula umthetho kaNkulunkulu abazakwamukela khona “uphawu lwesilo.” {GC 449.1}

Isixwayiso esesabeka okwedlula zonke esesike saphiwa uluntu sitholakala edabeni lwengilosi yesithathu. Kumele kube yisono esikhulu okwedlula zonke esiletha ulaka lukaNkulunkulu olungaxutshaniswanga lomusa. Abantu akumelanga batshiywe ebunyameni mayelana lendaba leyi eqakatheke kangaka, isixwayiso esiveza isono lesi kumele sinikwe umhlaba wonke kungakafiki ukwahlulela kukaNkulunkulu, ukwenzela ukuthi bonke abantu bazi ukuthi yindaba kufanele bazihluphe, njalo bathole ithuba lokubalekela lokhu. Amazwi esiprofethi ayachaza ukuthi ingilosi yakuqala izakwenza isimemezelo sayo “kwabakhileyo emhlabeni, kuzo zonke izizwe, lemihlobo, lezindimi labantu bonke.” Isixwayiso sengilosi yesithathu, esigoqela udaba lwengilosi lezi ezintathu, laso kumele sifinyelele umhlaba wonke. Sivezwe emazwini esiprofethi ngokuthi sikhulunywa ngelizwi elikhulu, yingilosi endiza emkhathini, njalo sizakwenza ukuthi umhlaba wonke ulalele. {GC 449.2}

Ekucineni wonke amaKrestu azaba semaqenjini amabili, labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu njalo lokholo lukaJesu, njalo lalabo abakhonza isilo lomfanekiso waso njalo abazakwamukela uphawu lwakhe. Loba nje ibandla kanye lombuso kuzasebenzisana ndawonye ukubamba ngamandla “abakhulu labancane, izinothi labaswelayo, izigqili labakhululekileyo” (Sambulo 13:16), ukuthi bamukele “uphawu lwesilo,” loba kunjalo abantu bakaNkulunkulu abasoke balwamukele. Umprofethi wasePatmosi “ubona labo abasebesinqobile isilo lomfanekiso waso lesibalo sebizo laso bemi eceleni kolwandle lwengilazi, bephethe amachacho kaNkulunkulu” njalo behlabela ingoma kaMose leyeWundlu. (Sambulo 15:2,3). {GC 450.1}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 26 — Umsebenzi Wemvuselelo.

Umsebenzi wokuvuselela iSabatha ozakwenziwa ngezinsuku zokucina uveziwe encwadini kaIsaya: “INkosi ithi: Nanzelela okufaneleyo, wenze ukulunga, ngoba ukusilisa kwami kuseduze ukufika, lokukhulula kwami kuzabonakaliswa. Ubusisiwe umuntu owenza lokhu, lendodana ebambelele kukho, ogcina iSabatha, engaloni, lothinta isandla sakhe ukuba singenzi okubi. Labezizwe abazihlanganisa leNkosi ukuyikhonza lokuthanda ibizo layo, babe yizinceku zayo, bonke abagcina iSabatha, bengaloni bebambelela esivumelwaneni sami, laba ngizabaletha entabeni yami engcwele, ngibathokozise endlini yami yokukhulekela.” (Isaya 56:1,2,6,7). {GC 451.1}

Amazwi lawa akhuluma ngesikhathi esiphila kiso, ngendlela okuboniswe ngalokho okwenzakalayo esikhathini esiveziweyo: “INkosi uNkulunkulu ebuyisa abathunjiweyo bakoIsrayeli ithi: Ngisezakubuyisa abanye futhi ngaphandle kwalabo asebebuyisiwe.” (Isaya 56:8). Lapha kuvezwe ukubuthwa lokungeniswa kwalabo abezizweni okwenziwa livangeli. Njalo phezu kwalabo abamukela iSabatha ngemva kokwamukela ivangeli, kubekwe isibusiso. Ngakhoke umlandu wokugcina iSabatha udlulela langemuva kokufa kukaKrestu, lokuvuka njalo lokwenyuka kwakhe esiya ezulwini, kusiya fika esikhathini lapho inceku zakhe ezizatshumayeza khona umhlaba wonke ngodaba olumnandi oluletha injabulo. {GC 451.2}

INkosi iyasilaya futhi isebenzisa umprofethi ofananayo: “Abafundi bami kabagoqe umqulu wobufakazi, banameke imfundiso yami.” (Isaya 8:16). Uphawu lomthetho kaNkulunkulu lutholakala emthethweni wesine. Lowu kuphela kuyo yonke elitshumi, ubeka kucace ibizo njalo lesikhundla salowo onika imilayo leyi. Umveza njengoMdali wezulu lomhlaba, ngakhoke uveza isizatho sokuthi kungani kumele akhonzwe phezu kwabo bonke. Ngaphandle kwamazwi lawa akulalutho emthethweni elitshumi ebonisa ukuthi imithetho leyi yanikwa ngamandla kabani. Nxa iSabatha laselitshintshwe ngupapa, uphawu lolu lwasuswa phakathi kwemithetho elitshumi. Abafundi bakaJesu namhlanje babizelwa ukuthi bawuvuselele ngokuphakamisa iSabatha elingumthetho wesine belibisele endaweni yalo eqondileyo njengesikhumbuzo soMdali njalo lophawu lwamandla wakhe. {GC 452.1}

“Emthethweni njalo lasemazwini weNkosi ayibufakazi.” Loba nje imfundiso eziphikisanayo zikhona, umthetho kaNkulunkulu yiwo kuphela umthetho ongayenzi iphutha okumele yonke imibono, lemfundiso, njalo lentshumayele zihlolwe ngawo. Umprofethi uthi: Nxa bengakhulumi okuvumelana lelizwi leli, kungenxa yokuthi akulakukhanya kibo.” (Isaya 8:20). {GC 452.2}

Umlayo lowu uveziwe futhi: “INkosi ithi: Memeza ngelizwi elikhulu, ungathuli, uphakamise ilizwi lakho njengelophondo, utshengise abantu bami iziphambeko zabo, lendlu kaJacobe izono zayo. Bayangidinga insuku zonke, bathanda ukwazi indlela zami kungathi bayisizwe esithanda ukwenza ukulunga, esingatshiyanga ukwahlulela kukaNkulunkulu waso, bebuza kimi izahlulelo zokulunga, bethanda ukusondela kuNkulunkulu.” (Isaya 58:1,2). Lapha kuvezwe iqula labantu abacabanga ukuthi bangcwele njalo ababonakala sengathi bathanda ukusebenzela uNkulunkulu, kodwa amazwi alukhuni walowo owenelisa ukuhlola inhliziyo abavezela ukuthi banyathezela phansi imithetho yakhe engcwele. {GC 452.3}

Umprofethi uveza ngale indlela umlayo lowu abantu asebewukhohliwe: “Amadodana akho azakwakha amanxiwa akho amadala, uvuse lezisekelo ezindala. Uzakuthiwa ungumvali wesikhala, lomlungisi wezindlu ezadilikayo, ukuba kuhlalwe kuzo. Uba ungoni iSabatha, ungenzi umsebenzi wakho ngosuku lwami olungcwele, ulibize iSabatha ngokuthi liyintokozo, losuku olungcwele lweNkosi ngokuthi lulodumo, uba ulihlonipha ngokungahambi langokungasebenzi ngalo, langokungakhulumi ize.” (Isaya 58:12-14). Amazwi lawa lokhe eqinisekile lasesikhathini esiphila kiso khathesi. Isikhala senziwa emlayweni kaNkulunkulu nxa iSabatha laseliguqulwe ngamandla weRoma. Kodwa isikhathi sesifikile ukuthi umlayo lowu uvuselelwe. Isikhala lesi kumele sivalwe njalo isisekelo senzalo yonke kusukela ekudalweni komhlaba kumele sivuselelwe. {GC 452.4}

Ngemva kokungcweliswa yikuphumula njalo lokubusisa koMdali, iSabatha lagcinwa nguAdamu ngaphambi kokona kwakhe ensimini yaseEdeni, njalo languAdamu ngemva kokuwa kwakhe, nxa wayesexotshelwe phandle kwendawo yakhe yentokozo. Lagcinwa njalo yibo bonke abaphila ngemva kwakhe kusukela kuAbela kusiya kuNowa, kusiya kuAbrahama, lakuJacobe. Nxa abakhethekileyo babesebugqilini elizweni laseGibithe, abanengi phakathi kokukhonzwa kwezithombe, bakhohlwa imilayo kaNkulunkulu, kodwa nxa iNkosi yaseyikhulule isizwe sakoIsrayeli, wabanika umthetho wakhe ngomdumo omkhulu phambi kwabo entabeni yaseSinai, ukwenzela ukuthi bazi intando yakhe bamesabe njalo bamhloniphe inaphakade. {GC 453.1}

Kusukela ngalolo suku kusiya fika khathesi ulwazi lomthetho kaNkulunkulu aluzake luphele emhlabeni, njalo iSabatha elingumthetho wesine lokhe ligcinwa. Loba nje “indoda yesono” yenelisa ukuvoxa ngaphansi kwenyawo usuku lukaNkulunkulu olungcwele, loba kwakunjalo langesikhathi lapho ayebusa khona, kwakukhona ababecatshe endaweni ezimbalwa ababelokhe belugcina ngcwele. Kusukela ngesikhathi seMvuselelo, kulokhe kulabantu abathile ngazo zonke izikhathi abalokhe begcina usuku lweSabatha ngcwele. Loba nje ezikhathini ezinengi bebekwenza lokhu ngaphansi kokuhlukunyezwa lokuchothozwa, ubufakazi obuqhubekayo bebulokhe bukhona ubuyenze ukuthi umthetho kaNkulunkulu uhlale ukhona kanye lomlandu ongcwele owokugcina iSabatha elasungulwa ekudalweni komhlaba. {GC 453.2}

Amaqiniso lawa, ngendlela avezwe ngayo kuSambulo 14 ndawonye “levangeli laphakade,” azakwehlukanisa ibandla likaKrestu ngesikhathi sokuza kwakhe. Ngoba njengomphumela wokutshunyayelwa kodaba lolu olwengilosi ezintathu kuvezwe ukuthi: “Nanti ithuba lokubekezela kwabangcwele, labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu njalo lokukholwa kukaJesu.” (Sambulo 14:12). Njalo udaba lolu ngolokucina oluzatshunyayelwa emhlabeni ngaphambi kokuza kweNkosi. Ngemva kokumenyezelwa kodaba lolu iNdodana yomuntu yabonwa ngumprofethi, isiza emayezini izobutha isivuno emhlabeni. {GC 453.3}

Labo abamukela ukukhanya mayelana lethempeli njalo lokungaguquki komthetho kaNkulunkulu bagcwala intokozo njalo lokumangala nxa babebona ubuhle njalo lokuvumelana kwamaqiniso lawa abasebenikwe ithuba lokuthi bewazwisise. Bafisa ukuthi ukukhanya lokhu okwakuvezwe kwaba ligugu emehlweni wabo kwaziswe wonke amaKrestu, njalo abazange bakholwe okunye ngaphande kokuthi kwakuzakwamukelwa ngabanye ngentokozo. Kodwa amaqiniso ayezabahlukanisa lomhlaba awazange amukelwe yinengi labantu ababezibiza ngokuthi bangabalandeli bakaKrestu. Ukulandela umthetho wesine kwakudinga ukuzinikela abanengi abangazange bakuthande. {GC 454.1}

Nxa amaqiniso weSabatha ayevezwa phambi kwabantu, abantu abanengi bacabanga njengalabo abomhlaba. Bathi bona: “Kudala sigcina usuku lwangeSonto, labokhokho bethu babegcina lolu usuku, njalo abantu abanengi abalungileyo sebafa belugcina ngentokozo. Nxa babengenzanga iphutha ngakho lokhu kutsho ukuthi lathi asenzanga iphutha. Ukugcina iSabatha leli elitsha kuzabangela ukuthi singahambelani lomhlaba, njalo asingeke sisaba lendonsela phezu kwabo. Kuyini iqula elincane eligcina usuku lweSabatha elingakwenza nxa liphikisana lomhlaba wonke ogcina usuku lweSonto?” Kwakungenxa yokusebenzisa amazwi afananayo ukuthi amaJuda azame ukuphika uKrestu. Okhokho babo babeyamukelwe nguNkulunkulu nxa babeletha imnikelo yabo, njalo kungani abantwana babengeke bathole usindiso nxa babelandela indlela efananayo? Kwakunjalo ngesikhathi sikaLuther lapho abathungameli bebandla leRoma abacabanga ukuthi amaKrestu aqotho ayefele phakathi kwenkolo yebandla leRoma, njalo lokho kwakusitsho ukuthi inkolo yabo yayifanele ukuthi umuntu athole usindiso. Umcabango onjalo wabayisizatho sokuthi kube lomgoqo owavimbela ukuthi ivangeli lihambe endaweni zonke njalo lihlale limsulwa. {GC 454.2}

Inengi labo lama emazwini wokuthi ukugcinwa kosuku lweSonto kwakube yimfundiso emileyo kusukela endulo njalo lwalube yinsika yebandla okweminyaka eminengi. Ukuphikisa umbono lowu kwavezwa ukuthi ukugcinwa kweSabatha kwakuqale kudala kakhulu, ngoba kwakusukela ekudalweni komhlaba, njalo kwakubekwe nguNkulunkulu uqobo lwakhe. Nxa umhlaba wawudalwa, nxa inkanyezi zokusa zazihlabela zonke, njalo indodana zonke zikaNkulunkulu zazimemeza ngenjabulo, yikho lapho iSabatha eladabuka khona. (Jobe 38:6,7) ; Genesisi 2:1-3). Kufanele ukuthi usuku lolu ludinge ukuba siluhloniphe, ngoba aluzange lubekwe ngamandla womuntu njalo alweyamanga phezu kwamasiko wabantu, kodwa lwasungulwa nguMdala weziNsuku njalo lwanikwa yilizwi lakhe elimi kuze kube nininini. {GC 454.3}

Nxa amehlo abantu ayedonselwa endabeni yokuvuselela iSabatha, abafundisi bamabandla amakhulu baqala ukutshintsha ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, bafaka ingcazelo ebufakazini balo ezazizabangela ukuthi zithulise labo ababefisa ukuzwisisa iqiniso. Njalo labo abangazange bahlolisise iMbhalo ngokwabo basuthiseka ngokuthi bamukele ingcazelo ezazivumelana lezifiso zabo. Ngokuphikisa, lobuqili, lamasiko abokhokho babo, njalo lamandla webandla, abantu abanengi bazama ukunyathezela iqiniso. Labo ababetshumayela iqiniso benza yonke imizamo yokuveza ubufakazi beBhayibhili obubonisa ukuthi umthetho wesine ugxile elizwini likaNkulunkulu. Amadoda ayelokuzehlisa njalo ehlome ngeBhayibhili kuphela, enelisa ukumelana lamazwi wamadoda ayeqeqetshile, ayejwayele ukusebenzisa ulaka lokubajuma, kodwa konke lokhu kwenza ukuthi benanzelele ukuthi konke ukuhlakanipha kwabo kwakungeke kuphikise ukuhlakanipha kwalabo ababeyame eBhayibhilini kuphela hatshi ekuhlakanipheni kwezikolo. {GC 455.1}

Ngenxa yokuswela ubufakazi obuvela eBhayibhilini obabusekela imicabango yabo, inengi labo lasebenzisa amazwi asetshenziswa yilabo ababephikisa uJesu njalo labafundi bakhe besithi: “Kungani labo abafundileyo abaphakathi kwethu bengazwisisi umbuzo lowu weSabatha? Kodwa balutshwana abakholwa lokho elikukholwayo. Ngeke kutsho ukuthi lina yini eliqondileyo njalo wonke lawa amadoda afundileyo akholwa amanga.” {GC 455.2}

Ukuze bamelane lamazwi lawa kwakudingeka ukuthi basebenzise amazwi weBhayibhili kuphela njalo lembali yendlela iNkosi eyayisebenza labantu bayo kusukela endulo. UNkulunkulu usebenza ngalabo abezwayo njalo balalele ilizwi lakhe, labo nxa kudingeka abazakhuluma amaqiniso anzima ukwamukeleka, njalo labo abangesabi ukuveza izono ezithandwa ngumuntu wonke. Isizatho sokuthi angavami ukukhetha abantu abafundileyo njalo abalezikhundla eziphezulu ukuthi bathungamele umsebenzini wokuvuselela yikuthi bandise ukuthembela emasikweni, lasemfundweni yabo, njalo abayiboni indingeko yokuthi bafundiswe nguNkulunkulu. Labo kuphela abalobudlelwano loMthombo wenhlakanipho yibo abenelisa ukuzwisisa kumbe ukuchasisa iBhayibhili. Abantu abalemfundo encinyane ezikolo zasemhlabeni kwesinye isikhathi bayabizwa ukuthi batshumayele ivangeli leqiniso, hatshi ngoba abafundanga, kodwa ngoba abalakho ukuzithemba okungabangela ukuthi bale ukufundiswa nguNkulunkulu. Bayafunda esikolo sikaKrestu, njalo ukuzithoba lokulalela kwabo kubenza baphakame kakhulu. Nxa ebanika ulwazi lweqiniso lakhe, uNkulunkulu ubanika udumo, olungeke luqathaniswe lalolu olwasemhlabeni. {GC 455.3}

Inengi labantu ababelindele ukuza kukaKrestu baphika amaqiniso ayephathelane lethempeli likaNkulunkulu elisezulwini njalo lomthetho kaNkulunkulu, njalo abanengi babo baphika ukholo lwabo lokuthi ukuza kweNkosi kwasekusondele bamukela imfundiso eziphikisanayo ezazisetshenziswa ukuchaza amazwi wesiprofethi. Abanye bathunganyelwa ukuthi benze amaphutha, baqhubeka befaka insuku lapho ababesithi uJesu wayezakuza khona. Ukukhanya okwasekukhanya manje mayelana lendaba yethempeli lasezulwini kwakumele kubabonise ukuthi awakho amazwi esiprofethi amayelana lesikhathi esithile ayezaqhubeka kuze kuyefika ukuza kukaKrestu kwesibili, njalo lokuthi usuku lokuza kwakhe asiluphiwanga. Kodwa nxa basebefulathele ukukhanya, baqhubeka bebeka insuku lapho ababesithi iNkosi yayizakuza khona, ngokwenza njalo babehlala bedangele ngoba akuzange kwenzeke ngaleyo indlela. {GC 456.1}

Nxa ibandla laseThesalonika laselamukele imibono yamanga mayelana lokuza kukaKrestu, umpostoli uPhawuli wabathumela umbiko wokuthi bahlolisise amathemba wabo ngokunanzelela besebenzisa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu. Wababuyisela emazwini wesiprofethi ayechaza izehlakalo ezazizakwenzeka ngaphambi kokuza kukaKrestu, njalo wababonisa ukuthi babengela sizatho sokumbona ngesikhathi ababephila kiso. “Kungabikhona umuntu olikhohlisayo langayiphi indlela” (2 Thesalonika 2:3), yiwo amazwi wakhe wokuxwayisa. Nxa babeqhubeka besiba lethemba elingasekelwa nguMbhalo, babezathunganyelwa ukuthi bathathe inyathelo elingalunganga, njalo ukudangala kwakuzabangela ukuthi bahlekwe ngabangakholwayo, njalo babezaba sengozini yokulahla ithemba njalo balingeke ukuthi bathandabuze amaqiniso aqakathekileyo ekusindisweni kwabo. Isixwayiso esinikwa nguPhawuli ebantwini baseThesalonika simumethe isifundo esikhulu kulabo abaphila ngezinsuku zokucina. Abantu abanengi abalindele ukuza kweNkosi balokucabanga ukuthi nxa bengabekanga usuku oluthize lokuza kweNkosi ngeke basebenze ngokukhuthala okwaneleyo emzameni yabo yokumlungela. Kodwa nxa amathemba wabo esiya ekhula, abuye angagcwaliseki, ukukholwa kwabo kuyehla kuze kuyefika ezingeni lapho okuba nzima khona ukuthi bathintwe ngamaqiniso amayelana lamazwi wesiprofethi. {GC 456.2}

Ukutshunyayelwa kwesikhathi esithile esokufika kwehola lokwahlulela, ekutshunyayelweni kodaba lwengilosi yakuqala, kwakuthunganyelwe nguNkulunkulu. Ukuvezwa kwezikhathi lezi ezazichazwa ludaba lolu ezazibeka ukuphela kwensuku ezingu2300 emnyakeni ka1844, kumi lalamuhla kuqondile. Imizamo eyenziwayo ukusa lamalanga eyokudinga ezinye insuku zokuqala lokuphetha kwesikhathi lesi esichazwa nguDanyeli, njalo lokusebenzisa imicabango yabantu ukusekela imibono leyi, kuthungamela abantu khatshana leqiniso, njalo kwenza inhlekisa yonke imizamo yokuchaza amazwi wesiprofethi. Ngazo zonke izikhathi nxa abantu bebeka usuku oluthile lokuza kukaKrestu, njalo nxa lokhu kufundiswa phakathi kwabantu, kwenza ukuthi uSathane ajabule kakhulu. Nxa isikhathi lesi sesidlulile, wenza ukuthi labo abakholwa lokhu babeyinhlekisa emphakathini, ngokwenza njalo ululaza umsebenzi omkhulu owenziwa zinceku zikaNkulunkulu kusukela ngomnyaka ka1843 kusiya ku1844. Labo abaqhubeka bekholwa iphutha leli ekucineni bazafaka usuku olukhatshana kakhulu okwedlula lapho uKrestu azabuya khona. Ngalokho bazahlala ethembeni lamanga njalo abanengi bazahlala bekholwa lokhu umusa uze uvalwe. {GC 457.1}

Imbali yesizwe sako Israyeli endulo iyisibonelo esihle salokho iqula labantu abakholwa ngokuza kukaKrestu abadlula kikho. UNkulunkulu wathungamela abantu bakhe emsebenzini wokumemezela ngehola lokwahlulela, ngendlela efanayo athungamela ngayo abantwabakhe besuka eGibhithe. Phakathi kokudangala abadlula kikho ukholo lwabo lwahlolwa njengalokhu okwenzeka ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli phambi kolwandle olubomvu. Ngabe babeqhubeke bethembele esandleni esithungamelayo esasibe labo ehambeni lwabo, babezabona usindiso lukaNkulunkulu. Ngabe bonke ababesebenze ngokubambana emsebenzini abawenza ngomnyaka ka1844, babeyamukele udaba lwengilosi yesithathu njalo balumemezela ngamandla kaMoya oyiNgcwele, iNkosi yayizaletha isivuno esikhulu ngenxa yemizamo yabo. Isikhukhula sokukhanya sasizakwehliselwa emhlabeni. Emnyakeni eminengi edlulileyo izakhamizi zomhlaba zazizathola isixwayiso lesi, lomsebenzi wokucina ngabe sewenziwa, njalo uKrestu ngabe sewabuya ukuzolanda abantu bakhe. {GC 457.2}

Kwakungasiyo intando kaNkulunkulu ukuthi isizwe sakoIsrayeli sibhudule enkangala okweminyaka engamatshumi amane, wayefisa ukubathungamela elizweni laseKhenani ababeke lapho, njengabantu abangcwele, njalo abagcwele intokozo. Kodwa “abenelisanga ukungena khona ngenxa yokungakholwa.” (Amaheberu 3:19). Ngenxa yokuhlehlela emuva lokufulathela iqiniso bafela enkangala, njalo abanye baphakanyiswa ukuthi bangene elizweni lesithembiso. Ngendlela efananayo, kwakungasiyo intando kaNkulunkulu ukuthi ukuza kukaKrestu kuthathe isikhathi eside kangaka njalo lokuthi abantu bakhe bahlale isikhathi esingaka emhlabeni wesono njalo losizi. Kodwa ukungakholwa yikho okwabahlukanisa loNkulunkulu. Nxa babesala ukwenza umsebenzi ayebanike wona, abanye bavuswa ukuthi bamemezele udaba lolu. Ngenxa yomusa wakhe, uJesu lokhe ephuza ukuza kwakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi izoni zibelethuba lokuzwa izixwayiso zakhe njalo zithole kuye indawo yokuphepha phambi kokuthi ulaka lukaNkulunkulu luthelwe emhlabeni. {GC 458.1}

Khathesi njengasendulo, ukutshunyayelwa kweqiniso elikhuza izono njalo lamaphutha ezikhathi esiphila kuzo kuzabangela ukuthi kubelalabo abamelana leqiniso. “Ngoba ilowo lalowo owenza okubi uzonda ukukhanya, kezi ekukhanyeni ukuba imisebenzi yakhe ingasolwa.” (Johane 3:20). Nxa abantu bebona ukuthi kabenelisi ukusekela lokho abakukholwayo ngelizwi likaNkulunkulu, abanengi babo bayazimisela ukubambelela enkolweni yabo, njalo ngomoya omubi bayenza imizamo yonke ukulwisana lesimo njalo lenjongo zalabo abama ngesibindi ukuveza imfundiso zamanga ezamukelwa ngumuntu wonke. Yiyo indlela efanayo eyayisetshenziswa kusukela endulo. Uprofethi uElijah wabizwa ngokuthi nguye owayehlupha isizwe sako Israyeli, uJeremiya bambiza umthengisi, uPhawuli bathi ngongcolisa ithempeli. Kusukela ngalezo nsuku kuzofika kathesi, labo abazimisela ukumela iqiniso lokhe bebezwa ngamabizo amanengi, agoqela ukuthi bangabakhohlisi, labafundisi bamanga, njalo bangabazonda ukuthula. Amaxuku abantu abangalakukholwa okusezingeni eliphezulu kangaka abangafuni ukwamukela ilizwi lesiprofethi eliqinisekileyo, bazakwamukela ngenjabulo wonke amanga alethwa kibo mayelana lalabo abaveza izono ezithandwa ngumuntu wonke emphakathini. Umoya lowu uzabe ulokhe ukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Njalo iBhayibhili liyafundisa sobala ukuthi isikhathi siyeza lapho okuzafakwa khona imithetho yelizwe ezaphikisana lemithetho kaNkulunkulu, okuzabangela ukuthi lowo lalowo okhetha ukulandela imithetho kaNkulunkulu abelesibindi sokumela ukuhlukunyezwa lokujeziswa njengomenzi wokubi. {GC 458.2}

Ngenxa yokwazi lokhu, uyini umsebenzi wesithunywa seqiniso? Kumele aphethe ngokuthi iqiniso akumelanga litshunyayelwe, njengoba izikhathi ezinengi libangela ukuthi abantu baliphike kumbe balivukele? Hatshi; kalasizatho esifaneleyo sokunyathezela ubufakazi belizwi likaNkulunkulu, ngenxa yokuthi lenza ukuthi kubelezitha, ngendlela efana laleyo eyalabo abenza umsebenzi weMvuselelo endulo. Izenzo zokukholwa ezenziwa ngabangcwele lalabo abafela iqiniso zabhalelwa ukuthi ziqinise izizukulwane zabo. Izibonelo zalabo abema ngesibindi bakhetha ubungcwele njalo lokulunga seziqinise abanengi ababizelwe ukuma njengofakazi bakaNkulunkulu. Bamukela umusa leqiniso hatshi ukuthi kube ngokwabo kuphela, kodwa ukuba ngenxa yabo, ulwazi lukaNkulunkulu lungakhanyisa umhlaba wonke. Kambe uNkulunkulu unikile yini ukukhanya kwakhe inceku zakhe enzalweni leyi? Nxa kunjalo kumele bakhanyisele umhlaba wonke. {GC 459.1}

Endulo uNkulunkulu watshela lowo owayekhuluma ngegama lakhe wathi: “Indlu yakoIsrayeli ayisoke ikulalele, ngoba abafuni ukungilalela mina.” Wabuya wathi futhi: “Uzakukhuluma amazwi wami kibo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bazalalela kumbe bazaphika.” (Hezekeli 3:7; 2:7). Encekwini kaNkulunkulu lamhlanje nanka amazwi anikwa wena: “Phakamisa ilizwi lakho njengophondo, utshele abantu bami iziphambeko zabo.” (Isaya 58:1). {GC 459.2}

Kusiya ngokuthi amathuba wabo angakanani, wonke umuntu owamukele ukukhanya kweqiniso ulomlandu osabekayo ofana lalowo owawusemahlombe womprofethi wako Israyeli, ilizwi leNkosi eleza kuye lisithi: “Wenake ndoda, ngikubeke ukuthi ube ngumlindi koIsrayeli, ngakhoke nxa usizwa ilizwi elivela kimi, ubaxwayise. Uba ngisithi komubi: Wena muntu omubi, uzakufa impela, uba ungakhulumi wena ukumxwayisa omubi ukuba atshiye indlela yakhe, lowomuntu omubi uzafela esonweni sakhe, kodwa umlandu uzakuba ngowakho. Kodwa uba umxwayisa omubi ukuba aphenduke endleleni yakhe, angatshiyi indlela yakhe, uzafela esonweni sakhe, kodwa wena uzakuphepha.” (Hezekeli 33:7-9). {GC 459.3}

Umgoqo omkhulu owenza ukuthi abantu bangamukeli iqiniso kumbe bangalitshumayeli yikuthi ligoqela ukungahlaliseki njalo lokuhlukunyezwa. Yiwo lawa amazwi bonke abalitshumayelayo abangakaze bawaphike. Kodwa lokhu akuvimbeli abalandeli bakaKrestu beqiniso. Laba abagoqizandla ngoba belindele ukuthi iqiniso lamukelwe ngabantu bonke. Nxa benanzelela umlandu wabo, bayazimisela ukwamukela isiphambano, njengoPhawuli bebala ukuthi “ukuhlupheka kwethu okuncane, okwesikhatshana nje, kusenzela ubukhosi obukhulu njalo obungapheliyo,” njengomunye endulo, “owaphakamisa ukuthukwa kukaKrestu njengegugu eledlula inotho yaseGibhithe.” (2 Corinte 4:17; Amaheberu 11:26). {GC 460.1}

Loba sekungaba yini isikhundla sabo, yilabo kuphela abathanda umhlaba enhliziyweni zabo abakhetha ukulandela lokho okufundiswa ngabantu kulokuthi balandele iqiniso ezintweni eziphathelane lenkolo. Kumele sikhethe ukulunga ngoba kulungile, sitshiye umphumela wakhona ezandleni zikaNkulunkulu. Ebantwini abaqotho, abakholwayo, njalo abazimiseleyo, umhlaba ukweleda bona ngenxa yenguquko abayilethayo. Ngabantu abafana labo, umsebenzi wemvuselelo walamuhla kumele uthwalelwe phambili. {GC 460.2}

INkosi ithi: “Ngilalelani lina elazi ukulunga, abantu abalomlayo wami enhliziyweni zabo, lingesabi ukusola kwabantu, lingapheli amandla ngenxa yokuthuka kwabo. Ngoba inondo izakubadla njengengubo, lempethu ibadle njengoboya bezimvu; kodwa ukukhulula kwami kuzakuma kuze kube ninini, lokusilisa kwami ezizukulwaneni zonke.” (Isaya 51: 7,8). {GC 460.3}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 27 — Imvuselelo Zensuku Zalamuhla.

Kuzo zonke indawo lapho ilizwi likaNkulunkulu elitshunyayelwe khona ngokwethembeka, kube lomphumela oveze sobala ukuthi livela ezulwini. UMoya kaNkulunkulu wathungamela udaba lwenceku zakhe, njalo ilizwi lalilamandla. Izoni zezwa umzwangedwa wazo uthinteka. Ukukhanya okukhanyisela umuntu wonke ophila emhlabeni kwavula imphefumulo yabo, izinto zonke zobunyama ezifihlakeleyo zenziwa zabasobala. Bonke ababelele bezwa betshiseka enhliziyweni zabo. Bananzelela ububi bezono zabo njalo lokwahlulela okuzayo. Bananzelela njalo ubungcwele bukaJehova njalo bafikelwa yikwesaba bokuma phambi kwakhe belecala, njalo bengcolile, phambi kwakhe owenelisa ukuhlola inhliziyo. Ngokwesaba babubula bathi: “Ngubani ozangikhulula emzimbeni lowu wokufa?” Nxa isiphambano saseKhalvari, lomnikelo waso wawuvezwa kibo, bananzelela ukuthi uKrestu kuphela wayelungele ukususa izono zabo, njalo lokhu kuphela yikho okwakungavuselela ubudlelwano obabukhona phakathi kwabantu loNkulunkulu. Ngokukholwa njalo lokuzehlisa bamukela iWundlu likaNkulunkulu, elisusa izono zomhlaba. Ngenxa yegazi likaJesu bamukela ukuthethelelwa kwezono ababezenzile. {GC 461.1}

Abantu laba baletha izithelo ezazibonisa ukuphenduka kwabo. Babonisa ukukholwa njalo babhabhathizwa, basukuma ukuthi bahambe ngempilo entsha sebeyizidalwa ezintsha phambi kaJesu Krestu bengasalandeli inkanuko zabo zakudala, kodwa ngokukholwa kweNdodana kaNkulunkulu balandela ezinyaweni zakhe, baveza isimo sakhe, njalo bazihlambulula njengoba laye ehlambulukile. Izinto ababezizonda endulo basebezithanda, njalo lezinto ababezithanda basebezizonda. Labo ababelokuzigqaja lababezikhukhumeza baphenduka babangabazithobayo labazehlisayo. Labo ababethanda ukukhuluma ize baqala ukukhetha amazwi wabo. Abathanda ukukhuluma inhlamba baqala ukuzithiba, izidakwa zatshiya utshwala, lababi baba lokulunga. Izinto zomhlaba ezibunayo zabekwa eceleni. AmaKrestu awazange adinge “ukuceca kwangaphandle, okokwaluka inwele, lokufaka igolide, lokokugqoka izambatho, kodwa...ukuba ngumuntu osithekileyo wenhliziyo oceca ngokungagugiyo lomoya omnene lokuthula, okuligugu phambi kukaNkulunkulu.” (1 Petro 3:3,4). {GC 461.2}

Inguquko lemvuselelo leyi yaletha ukuzihlolisisa kwenhliziyo okujulileyo njalo lokuzehlisa. Yayibonakala ngamazwi ayencenga izoni, lokuthanda bonke abathengwa ngegazi likaKrestu. Amadoda labesifazane babethandaza belwisana loNkulunkulu bencenga ukuthi abantu basindiswe. Izithelo zemvuselelo leyi zazibonakala ebantwini ababengabalekeli ukuzidela lokuzinikela, kodwa ababejabulela ukuthi babetholakale befanele ukudlula phakathi kwenhlupho ngenxa yebizo likaKrestu. Abantu babona inguquko empilweni zalabo ababesithi bangabalandeli bakaJesu. Umphakathi wabusiseka ngenxa yendonsela yabo. Bahlanganela loKrestu, bahlanyela ngoMoya, ukuba bavune impilo enaphakade. {GC 462.1}

Kwakungakhulunywa ngabo ukuthi: “Ngoba laphendulwa ngokudabukiswa.” “Ngoba ukudabuka okuthwalwa ngendlela kaNkulunkulu kuletha ukuphenduka angezisole ngakho umuntu, kuveze ukusiliswa, kodwa ukudabuka okuthwalwa ngendlela yomhlaba kuletha ukufa. Khangelani, khona lokhu kudabukiswa kwenu okungendlela kaNkulunkulu kuveze kini ukukhuthala okungaka, lokuziphendulela, lokuthukuthela, lokwesaba, lokusilangatha, lokutshiseka, lokuthanda ukuba kwenziwe ukulunga. Kukho konke lazibonakalisa ukuthi kalilacala.” (2Korinte 7:9-11). {GC 462.2}

Lokhu kungumphumela womsebenzi woMoya kaNkulunkulu. Akulabufakazi obuqotho bokuphenduka kweqiniso ngaphandle kokuthi kulethe inguquko empilweni yomuntu. Nxa ebuyisela lokhu akuthembisileyo, njalo enikela futhi lokho akugodlileyo, evuma izono zakhe, futhi ethanda uNkulunkulu njengoba ethanda omakhelwane bakhe, isoni siyenelisa ukwazi ukuthi silokuthula loNkulunkulu. Zazinjalo izithelo emnyakeni edlulileyo ezazisiba khona ngemva komsebenzi wemvuselelo. Nxa babesehlulelwa ngezithelo zabo, babesazakala njengabantu ababusisiweyo phambi kaNkulunkulu ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo yokuletha usundiso phambi kwabantu lokuphakamisa uluntu. {GC 462.3}

Kodwa imisebenzi yemvuselelo eyensuku zalamuhla ibonisa imphumela ehlukeneyo kakhulu laleyo endulo eyayilandela imisebenzi yenceku zikaNkulunkulu. Kuliqiniso ukuthi abantu abanengi bayabuya emhlanganweni leyi, abanye babonisa ukuthi baphendukile, njalo kulabantu abanengi ababuya emabandleni ngokutshiyana kwawo, loba kunjalo izithelo zakhona azibonisi ukuthi sekube lokukhula empilweni yabo yokukholwa. Isibane lesi esikhanya okwesikhatshana siyacitsha, sitshiye umnyama wakhona udlula lowo obukhona ngaphambilini. {GC 463.1}

Imihlangano eminengi yemvuselelo ivame ukugxila ekwenzeni ubizo olukhuluma lemizwa kanye lembono yabantu, njalo luthinta imizwa yabantu evame ukwamukela loba yini ezwakala intsha kumbe engajwayelekanga. Abantu abaphenduka ngale indlela abafuni ukuzwa ngamaqiniso eBhayibhili, njalo lamazwi wabaprofethi kanye labafundi bakaJesu. Ngaphandle kokuthi inkonzo ibe lezinto ezibathokozisayo ngokwenyama, abafuni ukuhlanganela lapho. Intshumayelo edinga ukuthi baphenduke ngokweqiniso ayibavuseleli. Izixwayiso ezivela elizwini likaNkulunkulu, eziveza ngosindiso lwabo azilalelwa. {GC 463.2}

Kibo bonke abantu abaphenduke ngokweqiniso ubudlelwane babo loNkulunkulu njalo lazo zonke izinto ezithungamela empilweni enaphakade buba mqoka empilweni zabo. Kodwa ungaphi uMoya wokuzinikela kuNkulunkulu lamhlanje emabandleni ajwayelekileyo? Abantu abaphendukayo abenzi imizamo yokutshiya ubumina njalo lothando lwezinto zomhlaba. Abalasifiso sokuzidela, lokuthatha isiphambano, njalo balandele uJesu, njengalokho ababeyikho bengakaphenduki. Ukukhonza sekuphenduke kwaba ngumdlalo walabo abangakholwayo njalo labathandabuzayo ngoba inengi lalabo abakhonzayo abawazi amaqiniso weBhayibhili. Amandla wobungcwele awasekho emabandleni amanengi. Ukuzilibazisa phakathi kwemvelo, lonkonzo zemidlalo ebandleni, lembukiswano ebandleni, lamathempeli aligugu, lokuthandwa ukubonwa okwenziwa ngamalunga ebandla, sekwasusa imicabango kaNkulunkulu engqondweni zabo. Umhlaba lenotho njalo lemisebenzi yasemhlabeni yikho okuhlala kugcwele engqondweni zabantu, njalo izinto eziphathelane lezulu kuba nzima ukuthi abantu bacabange ngazo. {GC 463.3}

Loba kugcwele ukuwa kokholo lokulunga, kulokhe kulabalandeli bakaKrestu beqiniso emabandleni lawa. Ngaphambi kokufika kokwahlulela kukaNkulunkulu emhlabeni kuzakubakhona phakathi kwabantu beNkosi imvuselelo eqotho engakaze ibonakale kusukela ngensuku zabafundi bakhe. UMoya lamandla kaNkulunkulu kuzathelwa phezu kwabantwana bakaNkulunkulu. Ngalesosikhathi abantu abanengi bazazihlukanisa lamabandla lawa, lapho uthando lwezinto zomhlaba oseludlule uthando lukaNkulunkulu lelizwi lakhe. Abanengi, okugoqela abafundisi lamalunga ebandla, bazakwamukela amaqiniso lawa uNkulunkulu avumele ukuthi amemezelwe ngalesi sikhathi ukulungiselela abantu ukuza kweNkosi kwesibili. USathane ufisa ukuvimbela umsebenzi lowu, njalo ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzakale lokhu, uzazama ukukwenqabela lokhu ngokuletha imvuselelo yamanga. Emabandleni lawo ayenelisa ukuletha amandla wakhe wokukhohlisa uzakwenza kubonakale sengathi uNkulunkulu uthele uMoya wakhe kiwo, kubekhona abazakubona sengathi yimvuselelo yeqiniso. Amaxuku abantu azathokoza besithi uNkulunkulu ubenzela izimanga, khona umsebenzi lowu uzabe uvela emoyeni kaSathane. Ngaphansi kwengubo yokukhonza, uSathane uzazama ukwengeza indonsela yakhe phakathi kwamabandla wamaKrestu. {GC 464.1}

Endaweni ezinengi lapho okube lemvuselelo eminyakeni edlulileyo, amandla afananayo abesemsebenzini, azabonakala ngamandla ensukwini ezizayo. Kuvame ukuba lokusetshenziswa kwemizwa okwenza bantu bathabe, kuxutshaniswe iqiniso lamanga, okwenzelwe ukuthi kukhohlise abanengi. Loba kunjalo akula loyedwa okumele akhohliswe. Nxa kusetshenziswa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu akukho nzima ukubona isimo somoya ongamuva kwemvuselelo leyi. Kuyo yonke indawo lapho abantu abangasebenzisi khona ubufakazi beBhayibhili, befulathela amaqiniso lawa acacileyo ahlola inhliziyo zabantu njalo abizela abantu ukuthi bazidele njalo batshiye umhlaba lenkanuko zawo, endaweni enjalo silesiqiniseko sokuthi izibusiso zikaNkulunkulu azikho. Njalo ngokusebenzisa umthetho owanikwa nguKrestu ngokwakhe, “Lizabazi ngezithelo zabo” (Mathewu 7:16), kusobala ukuthi konke lokhu kwakungasiwo umsebenzi woMoya kaNkulunkulu. {GC 464.2}

Elizwini leBhayibhili, uNkulunkulu wanika abantu isambulo sakhe, njalo kibo bonke abalamukelayo liyisihawu esibavikela kuyo yonke imijibila kaSathane. Kungenxa yokulahla amaqiniso lawa okuvule umnyango wokuthi kungene bonke lobu ububi obuphakathi komhlaba ozobiza ngokuthi uyakhonza. Isimo njalo lokuqakatheka komthetho kaNkulunkulu, sekwalahlekela abantu abaphila emhlabeni lamhlanje. Ukuzwisisa okungaqondanga mayelana lesimo njalo lokuqakatheka komthetho kaNkulunkulu sekwabangela ukuthi izinga lokulunga lehliswe emabandleni. Lokhu yikho isizatho sokuthi kungabi loMoya njalo lamandla kaNkulunkulu kuyo yonke imvuselelo eyenziwayo lamhlanje. {GC 465.1}

Banengi abantu abaphakemeyo emabandleni amanengi njalo abalungileyo abakuvezayo labo lokhu. Omunye wabo ngu Professor Edwards A. Park owabhala wathi: “Eyinye yengozi ezikhona yikuyekela ukuqinisa umthetho okwenziwa ngamabathungameli nxa betshumayela. Emnyakeni edlulileyo intshumayelo zonke zazigxile ekuboniseni abantu ububi obesempilweni zabo...Abatshumayeli bethu abaphakemeyo babeletha amazwi alohlonzi ngenxa yokuthi babelandela umzekeliso kaKrestu, njalo babephakamisa umthetho, lemfundiso yawo, njalo lezixwayiso zawo. Babehlala bephinda izinto ezimbili, ukuthi umthetho ungumfanekiso wobungcwele, njalo lokuthi umuntu ongathandi umthetho kathandi ivangeli, ngoba umthetho kanye levangeli, kuyisibuko esiveza isimo sikaNkulunkulu ngokweqiniso. Ingozi leyi ithungamela kweyinye, eyinye ngeyokwehlisa ububi besono, ekucineni abantu bacina bengasasiboni isono empilweni zabo. Ubukhulu bokulunga bomthetho buyalingana lobubi bokungawulandeli... {GC 465.2}

“Eyinye ingozi ehambelana lalezi ingozi eziveziweyo, yingozi yokululaza ukwahlulela kukaNkulunkulu. Into ejwayele ukuyenziwa emabandleni amanengi yikukhipha ukwahlulela kukaNkulunkulu phakathi kothando lwakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi uthando lube yinto eyamukelekayo kulokuthi luphakamiswe njengendlela yokuphila. Imizamo yalamuhla yokuchaza iBhayibhili ngeyokuhlukanisa lokho uNkulunkulu akubambanisileyo. Umbuzo uthi, kambe umthetho kaNkulunkulu ulungile loba mubi? Impendulo yikuthi muhle. Nxa kunjalo kutsho ukuthi ukwahlulela kulungile, ngoba kungumzamo wokumisa umthetho. Kusukela emkhubeni wokwehlisa umthetho lokwahlulela, njalo lokwehlisa ukungahloniphi kwabantu, abantu bacina bewela emkhubeni wokwehlisa umusa lowo ophiweyo njengomnikelo wesono.” Ngale indlela ivangeli liyalahlekelwa ngamandla lokuqakatheka kwalo engqondweni zabantu, njalo ngemva kwesikhatshana bayabe sebelungele ukulahlela eceleni iBhayibhili ngokwalo. {GC 465.3}

Abantu abanengi abafundisa iBhayibhili bathi uKrestu nxa wayesifa walahlela khatshana umthetho, ngaleso sizatho abantu abasadingeki ukuthi bagcine imthetho elitshumi. Kukhona abanye abaletha umthetho bawuchaze njengejogwe elinzima, njalo nxa beqathanisa ubunzima bomthetho baletha inkululeko abantu abangayikholisa ngaphansi kwevangeli. {GC 466.1}

Kodwa abaprofethi labafundi bakaJesu abazange bawubone ngale indlela umthetho kaNkulunkulu ongcwele. UDavida wathi: “Ngizahamba ngokukhululeka, ngoba ngiyifundile imithetho yakho.” (Amahubo 119:45). Umpostoli uJacobe owabhala ngemva kokufa kukaKrestu, ubiza imthetho elitshumi ngokuthi “ngumthetho wesikhosini” njalo “lomthetho olungileyo wenkululeko.” (Jacobe 2:8; 1:25). Njalo lomambuleli, owaloba sekudlule iminyaka engamatshumi amahlanu ngemva kokubethelwa kukaKrestu ubeka isibusiso kulabo “abenza imilayo yakhe, ukuba babe lelungelo esihlahleni sokuphila, bangene emzini ngamasango.” (Sambulo 22:14). {GC 466.2}

Imfundiso yokuthi uKrestu ngokufa kwakhe walahla umthetho kaYise ayilasisekelo. Ngabe kwakuyenzeka ukuthi umthetho utshintshwe kumbe ulahlwe, kwakungeke kube lendingeko yokuthi uKrestu afe efela ukuthi abantu bangatholi umphumela wesono. Ukufa kukaKrestu kulokuthi kulahle umthetho kuyibufakazi bokuthi umthetho awuguquki. INdodana kaNkulunkulu yabuya ukuthi “izophakamisa umthetho, iwenze ukuthi uhlonipheke.” (Isaya 42:21). Wabuya wathi: “Lingacabangi kuthi ngibuye ukuzo chitha umthetho;” “kuze kudlule izulu lomhlaba kakusoze kudlule ibadlana libe linye ingabe icwatshana libe linye lomlayo.” (Mathewu 5:17,18). Njalo nxa wayekhuluma ngaye wathi: “Ngiyathanda ukwenza intando yakho, Nkulunkulu wami, umlayo wakho usenhliziyweni yami.” (Amahubo 40:8). {GC 466.3}

Umlayo kaNkulunkulu, ngokudalwa kwawo, awuguquleki. Uyisambulo sentando njalo lesimo salowo owawubhalayo. UNkulunkulu uluthando, njalo lomthetho wakhe uluthando. Insika yawo itholakala emfundisweni yokuthi kumele sithande uNkulunkulu njalo sithande omakhelwane. “Uthando luyikugcwalisa umthetho.” (Roma 13:10). Isimo sikaNkulunkulu siyikulunga leqiniso, umthetho lawo unjalo. “Umthetho wakho uliqiniso:” “imithetho yakho yonke iyikulunga.” (Amahubo 119:142, 172). Njalo lompostoli uPhawuli uthi: “Ngakhoke umlayo ungcwele, lomthetho ungcwele, ulungile, njalo muhle. (Roma 7:12). Umthetho onjalo oveza ingqondo njalo lentando kaNkulunkulu kumele uphile inaphakade njengomnikazi. {GC 467.1}

Kungumsebenzi wokuphenduka njalo lokungcweliswa owokubuyisa abantu kuNkulunkulu ngokubaletha esimeni lapho abazahamba ngokulunga okuvezwa ngumthetho wakhe. Ekuqaleni, umuntu wadalwa ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu. Wayelesimo esihambelana lesimo njalo lomthetho kaNkulunkulu, isisekelo sokulunga sasilotshwe enhliziyweni yakhe. Kodwa isono samhlukanisa loMdali wakhe. Ngemva kokuwa kwakhe walalekelwa ngumfanekiso kaNkulunkulu. Inhliziyo yakhe yaqala ukulwisana lomthetho kaNkulunkulu. “Ngoba ingqondo yesono iyibutha kuNkulunkulu, ngoba kayizehlisi ngaphansi komthetho kaNkulunkulu, impela ngeke kwenzeke.” (Roma 8:7). Kodwa “uNkulunkulu walithanda ilizwe kangaka waze wanikela ngeNdodana yakhe ezelwe yodwa,” ukwenzela ukuthi umuntu abuyiswe kuNkulunkulu. Ngenxa yokulunga kukaKrestu uyabuyiselwa ebudlelwaneni ayelabo loMdali wakhe. Inhliziyo yakhe kumele ivuselelwe ngumusa ovela ezulwini, kumele abe lempilo entsha evela ezulwini. Inguquko leyi, ichaza ukuzalwa kutsha, nxa kungekho, uJesu uthi, “ngeke awubone umbuso wezulu.” {GC 467.2}

Inyathelo lakuqala lokubuyisana loNkulunkulu yikubona izono ezisenhliziyweni. “Isono siyikwephula umthetho.” “Kungenxa yomthetho ukuthi sazi isono.” (1 Johane 3:4; Roma 3:20). Ukwenzela ukuthi isoni sibone ububi baso, kumele umuntu lowu asebenzise umgomo kaNkulunkulu wokulunga. Umthetho uyisibuko esibonisa ukulunga kwesimo esingcwele njalo uncedisa umuntu ukuthi abone ububi obusempilweni yakhe. {GC 467.3}

Umthetho uvezela abantu izono zabo, kodwa awulamandla wokuzisusa. Loba ngakolunye uhlangothi umthetho uthembisa impilo kulabo abawulalelayo, uyachaza ukuthi isiphetho salabo abawephulayo yikufa. Ivangeli likaKrestu kuphela yilo elilamandla wokukhulula umuntu esabelweni sokufa njalo lokungcoliswa yisono. Kumele avume izono zakhe phambi kaNkulunkulu, ngoba eyephule umthetho wakhe, njalo abelokukholwa kuJesu, onguye umnikelo wesono. Ngale indlela uyenelisa ukuthola “ukuthethelelwa kwezono zakudala” njalo ubalethuba lokuthola isimo sobungcwele. Uba ngumntwana kaNkulunkulu, ngemva kokwamukela umoya wokubuyisana lezulu, lapho akhala khona esithi: “Abha Baba!” (Roma 8:15). {GC 467.4}

Kambe manje usekhululekile ukuthi ayephule umthetho kaNkulunkulu na? UPhawuli uthi: “Ngakhoke siyawenza umlayo ube yize ngokukholwa na? Phinde! Kodwa siyawuqinisa umlayo.” “Thina esafa mayelana lesono singaba sisasila kanjani kuso na?” (Roma 3:31; 6:2). UJohane uthi yena: “Ngoba ukumthanda uNkulunkulu yilokhu ukuba sigcine imilayo yakhe, njalo lemilayo yakhe kayinzima.” (1 Johane 5:3). Ekuzalweni okutsha inhliziyo iyabuyiswa ekuvumalaneni lentando kaNkulunkulu, nxa ilethwa ngaphansi kwemfundiso yomthetho. Nxa inguquko leyi enkulu seyenzakele phakathi kwesoni, uyabe esesukile ekufeni waya ekuphileni, wasuka esonweni waya ebungcweleni, wasuka ekuhlamukeni waya ekulaleleni njalo lekwenzeni intando kaNkulunkulu. Impilo endala yokwehlukana loNkulunkulu iyabe isiphelile, njalo impilo entsha yokubuyisana, leyokukholwa, njalo lothando iyabe isiqalalile. Kulapho “ukulunga komthetho” okuzagcwaliseka “kithi, esingahambi ngokwabantu kodwa esihamba ngokukaMoya.” (Roma 8:4). Njalo amazwi womphefumulo azakuba ngathi: “Ngiyawuthanda umlayo wakho kangaka! Usuku lonke nginakana ngawo.” (Amahubo 119:97). {GC 468.1}

“Umlayo kaNkulunkulu uphelele, uvuselela umphefumulo.” (Amahubo 19:7). Nxa umthetho ungekho abantu abalalwazi olufaneleyo mayelana lobungcwele kanye lokulunga kukaNkulunkulu, kumbe ngobubi babo njalo lokungcola kwabo. Abalakho ukuthinteka ngenxa yezono zabo njalo ababoni indingeko yokuvuma izono zabo. Nxa bengaboni isimo sabo sokulahlwa njengalabo abephule umthetho kaNkulunkulu, abananzeleli ukuthi badinga igazi likaKrestu elisusa izono. Ithemba losindiso liyamukelwa lingela zithelo ezibonakala ngokuguquka kwenhliziyo njalo lempilo. Ngale indlela ukuphenduka okungasikho okuqotho kuyanda, njalo amaxuku abantu ayangena ebandleni bona bengakaze bahlangane loKrestu. {GC 468.2}

Imfundiso ezingaqondanga eziphathelane lokungcweliswa futhi eziphuma ekulahlweni kumbe ekuphikweni komthetho, ziyandile lamhlanje emabandleni amanengi. Imfundiso lezi azilasisekelo esiphuma eBhayibhilini njalo izithelo zazo ziyingozi, njalo ngesizatho sokuthi zamukelwa ngabantu abanengi kangaka, kwenza ukuthi kubemqoka ukuthi abantu bonke bazwisisa ukuthi iBhayibhili lifundisani mayelana lokungcweliswa. {GC 469.1}

Ukungcweliswa kweqiniso kuyimfundiso yeBhayibhili. Umpostoli uPhawuli nxa wayeloba incwadi eyayisiya ebandleni laseThesalonika uthi: “Intando kaNkulunkulu yikuba libe ngcwele.” Njalo uyakhuleka esithi: “UNkulunkulu wokuthula uqobo kalenze libe ngcwele ngokupheleleyo.” (1 Thesalonika 4:3; 5:23). IBhayibhili lifundisa sobala ukuthi kuyini ukungcweliswa njalo lokuthi kutholakala njani. UMsindisi wathandazela abafundi bakhe: “Bangcwelise ngeqiniso lakho, ilizwi lakho liliqiniso.” (Johane 17:17). Njalo uPhawuli laye ufundisa ukuthi abazalwane kumele “bangcweliswe nguMoya oyiNgcwele.” (Roma 15:16). Kuyini umsebenzi kaMoya oyiNgcwele? UJesu watshela abafundi bakhe ukuthi: “Nxa uMoya weqiniso esefikile, yena uzakuliholela eqinisweni lonke.” (Johane 16:13). Njalo umlobi wamahubo uthi: “Umlayo wakho uliqiniso.” Ngelizwi njalo loMoya kaNkulunkulu kuyavulwa phambi kwabantu imfundiso ezimqoka ezigoqelwe emlayweni wakhe. Njalo njengoba umlayo kaNkulunkulu “ungcwele, futhi ulungile, njalo umuhle,” wona ongamazwi achaza ubungcwele bezulu, kuyalandela ukuthi isimilo esibunjwa ngenxa yokulandela umlayo sizabangcwele. UKrestu uyisibonelo esifaneleyo sesimo esinjalo. Uthi yena: “Ngiyigcinile imilayo kaBaba.” “Ngenza ngazo zonke izikhathi lezo izinto ezimthokozisayo.” (Johane 15:10; 8:29). Abalandeli bakaKrestu kumele bafane laye, ngomusa kaNkulunkulu babumbe izimilo ezihambelana lemfundiso yomlayo wakhe ongcwele. Lokhu yikho ukungcweliswa okufundiswa liBhayibhili. {GC 469.2}

Umsebenzi lowu ungenziwa kuphela ngokukholwa kuKrestu, ngamandla kaMoya kaNkulunkulu ophila phakathi kwethu. UPhawuli uxwayisa abazalwane esithi: “Sebenzelani ukusindiswa kwenu ngokwesaba njalo lokuthuthumela. Ngoba uNkulunkulu nguye osebenza kini elenza ukuba lithande njalo lisebenzele intando yakhe.” (KwabaseFiliphi 2:12,13). UmKrestu uzakuzwa imizwa yokulingwa, kodwa uzaqhubeka elwisana layo. Lapha yikho usizo lukaKrestu oludingakala khona.
