Ubuthakathaka benyama buyabambaniswa lamandla wezulu, ukukholwa kumemeze kuthi: “Makubongwe uNkulunkulu, yena osinika ukunqoba ngeNkosi yethu uJesu Krestu.” (1 Korinte 15:57). {GC 469.3}

IBhayibhili liyabonisa sobala ukuthi umsebenzi wokungcweliswa uhlala uqhubeka. Nxa isoni ekuphendukeni kwaso sithola ukuthula loNkulunkulu ngenxa yegazi lokubuyisana, impilo yokuba ngumKrestu iqala lapho. Manje sekumele aqhubeke esiya ekulungeni, akhule esiya ezingeni lokuphelela kukaKrestu. UPhawuli uthi: “Kunye engikwenzayo, ngikhohlwa okungasemuva ngilalamele lokho okungaphambili, ngizame ukufika ekucineni, ngizuze umvuzo wokubizwa okukhulu kwaphezulu okukaNkulunkulu kuKrestu Jesu.” (KwabaseFiliphi 3:13, 14). Njalo uPetro uyabeka phambi kwethu amanyathelo achaza indlela ubungcwele beBhayibhili obutholakala ngayo: “Ngalokhoke zamani ngawo wonke amandla ukwengezelela ukulunga ekukholweni kwenu, lasekulungeni lengezelele ukwazi, lasekwazini ukuzithinta, lasekuzithinteni ukubekezela, lasekubekezeleni isimo sobunkulunkulu, lasesimeni sobunkulunkulu ukuthanda abazalwane, lasekuthandeni abazalwane uthando...ngoba uba lisenza lokhu kalisoze liwe futhi.” (2 Petro 1:5-10). {GC 470.1}

Labo abathola ukungcweliswa kweBhayibhili bazabonisa umoya wokuzehlisa. Njengo Mose, sebebonile ukuphakama kobungcwele, njalo sebebonile ukungafaneli kwabo nxa beqathanisa lokulunga njalo lokuphakama kukaSimakade. {GC 470.2}

Umprofethi uDanyeli wayeyisibonelo sokungcweliswa kweqiniso. Impilo yakhe ngobude bayo yayigcwele ukusebenzela iNkosi yakhe ngokuthembeka. Wayeyindoda eyayithandwa lizulu kakhulu. (Danyeli 10:11). Loba kunjalo kulokuthi athi ungcwele njalo umsulwa, umprofethi lowu ohloniphekayo wazibeka esimeni sobubi sesizwe sakoIsrayeli nxa wayencengela abantu bakibo phambi kaNkulunkulu: “Kasikhuleki kuwe ngenxa yokulunga kwethu, kodwa ngenxa yesihawu sakho esikhulu. “Sonile senza okubi”. Uthi yena: “Kwathi ngisakhuluma ngikhuleka, ngivuma izno zami lezono zabantu bakithi uIsrayeli.” Njalo ngemva kwesikhathi nxa iNdodana kaNkulunkulu yaseyifikele phambi kwakhe, ukuzomnika ilizwi, uDanyeli uthi: “Ngaphelelwa ngamandla, ubuso bami baguquka kubi.” (Danyeli 9:18, 15, 20; 10:8). {GC 470.3}

Nxa uJobe wayesizwa ilizwi leNkosi phakathi kwesivunguzane wathi: “Ngakhoke sengizisola, ngiyaphenduka ngihlale othulini lasemlotheni.” (Jobe 42:60). Kwakungemva kokuthi uIsaya abone ubukhosi bukaNkulunkulu, njalo wezwa ingilosi imemeza isithi,” Ingcwele ngcwele, ngcwele, iNkosi yamabandla,” lapho akhala khona wathi, “Maye mina ngafa! Ngoba ngingumuntu olendebe ezingcolileyo.” (Isaya 6:3, 5). UPhawuli nxa wayesethwalelwe phezulu njalo wezwa izinto ezingeke zifinyelele endlebeni zomuntu, ukhuluma ngaye, “njengomncane kubo bonke abangcwele.” (2 Korinte 12:2-4; Efesu 3:8). KwakunguJohane othandekayo, owayejwayele ukweyama esifubeni sikaJesu, owathi ebona inkazimulo yakhe, wawela phansi njengomuntu ofileyo phambi kwenyawo zengilosi. (Sambulo 1:17). {GC 471.1}

Ngeke kube lokuziphakamisa, lokuzitshaya isifuba besithi sebekhululiwe esonweni, okungenziwa yilabo abahamba ngaphansi kwethunzi lesiphambano. Bayananzelela ukuthi kwakungenxa yezono zabo ezabangela usizi lobuhlungu obephula inhliziyo yeNdodana kaKrestu, njalo umcabango lowu uzabathungamela ukuthi bazehlise. Labo abaphila eduzane loJesu bayananzelela sobala ubuthakathaka njalo lobubi bomuntu, njalo ithemba labo lisemandleni woMsindisi owabethelwayo njalo wabuya wavuka. {GC 471.2}

Ukungcweliswa okulokhe kukhula lamuhla emabandleni, kumumethe umoya wokuziphakamisa njalo lokungaphakamisi umlayo kaNkulunkulu, njalo lokhu kwenza ukuthi kubesobala ukuthi imfundiso leyi ayiveli eBhayibhilini. Labo abathungamela imfundiso leyo bafundisa ukuthi ukungcweliswa kungumsebenzi owenzeka khonapho khonapho, njalo ngokukholwa kuphela bayamukela ubungcwele obupheleleyo. Bathi “kholwa kuphela, njalo isibusiso sizaba ngesakho.” Akula okunye okumele kwenziwe ngulowo owamukelayo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo bayaphika amandla womthetho kaNkulunkulu, befundisa ukuthi sebakhululwa phakathi komlandu wokugcina imilayo. Kodwa kuyenzeka yini ukuthi abantu babengcwele, ngokwentando njalo lesimo sikaNkulunkulu, bengazange balandele amazwi ayiwo umbhalo omele isimo lentando yakhe, njalo abonisa lokho okumthokozisayo? {GC 471.3}

Isifiso sabantu sokuba lenkolo elula engadingi ukuzimisela, lokuzidela, lokungahlukani lenkanuko zomhlaba, sekwabangela ukuthi imfundiso yokukholwa, njalo ukukholwa kuphela, ibe yimfundiso ethandwa ngumuntu wonke, kodwa lithini ilizwi likaNkulunkulu? Umpostoli uJacobe uthi: “Bazalwane bami kusizani uba umuntu esithi ulokukholwa, kodwa engalayo imisebenzi na? Ukukholwa kwakhe kungamsilisa na? ...Sithuthandini, uyathanda ukwazi ukuthi ukukholwa okungelamsebenzi kuyize na? UAbrahama ubaba kalungisiswanga yini ngemisebenzi ekunikeleni kwakhe indodana yakhe uIsaka phezu kwelathi na? Uyabona ukuthi ukukholwa kwakusebenza kanye lemisebenzi yakhe, lokuthi ukukholwa kwapheleliswa ngemisebenzi? ...Liyabona ukuthi umuntu uyalungisiswa ngemisebenzi, kungesikho ngokukholwa kuphela.” (Jacobe 2:14-24). {GC 472.1}

Ubufakazi belizwi likaNkulunkulu buphikisana lemfundiso leyi ekhohlisayo eyokukholwa okungahambi lemisebenzi. Akusikho ukukholwa okuphakamisa ubuhle bezulu kodwa kungekho ukulandela imigomo eyiyo ebangela ukuthi umuntu athole umusa wezulu, lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yikuziphakamisa, ngoba ukukholwa okuqotho kulesisekelo sakho ezithembisweni njalo lasemilayweni etholakala eBhayibhilini. {GC 472.2}

Kakungabi khona abazikhohlisayo ngemfundiso yokuthi bengaba ngcwele bona besephula ngamabomo loba ngowodwa umlayo kaNkulunkulu. Ukwenziwa kwesono esaziwayo kwenza ukuthi ilizwi likaMoya oyiNgcwele lithule enhliziyweni njalo kuhlukanisa umphefumulo loNkulunkulu. “Isono siyikwephula umlayo.” Njalo “wonke umuntu owephula umlayo, akakaze ambone, kumbe abemazi.” (1 Johane 3:6). Loba uJohane egxila kakhulu ethandweni encwadini zakhe, kodwa kathandabuzi ukuchaza isimo esiqotho sequla lalabo abathi bangcwelisiwe bona bephila impilo ephambene lemilayo kaNkulunkulu. “Lowo othi: Ngiyamazi kodwa engagcini imilayo yakhe ungumqambi wamanga, leqiniso alikho kuye. Kodwa lowo ogcina ilizwi lakhe, uthando lukaNkulunkulu luphelelisiwe kuye impela.” (1 Johane 2:4,5). Lapha yikho okuhlolwa khona ukholo lomuntu wonke. Ngeke sibeke ubungcwele loba kuwuphi umuntu ngaphandle kokuthi simlethe phambi kwesikali sikaNkulunkulu esilinganisa ubungcwele ezulwini lase mhlabeni. Nxa abantu bengezwa umthwalo womlayo, nxa belulaza imithetho kaNkulunkulu, uba besephula omunye wemithetho leyi, njalo befundisa abantu ukuthi benze ngokufanayo, bazaba yisinengiso phambi kwezulu, njalo singakwazi ukuthi imfundiso yabo ayila sisekelo. {GC 472.3}

Njalo labo abathi abalasono, babonisa ubufakazi bokuthi lowo otshonjalo ukhatshana lobungcwele. Kungenxa yokuthi kaqedisisi ukulunga njalo lobungcwele bukaNkulunkulu kumbe lokho okumele bebeyikho labo abazafinyelela ezingeni lesimo sakhe, ngoba engalakho ukuqedisisa okufaneleyo mayelana lokulunga njalo lobuhle bukaJesu, njalo lobukhulu futhi lobubi besono, okungabangela ukuthi umuntu acabange ukuthi ungcwele. Ubude bebanga eliphakathi kwakhe loKrestu, bubangela ukuthi imicabango yakhe yokulunga kwezulu ibe mfitshane, azibone emehlweni wakhe engcwele kulalokho ayikho khona. {GC 473.1}

Ukungcweliswa okutholakala eBhayibhilini kugoqela ubomi bomuntu bonke, umoya, lomphefumulo, njalo lomzimba. UPhawuli wakhulekela abantu baseThesalonika ukuthi “kulondolozwe umoya wenu wonke lomphefumulo lomzimba, ukuze lingasoleki ekufikeni kweNkosi yethu uJesu Krestu.” (1 Thesalonika 5:23). Wabuya waloba futhi wathi: “Ngakhoke bazalwane ngiyalincenga ukuba, ngesihawu sikaNkulunkulu, linikele imizimba yenu ibe ngumnikelo ophilileyo, ongcwele, owamukelekayo kuNkulunkulu, kube yikukhonza kwenu okuqotho.” (Roma 12:1). Ngesikhathi sokuphila kwesizwe sakoIsrayeli endulo yonke iminikelo eyayilethwa phambi kweNkosi yayihlolisiswa kabanzi. Nxa kwakukhona ukugogeka kumbe okungalunganga enyamazaneni eyayilethiwe, yayingamukelwa, ngoba uNkulunkulu wayebaxwayisile ukuthi umnikelo kwakumele ubemsulwa. Ngokunjalo amaKrestu lawo ayaxwayiswa ukuthi alethe imizimba yawo “ibe ngumnikelo ophilileyo, ongcwele, owamukelekayo kuNkulunkulu.” Ukwenzela ukuthi kwenzeke lokhu, amandla wabo wonke kumele agcinwe esesimeni esihle kakhulu. Zonke izenzo ezenza ukuthi amandla wokucabanga njalo lawokusebenza ayehle zibangela ukuthi umuntu angafaneli ukusebenzela uMdali. Kambe uNkulunulu uzajabulela loba yini encane kulalokho esilamandla wokukunikela na? UKrestu wathi: “Uzathanda iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho ngenhliziyo yakho yonke.” Labo abathanda uNkulunkulu ngenhliziyo yabo yonke bazafisa ukumsebenzela ngezikhathi zonke, njalo bazahlala bedinga ukuletha wonke amandla wabo ukuthi ahambelane lemithetho eyenza kubelula ukuthi benze intando yakhe. Abasoke ngokulandela imizwa yabo lokudla loba yini, bengcolise kumbe babangele ukuthi umnikelo abawuletha phambi kaBaba ube ngogulayo. {GC 473.2}

UPetro uthi: “Lizigcine ezinkanukweni zomzimba ezilwa lomphefumulo wenu.” (1 Petro 2:11). Konke ukuzithokozisa esonweni kwenza ukuthi amandla lengqondo yakomoya ilale, njalo ilizwi loMoya kaNkulunkulu awenelisi ukuthinta inhliziyo yomuntu owenza lokhu. UPhawuli nxa ebhalela ibandla laseKorinte uthi: “Asizihlambulule kukho konke ukungcola komzimba lokomoya, siphelelise ubungcwele bethu sisesaba iNkosi.” (1 Korinte 7:1). Njalo ngezithelo zakoMoya, ezigoqela uthando, intokozo, ukuthula, ukubekezela, ukuthobeka, ukulunga, ukukholwa njalo lokuzehlisa” ukubiza “ngokuzithiba.” (Galathiya 5:22,23). {GC 474.1}

Loba sinikwe izixwayiso lezi, mangaki amaKrestu aqeda amandla wabo egijimisa inzuzo kumbe ukukhonza ubuhle bomhlaba, bangaki abangcolisa umfanekiso wabo ngenxa yokungakhethi lokhu abamele bakudle, kumbe ngokunatha okudakayo, langokuzithokizisa ngezinto ezingalunganga. Njalo ibandla kulokuthi likhuze ububi lobu, esikhathini esinengi liyakhuthaza ububi lobi ngokufuna ukuthokozisa abantu, lokwenza ukuthi abantu bahlale becabanga ngenotho lokuzithokozisa, ukwenzela ukuthi abantu banikele, okubangela ukuthi uthando lukaKrestu luphole. Ngabe uJesu ubengangena emabandleni walamuhla njalo abone ukuzithokizisa okwenziwa ngaphansi kwebizo lokumkhonza, ubengeke abaxotshele ngaphandle njengalabo abatshintsha imali ethempelini na? {GC 474.2}

Umpostoli uJacobe wakhuluma ukuthi ukukhalipha okuvela ezulwini kulungile. Ngabe wayehlangane lalabo abaphatha ibizo likaJesu endebeni zabo bengcoliswe yikubhema igwayi, njalo labo abangcoliswe liphunga lalo, njalo abangcolisa umoya wasezulwini njalo ababangela ukuthi bonke abaseduzane labo baphefumule umoya lowu oyingozi, ngabe umpostoli wayehlangane lesenzo lesi esiphikisana lokuhlanzeka kwevangeli, wayengeke akubize ngokuthi “ngokomhlaba, kubi njalo ngokukaSathane” na? Izigqili zegwayi, ezithi lazo zingcwelisiwe, zikhuluma ngethemba lokuba sezulwini, kodwa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu likubeka sobala ukuthi “kakusoze kwangena ulutho olungcolileyo kuwo.” (Sambulo 21:27). {GC 474.3}

“Kalazi yini ukuthi umzimba wenu ulithempeli likaMoya oNgcwele ohlezi kini, elimamukele kuNkulunkulu na? Kalisibo abenu, kodwa lathengwa ngentengo. Ngakhoke dumisani uNkulunkulu emizimbeni yenu. (1 Korinte 6:19,20). Lowo olomzimba wakhe olithempeli lika Moya oNgcwele, ngeke avumele ukuthi umzimba wakhe ube yisigqili sento ewungcolisayo. Amandla wakhe angaphansi kaKrestu, yena owamthenga ngentengo yegazi lakhe. Konke okwakhe ngokweNkosi. Kungenzeka njani ukuthi angabekwa icala lokudlalisa lokho akuphiweyo na? Abantu abanengi abazibiza ngokuthi bangamaKrestu iminyaka yonke badlalisa imali enengi ezintweni ezingelamsebenzi, khona imphefumulo isifa idinga ilizwi lokuphila. UNkulunkulu uphangwa iminikelo yakhe lokwetshumi, bona bechitha inotho yabo enkanukweni zomzimba okwedlula lokho abakunika abaswelayo kumbe ukuxhasa ivangeli. Ngabe bonke abazibiza ngokuthi bangabalandeli bakaKrestu bebengcwelisiwe ngokweqiniso, inotho yabo kulokuthi idlaliswe ezintweni ezingela msebenzi njalo lezilimaza umzimba, bezizalethwa esikhwameni sebandla, njalo amaKrestu ebezaba ngumzekeliso wokuzithiba, lokuzidela, njalo lokuzinikela. Ngokwenza njalo bebezakuba yikukhanya kwezwe. {GC 475.1}

Umhlaba uphila impilo yokuzithokozisa. “Inkanuko zomzimba, lokukhanga amehlo, lokuziqakisa kwalokhu kuphila” kulawula abantu amabengi. (1 Johane 2:16). Kodwa abalandeli bakaKrestu balobizo olungcwele. “Ngakhoke phumani phakathi kwabo, lahlukane labo, kutsho iNkosi; lingathinti okungcolileyo.” Nxa sisebenzisa ukukhanya okuselizwini likaNkulunkulu, kuqondile ukuthi sithi ukungcweliswa ngeke kube ngokuqotho nxa kungagoqeli umsebenzi wokutshiya isono lempilo yokudinga ukuzithokozisa kwasemhlabeni. {GC 475.2}

Kibo labo abalandela izixwayiso lezi ilizwi lithi, “Phumani phakathi kwabo, lahlukane labo...lingathinti okungcolileyo,” njalo isithembiso sikaNkulunkulu sithi, “Ngizalamukela, ngibe nguYihlo wenu, lina libe ngamadodana lamadodakazi ami, kutsho iNkosi uSomandla.” (2 Kotinte 6:17,18). Kungumlandu wamaKrestu wonke ukuthi babelobudlelwane obujulileyo emsebenzini kaNkulunkulu. “Mina ngiyikukhanya kwezwe,” watsho uJesu. “Ongilandelayo kasoze ahambe emnyameni, kodwa uzakuba lokukhanya kokuphila.” (Johane 8:12). “Indlela yabalungileyo injengovivi lokusa oluqhubeka ngokukhanya njalo kuze kube semini.” (Izaga 4:18). Amanyathelo wonke wokukholwa lokuthembeka asondeza umphefumulo ebudlelwaneni obujulileyo phakathi komuntu lowo lokukhanya kwezwe, lapho okungelabunyama khona. Insaba ezikhanyayo Zelanga Lokulunga ziyakhanyisa phezu kwenceku zikaNkulunkulu, njalo bacina bebonisa inkazimulo yakhe. Njengoba inkanyezi zisitshela ukuthi kulokhukhanya okukhulu ezulwini ezithola khona inkazimulo yazo, ngokunjalo amaKrestu kumele abonise ukuthi kuloNkulunkulu esihlalweni somhlaba wonke olesimo esifanele ukukhonzwa lokulingiselwa. Umusa woMoya wakhe, lokulunga njalo lobungcwele besimo sakhe, buzabonakala kubofakazi bakhe. {GC 475.3}

UPhawuli encwadini yakhe eyayisiya ebandleni laseKolose uveza izibusiso ezinikwa abantwana bakaNkulunkulu. Uthi: “Kasiyekeli ukulikhulekela lokulicelela ukuba ligcwaliswe ngokwazi intando yakhe ngokuhlakanipha konke lokuqedisisa okungomoya, lihambe ngokufanele iNkosi, liyithokozise ngakho konke, lithele izithelo emisebenzini yonke elungileyo, likhule ekumazini uNkulunkulu. Aliqinise ngamandla wonke ngokwamandla obukhosi bakhe, kuze kube khona ukubekezela lesineke lokujabula ezintweni zonke. (Kolose 1:9-11). {GC 476.1}

Uyabhala futhi ngesifiso sakhe sokuthi abazalwane base Efesu bangafinyelela ekwazini ubude besipho sokuba ngamaKrestu. Uyabavulela, ngamazwi ajulileyo, isimanga samandla lolwazi abangabalalo njengamadodana lamadodakazi kaSomandla. “Ukuba ngokwenotho yobukhosi bakhe liqiniswe ngamandla ngoMoya wakhe enhliziyweni. UKrestu ahlale enhliziyweni zenu ngokukholwa. Lokhu selilempande, lesisekelo othandweni. Kalibe lamandla okuqedisisa kanye labo bonke abangcwele ububanzi, lobude, lokudepha, lokutshona kothando lukaKrestu, lokulwazi lanxa lusedlula ukwazi konke.” Kodwa umthandazo wakhe ufinyelela esihlothini sokwamukela isipho nxa esithi “ukuze ligcwaliswe ngakho konke ukugcwala kukaNkulunkulu.” (Efesu 3:16-19). {GC 476.2}

Lapha kuvezwe ubude balokho esingakuthola ngokukholwa ezithembisweni zikaBaba wethu osezulwini, nxa sigcwalisa indingeko zakhe. Ngenxa yalokho okwenziwa nguKrestu silelungilo lokufinyelela esihlalweni sikaSomandla. “Yena ongayigodlanga eyakhe iNdodana, kodwa wayinikelela thina sonke, angehluleka kanjani ukusinika konke kanye layo na?” (Roma 8:32). UBaba wanika iNdodana yakhe uMoya ongelakulinganiswa, njalo lathi siyenelisa ukuwamukela ngokuphelela kwawo. UJesu uthi, “Ngakhoke uba lina elingababi likwazi ukubapha abantwana benu iziphiwo ezinhle, kakhulu kungakanani uYihlo osezulwini uzakubapha abacela kuye uMoya oNgcwele.” (Luka 11:13). “Uba licela ulutho ebizweni lami, ngizakulwenza.” Celani lizakwamukeliswa ukuba intokozo yenu igcwale.” (Johane 14:14; 16:24). {GC 477.1}

Loba nje impilo yokuba ngumKrestu izabe igcwele ukuzehlisa, akumelanga ihlale igcwele usizi lokuzikhangelela phansi. Kuyisipho somuntu wonke ukuthi aphile ngendlela ethokozisa uNkulunkulu njalo eletha izibusiso zakhe. Akusiyo intando kaBaba wethu osezulwini ukuthi sibengaphansi kwamacala lobunyama. Abukho ubufakazi bokuzehlisa kweqiniso ngokuhamba sikhothamise amakhanda njalo lenhliziyo egcwele imicabango yobumina. Singahamba kuJesu sihlanjululwe, njalo sime phambi komthetho singela kuyangeka njalo lokuzisola. “Ngakhoke kakusekho ukulahlwa kibo abakuKrestu Jesu, abangalandeli inkanuko zenyama, kodwa abahamba ngokoMoya.” (Roma 8:1). {GC 477.2}

Ngenxa kaJesu amadodana kaAdamu awileyo aba “ngamadodana kaNkulunkulu.” “Ngoba lowo owenza ukuba babe ngcwele lalabo abenziwa baba ngcwele ngabohlanga lunye, ngakhoke kalanhloni ukubabiza ngokuthi ngabafowethu.” (Amaheberu 2:11). Impilo yomKrestu kumele ibe ngeyokukholwa, leyokunqoba, njalo leyokuthokoza kuNkulunkulu. “Ngoba konke okuzelwe nguNkulunkuku kuyawunqoba umhlaba, lokho okunqoba umhlaba yikukholwa kwenu.” (1 Johane 5:4). Inceku kaNkulunkulu uNehemiah wakhuluma amazwi aqinisekileyo: “Ngoba ukuthokoza ngeNkosi kungamandla wenu.” (Nehemiya 8:19). Njalo uPhawuli uthi: “Thokozani eNkosini njalonjalo, ngiyaphinda ngithi: Thokozani.” (Filiphi 4:4). “Thokozani njalonjalo. Khulekani lingadinwa, bongani uNkulunkulu ngakho konke, ngoba lokhu kuyintando kaNkulunkulu kuKristu Jesu ngani.” (1 Thesalonika 5:16-18). {GC 477.3}

Zinjalo izithelo zokuphenduka okutholakala eBhayibhilini njalo lokungcweliswa, njalo kungenxa yokuthi izisekelo zokulunga ezitholakala emlayweni kaNkulunkulu azidingwa ngamaKrestu lamuhla okwenza ukuthi izithelo lezi zingabonakali. Yiso isizatho esenza ukuthi kungabonakali umsebenzi ojulileyo kaMoya kaNkulunkulu owawuthungamela imisebenzi yemvuselelo endulo. {GC 478.1}

Kungenxa yokukhangela okwenza ukuthi siguqulwe. Njalo nxa imilayo leyi engcwele lapho uNkulunkulu avule khona phambi kwabantu ukulunga njalo lobungcwele besimo sakhe ilahlelwa eceleni, njalo lengqondo zabantu zihugwa yimfundiso yabantu, kuyamangalisa yini ukuthi ukulunga kwabantu sekwawa emabandleni na? Inkosi ithi: “Bangihlamukele mina umthombo wamanzi wokuphila, bazigebhela imithombo etshayo engabambi manzi.” (Jeremiya 2:13). {GC 478.2}

“Ubusisiwe umuntu ongahambi ngezeluleko zababi, ongalaleli izeluleko zezoni, ongahlaliyo labaklolodayo, kodwa okuthokoza kwakhe kusemlayweni weNkosi, unakana ngomlayo wayo emini lebusuku. Unjengesihlahla esihlanyelwe ngasemifuleni yamanzi, esithela isithelo saso ngesikhathi saso, esimahlamvu aso kawabuni. Kukho konke akwenzayo uyaphumelela.” (Amahubo 1:1-3). Kuphela nxa umthetho wakhe usuvuselelwe wabekwa endaweni yawo efaneleyo, yikho lapho okuzabonakala imvuselelo ebonisa ukukholwa kweqiniso ebantwini labo abazibiza ngokuthi bangabalandeli bakaKrestu. “INkosi ithi: Manini emaqamulweni ezindlela libone, libuze ngemikhondo yasendulo ukuthi ingaphi indlela enhle, lihambe ngayo, lizuze ukuthula.” (Jeremiya 6:16). {GC 478.3}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 28 — Ukumelana Lemisebenzi Yethu Phambi Komthethwandaba.

“Ngisakhangele, kwabekwa izihlalo zobukhosi, kwahlala oyisimakade, izambatho zakhe zazimhlophe njengongqoqwane, lenwele zekhanda lakhe zinjengoboya bezimvu obuhlambulukileyo, isihlalo sakhe sobukhosi singamalangabi omlilo, lamavili aso enjengomlilo ovuthayo. Kwavela umkhonjwana womlilo waphumela ngaphambi kwakhe. Inkulungwane zezinkulungwane zamkhonza, lezinkulungwane ezilitshumi zezinkulungwane ezilitshumi zema phambi kwakhe. Umthethwandaba wahlala, lezincwadi zavulwa.” (Danyeli 7:9,10). {GC 479.1}

Lwavezwa ngale indlela usuku olucolekileyo embonweni womprofethi uDanyeli lapho izimo lempilo zabantu ezizadlula ekuhlolisisweni phambi komaHluleli womhlaba wonke, njalo lapho wonke umuntu ozanikwa khona umvuzo “njengemisebenzi yakhe.” UMdala Wezinsuku nguNkulunkulu uBaba. Umlobi kamahubo uthi: “Zingakaveli intaba, ungakawenzi umhlaba lelizwe, kusukela endulo kuze kube nini lanini wena unguNkulunkulu.” (Amahubo 90:2). Nguye umthombo wokuphila njalo lomthombo wemilayo yonke, ezasetshenziswa ekwahluleleni. Njalo ingilosi ezingcwele zizakuba yizisebenzi lapha labofakazi, ezinengi okungela kubaleka, phambi komthethwandaba lowu. {GC 479.2}

“Ngabona emibonweni ebusuku kufika lamayezi aphezulu ofanana leNdodana yomuntu, wafika kuMdala Wezinsuku, wasondezwa phambi kwakhe. Wanikwa amandla okubusa, lodumo, lombuso, ukuba bonke abantu bezizwe lezindimi bamkhonze. Ukubusa kwakhe kakulakuphela, kakuyikudlula, lombuso wakhe uyilowo ongayikuchithwa.” (Danyeli 7:13,14). Ukuza kukaKrestu okuchazwe lapha asikho ukuza kwakhe kwesibili emhlabeni. Uzaphambi koMdala Wezinsuku ezulwini ukuzokwamukela amandla njalo lobukhosi njalo lombuso, azawunikwa emaphethelweni womsebenzi wakhe njangalowo osincengelayo. Kuyikho ukuza lokhu, njalo hatshi ukuza kwakhe kwesibili emhlabeni, okwakuchazwe emazwini wesiprofethi okwakuzakwenzakala ekupheleni kwensuku ezingu2300 ngomnyaka ka1844. Ehanqwe zingilosi ezingcwele, uMpristi wethu Omkhulu wangena endaweni engcwele ngcwele njalo lapha wema phambi kaNkulunkulu ukuba aqale umsebenzi wakhe wokucina awenzela thina, ukwenza umsebenzi wokuphenya impilo zabantu bonke lokwahlulela njalo lokwenza umsebenzi wokubuyisa labo abamukele igazi lakhe njengomnikelo wesono. {GC 479.3}

Enkonzweni efananayo eyayisenziwa endulo, labo kuphela ababeze phambi kaNkulunkulu bevuma izono zabo, njalo izono zabo ngenxa yegazi lomnikelo wesono, ezazithuthiselwe ethabanekelini, babesiba lengxenye phakathi kwenkonzo enkulu ngoSuku lokuBuyisana. Kunjalo lakhona ngosuku olukhulu lokubuyisana kokucina njalo ngesikhathi lapho okuphenywa khona abantu besebesahlulelwa, indaba kuphela ezikhangelwayo ngezalabo abazibiza ngokuthi bangabantwana bakaNkulunkulu. Ukwahlulelwa kwababi kungumsebenzi owehlukeneyo njalo kwenzakala ngesikhathi esehlukeneyo. “Ngoba sekuyisikhathi sokuba ukuthonisiswa kuqale endlini kaNkulunkulu, uba kuqala ngathi, kuzakuba yini ukuphela kwalabo abangalalelanga ivangeli likaNkulunkulu na?” (1 Petro 4:17). {GC 480.1}

Incwadi zempilo yabantu ezisezulwini, lapho okubhalwe khona amabizo njalo lezenzo zabantu, zizaholi izinqumo ezizakwenziwa ekuthonisisweni lokhu. Umprofethi uDanyeli uthi: “Ukuthonisisa kwaqala, kwavulwa izincwadi.” Umambuleli nxa wayechaza isehlakalo esifananayo wengeza wathi: “Kwavulwa lenye incwadi eyincwadi yokuphila. Abafileyo bahlulelwa ngalokhu okwakulotshiwe ezincwadini langalokho ababekwenzile.” (Isambulo 20:12). {GC 480.2}

Encwadini yokuphila kulotshwe amabizo wabo bonke asebeke bangena emsebenzini kaNkulunkulu. UJesu watshela abafundi bakhe wathi: “Thokozani ngokuthi amabizo wenu alotshiwe ezulwini.” (Luka 10:20). UPhawuli ukhuluma ngezinye izisebenzi ezithembekileyo njengaye, “amabizo azo asencwadini yokuphila.” (Filiphi 4:3). UDanyeli nxa wayekhangela phambili esikhathini “sokuhlupheka esingazanga sibe khona,” uyatsho ukuthi abantu bakaNkulunkulu bazakukhululwa, “bonke abazatholakala belotshiweyo ogwalweni.” Njalo umambuleli uyatsho ukuthi labo kuphela abalamabizo “alotshwe encwadini yeWundlu yokuphila” bazangena emzini kaNkulunkulu. (Danyeli 12:1; Sambulo 21:27). {GC 480.3}

“Incwadi yesikhumbuzo” ilotshiwe layo phambi kaNkulunkulu, lapho okubhalwe khona izenzo ezinhle zalabo “abesaba uNkulunkulu njalo abacabanga ngebizo lakhe.” (Malaki 3:16). Amazwi wabo wokukholwa, lezenzo zabo zothando, konke kulotshiwe ezulwini. UNehemiya ukhuluma ngalokhu nxa esithi: “Nkulunkulu wami, akungikhumbule mayelana lalokho, ungayicimi imisebenzi yami emihle engiyenzele indlu kaNkulunkulu wami lenkonzo yakhona.” (Nehemiya 13:14). Encwadini yesikhumbuzo sikaNkulunkulu zonke izenzo zokulunga zilotshwelwe ukuthi zingabuyi zesulwe futhi. Lapha zonke izilingo ezinqotshiweyo, lobubi obunqotshiweyo, lamazwi wozwelo akhulunyiweyo, konke kubhalwe ngokwethembeka. Njalo zonke izenzo zokuzinikela, lokuhlupheka konke kanye losizi okuthwalwe ngokubekezela ngenxa kaKrestu kulotshiwe. “Ukuhlupheka kwami ukubalile, faka izinyembezi zami embizweni yakho, kazikho encwadini yakho na?” (Amahubo 56:8). {GC 481.1}

Kulencwadi njalo yezono zonke zabantu. “Ngoba uNkulunkulu uzakwahlulela konke esikwenzayo layo yonke imfihlo, okuhle lokubi.” (Mtshumayeli 12:14). UMsindisi uthi: “Amazwi wonke ayize abawakhulumayo abantu, bazakuziphendulela ngawo ngosuku lokuthonisiswa. Ngoba ngamazwi akho, uzakukhululwa, langamazwi akho uzakulahlwa.” (Mathewu 12:36,37). Injongo zonke ezifihlakeleyo lezizatho ziyavela encwadini kaNkulunkulu ngokuphelela kwazo, ngoba uNkulunkulu “uzakuveza ekukhanyeni izinto ezifihlakeleyo emnyameni, uzakuveza obala imicabango yenhliziyo zabantu.” (1 Korinte 4:5). “Khangela kulotshiwe phambi kwami...ububi babo lobubi baboyise ndawonye, itsho iNkosi.” (Isaya 65:6,7). {GC 481.2}

Imisebenzi yomuntu wonke iyadlula phambi kaNkulunkulu ukuba icubungulwe njalo iyalotshwa ukuthi ngeyokuthembeka kumbe ngeyokungathembeki. Eceleni kwamabizo wonke encwadini zezulu kulotshwe ngokuqonda okukhulu wonke amazwi angalunganga, zonke izenzo zobumina, yonke imisebenzi engapheleliswanga, njalo lezono zonke ezenziwa ensitha, lazo zonke izenzo ezimbi. Izixwayiso ezivela ezulwini eziphikiweyo lezingalalelwanga, lamathuba adlalisiweyo, lamathuba angasetshenziswanga ukwenza okuhle, lendonsela kokuhle lasebubini, lezithelo zakho ngokugcwala kwazo, zonke lezi izinto zilotshwa ngokuthembeka yingilosi elobayo. {GC 482.1}

Umthetho kaNkulunkulu ungumgomo osetshenziswa ukuhlola impilo njalo lezimo zabantu phambi kokuthonisiswa. “Mesabe uNkulunkulu, ulalele imilayo yakhe, ngoba lowu yiwo umlandu womuntu wonke. Ngoba uNkulunkulu uzakwehlulela konke esikwenzayo layo yonke imfihlo, okuhle lokubi.” (Mtshumayeli 12:13,14). Umpostoli uJacobe wakhuza abazalwane wathi: “Khulumani lenze njengokufanele abazakwahlulelwa ngomlayo wenkululeko.” (Jacobe 2:12). {GC 482.2}

Labo ekuthonisisweni abatholakala befanele bazaba lengxenye ekuvukeni kwabalungileyo. UJesu wathi: “Kodwa labo okuthiwa bafanele ukufinyelela kulesosikhathi lasekuvukeni kwabafileyo...banjengezithunywa zasezulwini, bangabantwana bakaNkulunkulu, bahlanganyela ekuvukeni kwabafileyo.” (Luka 20:35,36). Uphinda njalo athi labo “abenze okuhle” bazaphuma “ekuvukeni kokuphila.” (Johane 5:29). Abangcwele abafileyo abasoke bavuswe kuze kuphele ukwahlulela lapho abazabizwa ngokuthi bafanele “uvuko lokuphila.” Ngakhoke abasoke babekhona ekwahluleleni lapho amabizo wabo ahlolisiswa khona. {GC 482.3}

UJesu uzakuma njengomMeli wabo, ebancengela phambi kaNkulunkulu. “Kodwa uba umuntu esona, siloMmeli kuBaba, uJesu Kristu olungileyo.” (1 Johane 2:1). “Ngoba uKrestu kangenanga endaweni engcwele ngcwele eyenziwe ngezandla, engumfanekiso waleyo eqotho, kodwa wangena ezulwini uqobo ukuba khathesi abonakale phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngenxa yethu.” “Ngakhoke ulamandla wokusilisa ngokupheleleyo abeza kuNkulunkulu ngaye, lokhu ephilela ukubanxusela.” (Amaheberu 9:24; 7:25). {GC 482.4}

Nxa incwadi zemisebenzi zivulwa ekwahluleleni, impilo zabantu bonke asebeke bakholwa kuJesu ziyadlula phambi kaNkulunkulu. Kusukela kulabo abaphila emhlabeni kuqala, uMmeli wethu uyaletha zonke izenzo zabantu kusukela ekuqaleni, acine ngalabo abaphilayo. Wonke amabizo ayalethwa, zonke izenzo zabo ziyaphenywa ngobunono obukhulu. Amabizo ayamukelwa, amanye ayalahlwa. Nxa kukhona olezono ezilokhe zisencwadini zasezulwini, ezingavunywanga njalo ezingathethelelwanga, amabizo abo azakwesulwa encwadini yokuphila, njalo lalokho okulotshwe encwadini yesikhumbuzo ngezenzo zabo ezinhle kuyesulwa. INkosi yathi kuMose: “Owonileyo kimi ngizamsusa ogwalweni lwami.” (Eksodusi 32:33). Njalo umprofethi uHezekeli uthi: “Kodwa nxa olungileyo ephambuka ekulungeni kwakhe, enze okubi, enze amanyala enziwa ngomubi, uzakuphila na? ...izenzo zakhe zonke ezilungileyo abezenzile azisayikukhunjulwa, ngenxa yenkohliso alecala ngayo, lesono asenzileyo, uzakufa.” (Hezekeli 18:24). {GC 483.1}

Bonke abaphenduke ngokuphelela batshiya isono, njalo ngokukholwa abamukele igazi likaKrestu njengomnikelo wokubuyisana lezulu, sebelegama elithi “bathethelelwe” elibhalwe eceleni kwamabizo wabo encwadini zezulu, njengoba sebehlanganele lobungcwele bukaKrestu, njalo lezimo zabo sezitholakale zihambelana lomlayo kaNkulunkulu, izono zabo zizakwesulwa, njalo bona ngokwabo bazatholakala befanele ukwamukela impilo engunaphakade. INkosi nxa ikhuluma ngomprofethi uIsaya ithi: “Mina nginguye owesula iziphambeko zakho ngenxa yami, kangisayikuzikhumbula lezono zakho.” (Isaya 43:25). UJesu wathi: “Onqobayo uzakwambathiswa ngokunjalo ingubo ezimhlophe, kangiyikulesula ibizo lakhe encwadini yokuphila, ngoba ngizakulivuma phambi kukaBaba, laphambi kwezithunywa zakhe.” (Sambulo 3:5). “Ilowo lalowo ongivuma phambi kwabantu, lami ngizakumvuma phambi kukaBaba osezulwini. Kodwa lowo ongiphika phambi kwabantu, lami ngizakumphika phambi kukaBaba osezulwini.” (Mathewu 10:32,33). {GC 483.2}

Indlela abantu abakhangela ngayo ngokulangazelela izinqumo ezenziwa emthethwanda yasemhlabeni ibonisa nje kancane indlela okukhangelwa ngayo emthethwanda wasezulwini nxa amabizo abhalwe encwadini yokuphila esiza ukuzohlolisiswa phambi koMahluleli womhlaba wonke. UMmeli ongcwele uyaletha isicelo sokuthi bonke abanqobileyo ngenxa yokukholwa egazini lakhe bathethelelwe iziphambeko zabo, bebuyiselwe ekhaya labo Edeni, njalo bafakwe umqhele njengendlalifa kanye laye “bamukele ukubusa kuqala.” (Mika 4:8). USathane emzameni yakhe yokudukisa njalo lokulinga abantu wayecabange ukuthi uzaphambanisa icebo lokudalwa komuntu, kodwa uKrestu manje uyacela ukuthi icebo leli lipheleliswe sengathi umuntu kazange awe. Ucelela abantu bakhe hatshi ukuthi bathethelelwe njalo bamukelwe ngokugcweleyo njalo lokupheleleyo kuphela, kodwa ukuthi babelengxenye ebukhosini bakhe njalo babelendawo esihlalweni sakhe. {GC 483.3}

Nxa uJesu elokhe encengela abantu bakhe, uSathane ubabeka icala phambi kaNkulunkulu njengezoni. Umlingi omkhulu wenze yonke imizamo ukuthi abenze bathandabuze, lokuthi balahle ithemba labo kuNkulunkulu, lokubahlukanisa lothando lwakhe, njalo lokuthi bephule umthetho wakhe. Manje usekhomba endleleni abayihambileyo, lasebubini bezimo zabo, lokungafani kwabo loKrestu, okubangele ukuthi uMsindisi wabo ahlazwe, kanye lezono zonke abalinge ukuthi bezenze, njalo ngenxa yalokhu ubabiza ngokuthi bangabakhe. {GC 484.1}

UJesu kaphiki izono zabo kodwa ubonisa ukuzidela lokukholwa kwabo, njalo nxa ebacelela intethelelo uyaphakamisa izandla zakhe ezilamanxeba phambi kaBaba lengilosi ezingcwele esithi: Ngiyabazi ngamabizo. Ngibabhale phakathi kwezandla zami. “Umnikelo owamukelekayo kuNkulunkulu ungumoya odabukileyo, inhliziyo edabukileyo lezisolayo, Nkulunkulu kawuyideli.” (Amahubo 51:17). Njalo kulowo obeka abantu bakhe icala uthi: “INkosi kayikukhuze wena Sathane, iNkosi elikhethileyo iJerusalema kayikukhuze, Lumuntu kanjengesikhuni esikhitshwe emlilweni na? (Zekariya 3:2). UKrestu uzagqokisa abathembekileyo bakhe ngobungcwele bakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi abamise phambi kukaYise “njengebandla elilenkazimulo, lingelacwatshana, lasici loba okunye nje.” (Efesu 5:27). Amabizo wabo azahlala elotshiwe encwadini yokuphila, njalo mayelana labo kulotshiwe ukuthi: “Bazahamba lami begqoke izembatho ezimhlophe, ngoba bafanele.” (Isambulo 3:4). {GC 484.2}

Ngale indlela kuzabonakala ukugwaliseka ngokupheleleyo kwesithembiso sesivumelwano esitsha: “Ngizathethelela ububi babo, lesono sabo kangisayikusikhumbula.” “Ngalezonsuku langalesosikhathi, kutsho iNkosi, kuzadingwa ukona koIsrayeli, kodwa kungafunyanwa, kudingwe lesono koJuda, kodwa singafunyanwa, ngoba ngizabathethelela labo abayingcosana engibatshiyayo.” (Jeremiya 31:34; 50:20). “Ngalolosuku isihlahla seNkosi sizakuba sihle, sibe lodumo, lezithelo zelizwe zizakuba ligugu lodumo lwabaseleyo eZiyone, abatshiywe eJerusalema, bonke ababhaliweyo ogwalweni lokuphila, kuthiwe bangcwele.” (Isaya 4:2,3). {GC 485.1}

Umsebenzi wokuphenya lowokwahlulela njalo lokwesulwa kwezono uzapheleliswa ngaphambi kokuza kweNkosi kwesibili. Njengoba abafileyo bezakwehlulelwa ngalokho okulotshwe encwadini, akungeke kwenzeke ukuthi izono zabantu zesulwe kungakadluli ukwahlulela lapho izenzo zabo ezizacubungulwa khona. Kodwa umpostoli uPhetro ukubeka sobala ukuthi izono zabakholwayo zizakwesulwa “nxa sekufike izikhathi zokuvuselelwa ezivela ebusweni beNkosi, njalo uzathumela uJesu Krestu.” (Imisebenzi 3:19,20). Nxa umsebenzi wokwahlulela ngokuphenya uqala uvalwa, uKrestu uzakuza, njalo umvuzo wakhe uzabe elawo ukuba anike wonke umuntu njengemisebenzi yakhe. {GC 485.2}

Enkonzweni yasendulo umpristi omkhulu, nxa wayeseqedile ukwenza umnikelo wesizwe sakoIsrayeli, wayephuma abusise ibandla. Ngokunjalo uKrestu ekupheleni komsebenzi wakhe wokusincengela, uzabonakala “engelasono ekusindisweni” (Amaheberu 9:28), ukuba abusise abantu bakhe abamlindeleyo ngokuphila okunaphakade. Njengo mpristi, ekukhipheni kwakhe izono ethempelini, wayezivuma phezu kwembuzi elahlwayo, ngokunjalo uKrestu uzabeka zonke izono phezu kaSathane, onguye umqali wesono. Imbuzi elahlwayo, nxa yayithwele izono zako Israyeli, yayithunyelwa enkangala “endaweni engahlali bantu” (Levi 16:22); ngokunjalo uSathane, ethwele icala lezono zonke abangele ukuthi abantu bakaNkulunkulu bazenze, uzabasemhlabeni okweminyaka eyinkulungwane, ozabe ungelamuntu ngaleso isikhathi, njalo ekucineni uzamukela ukujeziswa kwesono okupheleleyo emlilweni ozabhubhisa bonke ababi. Ngale indlela icebo losindiso lizapheleliswa lapho isono esizabhujiswa kokuphela njalo lokuhlengwa kwalabo ababelesifiso sokudela isono. {GC 485.3}

Ngesikhathi esasibekelwe ukwahlulela, ekupheleni kwensuku ezingu2300, ngomnyaka ka1844, kwaqala umsebenzi wokuphenya lokwesulwa kwezono. Bonke asebeke bamukela ibizo likaKrestu kumele bahlolisiswe. Bonke abafileyo labaphilayo kumele bathonisiswe “ngalezo izinto ezibhalwe engwalweni, njengemisebenzi yabo.” {GC 486.1}

Izono ezingavunywangwa njalo zalahlwa azisoke zithethelelwe njalo zesulwe phakathi kwencwadi zezulu, kodwa zizahlala njengofakazi omelane lesoni ngosuku lweNkosi. Sengabe wayeyenze izenzo zakhe zobubi libalele, kumbe phakathi komnyama wobusuku, kodwa zazisobala phambi kwakhe ozakusahlulela. Ingilosi zikaNkulunkulu zabona zonke izono njalo zazibhala phansi zingatshiyi lebala elilodwa. Isono sesingafihlwa, siphikwe, sifihlelwe ubaba lomama, lomfazi, labantwana njalo lalabo esiphila labo, akula omunye ngaphandle kwalabo abalecala abangacabangela ukuthi koniwe, kodwa sibekwe mgceke phambi kwentatheli zezulu. Ubunyama bosuku olumnyama okwedlula zonke, lokufihleka konke okusemhlabeni, akwanelanga ukwembesa umcabango owodwa ukuthi ungazakali phambi kweNkosi. UNkulunkulu ulencwadi elotshwe konke okungalunganga okwenzakala emhlabeni. Kakhohliswa yilokho okubonakala emehlweni wabantu sengathi yikulunga. Kayenzi phutha ekufundeni kwakhe izimo zabantu. Abantu bengakhohliswa yilabo abakhohlakeleyo enhliziyweni, kodwa uNkulunkulu ufinyelela konke ukuzenzisa njalo ufunda okungaphakathi. {GC 486.2}

Uzothe kangakanani umcabango lowu! Usuku ngosuku oludlulayo, luthwele umthalo walo wezinto ezibhalwe encwadini zezulu. Amazwi ake akhulunywa, izenzo ezake zenziwa, ngeke zisaguquleka. Ingilosi sezibhalile konke okuhle lokubi. Umuntu ophakeme okwedlula bonke emhlabeni ngeke enelise ukuletha lokho okubhaliweyo ngitsho lokosuku olulodwa. Izenzo zethu, lamazwi wethu, lenjongo zethu ezifihlakeleyo, zonke zilesisindo esinqumeni esizakwenziwa ngathi esentokozo kumbe esokukhala. Loba nje zingakhohlwa yithi,zizaba ngofakazi ukusikhulula kumbe ukusibeka icala. {GC 486.3}

Ngendlela efanayo labo abadwebayo abenelisa ukuveza ubuso bomuntu emdulini, isimo somuntu sivezwa ngokwethembeka encwadini zezulu. Kulusizi ukuthi abantu abathinteki nxa becabanga ngombhalo lowu ozabonwa lizulu. Ngabe iyezi elihlukanisa lokhu esikubonayo lesingakuboniyo belingasuswa, njalo abantu bebone ingilosi ebhala wonke amazwi lezenzo, okumele bahlangane lazo futhi ekuthonisisweni, mangaki amazwi akhulunywa lamuhla abengasoke akhulunywe, zingaki izenzo ebezingasoke zenziwe. {GC 487.1}

Ekwahluleleni zonke indlela izipho ezisetshenziswe ngayo zizacubungulwa. Sisebenzise njani inotho esiyibolekwe lizulu? INkosi izakwamukela abayo ekubuyeni kwayo kulenzuzo na? Sikhulisile yini amandla esiwaphiweyo, ezandleni njalo lasenhliziyweni, lasengqondweni, ukuthi sidumise uNkulunkulu njalo sibusise umhlaba? Sisebenzise njani isikhathi sethu, losiba lwethu, lelizwi lethu, lemali yethu, lendonsela yethu? Yini esiyenzele uKrestu, kulabo abaswelayo, labasenhlungwini, lasezintandaneni, kumbe abafelwakazi? UNkulunkulu usenze izitsha zelizwi lakhe elingcwele, senzeni ngokukhanya leqiniso esilinikiweyo ukuthi senze abantu bakhaliphele usindiso? Akula sisindo esibekwa ekukholweni okungela msebenzi, kuphela uthando oluboniswa ngemisebenzi yilo oluqotho. Luthando kuphela phambi kwezulu olwenza ukuthi izenzo zethu zibe lesisindo. Loba yini eyenziwa ngothando, loba incinyane kangakanani phambi kwamehloabantu, iyamukelwa njalo ilomvuzo ovela kuNkulunkulu. {GC 487.2}

Ubumina babantu obufihlakeleyo, buveziwe encwadini zasezulwini. Kukhona imbhalo yemisebenzi engenziwanga ngokuphelela, lokukhohlwa intando yoMsindisi. Lapho bazabona amathuba anikwa uSathane, lemicabango, njalo lamandla ayengakaKrestu. Mubi umbiko ingilosi eziwuthwalela ezulwini. Izidalwa ezikhaliphileyo, abantu abazibiza ngokuthi bangabalandeli bakaKrestu, baphatheke emsebenzini wokudinga inotho yomhlaba lekuzithokoziseni kwawo. Imali, lesikhathi, njalo lamandla anikelwa ezintweni zomhlaba njalo lasekuzithokoziseni, kodwa imizuzwana emincane ichithwa emthandazweni, lasekufundeni iBhayibhili, lasekuzideleni kanye lasekuvunyweni kwesono. {GC 487.3}

USathane usungula izinto ezinengi ukwenzela ukuthi zihlale zigcwele emicabangweni yethu, ukwenzela ukuthi singagxili emsebenzini okumele ngabe siwazi kakhulu. Umkhohlisi omkhulu uyawazonda amaqiniso aveza umnikelo wokubuyiswa njalo loMmeli omkhulu. Uyakwazi ukuthi kuye yonke into yeyame ekususeni ingqondo zabantu kuJesu laseqinisweni lakhe. {GC 488.1}

Labo abazakwamukela umvuzo wokuncenga okwenziwa nguMsindisi khathesi akumelanga bavumele loba yini ukuthi iphambanise umsebenzi wabo wokuba msulwa ekwesabeni uNkulunkulu. Amahola aligugu kulokuthi anikelwe ekuzithokoziseni, lekuzibonakaliseni, kumbe ekudingeni inzuzo, kumele anikelwe ekucubunguleni ngomkhuleko kwelizwi leqiniso. Udaba lwethempeli elisezulwini njalo lokwahlulela okwenzakala ndawonye lokuphenya imisebenzi yabantu, kumele kuzwisiswe ngokucaca yibo bonke abantu bakaNkulunkulu. Bonke badinga ukuthi bazizwisisele mayelana lendawo kanye lomsebenzi woMpristi wabo oMkhulu. Nxa kungenjalo akusoke kwenzeke ukuthi babonise ukukholwa okubalulekileyo ngalesi isikhathi kumbe ukuthi bame lapho uNkulunkulu athanda ukuthi bame khona. Wonke umuntu ulomphefumulo okumele awuhlenge kumbe ulahleke. Wonke umuntu ulendaba engakapheleli phambi kaNkulunkulu. Wonke umuntu kumele ahlangane loMahluleli omkhulu manqamu. Kubaluleke kangakanani ke, ukuthi zonke ingqondo zicabangisise kokuphela ngesehlakalo esicolekileyo lapho ukuthonisisa kuzaqala njalo ingwalo zivulwe, lapho ndawonye loDanyeli, wonke umuntu okumele azimele, ekupheleni kwesikhathi. {GC 488.2}

Bonke asebethole ukukhanya mayelana lendaba lezi kumele bahambise amaqiniso lawa uNkulunkulu awabeke ezandleni zabo. Ithempeli lasezulwini liyinziki yomsebenzi kaKrestu awenzela abantu. Kugoqela wonke umuntu ophila emhlabeni. Livula icebo losindiso, lisiletha ekupheleni kwesikhathi njalo liveza impi ephakathi kokulunga lesono. Kubaluke kakhulu ukuthi wonke umuntu kumele acubungule kakhulu indaba lezi njalo ayenelise ukuphendula wonke umuntu obuza ngesizatho sethemba eliphakathi kwabo. {GC 488.3}

Ukuncengela kukaKrestu akwenzela abantu bonke ethempelini elisezulwini kubalulekile ecebeni losindiso ngendlela efana lokufa kwakhe esiphambanweni. Ngokufa kwakhe waqala umsebenzi lowu ngemva kokuvuka kwakhe anyukela ukuthi ayewuqeda ezulwini. Kumele ngokukholwa singene phakathi kweveyili, “lapho umhlahlandlela ongene khona ngenxa yethu.” (Amaheberu 6:20). Yikho lapho ukukhanya okuvela esiphambanweni saseCalvari okukhanyisa khona. Yikho lapha esingathola khona imfihlakalo yecebo losindiso. Ukuhlengwa kwabantu kutholakala ngemva kwentengo enkulu ebhadalwa lizulu, umnikelo owenziwayo ulingana lentengo edingwa ngumlayo kaNkulunkulu owephulwayo. UJesu sewavula indlela eya esihlalweni sikaBaba, njalo ngokusincengela kwakhe izifiso zabo bonke abeza kuye ngokukholwa zayalethwa phambi kaNkulunkulu. {GC 489.1}

“Ofihla iziphambeko zakhe kayikuphumelela, kodwa lowo ozivumayo azitshiye, uzahawukelwa.” (Zaga 28:13). Nxa labo abafihla njalo abenza izaba ngamaphutha abo bebengabona ukuthi uSathane ujabula kanjani ngabo, langendlela ahleka ngayo uKresu lengilosi zakhe, bebezaphangisa bavume izono zabo njalo bazitshiye. Ngokusebenzisa ubuthakathaka bezimo, uSathane, uyenza imizamo yokuhola imicabango yonke, njalo uyazi ukuthi ubuthakathaka lobu nxa buthandeka, uzaphumelela. Ngakhoke uhlala esenza imizamo yokukhohlisa abalandeli bakaKrestu esebenzisa amaqhinga wakhe kucine kusiba nzima ukuthi banqobe. Kodwa uJesu uyabancengela ngezandla zakhe ezilamanxeba, lomzimba wakhe owahluzulwayo, njalo uyatsho kibo bonke abakhetha ulumlandela ukuthi: “Umusa wami ukwanele.” (2 Korinte 12:9). “Thwalani ijogwe lami phezu kwenu, lifunde kimi, ngoba ngimnene ngithobekile, kung’khona imiphefumulo yenu izakufumana ukuphumula. Ngoba ijogwe lami lilula, lomthwalo wami ulula.” (Mathewu 11:29,30). Kakungabi loyedwa ocabanga ukuthi ubuthakathaka babo abulapheki. UNkulunkulu uzanika ukukholwa lomusa wokuthi banqobe konke. {GC 489.2}

Siphila manje phakathi kosuku olukhulu lokubuyisana. Enkonzweni eyayingumfanekiso endulo, nxa umpristi omkhulu wayesenza umsebenzi wokubuyisa isizwe sakoIsrayeli, kwakudingakala ukuthi bonke abantu babubule bevuma izono zabo bezehlisa phambi kweNkosi, nxa bengenzanga njalo babequnywa phakathi kwebandla okutsho ukuthi babesifa. Ngokufanayo, bonke abafisa ukuthi amabizo wabo agcinwe encwadini yokuphila, kumele manje emalangeni ambalwa aseleyo lapho umusa usesekhona, babubule bavume izono zabo phambi kaNkulunkulu ngokweqiniso. Kumele kube lokuhlola inhliziyo okujulileyo njalo lokuqotho. Umoya wokudlala ogcwele ebantwini abanengi abazibiza ngokuthi bangamaKrestu kumele ususwe. Kulempi enkulu phambi kwabo bonke abazathulisa imicabango lemizwa emibi efuna ukubabusa. Umsebenzi wokulungiselela uqondane lomuntu munye ngamunye. Asisindiswa ngamaxuku. Ukulunga lokuzimisela komunye akusoze kusize omunye ongelakho lokhu ukuthi akuthole laye. Loba nje izizwe zonke zizadlula phambi kokuthonisiswa phambi kaNkulunkulu, kodwa uzacubungula udaba lomuntu wonke munye ngamunye ngobunono obukhulu sengathi kwakulomuntu oyedwa kuphela emhlabeni. Wonke umuntu kumele ahlolwe njalo atholakale engela chatha kumbe loba yini engcolisayo. {GC 489.3}

Zicolekile izehlakalo ezibambene lokuphethwa komsebenzi wokubuyisa abantu. Ziyesabeka izinqumo ezimayelana lomsebenzi lowu. Ukwahlulelwa kuyaqhubeka lamhlanje ethempelini lasezulwini. Okweminyaka eminengi umsebenzi lowu lokhe uqhubeka. Masinyane, akulamuntu okwaziyo ukut masinyane kangakanani, kuzadlulela ebantwini abaphilayo. Phambi kukaNkulunkulu impilo zethu zizafika ukuthi zicubungulwe. Ngalesi isikhathi esiphila kiso okwedlula zonke izikhathi kudingeka ukuthi silalele amazwi kaKrestu athi: “Qaphelani lilinde, ngoba kalisazi isikhathi ukuthi sizakuba nini.” (Marko 13:33). “Uba ungavuki ngizakuza kuwe njengesela, kawusoze wasazi isikhathi engizakuza ngaso kuwe.” (Sambulo 3:3). {GC 490.1}

Nxa umsebenzi wokwahlulela komuntu munye ngamunye sewuphelile, isiphetho somuntu wonke sizabe sesiyenziwe, ekuphileni kumbe ekufeni. Umusa uzavalwa sekusele isikhatshana ukuthi uJesu abuye emafini wezulu. UKrestu kuSambulo, nxa wayekhangela phambili esikhathini lesi, uthi: “Ongalunganga kahlale esenza okungalunganga, ongcolileyo ahlale engcolile, kodwa olungileyo ahlale esenza ukulunga, njalo longcwele ahlale engcwele. Khangelani ngiyeza masinyane, ngilomvuzo wami ukunika lowo lalowo njengemisebenzi yakhe.” (Sambulo 22:11,12). {GC 490.2}

Abalungileyo lababi bazabe belokhe bephila emhlabeni besesimeni sabo senyama, abantu bazabe belima njalo besakha, besidla njalo benatha, bonke bengananzeleli ukuthi isinqumo sokucina esingaguqulekiyo, sesiyenziwe ethempelini eliphezulu. Ngaphambi kukaZamcolo ngemva kokuthi uNowa wayesengene emkhunjini, uNkulunkulu wamvalela phakathi wavalela ababi phandle, kodwa okwamalanga ayisikhombisa abantu bengazi ukuthi umusa wawusuvaliwe, baqhubeka ngempilo yabo yobutshapha, yokudinga ukuzithokozisa kwasemhlabeni, njalo bahleka ulunya izixwayiso ezazimayelana lokwahlulelwa kwabo. “Ngokunjalo” kutsho uMsindisi, “kuzakuba njalo lokuza kweNdodana yomuntu.” (Mathewu 24:39). Ngokuthula, kungela muntu onanzelelayo njengesela ebusuku, lizakuza ihola eliveza isiphetho somuntu wonke, ukususwa komusa ngokokucina oyiwo oncengela abantu abonileyo. {GC 491.1}

“Ngakhoke lindani... funa ifike ilijume, ilifumane lilele.” (Marko 13:35,36). Siyingozi isimo salabo abadinwayo ngokulinda, bacine begijimisa injabulo yomhlaba. Nxa umuntu wamabhizimusi elokhe ezihlupha ngokuthola inzuzo, nxa umuntu othanda injabulo yakulo umhlaba elokhe edinga indlela zokuzithokozisa, nxa indodakazi ethanda umceco wasemhlabeni ilokhe ihlela umceco wayo, sekungenzeka kube ngalelo ihola lapho uMahluleli womhlaba wonke azanika isigwebo esithi: “Ulinganisiwe ngezilinganiso, ufunyenwe ulula.” (Danyeli 5:27). {GC 491.2}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 29 — Imvelaphi Yesono.

Engqondweni zabantu abanengi umcabango omayelana lokuthi isono savela ngaphi lembangela yaso yenza badideke kakhulu. Bayabona umsebenzi wobubi, lomphumela wawo wosizi lokubhubha, njalo bayabuza ukuthi konke lokhu kwenzeka kanjani ngaphansi kwamehlo kaSimakade olokukhalipha okukhulu lolamandla lothando. Konke lokhu kuyimfihlakalo abangelawo amazwi wokuyichasisa. Njalo ekungazini lokuthandabuzeni kwabo bacina besehluleka ukuzwisisa amaqiniso avezwe sobala elizwini likaNkulunkulu njalo amqoka ekusindisweni kwabo. Bakhona labo abathi ngokudingisisa kwabo ngesizatho sokuthi kube lobubi emhlabeni, abacina bezama ukudingisisa ezintweni uNkulunkulu angasivezelanga zona, ngaleso sizatho bayehluleka ukuthola impendulo, njalo abantu abanjalo bacina besiba sesimeni sokuthandabuza besebesebenzisa isizatho lesi ukuphika amazwi atholakala eBhayibhilini. Abanye ngakolunye uhlangothi bayehluleka ukuzwisisa inkinga yesono ngesizatho sokuthi kulemfundiso ezingaqondanga emhlabeni ezimayelana lesimo sikaNkulunkulu kanye lombuso wakhe kanye lendlela akhetha ukuqeda isono ngayo. {GC 492.1}

Akwenzeki ukuthi sichasise imvelaphi yesono ngendlela ezayenza ukuthi sithole isizatho sokuthi sibekhona emhlabeni. Kodwa siyenelisa ukuzwisisa umvelaphi wesono njalo lendlela isono esizaqedwa ngayo okuveza sobala ukulunga lothando lukaNkulunkulu ngendlela akhethe ukuphatha ngayo ububi obusemhlabeni. Akula eyinye into efundiswe ngokucacileyo eBhayibhilini kulokuthi uNkulunkulu wayengelacala mayelana lokungena kwesono emhlabeni, lokuthi akuzange kube khona ukususwa komusa, kumbe ukusilela embusweni wezulu okwabangela ukuthi kube lokuhlamuka okwabakhona. Isono singumafohlela, njalo akulasizatho esinganikwa esichaza ukubakhona kwaso. Akuzwisiseki, njalo akuchasiseki, ukuzama ukwenza njalo kucina kusiba yikusimela. Ngabe bekulendlela yokusichaza, kumbe isizatho sokubakhona kwaso besingatholakala, besingeke saba yisono. Ingcazelo yethu eyodwa yesono itholakala elizwini likaNkulunkulu; “kuyikwephula umlayo;” kuyikukhula kwemfundiso elwisana lemilayo yothando eyisisekelo sombuso wasezulwini. {GC 492.2}

Isono singakabi khona kwakulokuthula lentokozo emhlabeni wonke. Konke kwakulungile kuhambelana lentando yoMdali. Uthando lukaNkulunkulu lwalugcwele indawo yonke, njalo uthando omunye komunye lwalumsulwa. UKrestu uLizwi, iNdodana ezelwe yodwa kaNkulunkulu, wayemunye loBaba, babemunye ngemvelo, langesimo, langenjongo, kwakunguye kuphela yokindawo owayelelungelo lokuba semhlanganweni kaNkulunkulu. NgoKrestu uBaba wadala zonke izidalwa zasezulwini. “Ngoba konke kwadalwa ngaye, okusezulwini, ...loba kuyizihlalo zobukhosi, loba kuyiziphathamandla, loba kuyimbuso, loba kungamandla, konke kwadalwa ngayo” (Kolose 1:16), njalo kuKrestu owayelingana loBaba izulu lonke laliletha ukukhonza kwalo. {GC 493.1}

Umthetho wothando owuyisisekelo sombuso kaNkulunkulu, lentokozo yezidalwa zonke yayeyame ekuthini balandele imfundiso yawo yonke ngoba umthetho yiwo oyinsika yokulunga. UNkulunkulu udinga endalweni yakhe yonke inkonzo yothando, ukukhonza okuphuma ekuzwisiseni isimo sakhe. Kathokozi ngokukhonza okwenziwa ngoba abantu bebanjwa ngamandla, njalo kubo bonke abantu ubanika amandla wokuzikhethela, ukwenzela ukuthi bamkhonze ngobabekuthanda ukukwenza lokhu. {GC 493.2}

Kodwa kukhona oyedwa owakhetha ukuphathakabi inkululeko leyi. Isono sasungua ngaye, owayeseduze kuKrestu, njalo owayephakanyiswe nguNkulunkulu njalo owelamandla lobukhosi obuphezu kwezidalwa zonke ezulwini. Ngaphambi kokuwa kwakhe uLusifa waye ngowokuqala wengilosi ezazimboza inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu, futhi wayengcwele njalo engelasici. “INkosi uNkulunkulu ithi; wawuyisiboniso sokupheleleyo, ugcwele ukuhlakanipha, uphelele ngobuhle. WawuseEdeni insimu kaNkulunkulu, ucecile ngawo wonke amatshe amahle...Ngakwenza waba likherubi lokulinda, usentabeni engcwele kaNkulunkulu, wahamba phakathi kwamatshe avutha umlilo. Wawuphelele endleleni zakho, kusukela osukwini owadalwa ngalo kwaze kwafunyaniswa ububi kuwe.” Hezekeli 28:12-15. {GC 493.3}

ULusifa wayelethuba lokuqhubeka ephansi kukaNkulunkulu, ethandwa njalo ehlonitshwa zingilosi zonke, esebenzisa amandla wakhe ukubuyisa abanye njalo lokudumisa uMenzi wakhe. Kodwa umprofethi uthi, “Inhliziyo yakho yaziphakamisa ngenxa yobuhle bakho, wona ukuhlakanipha kwakho ngenxa yodumo lwakho.” Hezekeli 28:17. Kancane kancane, uLusifa waqala ukufisa ukukhonzwa ngokwakhe. “Ngoba uzitshaya ohlakaniphileyo njengoNkulunkulu....” “Wena wathi enhlizweni yakho, ngizakwenyukela ezulwini, ngaphezu kwezinkanyezi zikaNkulunkulu ngibeke khona isihlalo sami sobukhosi...ngizakwenyukela ngaphezu kwendawo eziphakemeyo emayezini, ngizenze ngibe njengoPhezukonke.” Hezekelo 28: 6, Isaya 14:13,14. Kulokuthi adinge indlela yokuphakamisa uNkulunkulu phambi kwezidalwa zakhe, kwakuyinjongo kaLusifa ukuthi eyenze ukuthi bakhonze yena endaweni yoMdali. Njalo ngenxa yokunxwanela inhlonipho uBaba ayeyinike iNdodana yakhe, uLusifa wafisa amandla ayengakaKrestu kuphela. {GC 494.1}

Lonke izulu lalithokozele ukubonisa ubukhosi boMdali njalo lokumdumisa. Njalo nxa uNkulunkulu wayephakanyiswa ngale indlela, konke kwakube lokuthula lentokozo. Kodwa manje kwasekulenhlanyelo eyayisiphambanisa konke lokhu. Inkonzo yokuziphakamisa, eyayiphikisana lecebo likaMdali, yaqala ukuvusa imicabango emibi engqondweni ezazigcwele inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu. Izidalwa zezulu zamncenga uLusifa. INdodana kaNkulunkulu yambonisa ubukhulu, lokulunga njalo lobuhle boMdali, njalo lobungcwele bomthetho wakhe ongaguqukiyo. UNkulunkulu ngokwakhe nguye owayeyakhe indlela umbuso wezulu owawuqhutshwa ngayo, njalo ngokuphambuka kuyo, uLusifa wayezakonela uMdali wakhe, azilethele ukufa. Kodwa izixwayiso ezanikwa ngothando njalo lomusa, zabangela ukuthi umoya wenkani ukhule ngamandla kuye. ULusifa wavumela ukunxwanela kwakhe isikhundla sikaKrestu ukuthi kukhule, njalo waqala ukuba lamadlabuzane wokuthi wayengakwenza lokhu. {GC 494.2}

Ukuziphakamisa ngenxa yenkazimulo yakhe kwakhulisa isifiso sakhe sokubusa. Ukuphakamiswa okwakubekwe kuLusifa akazange akwamukele njengesipho esivela kuNkulunkulu okwabangela ukuthi angabi lokubonga okwakumele akulethe kuMdali. Waqala ukuziphakamisa ngenxa yenkazimulo lokuphakama kwakhe, wafisa ukulingana loNkulunkulu. Wayethandwa njalo ehlonitshwa yizidalwa zonke zezulu. Ingilosi zazithokoza ukwenza lokhu ayezitshela khona, njalo wayembeswe ngokuhlakanipha lobukhosi okwedlula zonke. Loba kunjalo iNdodana kaNkulunkulu yayihlonitshwa njengoMkhulu wezulu, lowo owayelamandla alingana lakaBaba. Kuyo yonke imihlangano kaNkulunkulu, uKrestu wayesiba khona, kodwa uLusifa wayengavunyelwa ukubakhona. “Yindaba,” yaqala ukubuza ingilosi leyi, “kungani uKrestu ephezulu? Kungani ephakanyiswa okwedlula uLusifa? {GC 495.1}

Watshiya indawo yakhe eyokwembesa ubukhosi bukaNkulunkulu, uLusifa waphuma ukuthi ayenika ezinye ingilosi umoya wakhe wokukhonona. Wasebenza ensitha, njalo okwesikhatshana wafihla injongo yakhe yeqiniso esenza engathi wayephakamisa uNkulunkulu, wenza imizamo yokuthi alethe ukungasuthiseki ngemithetho kaNkulunkulu eyayilawula izidalwa zonke zezulu, esithi lokhu kwakuletha umgoqo ongadingekiyo. Njengoba izimo zabo zazingcwele, waletha umcabango wokuthi ingilosi kwakumele zilalele kuphela lokho okutshiwo yintando yazo. Wazama ukuthi bamzwele usizi ngokubatshela ukuthi uNkulunkulu wayengamphathanga kahle ngokuphakamisa uKrestu okwedlula yena. Wabatshela ukuthi isifiso sakhe sokuthola amandla adlula lawa ayelawo kwakungasiyo imizamo yokudinga ukuziphakamisa, kodwa wayezama ukutholela izidalwa zonke inkululeko, ukuze ngale indlela benelise ukufinyelela izinga eliphezulu lokuphila. {GC 495.2}

UNkulunkulu emuseni wakhe wabekezelela uLusifa okwesikhathi eside. Kazange ehliswe esikhundleni sakhe nxa wayeqala ukuletha umoya lowu owokusola, ngitsho lalapho ayeseqala khona ukuletha amanga phambi kwezinye ingilosi. Wagcinwa ezulwini okwesikhathi eside. Ukusa kwamalanga wayethenjiswa intethelelo ngaphansi kwamazwi wokuthi kwakumele aphenduke njalo azehlise. Yonke imizamo leyi yayiqondiswe ukuthi imbonise ukuthi wayesenza iphutha. Umoya wokungasuthiseki wawungakaze ubekhona ezulwini. ULusifa ngokwakhe ekuqaleni kazange ananzelele ukuthi wayesenzani, kazange azwisise isimo esiqotho semizwa yakhe. Kodwa nxa ukungasuthiseki kwakhe kwasekuveziwe ukuthi kwakungela sizatho, uLusifa wananzelela ukuthi wayeyenze iphutha, lokuthi imithetho yezulu yayilungile, njalo lokuthi kwakumele ayiphakamise phambi kwezidalwa zonke ezulwini. Ngabe wayekwenzile lokhu wayezazihlenga yena kanye lengilosi ezinengi. Ngalesi isikhathi wayengakalahli ngokuphelela inhlonipho ayelayo phambi kaNkulunkulu. Loba nje wayesetshiye isikhundla sakhe sokuba yikherubi emboza ubukhosi bukaNkulunkulu, ngabe wayefisa ukubuyela kuNkulunkulu, evuma ukuhlakanipha koMdali, njalo elokusithiseka ngokuthatha isikhundla ayesinikwe nguNkulunkulu, wayezabuyiselwa esikhundleni sakhe. Kodwa ukuziphakamisa kwanqabela ukuthi azehlise. Waqhubeka enika izizatho zokuvikela isinqumo ayesithethe, esitsho ukuthi kwakungela sizatho sokuthi avume isono sakhe, njalo wazimisela ukuthi wayezalwisana loMdali wakhe. {GC 495.3}

Wonke amandla ayewaphiwe waqala ukuwasebenzisa emsebenzini wokudukisa, ukwenzela ukuthi athole uzwelo lwezinye ingilosi ezazingaphansi kwamandla wakhe. Lesizatho sokuthi uKrestu wayemxwayisile saguqulwa senziwa njengento embi. Kibo labo ababemthanda njalo bemthemba, uSathane wabatshela ukuthi wayekhuzwe ngendlela engalunganga, lokuthi isikhundla sakhe sasingahlonitshwanga, njalo lokuthi amalungelo akhe ayencindezelwe. Kusukela ekuguquleni amazwi kaKrestu waqhubeka esiyaphambili waqala ukuqamba amanga, ebeka icala phezu kweNdodana kaNkulunkulu ezama ukumnyangisa phambi kwezidalwa zezulu. Wazama futhi ukuletha impi phakathi kwakhe lengilosi ezazikhethe ukulandela intando kaNkulunkulu. Bonke labo ayehluleke ukubakhohlisa ukuthi babesequleni lakhe, wababeka icala lokungabi lendaba lamalungelo ezinye izidalwa zezulu. Umsebenzi lowo ayewenza yena wawuphendulela wenza sengathi wawusenziwa yilabo ababekhethe ukulandela intando kaNkulunkulu. Njalo ukwenzela ukuthi enze ukuthi amazwi akhe okusola uNkulunkulu abelesisindo, wazama ukuphendulela amazwi lezenzo zoMdali. Kwakuyinjongo yakhe ukudida ingilosi ngokusebenzisa amazwi acatshileyo ayephikisa injongo kaNkulunkulu. Yonke into eyayisobala wenza ukuthi ingazwisiseki, njalo ngobungcitshi bakhe wenza ukuthi amazwi kaJehova athandabuzeke. Isikhundla sakhe esasiphezulu, esasimenza abeseduzane loNkulunkulu, senza ukuthi amazwi wakhe abelamandla, njalo abanengi baholelwa ukuthi bavumelane laye ekuhlamukeleni amandla ezulu. {GC 496.1}

UNkulunkulu ngokuhlakanipha kwakhe wavumela uSathane ukuthi aqhubeke ngomsebenzi wakhe, kwaze kwayafika ebangeni lapho umoya wokungasuthiseki owacina usungumvukela osegcekeni. Kwakubalulekile ukuthi amacebo wakhe akhule aze aphelele, ukwenzela ukuthi isimo sawo sibonwe ngumuntu wonke. ULusifa njengekherubi eligcotshiweyo, wayephakanyisiwe kakhulu, njalo wayethandwa yizidalwa zonke zezulu, njalo indonsela yakhe phezu kwabo yayinkulu kakhulu. Umbuso kaNkulunkulu wawungagoqeli kuphela labo ababehlala ezulwini kodwa yonke imihlaba ayeyidalile, njalo uSathane wayecabanga ukuthi nxa wayengathatha ingilosi zonke zezulu laye, wayezenelisa ukuthatha yonke imihlaba eyayidaliwe. Wayesebenzise ubungcitshi bakhe ukuletha amazwi akhe njalo wasebenzisa ubuqili bonke ukuthi akhohlise izithunywa zezulu. Amandla akhe wokukhohlisa ayemakhulu, njalo ngokuzivala ngengubo yamanga wayesenelise ukunqoba abanye. Lengilosi ezazikhethe ukulandela intando kaNkulunkulu azizange zizwisise ngokugcweleyo isimo sakhe futhi azizange ziqedisise ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuzaholela ngaphi. {GC 497.1}

USathane wayekade ephakanyiswe kakhulu okwabangela ukuthi izenzo zakhe zembeswe ngemfihlakalo, okwenza ukuthi kubenzima ukuvezela ingilosi isimo somoya ayelawo. Ngaphandle kokuthi amacebo wakhe akhule aphelele, isono sasingeke sibonakale sisibi ngendlela esiyiyo yona. Kuze kuyefika lapha sasingazange sibe lendawo embusweni wezulu, njalo ingilosi zazingazwisisi isimo saso njalo lobubi baso. Abazange bananzelele umphumela owawuzaba khona nxa basebezabeka umthetho kaNkulunkulu eceleni. USathane ekuqaleni wayefihle umsebenzi wakhe ngaphansi kokuthi wayelokhe elandela intando kaNkulunkulu. Wasebenzisa amazwi okuthi wayezama ukukhulisa ukuhlonitshwa kukaNkulunkulu, njalo lesisekelo sombuso wakhe, njalo lenhlalakahle yezidalwa zonke zasezulwini. Nxa wayeqhubeka efaka ukungasuthiseki engqondweni zengilosi zasezulwini ezazingaphansi kwakhe, wasebenzisa ubuqili bakhe ukuthi kubonakale sengathi wayezama ukususa ukungasuthiseki kwabo. Nxa wayesithi kumele kube lenguquko yendlela izinto ezazisenziwa ngayo njalo lemithetho kaNkulunkulu, kwakungaphansi kobuqili bokuthi lokhu kwakudingeka ukwenzela ukuthi kube lokubambana ezulwini. {GC 497.2}

Ngendlela uNkulunkulu aphatha ngayo isono esasesikhona, kwakungekho okunye ayengakwenza kulokuthi asebenzise ukulunga njalo leqiniso. USathane wayesenelisa ukusebenzisa lokho uNkulunkulu ayengeke akusebenzise, okungamanga njalo lokukhohlisa. Wayezamile ukwenza ukuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu liphendulwe libe ngamanga njalo wayephikise indlela ayebusa ngayo ezulwini, esithi uNkulunkulu wayengalunganga ngokufaka imithetho phezu kwezidalwa zezulu, njalo lokudinga ukuthi bazehlise njalo balandele intando yakhe. Injongo yakhe kwakuyikuthi aphakanyiswe yena akhonzwe. Ngakhoke kwakumele kubonakale phambi kwezidalwa zezulu, lezidalwa ezikweminye imhlaba, ukuthi umbuso kaNkulunkulu wawulungile, njalo lokuthi umthetho wakhe ulungile. USathane wayekwenze kwabonakala sengathi nguye owayezama ukuthi kube lokuthula emhlabeni wonke. Isimo sakhe njalo lenjongo yakhe kwakumele kuvezwe sobala phambi kwabo bonke. Kwakumele anikwe isikhathi esifaneleyo ukuthi kubonakale injongo yakhe yobubi. {GC 498.1}

Ukungahlaliseki ayesekudalile ezulwini, uSathane wabeka icala lakho phezu kwemithetho njalo lombuso kaNkulunkulu. Bonke ububi wabubeka phezu kombuso wezulu. Watshela ababemlalele ukuthi injongo yakhe yayingeyokuqinisa imthetho kaJehova. Ngakhoke kwakudingeka ukuthi abonise umfanekiso wamazwi wakhe, njalo abonise umphumela wenguquko ayefuna ukuyenza emlayweni. Umsebenzi wakhe kwakumele umbophe ngokwawo. USathane wayeqhubeke ngokuthi wayengasuye umhlamuki. Izidalwa zonke kwakumele zibone ukuvezwa komkhohlisi. {GC 498.2}

Langemva kokuba kwasekubekiwe isinqumo sokuthi wayengeke esahlala ezulwini, uNkulunkulu kazange ambhubhise uSathane. Njengoba uNkulunkulu edinga ukuthi simkhonze ngothando kuphela, ngokunjalo ukukhonzwa kwakhe kumele kwenziwe ngenxa yothando lokunanzelela ukuthi ulungile njalo ulesihawu. Izidalwa zasezulwini labanye abakwemihlaba, ngoba babengalungelanga ukuzwisisa isimo njalo lomphumela wesono, babengeke babone ukulunga njalo lomusa kaNkulunkulu ngabe wayembhubhisile. Ngabe wayebhujisiwe eqeda ukona, babezakhonza uNkulunkulu ngaphansi kokwesaba hatshi ngenxa yothando. Indonsela yomkhohlisi yayingeke itshabalale yonke, ngitsho lomoya wokuhlamuka wawungeke ubhujiswe wonke. Ububi kwakumele buvunyelwe ukuthi bukhule bubonakale. USathane kwakumele anikwe ithuba lokuveza isimo sakhe seqiniso ukwenzela ukuthi wonke umuntu azibonele ukuthi uNkulunkulu ulungile njalo ulomusa njalo lokuthi umthetho wakhe ngeke uguquke. {GC 498.3}

Ukuhlamuka kukaSathane kwakuzaba yisifundo sendalo yonke eyayikhona leyayizakuba khona, njengobufakazi besimo njalo lezithelo zesono ezimbi. Ukusebenza kukaSathane, lomphumela wakho ebantwini lasezingilosini, kwakuzabonisa izithelo zokulahla umthetho kaBaba. Kwakuzaba yibufakazi bokuthi ukubakhona kombuso kaNkulunkulu lomthetho wakhe yikho okuqukethe injabulo yezidalwa zonke. Ngale indlela imbali yesenzo lesi yayizaba yisikhumbuzo esingapheliyo esivikela izidalwa zonke ukuthi zingaweli esonweni njalo zingamukeli isijeziso esizakwehlela bonke abonayo. {GC 499.1}

Ngitsho lasemephethelweni wempikiswaneni leyi eyayisezulwini, uSathane waqhubeka esithi kwakungela bubi ayebenzile. Kwathi sekubekwe ilizwi lokuthi yena lazo zonke ingilosi ezazisehlangothini lwakhe zazingeke ziqhubeke zihlala ezulwini, yikho lapho uSathane aqala ukukhuluma ukuthi wayewuzonda umthetho woMdali. Waqhubeka ngemfundiso yakhe yokuthi izidalwa zezulu zazingawudingi umthetho, kodwa kwakumele ziyekelwe ukuthi zilandele intando yazo eyayizahlala iziholela ebuhleni. Waphika imilayo wayibiza ngokuthi yayiyindlela yokwenqabela ukuthi bazibuse, njalo wakwenza kwaba sobala ukuthi kwakuyinjongo yakhe ukuthi umthetho ubhidlizwe, lokuthi ngemva kwalokho izidalwa zezulu zazizakwenelisa ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezu kwalelo ezazikulo. {GC 499.2}

Ngelizwi elilodwa uSathane lengilosi ayezikhohlisile babeka icala lokuhlamuka kwabo phezu kukaKrestu, besithi ngabe babengakhuzwanga, babengeke bahlamuke. Ngale indlela babonisa inkani njalo lokungazisoli, bezama ngeze ukuwisa umbuso kaNkulunkulu, ngesikhathi esifanayo bezibiza ngokuthi babengela cala kodwa ngenxa yombuso wochuku basebezithole besesimeni ababekiso, kodwa ekucineni umkhohlisi omkhulu lalabo ababemlalele baxotshelwa phandle kwezulu. {GC 499.3}

Umoya ofanayo owabangela ukuhlamuka ezulwini lokhe ubangela ukuthi abantu bahlamuke lasemhlabeni. USathane lokhe eqhubeka enika abantu imfundiso ayinika ingilosi ezulwini. Umoya wakhe manje uphila ebantwaneni bokungalaleli. Njengaye bayazama ukwephula umthetho kaNkulunkulu njalo bathembisa abantu ukuthi bazathola inkululeko ngokwephula imilayo. Ukukhuzwa ngenxa yesono lokhe kubangela inzondo njalo lokuhlamuka. Nxa imilayezo kaNkulunkulu yokuxwayisa ilethwa phambi komzwangedwa, uSathane ukhokhela abantu ukuthi bazivikele njalo bafune uzwelo lwabanye endleleni yabo yesono. Kulokuthi baqondise amaphutha wabo, benza ukuthi lowo obakhuzayo azondwe, sengathi nguye obangela ubunzima. Kusukela ensukwini zika Abela olungileyo kusiya fika esikhathini sethu, unjalo umoya oqondiswa kulabo abakhuza isono. {GC 500.1}

Ngendlela efananayo yokuphendulela isimo sikaNkulunkulu ayeyenzile ezulwini, esenza ukuthi abonakale njengombusi olochuku, uSathane wabangela ukuthi abantu bone. Njalo ngemva kokuthi anqobe, waqala ukuthi imthetho kaNkulunkulu engalunganga yiyo eyayibangele ukuthi umuntu awe, ngendlela efananayo umthetho owawubangele ukuthi laye ahlamuke. {GC 500.2}

Kodwa uSimakade uqobo lwakhe uyatsho ukuthi: “YiNkosi! yiNkosi! nguNkulunkulu olesihawu lomusa, ophuza ukuthukuthela, ogcwele uthando olungapheliyo lobuqotho, ohawukela abayizigidi, othethelela ububi leziphambeko lezono, kodwa ongayikubayekela abalecala.” (Eksodusi 34:6,7). {GC 500.3}

Ngokuxotsha kwakhe uSathane ezulwini, uNkulunkulu waveza ukulunga kwakhe njalo wagcina ukuhlonipheka kwesihlalo sakhe. Kodwa ngemva kokona komuntu ngenxa yokulalela amazwi womlingi, uNkulunkulu wabonisa ubufakazi bothando lwakhe ngokunikela iNdodana yakhe ezelwe yodwa ukuthi ifele umhlaba wonke. Emsebenzini wokubuyisana isimilo sikaNkulunkulu sivezwe sobala. Umnikelo owenziwa esiphambanweni uveza sobala phambi kwezidalwa zonke ukuthi indlela yesono eyakhethwa nguSathane ngeke ibekwe phezu kombuso kaNkulunkulu. {GC 500.4}

Empini ephakathi kukaKrestu loSathane, nxa uMsindisi wayesemhlabeni, isimilo somkhohlisi sabonakala sobala. Akula esinye isenzo esasingabangela ukuthi ingilosi ezisezuwini zime ukuzwela uSathane okwedlula indlela aphatha ngayo uKrestu ngochuku nxa wayesemhlabeni. Amazwi wakhe ayisinengiso awokuthi uKrestu kamkhonze, njalo lokuziphakamisa kwakhe okwamenza ukuthi athwalele uKrestu phezu kwentaba lethempeli, njalo lenjongo yakhe yokuthi aziphosele phansi athathe umphefumulo wakhe, njalo lobubi obamlandela endaweni zonke ayehamba kuzo, lokufuqa kwakhe abapristi labantu ukuthi bamphike, njalo lokumemeza kokucina, “Makabethelwe! Makabethelwe! konke lokhu kwamangalisa izidalwa zonke ezazibukele. {GC 501.1}

KwakunguSathane owahola umhlaba ukuthi uphike uKrestu. Umkhohlisi wasebenzisa wonke amandla wakhe njalo lobuqili bonke ukuthi abulale uKrestu, ngoba wabona ukuthi uthando lomusa woMsindisi, njalo lesihelo sakhe kwakubonisa umhlaba isimo sikaNkulunkulu. USathane wenza imizamo yonke ukuphikisa yonke into eyayikhulunywa nguKrestu, njalo wasebenzisa abantu njengezisebenzi zakhe ukuthi benze impilo yakhe ibe ngeyosizi lokuhlupheka. Amaqhinga kanye lamanga ayewasebenzisile ukuthi avimbe umsebenzi kaKrestu, lenzondo ayiletha ngabantu ababengamlaleli, njalo lamacala awabeka phezu kwalowo owayelokulunga okwakungakaze kubonakale emhlabeni, konke kwakuphuma enhliziyweni eyayidinga ukuphindisela. Amalangabi wenzondo lomona, lokuphindisela, aphakama eKhalivari phezu kweNdodana kaNkulunkulu, izulu lonke lakukhangela lokhu ligcwele usizi lokumangala benanzelela ngokokuqala ukuthi isono sasisibi ngale indlela. {GC 501.2}

Nxa umnikelo omkhulu okwedlula yonke wasewenziwe, uKrestu wenyukela phezulu, wayala ukwamukela ukuphakanyiswa ingilosi ezazimnika khona ngaphambi kokuthi alethe isicelo phambi kaBaba esithi: “Ngiyafisa ukuthi labo onginike bona labo, bebelami lapho engikhona.” (Johane 17:24). Ngemva kokutsho kwakhe isicelo lesi, impendulo egcwele uthando lamandla yezwakala ivela esihlalweni sikaBaba: “Izithunywa zonke zikaNkulunkulu azimkhonze.” (Amaheberu 1:6). Akuzange kube lesici esatholakala kuKrestu. Ukuyangiswa kwakhe kuphelile, lomnikelo wakhe wapheleliswa, kwanikwa kuye ibizo eliphezu kwawo wonke amabizo. {GC 501.3}

Manje icala likaSathane laselimile phambi kwakhe kungela mazwi okuzama ukulivikela. Wayesebonisile isimo sakhe seqiniso njengomqambi wamanga njalo lombulali. Kwabonakala ukuthi umoya ofanayo ayewusebenzisile ukubusa abantu, abangaphansi kwamandla wakhe, wayezawusebenzisa ngabe wayeyenelisile ukukhokhela izidalwa zezulu. Wayefundise ukuthi ukwephulwa komthetho kaNkulunkulu kwakuzaletha inkululeko lodumo, kodwa kwabonakala ukuthi umphumela wakho kwakuyibugqili lokufa. {GC 502.1}

Amanga kaSathane ayewalethe mayelana lesimo sombuso wezulu abonakala phambi komhlaba wonke. Wayebeke phezu kaNkulunkulu icala lokufuna ukuziphakamisa kuphela ngokufuna ukuthi izidalwa zakhe zizehlise njalo zimkhonze, njalo wayeqhubeke wathi, loba uMdali wayefuna ukuthi abanye bazidele, yena wayengenzanga lutho olubonisa ukuzidela kwakhe. Manje kwavezwa sobala ukuthi abantu basindiswe, uMbusi wendalo yonke wayeyenze umnikelo omkhulu okwedlula yonke owawungenziwa luthando kuphela, “Ngoba uNkulunkulu wayekuKrestu ebuyisana lomhlaba kuye.” (2 Korinte 5:19). Kwavezwa sobala futhi ukuthi loba uSathane wayevule umnyango ukuthi isono singene ngenxa yokufuna ukuphakanyiswa lokubusa, uKrestu ukwenzela ukuthi abhubhise isono, wayezehlisile wakhetha ukulalela waze wayakufa. {GC 502.2}

UNkulunkulu wayebonisile indlela azonda ngayo ukuhlamuka. Izulu lonke labona ukulunga kwakhe, ekubekeni icala kuSathane njalo lasekusindisweni kwabantu. ULusifa wayetshilo ukuthi nxa kwakuyikuthi umlayo kaNkulunkulu awuguquki, njalo lesigwebo sawo sasingeke sisuswe, wonke umuntu owayewephulile kwakumele alahlwe kokuphela. Wayekukhulumile njalo wathi abantu ngemva kokuwa kwabo basebefike ezingeni lokuthi babengasindiseki ngakho basebeyimpahla yakhe. Kodwa ukufa kukaKrestu kwakuyisenzo esasimele abantu esasingasoke siguqulwe. Isigwebo sokwephula umlayo sawela phezu kwalowo owayelingana loNkulunkulu, njalo umuntu wayesekhululekile ukwamukela ubungcwele bukaKrestu njalo ngempilo yokuzehlisa anqobe, njengoba iNdodana kaNkulunkulu yayinqobile, phezu kwamandla kaSathane. Ngale indlela uNkulunkulu ulungile njalo uyamukela njengabalungileyo labo abakholwa kuKrestu. {GC 502.3}

Kodwa kwakungasiso isizatho sokuhlenga abantu kuphela esabangela ukuthi uKrestu abuye emhlabeni ahlupheke njalo afe. Wabuya ukuthi “aphakamise umthetho” njalo “lokuwenza ukuthi uhlonipheke.” Hatshi kuphela ukuthi labo abahlala emhlabeni lowu kumele bagcine umlayo ngendlela efaneleyo, kodwa kwavezwa kuyo yonke imihlaba ukuthi umthetho kaNkulunkulu awuguquleki. Ngabe wawubekwe eceleni, iNdodana kaNkulunkulu yayingeke ibe lesizatho sokuthi inikele impilo yayo njengomhlatshelo wokwephulwa kwawo. Ukufa kukaKrestu kuyibufakazi bokuthi awuguquleki. Njalo lomnikelo owabangelwa luthando lukaBaba leNdodana, ukuthi izoni zisindiswe, ubonisa phambi kwezidalwa zonke, lokho okwakungeke kwenziwe ngelinye icebo ngaphandle kwecebo losindiso, njalo lokuthi ukulunga lomusa kuyinsika yomthetho lombuso kaNkulunkulu. {GC 503.1}

Ngosuku lokwahlulela lapho isigcwebo esizabekwa khona, kuzabonakala ukuthi akulasizatho sokuthi isono sibekhona. Lapho uMahluleli womhlaba wonke azabuza uSathane, “Kungani wangivukela, njalo wangiphanga izidalwa zombuso wami? umqali wobubi uzaswela isizatho. Imilomo yonke izaphela amathe, njalo bonke abantu abahlamukayo bazaswela amazwi wokutsho. {GC 503.2}

Isiphambano saseKhalvari loba siveza ukuthi umthetho awuguquki, sivezela umhlaba wonke ukuthi inkokhelo yesono iyikufa. Emazwini woMsindisi wokucina athi, “Kuphelile,” isigwebo sokufa kukaSathane sezwakala. Impikiswano enkulu kakhulu eyayiqhubeke okwesikhathi esingaka yaseyifike emaphethelweni wayo, njalo kwasekusobala ukuthi ububi babuzatshabalaliswa kungekudala. Indodana kaNkulunkulu yadlula phakathi kwethuna, ukwenzela ukuthi “ngokufa amchithe obelamandla okufa onguSathane.” (Amaheberu 2:14). Isifiso sikaLusifa sokuphakanyiswa sasiholele ukuthi athi: “Ngizakwenyukela ezulwini, ngaphezu kwezinkanyezi zikaNkulunkulu...ngizenze ngibe njengoPhezulu.” (Isaya 14:13,14). UNkulunkulu uthi: “Ngizakwenza ubengumlotha emhlabathini...kawusayi kubakhona kuze kube ninini.” (Hezekeli 28:18,19). “Ngoba usuku luyeza oluvutha njengeziko lapho bonke abaziphakamisayo labenza okubi bazakuba njengezibi ezitshayo, lolosuku oluzayo luzabatshisa, kutsho iNkosi yamabandla, lungabatshiyeli impande logatsha.” (Malaki 4:1). {GC 503.3}

Umhlaba wonke uzabe ubengofakazi besimo njalo lomphumela wesono. Njalo ukuqedwa kwaso, okwakuzaletha ukwesaba phakathi kwengilosi ngabe kwakwenziwe ekuqaleni, manje kuzaphakamisa uthando lwakhe njalo lokuhlonitshwa kwakhe phambi kwemihlaba yonke elezidalwa ezithokozela ukwenza intando yakhe, njalo abalomthetho wakhe enhliziyweni zabo. Isono asisoze siphakamise ikhanda futhi. Ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lithi: “Ukuhlupheka akusoke kuphakame ngokwesibili.” (Nahume 1:9). Umlayo kaNkulunkulu, uSathane awuchothoze ngokuthi lijogwe lobugqili, uzakuphakanyiswa njengomthetho wenkululeko. Indalo ehloliweyo njalo yalinganiswa ayisoke njalo iphambulwe ekumkhonzeni yena olesimo esivezwe ngokuphelela phambi kwabo njengothando olungela mkhawulo njalo lokuhlakanipha okungela kubalwa. {GC 504.1}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 30 — Ubutha Phakathi Komuntu LoSathane.

“Ngizafaka ubutha phakathi kwakho lowesifazana, laphakathi kwenzalo yakho lenzalo yakhe, izakucobodisa ikhanda lakho, njalo wena uzakuhluzula isithende sakhe.” Genesisi 3:15. Isigwebo esabekwa nguNkulunkulu phezu kaSathane ngemva kokuwa komuntu sasiyisiprofethi njalo esasigoqela izizukulwane zonke kuzekuyefika ekupheleni kwesikhathi njalo kwakuveza impi enkulu eyayizakwehlela yonke imihlobo yabantu ababezaphila emhlabeni. {GC 505.1}

UNkulunkulu uthi: “Ngizafaka inzondo.” Inzondo leyi ayizibuyeli yodwa ngemva kokuzalwa komuntu. Nxa umuntu wayeseyephule umlayo kaNkalunkulu, isimo sakhe saguquka saba ngesokona, njalo waqala ukuba moya munye loSathane. Ngokwenyama lokuzalwa akulanzondo ekhona phakathi kwezoni lomqali wesono. Bonke bobabili baqala ukuba yizoni ngenxa yokuhlamukela intando kaNkulunkulu. Lowo ohlamukayo katholi ukuphumula, ngaphandle kokuthi athole uzwelo njalo lokusekelwa ngokuhugela abanye ukuthi balandele umzekeliso wakhe. Ngenxa yalesi isizatho ingilosi ezawayo ndawonye labantu ababi bayabambana ebunganini obuyize. Ngabe uNkulunkulu wayengangenelanga ngendlela angenela ngayo, uSathane labantu babezabambana bahlamukele izulu, njalo kulokuthi abantu bathakazelele inzondo phakathi kwabo loSathane, imuli yonke yoluntu yayizabambana ukuba iphikisane loNkulunkulu. {GC 505.2}

USathane walinga umuntu ukuthi awone, ngendlela efana laleyo ayebangele ukuthi ingilosi zihlamuke ngayo, ngale indlela ukuze athole ukuxhaswa ekulweni kwakhe leZulu. Kwakungekho ukungazwisisani phakathi kwakhe lengilosi ezawayo mayelana lendlela ababezonda ngayo uKrestu, loba nje ezintweni ezehlukeneyo kwakukhona ukungavumelani, kodwa babelokubambana emsebenzini wabo wokuphikisa amandla oMbusi womhlaba wonke. Kodwa nxa uSathane wayesizwa ukuba kwakuzaba khona ubutha phakathi kwakhe lowesifazana, laphakathi kwenzalo yakhe lenzalo yowesifazana, kwabasobala kuye ukuthi imizamo yakhe eyokungcolisa isimo somuntu yayizamiswa ngelinye ilanga ngoba wananzelela ukuthi kwakuzaba lendlela yokuthi umuntu ayenelise ukumelana lamandla wakhe. {GC 505.3}

Inzondo uSathane alayo phezu koluntu seyabaselwa ngenxa yokuthi ngoKrestu sebeyizidalwa okuboniswa kuzo uthando lokuNkulunkulu njalo lesihawu sakhe. Kuyisifiso sakhe ukuba aphambanise icebo lezulu elokuhlengwa kwabantu, lokungcolisa ibizo likaNkulunkulu, ngokuguqula njalo lokuphambanisa imisebenzi yezandla zakhe, ngoba efuna ukuletha usizi ezulwini njalo lokuba agcwalise umhlaba usizi njalo lokufa. Njalo ubeka phezu kukaNkulunkulu icala lobubi bonke abulethileyo emhlabeni ngenxa yokuthi nguye owadala umuntu. {GC 506.1}

Kungenxa yomusa uKrestu awuhlanyela enhliziyweni zabantu obangela ukuthi kubelenzondo phakathi kwabo loSathane. Nxa umusa lamandla lawa avuselelayo kungekho, umuntu ubezaqhubeka eyisigqili sikaSathane, isigqili ebesizahlala silungele ukwenza intando yakhe. Kodwa amandla lawa amatsha enhliziyweni adala impikiswano lapho obekulokuthula khona ngaphambilini. Amandla lawa avela kuKrestu yiwo ayenza ukuthi umuntu anqobe izilingo zomubi. Lowo lalowo obonakala ezonda isono endaweni yokuthi asithande, lalowo olwisana njalo lonqoba imizwa yokona ebikade ibusa empilweni yakhe, uyabonisa ukusebenza kwamandla avela phezulu kuphela. {GC 506.2}

Ubutha obukhona phakathi komoya kaKrestu lomoya kaSathane wavezwa sobala endleleni umhlaba owamukela ngayo uKrestu lapha emhlabeni. Kwakungasiso isizatho sokuthi kabuyanga ngokuziphakamisa njalo lokubonisa inotho okwabangela ukuthi amaJuda amphike. Bakunanzelela ukuba wayelamandla ayesenelisa ukuthatha indawo yalokho angazange akubonise ngokwempilo yakhe yangaphandle. Kodwa ukulunga lokubamsulwa kukaKrestu yikho okwaletha phezu kwakhe inzondo yomhlaba. Impilo yakhe yokuzidela leyokungoni yayingamukeleki ebantwini abazigqajayo njalo labalandela inkanuko yemizimba yabo ngoba yayibabonisa ububi babo. Yikho lokhu okwabangela inzondo ababelayo ngeNdodana kaNkulunkulu. USathane ndawonye lengilosi ezimbi babambana labantu ababi. Onke amandla okuhlamukela iqiniso abamoya munye emsebenzini wokulwisa iNkosana yamaqiniso. {GC 506.3}

Inzondo efanayo iboniswa phezu kwabalandeli bakaKresu ngendlela eyaboniswa phezu kweNkosi yabo. Lowo onanzelela ububi besono, njalo ngamandla avela phezulu onqoba izilingo, kasoke aphuthe ukuvusa inzondo kaSathane njalo leyezisebenzi zakhe. Inzondo yemfundiso yeqiniso lokuphikiswa lokuhlukunyezwa kwalabo abamela iqiniso, kuzaqhubeka kukhona ngazo zonke izikhathi isoni kanye lezoni nxa zisasekhona emhlabeni. Abalandeli bakaKrestu njalo lenceku zikaSathane akwenzakali ukuthi babemoya munye. Inzondo ebangelwa yikuthwala isiphambano ayikami lalamuhla. “Bonke abazaphila impilo yobungcwele kuKrestu bazadlula phakathi kokuhlukunyezwa.’ 2 Timothi 3:12. {GC 507.1}

Inceku zikaSathane zihleli zisebenza ngaphansi kobukhokheli bakhe ngoba zifuna ukukhulusa amandla akhe njalo lokwakha umbuso wakhe oyiwo olwisana lombuso kaNkulunkulu. Kungenxa yalokho okubangela ukuthi basebenzele ukudukisa abalandeli bakaKrestu njalo lokuthi babahuge ukuze bamhlamukele. Njengomholi wabo bayahlanekela njalo baguqule amazwi eBhayibhili ukwenzela ukuthi bafeze inhloso yabo. Ngendlela uSathane azama ngayo ukungcolisa ibizo likaNkulunkulu, ngokunjalo abalandeli bakhe bahlala bedinga amacebo okungcolisa ibizo labantwana bakaNkulunkulu. Umoya ofananayo owabangela ukubulawa kukaKrestu uholela ababi ukuba babulale abalandeli bakhe. Konke lokhu kuveziwe emazwini esiprofethi awokuqala: “Ngizafaka ubutha phakathi kwakho njalo lowesifazana, njalo laphakathi kwenzalo yakho lenzalo yakhe.” Njalo lokhu kuzaqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni. {GC 507.2}

USathane uqhubeka eqoqa ibutho lakhe njalo usebenzisa wonke amandla akhe ekuhlaseleni akwenzayo. Kungani engahlangani labantu abazama ukumlwisa kakhulu na? Kungani amabutho kaKrestu elele njalo enganaki isimo abakiso na? Kungenxa yokuba balobudlelwano obuqotho loKrestu obuncinyane, njalo abalawo uMoya wakhe. Isono emehlweni wabo asenyanyeki njalo asisilo ihlazo phambi kwabo ngendlela esasibonakala ngayo phambi kweNkosi yabo. Abahlangani laso ngokuzimisela okwenziwa nguKrestu, langokulwisa okulenhloso yokungafuni ukuwa. Abananzeleli ububi besono njalo lobubanzi bokungcola kwaso, njalo amehlo wabo afiphele ukuba babone isimo saso njalo lamandla enkosi yobumnyama. Kulobutha obungatsho lutho phakathi kwabo loSathane lemisebenzi yakhe, ngoba kulokungaqedisisi amandla lobubi njalo lobukhulu bokulwisa uKrestu lebandla lakhe akwenzayo. Inengi labantu likhohlisiwe ngaleso sizatho. Abakwazi ukuthi isitha sabo singumkhulu webutho omkhulu owenelisa ukulawula ingqondo zezingilosi ezawayo, lokuthi usebenzisa amaqhinga lamacebo alobungcitshi obukhulu ekulweni loKrestu ngenxa yenhloso yokwenqabela ukuba abantu basindiswe. Phakathi kwabantu abazibiza ngokuthi bangamaKrestu ngitsho laphakathi kwabafundisi, kukalutshwana ukuzwa kukhulunywa ngoSathane, kuphela nxa ibizo lakhe lingene phakathi kwentshumayelo nje. Ubufakazi bokubakhona njalo lokuphumelela kwakhe abunakwa, izixwayiso zobuqili bakhe aziqakathekiswa, njalo indlela abenza ngayo ibonisa ukuthi sebakhohlwa ukuthi ukhona emhlabeni. {GC 507.3}

Nxa abantu belokhe beqhubeka bengananzeleli amaqhinga wakhe, isitha lesi esingalaliyo sihlala sisendleleni yabo ngezikhathi zonke. Ubakhona kuzo zonke izigaba zemuli, kuyo yonke imigwaqo emadolobheni, emabandleni wonke, emihlanganweni yelizwe, emthethwandaba, elinga njalo ehuga, kuzo zonke indawo uhlala engcolisa impilo njalo lemzimba yamadoda, labesifazane, labantwana, uyabhidliza izimuli, uhlanyela inzondo, ukulungisela, izimpi, ubugovu, njalo lokubulalana. Ngesikhathi esifanayo amaKrestu amukela lezi izinto sengathi uNkulunkulu nguye ohlelileyo ukuba zenzakale. {GC 508.1}

USathane ngazo zonke izikhathi uhlala esenza amaqhinga okunqoba abantwana bakaNkulunkulu ngokwephula imiduli lothango olubahlukanisa lomhlaba. Abantwana bakoIsrayeli endulo baholelwa esonweni ngemva kokubambana labezizwe okuyinto ababetshelwe ukuba bangayenzi.
