UIsrayeli walamuhla laye uholelwa ekulahlweni ngendlela efanayo. “Unkulunkulu walesisikhathi uphumputhekisile ingqondo zabangakholwayo, ukuze kungakhanyi kibo ukukhanya kwevangeli lenkazimulo kaKristu, ongumfanekiso kaNkulunkulu.” 2 Khorinte 4:4. Bonke abangasibo abalandeli bakaKrestu beqiniso bayizisebenzi zikaSathane. Enhliziyweni engaphendukanga kulothando lwesono njalo lendonsela yokusikholisa njalo lokusikhulumela lokusivikela. Enhliziyweni esiphendukile kulenzondo yesono lokuzimisela okukhulu ekwenzeni imizamo yokusinqoba. Nxa amaKrestu ekhetha ukwakha ubudlelwano labantu abangakhonziy labangakholwayo, bazifaka engozini yokulingwa. USathane uyazifihla ukuba angabonakali njalo kancane kancane uyafiphalisa amehlo abo ukuze bengananzeleli imijibila yakhe. Ubenza bangananzeleli ukuba ubudlelwano obunjalo budalelwe ukubalimaza njalo ngesikhathi esifanayo bayabe beguqulwa ukuba bafane lomhlaba ngokwesimo sabo, langamazwi abawakhulumayo, njalo langezenzo, okubangela ukuba baqhubeka besiba yiziphofu kokwakomoya. {GC 508.2}

Ukulandela inkanuko zomhlaba kubangela ukuba ibandla liphendukele emhlabeni, akwenzeki ukuthi kuphendulele umhlaba kuKrestu. Ukujwayela isono ekucineni kubangela ukuthi isono sicine singasabonakali sisenyanyeka. Lowo okhetha ukwakha ubudlelwano lezisebenzi zikaSathane ekucineni ulahlekelwa yikwesaba inkosi yabo. Nxa ngesikhathi sisemsebenzini sifakwa ngaphansi kokuvivinywa, ngendlela uDanyeli afakwa ngayo esigodlweni senkosi, singaba lesiqiniseko sokuthi uNkulunkulu uzasivikela, kodwa nxa sizifaka ngaphansi kwezilingo sizakuwa kuphela ekucineni. {GC 509.1}

Umlingi wandise ukuphumelela kakhulu nxa esebenzisa abantu abangacatshangelwayo ukuthi bangaphansi kwamandla wakhe. Abantu abafundileyo kakhulu njalo labalezipho ezingajwayelekanga bandise ukuhlonitshwa lokuthandwa ngabantu, sengathi izipho lezi zingavala isikhexe sokungamesabi uNkulunkulu kumbe lokuthi zingabangela ukuthi bamukeleke phambi kwakhe. Izipho lendlela abantu abaziphatha ngayo nxa kukhangelwa kumi kodwa, kuyimizekeliso yezipho ezivela kuNkulunkulu, kodwa nxa lokhu kusenziwa ukuthi kuthathe indawo yokulunga, nxa kulokuthi kusetshenziswe ukuletha inhliziyo eduze loNkulunkulu, kubangela ukuthi abantu baholelwe khatshana laye, ekucineni abantu bakhona baphenduka babe yisinengiso njalo lemijibila yomubi. Kulomcabango osengqondweni zabanengi owokuthi konke okuhambelana lokulunga njalo lokuphatha kahle abantu kufanele kube kuvela kuKrestu. Akukaze kube lephutha elikhulu okwedlula leli. Kuliqiniso ukuthi zonke lezi izinto kumele zitholakale kuwo wonke amaKrestu, ngoba zingaletha indonsela elamandla amakhulu enkolweni yeqiniso, kodwa kufanele zinikelwe kuNkulunkulu, ngoba zilamandla okusetshenziswa kokubi. Amadoda amanengi akhaliphileyo njalo alezimilo ezilolongiweyo, abangenzi izenzo ezazakalayo ukuthi azilunganga, atholakala eyizisebenzi zakaSathane ezilolongiweyo. Isimilo sakhe esifihlakeleyo njalo lendonsela alayo yenza ukuthi abeyisitha sombuso kaKrestu esiyingozi kakhulu kulalabo abangelakho okubukekayo ngabo. {GC 509.2}

Ngomkhuleko oqotho njalo lokwethemba uNkulunkulu kuphela, uSolomoni wamukela inhlakanipho eyamangalisa njalo leyayifiswa ngumhlaba wonke. Kodwa wathi esefulathele umthombo wamandla wakhe, njalo waqhubeka ngempilo yokuzithemba yena, kwaba lula ukuthi awele esonweni. Ngemva kwalokho ukuhlanakipha konke lamandla ayenikwe inkosi eyayilokuhlakanipha okwedlula zonke, kwabangela ukuthi abe yisikhali esesabekayo esandleni sikaSathane. {GC 509.3}

Loba nje uSathane ehlala esebenzela ukufiphalisa ingqondo zamaKrestu ukuthi zingakunanzeleli lokhu, amaKrestu awangakhohlwa ukuthi “kasibindani legazi lenyama, kodwa lemibuso lamandla, lababusi balumhlaba wobumnyama balesisikhathi, labomoya ababi endaweni eziphezulu.” Efesu 6:12. Amazwi okulimukisa ezwakala kusukela endulo esiza esikhathini sethu athi: “Qondani lilinde ngoba isitha senu uSathane, siyazula njengesilwane esibhongayo sidinga esingamginya.” 1 Phetro 5:8. “Hlomani izikhali zonke zikaNkulunkulu ukuze libe lamandla okumelana lobuqili bukaSathane.” Efesu 6:11. {GC 510.1}

Kusukela ensukwini zika Adamu kusiyafika esikhathini sethu, isitha sethu esikhulu silokhe sisebenzisa amandla waso ukugqilaza njalo lokubulala abantu. Khathesi ulungiselela umkhankaso wakhe wokucina azawuqondisa ebandleni. Bonke abazama ukulandela uJesu bazangena phakathi kwempi enkulu lesitha lesi esingadeliyo. UmKrestu nxa eqhubeka esakha isimo esiseduzane laleso esikhangelelwe lizulu, yikho lapho azifaka khona egcekeni ukuba ahlaselwe nguSathane. Bonke abaphatheke emsebenzini kaNkulunkulu, njalo abasebenzela ukuveza amaqhinga kaSathane njalo lokuveza uKrestu phambi kwabantu, bazakwenelisa ukuba lengxenye ebufakazini bukaPhawuli, lapho akhuluma khona ngokusebenzela iNkosi ngokuzehlisa konke okwengqondo, langenyembezi ezinengi njalo lezilingo. {GC 510.2}

USathane wahlasela uKrestu ngezilingo ezesabeka okwedlula zonke njalo lezibonisa ubugcitshi bakhe bonke, kodwa ngazo zonke izikhathi uKrestu wamninela khatshana. Izimpi lezi zaliwa endaweni yethu, ukunqoba kwakhe konke kwenza ukuba lathi senelise ukunqoba. UKrestu uzanika amandla bonke abawadingayo. Akulamuntu ngaphandle kokuthi azivumele yena onganqotshwa nguSathane. Umlingi kalawo amandla okulawula amandla okukhetha kwethu kumbe okusibamba ngamandla ukuthi sone. Usengazwisa ubuhlungu benhliziyo, kodwa ngeke adonge ukubamsulwa kwethu. Usengadabula inhliziyo kodwa ngeke angcolise. Isizatho sokuthi uKrestu sewanqoba kumele sinike abalandeli bakhe amadlabuzane wokulwa ngesibindi impi ekhona phakathi kwabo lesono kanye loSathane. {GC 510.3}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 31 — Ukusebenza Kwemimoya Emibi.

Ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwezinto ezibonakalayo lezingabonwayo emhlabeni, lokusebenza kwengilosi zikaNkulunkulu, njalo lemimoya emibi, buvezwe sobala eBhayibhilini, njalo abuhlukaniseki lembali yabantu. Sekulemfundiso ekhulayo kulezi insuku eyabantu abangafuni ukukholwa ukuthi kulemimoya emibi emhlabeni, ngesikhathi esifanayo ingilosi ezilungileyo “ezihambela labo abazakuba zindlalifa zokusindiswa” Amaheberu 1:14 ziphathwa njengemimoya yabantu abafileyo. Kodwa iMibhalo ayifundisi kuphela ngokuthi kulengilosi eziphila phakathi kwethu, ezilungileyo lezimbi, kodwa iletha ubufakazi obungaphikisekiyo obuchaza ukuthi ingilosi lezi azisiyo imimoya yabantu abafileyo. {GC 511.1}

Ngaphambi kokudalwa komuntu, ingilosi zazikhona, ngoba nxa isisekelo somhlaba sasibekwa, “inkanyezi zokusa zahlabela ndawonye, njalo amadodana kaNkulunkulu wonke amemeza ngamazwi entokozo.” Jobe 38:7. Ngemva kokuwa komuntu, ingilosi zathunyelwa ukuthi zilinde isihlahla sokuphila, njalo lokhu kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthi kufe loyedwa umuntu. Ingilosi ngokudalwa kwazo zilesimo esiphezulu kulumuntu, ngoba umlobi kamahubo uthi umuntu wadalwa “wabangaphansi kancane kulengilosi.” Amahubo 8:5. {GC 511.2}

Siyaziswa eBhayibhilini ngenani njalo lamandla kanye lenkazimulo yezidalwa zezulu, njalo lobudlelwano bazo lombuso kaNkulunkulu, njalo lomsebenzi eziwenzayo phakathi kwecebo losindiso. “INkosi isimisile isihlalo sayo emazulwini, njalo lombuso wayo uphezu kwakho konke.” Njalo uMprofethi uthi, “Ngasengisizwa ilizwi lezithunywa ezingelakubalwa.” Phambi kwesihlalo seNkosi yamakhosi zilindile - “ingilosi ezilamandla amakhulu,” “izisebenzi zakhe, ezenza intando yakhe,” ezilalela ilizwi lakhe.” Amahubo 103:19-21, Sambulo 5:11. Inkulungwane zezinkulungwane, lezinkulungwane ezilitshumi zezinkulungwane ezilitshumi, kwakuzingilosi zezulu ezabonwa ngumprofethu uDanyeli. Umpostoli uPhawuli waziveza “njengenani elingelakubalwa.” Danyeli 7:10, Amaheberu 12:22. Njengezithunywa zikaNkulunkulu ziyaphuma, “njengomfanekiso wokuphazima kombani,” Hezekeli 1:14, zikhazimula ngenkazimulo yazo njalo ngesiqubu esikhulu. Ingilosi eyabonakala engcwabeni loMsindisi, ubuso bayo babungathi “ngumbane, njalo lengubo yakhe yayimhlophe njengonqwaqwane”, lokhu kwabangela ukuthi labo ababelindile besabe, njalo “baphenduka abantu abafileyo.” Mathewu 28:3,4. Nxa uSenakeribi, inkosi yaseAsiriya eyayiziphakamisa, yaseyihlambaze igama likaNkulunkulu, njalo yethusela isizwe sakoIsrayeli, “Inkosi yathumela isithunywa sayo ebusuku, sayabulala izinkulungwane ezilikhulu lamatshumi aficaminwembili lanhlanu ezihonqweni zamaAsiriya. “Sabulala amaqhawe wonke labaphathi bezimpi lezinduna ezihonqweni zenkosi yaseAsiriya,” ababephakathi kwebutho lika Senakeribi. “Yona yabuyela elizweni layo ilenhloni.” 2 Amakhosi 19:5; 2 Imilandu 32:21. {GC 511.3}

Ingilosi ziyathunyelwa ukuthi zizokwenza umsebenzi wokubonisa umusa ebantwaneni bakaNkulunkulu. KuAbrahama, zaletha izithembiso zokubusiswa, emasangweni aseSodoma, ukuzohlenga uLothi phakathi komlilo. KuElija nxa wayesezakufa ngokudinwa njalo ngendlala enkangala, kuElisha ngenqola lamabhiza omlilo edolobheni elincane izitha zakhe ezazimvalele khona, kuDanyeli, nxa wayedinga ukuhlanipha kwasezulwini esigodlweni senkosi eyayingumhedeni lanxa wayesephoselwe emgodini wezilwane, kuPetro nxa wayesebotshelwe ukufa entolongweni, kuzibotshwa zaseFiliphi; kuPhawuli labanye ayelabo phakathi kwesiphepho olwandle, ukuvula ingqondo kaConeliasi ukuthi amukele ivangeli; ukuthumela uPetro lodaba losindiso ukuba alunike indoda yezizwe — ngale indlela ingilosi ezingcwele, kusukela endulo, zazisebenzela abantu bakaNkulunkulu. {GC 512.1}

Ingilosi yokulinda inikwa wonke umuntu olandela uKrestu. Abalindi laba abavela ezulwini bavikela bonke abangcwele emandleni kaSathane. Lokhu uSathane ngokwakhe wakunanzelela nxa wayesithi: “UJobe umesabela ize uNkulunkulu na? Kawumvikelanga inxa zonke yena lendlu yakhe kanye lakho konke alakho na?” Jobe 1:9,10. Indlela uNkulunkulu avikela ngayo abantu bakhe ivezwe emazwini womlobi wamahubo: “Isithunywa seNkosi siyabavikela labo abayesabayo, sibakhulule.” Amahubo 34:7. UMsindisi nxa wayekhuluma ngalabo abakholwa kuye wathi: “Khangelani lingadeleli omunye walaba abancinyane ngoba ngithi kini: Ezulwini izithunywa zabo zihlala zibona ubuso bukaBaba osezulwini.” Mathewu 18:10. Ingilosi ezinikwe umsebenzi wokuvikela abantwana bakaNkulunkulu ziyenelisa ukufinyelela uNkulunkulu ngaso sonke isikhathi. {GC 512.2}

Ngale indlela abantu bakaNkulunkulu abahlangana lamandla lobubi bukaSathane, njalo abalwisana lemimoya yonke yobubi, balesiqiniseko sokuthi kukhona abalindi abangabatshiyiyo abavela ezulwini. Njalo isiqiniseko lesi asinikwanga ngoba indingeko yakhona ingekho. Nxa uNkulunkulu enike abantwana bakhe isithembiso somusa lokuvikelwa, kungenxa yokuthi kulamandla amakhulu obubi okumele alwiswe, amandla amanengi, azimiseleyo, njalo angadinwayo okumele abantu bonke bawazi. {GC 513.1}

Imimoya emibi ekuqaleni eyayidalwe ingelasono, yayilingana ngokudalwa, lamandla, lobukhosi lengilosi ezingcwele eziyizithunywa zikaNkulunkulu lamhlanje. Kodwa ngokuwa ngenxa yesono, ingilosi lezi zibambene lamhlanje njalo zisebenzela ukuhlamukela uNkulunkulu lokubhidliza abantu. Ngemva kokubambana loSathane ekuhlamukeni kwakhe, njalo laye zalahlelwa ngaphandle kwezulu njalo kusukela endulo, zisebenzisana laye empini yakhe ayilwa lamandla ezulu. Siyatshelwa eMbhalweni ngokubuthana kwazo njalo lombuso wazo, njalo lezikhundla zazo, lokuhlakanipha kanye lokukhohlisa kwazo, njalo lamacebo wazo alwisana lokuthula njalo lenjabulo yabantu. {GC 513.2}

Imbali etholakala eThestamentini elidala iyachaza ngokubakhona kwazo kanye lomsebenzi wazo, kodwa kwakuphakathi kwensuku zikaKrestu emhlabeni lapho imimoya emibi eyabonisa khona amandla okwedlula izikhathi zonke. UKrestu wayeze ukuzongena ecebeni elaliyenzelwe ukusindiswa kwabantu, njalo uSathane wazimisela ukuvikela ilungelo lakhe lokuhola umhlaba. Wayephumelele emsebenzini wakhe wokwenza ukuthi abantu bakhonze izithixo endaweni zonke zomhlaba ngaphandle kwelizwe lasePalestine. Elizweni leli elilodwa elalingakakhothameli amandla wakhe ngokupheleleyo, uKrestu wabuya ukuthi azonika abantu ukukhanya kwasezulwini. Kule indawo amandla amabili alwela ukubusa. UJesu wayeselula isandla sakhe sothando, enxusa bonke abafisayo ukuthi bazothola ukuthethelelwa njalo lokuthula kuye. Ixuku lobunyama lananzelela ukuthi lalingelamandla amanengi, njalo bananzelela ukuthi nxa umsebenzi kaKrestu wawungaphumelela, ukubusa kwabo kwakuzaphela masinyane. USathane wagcwala ulaka njengesilwane esibotshelweyo, njalo wenza inkani ebonisa amandla wakhe phezu kwemizimba njalo lemphefumulo yabantu. {GC 513.3}

Iqiniso lokuthi abantu babengenwa ngamadimoni livezwe sobala eThestamentini elitsha. Abantu ababelamadimoni laba, babengaguli nje ngenxa yemikhuhlane ejwayelekileyo. UKrestu wayelokuzwisisa okuqondileyo mayelana lalokho ayehlangena lakho, njalo wananzelela ubukhona bemimoya emibi phakathi kwabo. {GC 514.1}

Umzekeliso omangalisayo oveza inani, lamandla njalo lochuku lwawo, njalo lamandla kanye lomusa kaKrestu, uvezwe endabeni yokusiliswa kwabantu ababelamadimoni endaweni yaseGadara. Abantu laba ababengcolile, besehlula ukubotshwa konke, bebhubhudla amagwebu, belolaka, babezwakala ngokukhala kwabo, bezilimaza, njalo beyingozi kibo bonke ababebalanda. Ukuvuza kwegazi emzimbeni yabo njalo lengqondo ezaseziphambene kwakuletha umfanekiso owawuthokozisa uSathane. Elinye lamadimoni lawa ayehola amadoda lawa lathi: “Ibizo lami nginguLigiyoni, ngoba sibanengi.” Marko 5:9. Emabuthweni aseRoma iligiyoni yayisiba lamamabutho aphakathi kwenkulungwane ezintathu kusiya kwezinhlanu. Amabutho kaSathane lawo ayesebenza ngamaxuku, njalo ixuku elilodwa lamadimoni lawa lalingabi ngaphansi kweligiyoni. {GC 514.2}

Ngelizwi likaJesu imimoya emibi yaphuma phakathi kwamadoda lawa, yabatshiya behleli ngokuthula ezinyaweni zoMsindisi, becolekile, umcabango wabo usuphendukile, njalo belungile. Kodwa amadimoni avunyelwa ukuthi aphosele ingulube elwandle, njalo kuzakhamizi zaseGadara ukulahlekelwa zingulube zabo kwakulohlonzi okwedlula izibusiso uKrestu ayezinike amadoda lawa, ngakho uMsindisi wacelwa ukuthi asuke kule indawo. Lowu kwakungumphumela uSathane ayewufuna. Ngokubeka icala lokulahlekelwa yizifuyo zabo kuJesu, wavusa ukwesaba okubangelwa yibumina ebantwini njalo wabanqabela ukuthi bazwe amazwi kaKrestu. USathane uhlala ebeka icala phezu kwamaKrestu nxa kukhona okulahlekileyo, lokungahambanga kahle, njalo lokuhlupheka, kulokuthi ayekele icala libekwe lapho okumele libe khona, phezu kwakhe lezisebenzi zakhe. {GC 514.3}

Kodwa injongo kaKrestu yayingeke imiswe yimizamo yakhe. Wavumela imimoya emibi ukuthi ibhubhise ingulube njengendlela yokukhuza amaJuda lawa ayefuya izifuyo lezi bona besazi ukuthi zingcolile phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngoba befuna inzuzo. Ngabe uKrestu wayenganqabelanga amadimoni lawa, ayezaphosela elwandle hatshi kuphela lengulube kodwa lalabo ababezelusile kanye labanikazi. Ukuvikelwa kwabelusi labanikazi kwakungenxa yamandla akhe, ayesetshenziswe ngomusa ukuthi abavikele. Ngokunjalo futhi isehlakalo lesi savunyelwa ukwenzakala ukwenzela ukuthi abafundi babone uchuku lwamandla kaSathane phezu kwabantu lenyamazana. UMsindisi wayefisa ukuthi abalandeli bakhe babe lolwazi ngesitha ababezahlangana laso, lokuthi engabakhohlisi. Kwakuyintando yakhe njalo ukuthi abantu bakule indawo babone amandla akhe okwephula ubugqili obabubekwe nguSathane njalo lokukhulula bonke ayebathumbile. Loba nje uJesu ngokwakhe wasuka endaweni lweyi, amadoda lawa ayekhululiwe, asala etshumayela ngomusa walowo owayebakhululile. {GC 515.1}

Ezinye izehlakalo ezihambelanayo zilotshiwe eBhayibhilini. Indodakazi yomama wase Syrophonicia yayihlutshwa ngamadimoni, uJesu awakhiphayo ngelizwi lakhe. Marko 7:26-30. “Omunye owayelamadimoni, eyisiphofu njalo engakhulumi.” Mathewu 12:22, omunye omutsha owayelomoya oyisimungulu “lapho ombamba khona umlahla phansi, abhubhudle amagwebu, ukuthi umbulale” Marko 9:17-27; lomunye owayelahlekelwe zingqondo zakhe, njalo ehlukunyezwa “ngumoya omubi” Luka 4:33-36, owayephambanisa ukuthula kweSabatha ebandleni laseCapenaumi, bonke basiliswa nguMsindisi owayelozwelo. Phose kuzo zonke izikhathi, uKrestu wayekhuluma lamadimoni njengezidalwa ezikhaliphileyo, ewatshela ukuthi aphume njalo ewaqonqosela ukuthi angamhluphi futhi. Abantu ababekhonza edolobheni laseCapernaumi, nxa babebona amandla wakhe, “bamangala bonke, bakhulumisana besithi: Yilizwi bani leli? Ngoba ngamandla uyalaya omoya ababi, baphume.” Luka 4:36. {GC 515.2}

Labo abalamadimoni bayandise ukuchazwa njengabantu abasesimeni sokuhlupheka, kodwa kwakunganjalo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ngesizatho sokufuna ukuba lamandla aphezu kwawabantu bonke, abanye babesamukela umoya kaSathane. Laba babengela kuphikisana lamadimoni. Phakathi kwequla leli kwakulalabo ababelomoya wokutshaya amathambo, ababefana loSimon Magus, loElymus, njalo lentombazana eyalandela uPhawuli loSilas edolobheni laseFiliphi {GC 516.1}.

Akulabantu abasengozini yokungenwa yimimoya emibi okwedlula labo abathi nxa besizwa ubufakazi obusobala obuvela eBhayibhilini abayalayo ukuthi imimoya emibi lamadimoni ikhona njalo iyaphila emhlabeni. Nxa sihlala singazi ngokusebenza kwayo, imimoya kaSathane ibalamandla phezu kwethu, ngoba abanye bayalalela ukukhokhela kwayo bona becabanga ukuthi balandela ukuhlakanipha kwengqondo zabo. Yiso isizatho sokuthi nxa sifika ensukwini zokucina, lapho uSathane azasebenza ngamandla amakhulu ukukhohlisa lokubulala, uhambisa yonke indawo imfundiso yokuthi akulasidalwa esithiwa nguSathane esiphilayo emhlabeni. Kuyindlela asebenza ngayo ukuthi azifihle yena lendlela asebenza ngayo. {GC 516.2}

Akulanto umkhohlisi ayesaba kangaka okwedlula ukuthi sizabawazi amaqhinga akhe wonke. Ngemizamo yokufihla isimo sakhe njalo lenjongo zakhe, usebangele ukuthi labo abakhuluma ngobukhona bakhe bakhangelwe njengabantu abasangeneyo njalo wenza ukuthi behlekwe ulunya. Uyathokoza nxa labo abadwebayo besenza umfanekiso wesidalwa esibi njalo esilempondo esingabonakaliyo ukuthi ngumuntu kumbe yinyamazana. Uyajabula nxa esizwa ibizo lakhe lisetshenziswa emaqenjini wemidlalo, njalo lalabo abenza inhlekisa ngalo ngoba becabanga ukuthi bakhaliphile njalo balolwazi ngaye. {GC 516.3}

Kungenxa yokuthi uzifihle ngobunono obukhulu okwenza ukuthi kube lombuzo obuzwa endaweni ezinengi: “Ngabe kukhona vele isidalwa esinjalo emhlabeni?” Kuyibufakazi bokuphumelela kwakhe okwenza ukuthi kube lemfundiso emhlabeni ezibangela ukuthi ubufakazi obusobala obutholakala eBhayibhilini mayelana laye bamukelwe njengamanga lamhlanje. Njalo kungenxa yokuthi uSathane uyenelisa ukuholela ingqondo zalabo abangananzeleli indonsela yakhe, okubangela ukuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lisinike imzekeliso eminengi kangaka mayelana lomsebenzi wakhe, liyavula phambi kwethu amaqhinga akhe, ukwenzela ukuthi silulame angasikhohlisi. {GC 517.1}

Amandla njalo lobubi bukaSathane kanye lengilosi zakhe ebengasethusa ngabe bekungasikho ukuthi siyenelisa ukuthola indawo yokuphepha njalo lokukhululwa ngenxa yamandla woMsindisi wethu. Siyenza imizamo yonke yokuvikela imizi yethu ngokufaka amabhawudo lamakhiye sizama ukuvikela inotho yethu lempilo zethu ukwenzela ukuthi zingaphanjaniswa ngabantu ababi, kodwa asicabangi ngemimoya emibi ehlala izama ukungena phakathi kwethu, njalo esingelamandla ngokwenyama wokuzivikela nxa isihlasela. Nxa imimoya leyi inikwe imvumo, iyenelisa ukuphambanisa ingqondo zethu, ihlukumeze imizimba yethu, ibhidlize imfuyo yethu njalo lempilo zethu. Into eyithokozisayo yikusibona sihlupheka njalo sisifa. Siyesabeka isimo salabo abaphika intando kaNkulunkulu njalo bavumele izilingo zikaSathane, kuze kufike isikhathi lapho uNkulunkulu abayekela ukuthi babesezandleni zamadimoni kaSathane. Kodwa labo abalandela uKrestu bahlala bephephile ngaphansi kwelihlo lakhe elingalaliyo. Ingilosi ezilamandla amakhulu ziyathunyelwa zivela ezulwini ukuthi zibavikele. Omubi kenelisi ukufohla uthango uNkulunkulu alufake ebantwini bakhe. {GC 517.2}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 32 — Imijibila KaSathane.

Impikiswano enkulu phakathi kukaKrestu loSathane, elokhe iqhubeka okweminyaka phose efika inkulungwane eziyisithupha, isizaphela, njalo omubi manje usesebenza ngamandla aphindwe kabili ngoba ezama ukunqoba umsebenzi kaKrestu wokuhlenga abantu njalo lokubophela abantu emjibileni yakhe. Injongo yakhe ngeyokuthi abambe abantu emnyameni kuzekufike isikhathi lapho uMsindisi azakuma khona ukusincengela, lapho okuyabe sekungasela umnikelo wesono, njalo ithuba lokuphenduka eliyabe lingasekho khona. {GC 518.1}

Nxa kungekho imizamo yokulwisa amandla akhe, nxa ukungabilendaba kugcwele ebandleni njalo lasemhlabeni, uSathane kalandaba, ngoba kakho engozini yokulahlekelwa yilabo abathumba ngokuthanda kwakhe. Kodwa nxa abantu bebizelwa empilweni ephakade, njalo imphefumulo nxa ibuza ukuthi, “Kuyini okumele ngikwenze ukuba ngisindiswe?” uyabuya laye ezozama ukulwisana lamandla kaKrestu njalo lokuphikisa indonsela kaMoya oNgcwele. {GC 512.2}

IBhayibhili liyachaza ukuthi ngolunye usuku, nxa ingilosi zikaNkulunkulu zazizohlangana phambi kaNkulunkulu, uSathane laye wabuya phakathi kwabo, hatshi ukuzokhothama phambi kaSimakade, kodwa ukuzophumelelisa injongo yakhe phezu kwabangcwele. (Job 1:6). Uzangenjongo efananayo lamuhla nxa abantu bebuthene ukuba bakhonze uNkulunkulu. Loba nje engabonakali, usebenza ngobungcitshi obukhulu ezama ukukhokhela ingqondo zabantu laba abakhonzayo. Njengomkhulu webutho ubeka amacebo wakhe phansi kuselesikhathi. Nxa ebona isithunywa sikaNkulunkulu sihlola uMbhalo, uyaqaphelisa indaba azakhuluma ngayo phambi kwabantu. Abesesebenzisa wonke amandla wakhe lobuqili alabo ukuhlela izehlakalo ngendlela yokuthi indaba leyi ingafinyeleli lowo amkhohlisa ngezinto okuzakhulunywa ngazo. Lowo odinga amazwi lawa kakhulu uyafuqwa ukuthi abesendaweni ethile edinga ukuthi abekhona, kumbe ngezinye indlela engenelisi ukuzwa amazwi lawa abengasiza umphefumulo wakhe. {GC 518.3}

USathane uyabona njalo nxa inceku zikaNkulunkulu zilomthwalo ngenxa yobunyama obembese abantu. Uyezwa imithandazo yabo yokucela umusa njalo lamandla wokususa ukulala okusebandleni, lobutshapha njalo lokungakholwa. Ngamandla avuselelweyo uyabumba amanye amaqhinga. Uyalinga abantu ukuthi bengazithibi ekudleni kumbe kokunye abantu abazithokozisa ngakho, njalo ngale indlela uyenelisa ukuthundubeza imizwa yabo ukwenzela ukuthi behluleke ukuzwa lezo izinto okumele bazifunde. {GC 519.1}

USathane uyazi kahle ukuthi bonke angenelisa ukubahola ukuthi bayekele ukukhuleka njalo lokubala iBhayibhili, bazakwehlulwa yikuhlasela kwakhe. Ngakho uyabumba yonke imijibila angayisebenzisa ukuthi ingqondo ihlale igcwele zonke izinto ezibavimbela ukuthi bathandaze njalo babale ilizwi likaNkulunkulu. Kuhlala kulequla lalabo abazibiza ngokuthi balungile, abathi kulokuthi benze imizamo yokwazi iqiniso, bona benza kube yinkolo yabo ukuhlala bedinga amaphutha kulabo abangavumelani labo. Abantu abanjalo bayizisebenzi zikaSathane ezinkulu. Abantu abahlala bebeka icala kwabanye abazalwane abakho balutshwana, njalo bahlala bephathekile nxa uNkulunkulu esemsebenzini njalo nxa inceku zakhe zimkhonza ngokweqiniso. Bazafaka amanga phezu kwamazwi lezenzo zalabo abathanda njalo abalandela iqiniso. Bazakwenza ukuthi inceku zikaNkulunkulu ezisebenza ngokuzimisela njalo lokuzidela zibonakale njengabakhohlisi kumbe abantu abakhohlisiweyo. Kungumsebenzi wabo ukuphendulela injongo zezenzo zabo ezinhle, lokuhambisa imbiko yamanga ngabo, ukwenzela ukuthi labo abatsha ebandleni bangabathembi. Kuyoyonke indlela abangayisebenzisa benza ukuthi konke okuhle lokulungileyo kubonakale sengathi kubi njalo kuyinkohliso. {GC 519.2}

Kodwa akulamuntu okufanele ukuthi akhohliswe mayelana labo. Kuyabonakala sobala ukuthi bangabantwana bakabani, njalo lokuthi balandela umzekeliso kabani, njalo lokuthi benza umsebenzi kabani. “Lizakubazi ngezithelo zabo.” Mathewu 7:16. Umsebenzi wabo ufana lokaSathane, umkhohlisi omkhulu, “ummangaleli wabazalwane.” Sambulo 12:10. {GC 519.3}

Umkhohlisi omkhulu ulezisebenzi zakhe ezihlala zilungele ukuletha loba yiphi imfundiso yamanga ukwenzela ukuthi badukise abantu, ulemfundiso ezilungiselelwe abantu ngokutshiyana kwabo. Kulicebo lakhe ukuletha ebandleni izinto ezingalunganga ezibangela ukuthi kube lokuthandabuza njalo zivimbele labo abalesifiso sokusebenzela uNkulunkulu. Abantu abanengi abangelakho ukukholwa kweqiniso kuNkulunkulu kumbe elizwini lakhe bayamukela ezinye imfundiso zeqiniso, bamukelwe njengamaKrestu, njalo ngale indlela bayenelisa ukuletha imfundiso zabo zamanga sengathi ngamaqiniso avela eBhayibhilini. {GC 520.1}

Imfundiso yokuthi akukhathalekile ukuthi umuntu ukholwani, ngeyinye yenkohliso kaSathane esibangele ukuthi aphumelele kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe wokudukisa abantu. Uyazi ukuthi iqiniso, nxa lamukelwe ngothando, liyangcwelisa umphefumulo walowo olamukelayo, ngakhoke uhlala ezama ukuletha imfundiso zamanga njalo levangeli elihlukileyo. Kusukela ekuqaleni inceku zikaNkulunkulu zazihlala zilwisana labafundisi bamanga, hatshi kuphela njengamadoda ayingozi, kodwa njengabasunguli bamanga ayingozi emphefumulweni yabantu. UElijah loJeremiya, loPhawuli, bonke bema ngesibindi baphikisa labo ababephambula abantu elizwini likaNkulunkulu. Umoya lowo ofundisa abantu ukuthi ukulandela inkolo yeqiniso akubalulekanga, ayizange yamukelwe ngamadoda lawa ayengabavikeli beqiniso. {GC 520.2}

Ingcazelo zeBhayibhili ezingekho sobala abantu abazibumbela zona, njalo lemfundiso ezinengi eziphikisanayo mayelana lokukholwa, ezitholakala emabandleni amaKrestu zingumsebenzi kaSathane wokudida ingqondo zabantu ukwenzela ukuthi bengananzeleli iqiniso. Njalo lokulwisana njalo lokwehlukana okusemabandleni kungenxa yokuchasisa iBhayibhili ngendlela evumelana lenhliziyo zabantu njalo lokusekela imfundiso ethile abayithandayo. Kulokuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu libalwe ngokunanzelela njalo lokuzehlisa kwenhliziyo ukwenzela ukuthi abantu bafumane intando yakhe, abanengi bazama kuphela ukuthola lokho okungajwayelekanga kumbe okungaziwayo. {GC 520.3}

Ukwenzela ukuthi basekele imfundiso zamanga njalo ezingafanelanga inkolo yamaKrestu, abanye bayathatha imigca ethile eBhayibhilini bayehlukanise lendikimba yendaba, kwesinye isikhathi bathatha ingxenye ethile yevesi bayenze sengathii iyasekela umcijo wabo, khona ingxenye abayitshiyayo ibizabonisa ukuthi umutsho wakhona awuvumelani lalokho abakufundisayo. Ngobuqili obufana lobenyoka bayazifihla ngemuva kwamazwi angelasisindo adalelwe ukusekela inkanuko zabo zenyama. Ngale indlela abanengi bayakhetha ukuphendulela lokho okutshiwo lilizwi likaNkulunkulu. Abanye abalengqondo ezithanda imfanekiso, bayathatha imfanekiso eseBhayibhilini, bayichaze ngendlela ehambelana lentando yabo, bengamukeli ukuthi iBhayibhili liyazichasisa lona, besebefundisa imbono yabo sengathi iyimfundiso yeBhayibhili. {GC 521.1}

Kuzozonke indawo lapho iBhayibhili elibalwa khona kungabanga lomkhuleko, lokuzehlisa njalo lomoya ovuma ukufundiswa, amazwi acacileyo okwedlula wonke njalo lalawo anzima ukuzwisiseka acina ephendulelwa njalo ephikisana lengcazelo eqotho. Abaholi bebandla leRoma bayakhetha ingxenye zoMbhalo ezisekela injongo yabo, bazichasise ngendlela evumelana labo, njalo besebeyiletha phambi kwabantu, ngesikhathi esifanayo ababaniki ithuba lokuzibalela iBhayibhili lokuthi bazizwisisele ngokwabo amaqiniso walo. IBhayibhili ngokuphelela kwalo kumele linikwe abantu njengokuba linjalo. Bekungaba ngcono ukuthi bengabi lokufundiswa ngeBhayibhili kulokuthi imfundiso yalo ichazwe ngendlela engaqondanga. {GC 521.2}

IBhayibhili ladalelwa ukuthi liholele bonke abalesifiso sokwazi intando yomdali wabo. UNkulunkulu wanika abantu ilizwi lesiprofethi eliqinisekileyo, ingilosi njalo loKrestu ngokwakhe beza ukuthi benze ukuthi uDanyeli loJohane bazwisise zonke izinto ezazizakwenzakala. Zonke lezo izinto eziphathelene lokusindiswa kwethu azizange zitshiywe zifihlakele. Azizange zichazwe ngendlela ebangela ukuthi zingazwisiseki njalo zikhohlise labo abadinga iqiniso ngokwethembeka. INkosi yathi: “Bhala umbono, uwenze ucace...ukwenzela ukuthi lowo owufundayo agijime.” (Habakuki 2:2). Ilizwi likaNkulunkulu licacile kibo bonke abalifunda ngenhliziyo yomkhuleko. Wonke umuntu ozimiseleyo njalo othembekileyo uzafinyelela ekukhanyeni kweqiniso. “Ukukhanya kuhlanyelelwe abangcwele.” (Amahubo 97:11). Njalo alikho ibandla elingakhula ebungcweleni ngaphandle kokuthi amalunga alo abengabantu abahlolisisa iqiniso njengegugu elifihlakeleyo. {GC 521.3}

Ngenxa yamazwi wokuthi abantu kumele bamukele lokho okufunwa yintando yabo, abantu bavaleka amehlo ukuthi bengaboni imijibila yesitha, yena ngezikhathi zonke esebenzela ukuthi injongo zakhe zifezeke. Nxa ephumelela ukususa iBhayibhili njalo lokufaka imbono yabantu endaweni yalo, umthetho kaNkulunkulu uyalahlwa njalo amabandla angaphansi kobugqili besono ngesikhathi bona besithi bakhululekile. {GC 522.1}

Ebantwini abanengi ulwazi lwezemfundo seluphenduke lwaba yisiqalekiso. UNkulunkulu uvumele ukukhanya ukuthi kuthelwe emhlabeni osekwenze ukuthi kutholakale imfihlo ekufundweni kwemvelo, kodwa ngitsho labo bonke abantu abakhaliphe okwedlula bonke, nxa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lingayisilo elibaholayo ekufundeni kwabo, bacina bedideka emizameni yabo yokuhlolisisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwemvelo lelizwi likaNkulunkulu. {GC 522.2}

Ulwazi lwabantu mayelana lendalo kanye lezinto zakomoya aluphelelanga, ngakho abanye bayehluleka ukubambanisa imbono yabo ngezinto eziphathelene lemvelo lalokho okubhalwe elizwini likaNkulunkulu. Abanengi bayamukela imigca yokuzicabangela njengeqiniso elisekelwa yikufunda kwabo ngemvelo, njalo bacabanga ukuthi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu kumele lihlolwe ngemfundiso “yalokho okuthiwa yilwazi kungesikho.” (1 Timothi 6:20). UMdali njalo lemisebenzi yakhe iphezu kokuzwisisa kwabo, njalo ngenxa yokuthi bayehluleka ukuchaza lokhu besebenzisa ulwazi lwemvelo, imbali etholakala eBhayibhilini yamukelwa njengamanga. Labo abathandabuza amazwi weThestamenti elidala lelitsha esikhathini esinengi bathatha inyathelo elilandelayo lokuthandabuza ubukhona bukaNkulunkulu bathathe amandla wakhe njengamandla wemvelo. Ngemva kokulahla insika yabo, bazithola betshayana lamadwala wokuhlamukela uNkulunkulu. {GC 522.3}

Ngale indlela inengi labo licina lihlamukela inkolo yeqiniso njalo ekucineni bayahugwa nguSathane. Abantu kudala bezama ukuba lokuhlakanipha okwedlula uMdali wabo, imfundiso yomuntu ihleli izama ukuveza imfihlo ezingasoke zivezwe kulo umhlaba. Ngabe abantu bebengazama ukuzwisisa lokho uNkulunkulu akuvezileyo ngaye njalo lenjongo yakhe, bebengathola ulwazi olumayelana lobukhosi, lokuphakama, njalo lamandla kaJehova abezabangela ukuthi bananzelele ubuncane babo njalo bebezasuthiseka ngalokho okuvezelwe bona kanye labantwababo. {GC 522.4}

Kungelinye lamaqhinga kaSathane elokwenza ukuthi ingqondo zabantu zihlale zihlolisisa izinto lezo uNkulunkulu angazivezanga njalo angahlosanga ukuthi bazizwisise. Kwakungenxa yalesi isizatho ukuthi uLusifa alahlekelwe yindawo yakhe ezulwini. Waqala ukungasuthiseki ngenxa yokuthi imfihlo kaNkulunkulu mayelana lenjongo yakhe yayingambulelwanga yena, njalo wacina elahla konke okwakuveziwe mayelana lomsebenzi wakhe ayewuphiwe. Ngokuletha ukungasuthiseki okufanayo phakathi kwengilosi ezazingaphansi kwakhe, wabangela ukuthi lazo ziwe. Manje uhlala ezama ukufaka umoya ofananayo engqondweni zabantu ngoba efuna ukubaholela ukuthi baphike imilayo kaNkulunkulu. {GC 523.1}

Labo abangafuni ukwamukela amaqiniso asobala atholakala eBhayibhilini bahlala bedinga inganekwano ezizathulisa umzwangedwa wabo. Zonke imfundiso ezingadingi ukuthi abantu bazidele, njalo bazehlise zamukelwa ngenjabulo ngabantu abanjalo. Abantu laba bacina besehlisa amandla wemicabango yabo ukwenzela ukuthi belandele inkanuko zenyama. Ngenxa yokuthi bazitshela ukuthi ukukhalipha kwabo kwedlula imizamo yokuhlolisisa iMbhalo ngokuzehlisa njalo lokukhuleka, bacina bengelahawu lokubavikela phambi komkhohlisi. USathane uhlala elungele ukunika inhliziyo lokho ekufunayo, njalo uyabeka imijibila yakhe endaweni yeqiniso. Kwakungenxa yalokhu okwabangela ukuthi umbuso wabopapa uthole amandla phezu kwengqondo zabantu, njalo ngokuphika iqiniso ngoba ligoqela isiphambano, amabandla alamuhla alandela indlela efananayo. Bonke abangafundiyo ilizwi likaNkulunkulu abakhetha ukubala amazwi womuntu, ngoba besenzela ukuthi bengaphikisani lomhlaba, bazacina besamukela imfundiso yamanga becabanga ukuthi liqiniso. Yonke imfundiso yamanga ekhona emhlabeni izakwamukelwa yilabo abakhetha ukuphika iqiniso. Lowo okhangela inkohliso ethile ngelihlo lokumangala uzacina esamukela eyinye elandelayo. Umpostoli uPhawuli nxa wayekhuluma ngequla lalabo “abangamukelanga uthando lweqiniso, ukwenzela ukuthi basindiswe,” uthi: “Ngalesi sizatho uNkulunkulu uzabathumela umoya odukisayo, ukuze bakholwe amanga, ukuba bonke abangakholwanga iqiniso kodwa bethokoziswa yikungalungi balahlwe. (2 Thesalonika 2:10-12). Nxa sisizwa amazwi alukhuni njengalawa, kuqakathekile ukuthi silimuke njalo sinanzelele zonke imfundiso esizamukelayo. {GC 523.2}

Phakathi kwamaqhinga womkhohlisi asebengale ukuthi aphumelele kakhulu awasebenzisa ukukhohlisa abantu abanengi, kumi imfundiso njalo lezenzo zamanga zemimoya. Uyazifihla njengengilosi yokukhanya, abesedonsela abantu abanengi abangananzeleliyo kuye. Ngabe abantu bebengabala iBhayibhili kuphela bekhulekela ukuthi bezwisise, bebengeke betshiywe besemnyameni ukuthi bamukele imfundiso zamanga. Kodwa nxa bephika iqiniso bazibeka esimeni sokuthi bakhohliswe kalula. {GC 524.1}

Eyinye imfundiso eyingozi ngeyokuphika ubuNkulunkulu bukaKrestu, eyokuthi kazange abekhona ezulwini ngaphambi kokuzalwa kwakhe emhlabeni. Imfundiso leyi yamukelwa ngabantu abanengi abazibiza ngokuthi bayalikholwa iBhayibhili, kodwa yona iphikisa amazwi kaKrestu asobala mayelana lobudlelwane bakhe loBaba, lesimo sakhe esingcwele njalo lobukhona bakhe kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngeke yamukeleke imfundiso leyi ngaphandle kokuzama ukuguqula imfundiso yeBhayibhili ecacileyo. Imfundiso leyi ayehlisi kuphela imicabango yabantu mayelana lecebo lokusindiswa komuntu, kodwa ikhangelela phansi ukukholwa kweBhayibhili njengesambulelo esivela kuNkulunkulu. Nxa lokhu kuyenza ukuthi ibeyingozi, kuyenza futhi ukuba kubenzima ukuyiqondisa. Nxa abantu bephika ubufakazi beBhayibhili mayelana lobuNkulunkulu bukaKrestu, kubayize ukuzama ukuphikisana labo, ngoba akulakuphikisana loba kulamandla angakanani, okungabenza ukuthi balahle inkolo yabo. “Umuntu wemvelo kazamukeli izinto zikaMoya kaNkulunkulu, ngoba ziyibuthutha kuye, kalawo amandla okuziqedisisa, ngoba ziqedisiswa ngokuboniswa nguMoya.” (1 Korinte 2:14). Akulamuntu okholwa iphutha leli ongaba lokuqedisisa okupheleleyo ngesimo njalo lomsebenzi kaKrestu kumbe ngecebo likaNkulunkulu lokusindiswa komuntu. {GC 524.2}

Eyinye njalo imfundiso yamanga elokhe ikhula emhlabeni ngeyokuthi akulasidalwa esibizwa ngokuthi nguSathane esiphilayo, njalo lokuthi ibizo leli lisetshenziswa eBhayibhilini ukuchaza imicabango lezifiso zabantu ezimbi. {GC 524.3}

Imfundiso etshunyayelwa kakhulu emabandleni amanengi eyokuthi ukuza kukaKrestu kwesibili kutsho ukuza kwakhe emuntwini munye ngamunye ekufeni kwabo, iyinkohliso edalelwe ukuphambula ingqondo zabantu eqinisweni lokuza kwakhe emayezini wezulu. Okweminyaka eminengi uSathane lokhe esithi: “Khangela, usendlini efihlakeleyo” (Mathewu 24:23-26); njalo abantu abanengi balahliwe ngenxa yokwamukela imfundiso leyi. {GC 525.1}

Ulwazi lwasemhlabeni lufundisa futhi ukuthi umkhuleko awuqakathekanga. Izikhwicamfundo zasemhlabeni zithi ngeke kube lempendulo yomkhuleko, ngoba lokhu kuyabe kuyikwephula umthetho, lesibonakaliso, njalo lokuthi izibonakaliso azikho emhlabeni. Bafundisa ukuthi umhlaba ubuswa yimithetho engaguqukiyo njalo lokuthi uNkulunkulu uqobo lwakhe kenzi lutho oluphambene lemithetho leyi. Ngale indlela baveza uNkulunkulu sengathi laye ubotshwe yimithetho yakhe, sengathi ukusebenza komthetho kuphambene lokukhululeka kwakhe. Imfundiso efana laleyi iphambene lobufakazi beBhayibhili. UKrestu labafundi bakhe abazange benze izibonakaliso na? UMsindisi olesihawu ofananayo uyaphila lamuhla, njalo ulesifiso sokulalela umthandazo wokukholwa ngendlela ayekuthakazelela ngayo nxa wayesaphila emhlabeni. Indalo yasemhlabeni yasebenzisana lamandla wezulu. Kulicebo likaNkulunkulu ukusinika, njengempendulo yomkhuleko wokukholwa, lokho abengeke asinike khona ngabe besingacelanga. {GC 525.2}

Zinengi kakhulu imfundiso zamanga esezingene emabandleni amaKrestu lamhlanje. Kunzima ukuzama ukubala izithelo ezimbi ezibangelwa yikususa loba ngeyodwa imfundiso yeqiniso esekelwa lilizwi likaNkulunkulu. Balutshwana abakwenzayo lokhu abama ngemva kokuphika imfundiso eyodwa kuphela. Inengi labo liyaqhubeka liphika zonke imfundiso zeqiniso ngokulandelana kwazo baze becine bengalakho lokukodwa abakukholwayo okuvela eBhayibhilini. {GC 525.3}

Amaphutha emfundiso ezijwayelekileyo asebangele ukuthi inengi labantu licine lingakholwa ngitsho lakulabo abebekade bezakholwa imfundiso yeqiniso etholakala eBhayibhilini. Kubanzima ukuthi bamukele imfundiso eziveza ukulunga kukaNkulunkulu, lomusa lothando lwakhe, njalo njengoba lokhu kufundiswa njengamazwi aphuma eBhayibhilini, bayala ukukwamukela njenge lizwi likaNkulunkulu. {GC 525.4}

Lokhu yikho uSathane afuna ukuthi kwenzakale. Akukho okunye akufisa okwedlula ukubhidliza ithemba abantu abalalo kuNkulunkulu laselizwini lakhe. USathane umi njengomkhulu webutho labantu abathandabuzayo, njalo usebenza ngamandla wakhe wonke ukulinga abantu ukuthi bahlanganyele laye. Sekuyinto ejwayelekileyo njalo eyamukelekayo ukuthi umuntu athandabuze. Kulequla elikhulu labantu abakhangela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ngelihlo lokungethembi ngesizatho esifanayo sokungethembi uMlobi walo, ngoba liyaveza njalo likhuze isono. Labo abangafuniyo ukulandela imfundiso yalo bayazama ukulahla amandla walo. Bayafunda iBhayibhili, kumbe balalele imfundiso yalo nxa itshunyayelwa, ngoba bedinga indlela zokuthola amaphutha kilo kumbe entshumayelweni. kababalutshwane abacina besiba ngabangakholwayo ngoba befuna ukuvikela amanyethelo wabo wokungafuni kubalamlandu. Abanye bamukela imfundiso zokuthandabuza ngenxa yokuziphakamisa njalo lobuvila. Ngenxa yokuthanda impilo yokuzithokozisa abazami ukwenza izinto ezinkulu ezizabangela ukuthi bahlonitshwe ezidinga ukuzimisela njalo lokuzidela, bayahlosa ukwazakala njengabantu abakhaliphileyo ngokuphikisa iBhayibhili. Kunengi ngengqondo ezingakhanyiselwanga lizulu esingeke sikuzwisise, ngakhoke bayathola izizatho zokuchothoza iBhayibhili. Banengi abacabanga ukuthi kuyinto ebukekekayo ukuma ehlangothini lokungakholwa, lelokuthandabuza, njalo lelokuhlamuka. Kodwa ngaphansi kwakho konke lokhu kuyabonakala ukuthi abantu laba bafuqwa yikuzithemba njalo lobumina. Abanye bayathokozelela ukuthola izinto eziseMbhalweni ngoba befuna ukudida abanye. Abanye ekuqaleni bayachothoza njalo benze isinqumo ehlangothini olungaqondanga, ngoba befuna ukuletha impikiswano kuphela. Abananzeleli ukuthi bayazibophela emjibileni yomkhohlisi. Kodwa ngemva kokubonisa ukungakholwa phambi kwabantu, bacina bebona sengathi kumele basekele isinqumo sabo. Ngale indlela bayabambana labangakholwayo bazivalele amasango weParadayisi. {GC 526.1}

UNkulunkulu unikile elizwini lakhe ubufakazi obaneleyo mayelana lesimo sakhe esingcwele. Amaqiniso aphathelane lokusindiswa kwethu avezwe sobala. Ngokuphathiswa nguMoya oNgcwele, yena othenjiswe bonke abawucela ngokuzimisela, wonke umuntu uyenelisa ukuzizwisisela amaqiniso lawa. UNkulunkulu unike abantu isisekelo esilamandla lapho abangabeka khona ukholo lwabo. {GC 526.2}

Loba kunjalo ingqondo zabantu aziphelelanga ukuthi ziqedisise ngokuphelela amacebo lenjongo zikaSimakade. Ngeke ngokucwayisisa kwethu sifumane uNkulunkulu. Akumelanga ngokuziphakamisa sizame ukuphakamisa iveyili elivala iNkosi yethu. Umpostoli uthi: “Yeka izahlulelo zakhe ezingaphenyekiyo lendlela zakhe ezingalandelekiyo.” (Roma 11:33). Siyenelisa kuphela ukuzwisisa indlela asebenzisana lathi, njalo lenjongo zakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi sinanzelele uthando lwakhe olungapheliyo njalo lesihawu esibanjaniswe lamandla angapheliyo. UBaba wethu osezulwini wenza konke ngokuhlanipha njalo lokulunga, njalo akufanelanga sibe lokungasuthiseki njalo lokuthandabuza, kodwa kumele simkhothamele ngokuzehlisa. Uzasivezela injongo zakhe ezifaneleyo kuphela nxa zisilungele ukuthi sizazi, njalo okwedlula lokhu kumele sithembe isandla sakhe esingaphuthiyo, lenhliziyo egcwele uthando. {GC 527.1}

Loba nje uNkulunkulu enike ubufakazi obunengi obenza ukuthi sibe lokukholwa, kasoke asuse zonke izinto ezibangela ukuthi abantu bengakholwa. Bonke abadinga ingwegwe yokulengisa ukuthandabuza kwabo bazayithola. Njalo labo abala ukwamukela njalo lokulandela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ngaphandle kokuthi konke abangavumelani lakho kube sekususiswe, njalo kube sekungasela ithuba lokuthandabuza, abasoke bafinyelele ekukhanyeni. {GC 527.2}

Ukuthandabuza uNkulunkulu kuyisithelo senhliziyo engahlanjululwanga, yona elobutha loNkulunkulu. Kodwa ukukholwa kuqiniswa nguMoya oNgcwele, njalo kuzakhula kuphela nxa kusetshenziswa. Akulamuntu ongakhula ekukholweni engazange asebenzise amandla wakhe wonke lokuzimisela. Ukuthandabuza kuyakhula nxa kulokhe kufukamelwa, njalo nxa abantu, kulokuthi bagxile emazwini uNkulunkulu asinike wona ukuthi akhuthaze ukukholwa, bevumela ukuthi bathandabuze njalo babelemibuzo, bazathola ukuthi ukuthandabuza kwabo kuyabe kuqhubeka kukhula. {GC 527.3}

Kodwa labo abathandabuza izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu njalo abangathembi isiqiniseko somusa wakhe abamthokozisi, njalo indonsela yabo, kulokuthi idonsele abanye kuKrestu, icina ibafuqela khatshana laye. Bayizihlahla ezingatheliyo, eziqhelisa ingatsha zazo endaweni zonke, zivala ilanga ukuthi lingafinyeleli ezinye izihlahla, njalo ezibangela ukuthi zife ngenxa yomthunzi wazo. Umsebenzi abawenze impilo yabo bonke, izakuma njengofakazi abangaphuthiyo ngosuku lokwahlulela. Bahlanyela intanga zokuthandabuza njalo lokungakholwa ezizaletha isivuno esingaphuthiyo. {GC 527.4}

Kulendlela eyodwa kuphela evulelwe labo abafisa ukukhululwa emoyeni wokuthandabuza. Kulokuthi baphikise kumbe bangasuthiseki ngalokho abangakuzwisisiyo, kabalandele ukukhanya abalakho njalo ngemva kwalokho bazakwamukela ukukhanya okuphindiweyo. Kabayenze wonke umsebenzi obekwe waba sobala phambi kwabo, njalo bazanikwa ulwazi njalo lamandla wokwenza zonke izinto abazithandabuzayo kathesi. {GC 528.1}

USathane uyenelisa ukuletha into isiphamaso kodwa sibukeka sengathi liqiniso okubangela ukuthi kukhohlise labo abafuna ukukhohliswa, abaloyisa ukufulathela ukuzidela lokuzinikela okudingwa liqiniso; kodwa akwenzeki ukuthi anqobe loba ngoyedwa, ofisa ukwazi iqiniso loba ngayiphi intengo. UKrestu uliqiniso njalo “lokukhanya okukhanyisela wonke umuntu oza emhlabeni.” (Johane 1:9). UMoya weqiniso wathunyelwa emhlabenI ukuthi ukhokhelele abantu eqinisweni lonke. Njalo emandleni eNdodana kaNkulunkulu kuyamenyezelwa ukuthi: “Funani lizakufumana.” “Uba umuntu ethanda ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu, uzakwazi ngemfundiso.” (Mathewu 7:7; Johane 7:17). {GC 528.2}

Abalandeli bakaKrestu bazi okuncinyane mayelana lamacebo kaSathane awenza ndawonye lezisebenzi zakhe awokulwisana labo. Kodwa lowo ohlala emazulwini uzavikela ukuthi wonke amacebo akhe angabehleli ukwenzela ukuthi amacebo ezulu aphumeleliswe. INkosi iyavumela ukuthi abantu bayo badlule phakathi kokulingwa okukhulu, hatshi ngoba uyakholisa ukubabona besenhlungwini lasesizini, kodwa ngoba lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi bedlule kukho ukwenzela ukuthi banqobe. Ngeke ngazo zonke izikhathi asebenzise ubukhosi bakhe ukuthi abavikele ukuthi bengalingwa, ngoba isizatho sokuhlolwa ngesokuthi bazilungiselele ukumelana lezilingo zomubi. {GC 528.3}

Akulabantu ababi kumbe ingilosi ezimbi ezinganqabela ukuhamba komsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, kumbe ukusitha ubuso bakhe phambi kwabantu bakhe, nxa bona besiza kuye ngenhliziyo ezivumayo, njalo bevuma izono zabo futhi bezitshiya, njalo ngokukholwa becela izithembiso zakhe. Konke ukulingwa, lemimoya yonke ephikisayo, loba lokho okwenziwa egcekeni kumbe ensitha, bayenelisa ukukunqoba, “hatshi ngempi langamandla, kodwa ngoMoya wami, kutsho iNkosi yamabandla.” (Zekariya 4:6). {GC 529.1}

“Ngoba amehlo eNkosi akubo abalungileyo, lezindlebe zayo zilalela ukukhuleka kwabo…pho ngubani ongalilimaza, uba litshisekela okuhle na?” (1 Petro 3:12, 13). Nxa uBhalami, wayesehugwe yizipho zenotho, wazama ukuqalekisa isizwe sako Israyeli, njalo ngokwenza iminikelo eNkosini wayezama ukuthi uNkulunkulu eqalekise abantu bakhe, uMoya kaNkulunkulu wavimbela ububi ayezama ukubenza, njalo uBhalami waphoqelwa ukuthi athi: “Ngingamqalekisa kanjani ongaqalekiswanga nguNkulunkulu na? ngingamthuka kanjani ongathukwanga nguNkulunkulu na? “Kangife ukufa kolungileyo, lokuphela kwami kube njengokwakhe!” Lapho umnikelo wasewenziwe futhi umprofethi omubi wazithola esesithi: “Khangela ngilayiwe ukubusisa, ngoba ubusisile, kangilamandla mina okuguqula. Ububi abufunyaniswanga, lamanga kuJakobe, kakubonakalanga kuIsrayeli. Inkosi uNkulunkulu wabo ilabo, ukumemeza kwenkosi kuphakathi kwabo.” “Ngempela akulamilingo kuJakobe kakulakuvumisa koIsrayeli. Khathesi kuzakutshiwo ngoJakobe langoIsrayeli ukuthi: Khangela ukuthi uNkulunkulu wenzeni.” Loba kwakunjalo banikela okwesithathu, njalo ngalesi isikhathi uBalami wehluleka ukubaqalekisa. Kodwa ngokusebenzisa indebe zomprofethi lowu loba wayengafuni, uMoya kaNkulunkulu wakhuluma amazwi wokunqoba kwabakhethekileyo bakhe, njalo waveza ububi bezitha zabo: “Kababusiswe bonke abakubusisayo, baqalekiswe bonke abakuqalekisayo!” Amanani 23:10,20,21,23; 24:9. {GC 529.2}

Isizwe sakoIsrayeli sasilandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu ngalesi isikhathi, njalo nxa babeqhubeka belandela umthetho wakhe, kwakungela mandla emhlabeni lasegehena ayengabanqoba. Kodwa isiqalekiso uBalami ayehlulekile ukusibeka phezu kwabantwana bakaNkulunkulu, wenelisa ukusiletha phezu kwabo ekucineni ngemva kokubalinga ukuthi bone phambi kweNkosi. Nxa basebephule imithetho kaNkulunkulu, bazehlukanisa laye, njalo batshiywa ukuthi bezwe amandla ombulali. {GC 529.3}

USathane uyazi kahle ukuthi umphefumulo obuthakathaka owodwa obambelela kuKrestu ulamandla amakhulu phezu kwezisebenzi zobunyama, njalo lokuthi, nxa kungenzeka aziveze sobala phambi kwabo, uzakwehlulwa. Ngakhoke uyazama ukubadonsela khatshana lensika yabo, abesebacathamela lebutho lakhe, elungele ukubhubhisa bonke abanyathela ensimini yakhe. Kuphela ngokuthembela kuNkulunkulu ngokuzehlisa njalo lokulandela imilayo yakhe yonke, yikho esilokuphepha khona. {GC 530.1}

Akulamuntu ophephileyo okosuku kumbe okwehola elilodwa engakhulekanga. Kuqakathekile ukuthi sicele iNkosi ukuthi isinike inhlakanipho yokuthi siqedisise ilizwi layo. Elizwini yikho okuvezwe khona imijibila yonke kaSathane njalo lendlela esingamqoba ngayo. USathane uyintshantshu ekuchaphuneni iBhayibhili, leyokufaka eyakhe ingcazelo emazwini walo, ayisebenzisa ukuthi asikhube ngayo. Kumele sibale iBhayibhili ngenhliziyo elokuzehlisa, singavumi ukulahlekelwa yikuthi kumele sithembele kuNkulunkulu. Loba nje kumele sihlale sinanzelela imijibila kaSathane, kumele sikhuleke ngokukholwa kokuphela sisithi: “Ungasiholi ekulingweni.” {GC 530.2}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 33 — Inkohliso Enkulu Yakuqala.

Kusukela embalini yomuntu yakuqala emhlabeni, uSathane waqala imizamo yakhe yokudukisa uluntu. Yena owayesungule ukuhlamuka ezulwini wafisa ukuthi izidalwa zasemhlabeni sibambane laye empini yakhe yokulwisana lombuso kaNkulunkulu. UAdam loEva babephila phakathi kwenjabulo yokulandela umthetho kaNkulunkulu, njalo impilo yabo yayiyibufakazi obabuphikisa amazwi kaSathane ayewakhulume ezulwini, awokuthi umlayo kaNkulunkulu wawuncindezela njalo wawuphikisana lenhlalakahle yezidalwa zakhe. Njalo umona kaSathane wakhula ngamandla nxa wayebona umuzi wokuthula owawulungiselwe laba bobabili. Wazimisela ukuthi wayezabangela ukuwa kwabo ezitshela ukuthi ngemva kokubahlukanisa loNkulunkulu wayezabafaka ngaphansi kwamandla wakhe njalo wayezathumba umhlaba ayakhe kuwo umbuso akhe owawuzaphikisana loNkulunkulu. {GC 531.1}

Ngabe uSathane wayeziveze ngesimo sakhe seqiniso, wayengeke enelise ukubalinga, ngoba uAdamu loEva babexwayisiwe ngesitha lesi esiyingozi, kodwa wasebenza ebunyameni, wafihla injongo yakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi aphumelelise iqhinga lakhe. Wasebenzisa inyoka, ngalesi isikhathi eyayiyisidalwa esihle kakhulu, wafika kuEva wathi: “Impela uNkulunkulu watsho yini ukuthi, lingadli okwezihlahla zasensimini na?” Genesisi 3:1. Ngabe uEva wayezibambile wangangeni phakathi kwempikiswano lomlingi, wayezabe ephephile, kodwa waqala ukukhuluma laye wawela phakathi kwemijibila yakhe. Lalamuhla uSathane unqoba abanengi ngendlela efanayo. Bayathandabuza njalo baphikise lokho okufunwa nguNkulunkulu, njalo kulokuthi balandele imilayo kaJehova, bona bamukela imfundiso zabantu eziyizo ezigoqela amaqhinga kaSathane. {GC 531.2}

“Owesifazana wathi enyokeni, singadla izithelo zezihlahla zasensimini, kodwa ngesithelo zesihlahla esiphakathi kwensimu uNkulunkulu wathi, lingazidli, lingazithinti ukuba lingafi. Inyoka yathi kowesifazana kaliyikufa. Ngoba uNkulunkulu uyazi ukuthi mhla lizidlayo, amehlo enu azavuleka, libe njengoNkulunkulu, likwazi konke okuhle lokubi.” Genesisi 13:2-5. Wamtshela ukuthi babezakuba njengoNkulunkulu, bebelokuhlakanipha okwedlula lokho ababelakho njalo benelise ukufinyelela izinga eliphezulu lokuphila. UEva wavumela isilingo lesi, njalo ngokusebenzisa indonsela yakhe, uAdamu laye waholelwa esonweni. Bamukela amazwi enyoka, awokuthi uNkulunkulu wayengatsho lokho ayekutshilo, bathandabuza uMdali wabo njalo banakana ukuthi wayenyathezela inkululeko yabo njalo babezathola inhlakanipho enkulu lokuphakama ngesenzo sokwephula kwabo umthetho wakhe. {GC 532.1}

Kodwa yiphi ingcazelo uAdamu ngemva kokona kwakhe ayifumanayo eyayimelwe ngamazwi athi, “Ngalolosuku elizakudla khona lizakufa impela”? Wathola yini ukuthi ayesitsho lokho uSathane ayebangele ukuthi bakukholwe, ukuthi wayezangeniswa ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila? Ngabe kwakunjalo kwakuzaba lenzuzo enkulu ababezayithola ngokwephula umlayo kaNkulunkulu, njalo uSathane weyezakuba ngumkhululi woluntu. Kodwa uAdamu kazange athole ukuthi lokhu kwakungumutsho wamazwi ayekhulunywe nguMdali. UNkulunkulu wayetshilo ukuthi njengesigwebo sokona, umuntu kwakumele abuyele emhlabathini lapho ayephume khona: “Ngoba ungumhlabathi, uzabuyela emhlabathini.” Genesisi 3:19. Amazwi kaSathane, “Amehlo wenu azavulwa,” agcwaliseka ngokuthi: Ngemva kokona kukaAdamu loEva, amehlo wabo avulwa ukuthi bazwisise ububi, baqala ukwazi isono, njalo banambitha isithelo esibabayo sokona kwabo. {GC 532.2}

Enkabeni yensimu yaseEdeni kwakulesihlahla sokuphila, esasilezithelo ezilamandla wokunika impilo enguphakade. Ngabe uAdamu wayeqhubeke ngokulandela intando kaNkulunkulu, wayezaqhubeka elemvumo yokudla isithelo lesi njalo wayezenelisa ukuphila iphakade. Kodwa ngemva kokona kwakhe, kwasekumele amukele ukufa. Isigwebo esithi, “Ngoba ungumhlabathi, uzabuyela emhlabathini,” sikhomba ukutshabalaliswa kwempilo. {GC 532.3}

Impilo ephakade eyayithenjiswe umuntu kuphela nxa wayelandele imilayo kaNkulunkulu yaseyisusiwe ngenxa yokona. UAdamu wayengeke adlulisela kunzalo yakhe lokho ayengaselakho yena, njalo kwakungasela themba ebantwini ngemva kokuwa kwabo, ngabe uNkulunkulu wayenganikelanga iNdodana yakhe, eyabangela ukuthi benelise ukufinyelela impilo ephakade ngaye. “Njengalokho ukufa kwabehlela bonke abantu ngoba bonke bonile,” UKrestu “waletha ekukhanyeni ukuphila lokungabhubhi ngevangeli.” Roma 5:12; 2 Timothi 1:10. Njalo kuphela ngoKrestu yikho impilo ephakade etholakala khona. UJesu wathi: “Yena okholwa eNdodaneni ulokuphila okungapheliyo, kodwa yena ongakholwayo eNdodaneni kayikubona ukuphila kodwa ulaka lukaNkulunkulu luhlezi phezu kwakhe.” Johane 3:36. Wonke umuntu ulethuba lokufumana isipho lesi esiligugu kangaka kuphela nxa elandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Bonke “abathi ngesineke bafune inkazimulo lodumo lokungabhubhi ngokwenza imisebenzi emihle, uzakubanika ukuphila okungapheliyo.” Roma 2:7. {GC 533.1}

Umkhohlisi omkhulu nguye yedwa owathembisa uAdamu impilo engapheliyo ngokwephula imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Njalo lamazwi akhulunywa yinyoka kuEva athi: “Kaliyikufa” aba yintshumayelo yakuqala eyatshunyayelwa ngemfundiso yokuthi umphefumulo womuntu awufi. Kodwa amazwi lawa, ayevela emlonyeni kaSathane uqobo lwakhe, atshunyayelwa njengeqiniso emabandleni amaKrestu lamhlanje njalo amukelwa kalula ngendlela efananayo amukelwa ngayo ngabazali bethu bakuqala. Isigwebo esivela ezulwini esithi, “Umphefumulo owonayo uzakufa” (Hezekeli 18:20), senziwa ukuthi sitsho ukuthi: Umphefumulo owonayo awusoze ufe, kodwa uzaphila inaphakade. Kuyamangalisa ukuthi abantu babambelela emazwini kaSathane njalo bakhetha ukungakholwa amazwi kaNkulunkulu. {GC 533.2}

Ngabe umuntu ngemva kokuwa kwakhe wayevunyelwe ukudla isihlahla sokuphila wayezanelisa ukwamukela impilo engapheliyo, ngale indlela isono sasizabakhona kuze kube nini nini. Kodwa ingilosi ezazilenkemba yelangabi zavikela “indlela eya esihlahleni sokuphila” (Genesisi 3:24), njalo akula loyedwa ophuma emulini kaAdamu oseke wavunyelwa ukuthi athabathe isithelo lesi esinika impilo. Ngakhoke asikho isoni esingaphila impilo engapheliyo. {GC 533.3}

Kodwa ngemva kokuwa, uSathane watshela ingilosi zakhe ukuthi ziyenze yonke imizamo yokuletha imfundiso yokuthi umphefumulo ulamandla wokuphila kokuphela, njalo ngemva kokwenza ukuthi abantu bamukele amanga lawa, ingilosi zakhe zazizabakhokhelela ukuthi bacabange ukuthi isoni sasizaphila phakathi kosizi olungapheliyo. Ensukwini zalamuhla umkhohlisi ngenxa yokusebenzisa inceku zakhe, uveza uNkulunkulu njengombusi othanda ukuphindisela njalo olochuku, ufundisa ukuthi uphosela egehena bonke abangamjabulisiyo, njalo wenza ukuthi bamukele ulaka lwakhe, njalo lokuthi nxa besizwa ubuhlungu emalangabini, uMdali wabo ubakhangela ngentokozo njalo lokusuthiseka. {GC 534.1}

Ngale indlela umkhohlisi ugqokisa uMdali ngezakhe izembatho. Uchuku luphuma kuSathane ngokwakhe. UNkulunkulu uluthando, konke akudalayo kwakumsulwa, kungcwele, njalo kukuhle, kwaze kwafika isikhathi lapho isono esalethwa ngumhlamuki omkhulu. USathane nguye olinga abantu ukuthi bone, njalo abesebabulala nxa esenelisa, njalo nxa eseqede ngabo, uyathokoza ngenxa yobubi ayabe sebulethile. Ngabe ubephiwe imvumo ubezabuthelela wonke umuntu abe ngaphansi kwakhe. Ngabe bekungasikho ukuthi amandla ezulu ayangenela, bekungasoke kube leyodwa indodana kumbe indodakazi kaAdamu ebizaphunyuka. {GC 534.2}

USathane uzama ukunqoba abantu lamhlanje, njengoba wanqoba abazali bethu bakuqala ngosebenzisa iqhinga lokunyikinya ukholo lwabo kuMdali wabo njalo lokubahola ukuthi bathandabuze inhlakanipho yombuso wezulu njalo lokulunga kwemilayo yakhe. USathane lenceku zakhe baveza uNkulunkulu sengathi mubi okwedlula bona, ukwenzela ukuthi kubonakale sengathi mubi njalo lokuhlamuka kwabo kulungile. Umkhohlisi omkhulu uyazama ukubeka isimo sakhe sochuku phezu kaBaba wethu osezulwini, ukwenzela ukuthi kubonakale sengathi nguye umoniwa owaxotshwa ezulwini ngoba wayengakhothamelanga umbuso owawunyathezela amalungelo wakhe. Uveza phambi komhlaba inkululeko abangayikholisa ngaphansi kwakhe, nxa eyiqathanisa lobugqili obulethwa yimithetho kaJehova. Ngale indlela uyaphumelela ukulinga imphefumulo eminengi ukuthi yehlukane loNkulunkulu. {GC 534.3}

Iphambene kangakanani lemizwa yethu yonke yothando leyesihawu, njalo lokuzwisisa esilakho mayelana lokulunga, imfundiso yokuthi abantu ababi abafileyo bayatshiswa ngomlilo endaweni okuthiwa yigehena kokuphela, ngenxa yezono abazenze empilweni emfitshane emhlabeni bayatshiswa kokuphela phambi kukaNkulunkulu. Loba kunjalo imfundiso leyi lokhe ifundiswa emabandleni amanengi. Esinye isikhwicamfundo kwezenkolo sathi: “Isenzo sokutshiswa kwabantu egehena sizayenza ukuthi abangcwele bathokoze kokuphela. Nxa bebona abanye abazelwe ngokwenyama njengabo besebuhlungwini, lokhu kuzabenza ukuthi benanzelele injabulo abaphila kiyo.” Omunye wasebenzisa amazwi athi: “Nxa isigwebo sokujeziswa sibekwa kokuphela phezu kwezidalwa okumele zamukele ulaka, intuthu yokutsha kwabo izahlala isenyuka phambi kwamehlo ezidalwa zomusa, bona kulokuthi bahlanganyele ebuhlungwini balabo abatshiswayo, bazakuthi, Amen, Aleluya! Idumiseni iNkosi!” {GC 535.1}

Itholakala kuwaphi amakhosi elizwini likaNkulunkulu imfundiso leyi? Kambe abasindisiweyo ezulwini bazakhohlwa imizwa yabo yozwelo lesihawu, njalo lemizwa yomuntu wonke na? Imizwa leyi izaguqulwa ibe ngeyochuku na? Hatshi, hatshi, imfundiso leyi ayisiyo yencwadi kaNkulunkulu. Labo abafundisa imfundiso efana laleyi, bengaba ngamadoda aqeqetshileyo njalo acabanga ukuthi enza okuhle, kodwa iqiniso yikuthi badukiswe yikusebenza kukaSathane. Ubaholela ukuthi baguqule amazwi oMbhalo, belandele amazwi abonisa uchuku lwakhe, hatshi olutholakala kuMdali wethu. “Ngiyazifunga mina, kutsho iNkosi, kangithokozi ngokufa komubi, kodwa ngokuba omubi atshiye indlela yakhe aphile, tshiyanike, tshiyani indlela zenu ezimbi, ngoba lizafelani, lina bakoIsrayeli na?” Hezekeli 33:11. {GC 535.2}

Ubezatholani uNkulunkulu nxa besingavuma ukuthi uyathokoza ngokubona abantu besitsha kokuphela, lokuthi uyajabula nxa esizwa ukukhala kobuhlungu kwalabo abafake emalangabini wegehena? Ukukhala kwabo kungaba kuyingoma emnandi endlebeni zalowo oLuthando olungapheliyo na? Kuyafundiswa ukuthi ukuhlupheka kwababi kubonisa ukuthi uNkulunkulu uzonda kangakanani isono, esiyiso esiphambanisa ukuthula komhlaba wonke. Khepha ukuthuka uNkulunkulu okungaka! Sekungathi isizatho sokuthi uNkulunkulu uzonda isono yiso esenza ukuthi isono siqhubeke sikhona. Ngoba nxa ulandela imfundiso yabantu laba, ukutshiswa kokuphela kungela themba lokuhawukelwa kwenza abatshiswayo bazonde kakhulu, baqale ukuthethisa njalo lokuqalekisa, ngokwenza njalo kufundiswa ukuthi bahlala besengeza amacala wabo. Ubukhosi bukaNkulunkulu abukhuliswa yikwekela ukuthi isono siphile kokuphela. {GC 536.1}

Ayikho ingqondo yomuntu engenelisa ukulinganisa ubukhulu bobubi obulethwe yimfundiso leyi yokutshiswa kwabantu kokuphela. Inkolo yeBhayibhili egcwele, uthando, njalo lokulunga, lesihawu, yenzwa ukuthi ibemnyama ngenxa yemfundiso leyi yamanga. Nxa sikhangela indlela uSathane angcolisa ngayo isimo sikaNkulunkulu ngamanga, kuyasimangalisa yini ukuthi uMdali wethu uyesatshwa, njalo uyazondwa na? Umfanekiso kaNkulunkulu osabekayo osugcwele emhlabeni ngenxa yemfundiso ezitshunyayelwa emabandleni sezabangela ukuthi inkulungwane, yebo lezigidi zabantu ziphike ubukhona bakhe. {GC 536.2}

Imfundiso yokutshiswa kokuphela ngeyinye yemfundiso zamanga ezigoqela iwayini yesinengiso seBhabhiloni, alinathisa izizwe zonke. (Sambulo 14:8; 17:2). Ukuthi abafundisi bakaKrestu labo bayamukela imfundiso leyi njalo bayayitshumayela kuyisimanga. Bayamukela ivela eRoma, ngendlela efanayo abamukela ngayo isabatha lamanga. Kuliqiniso ukuthi yafundiswa ngamadoda amsulwa njalo aphakemeyo, kodwa ukukhanya endabeni leyi kwakungakafiki kibo ngendlela osekufike ngayo kithi. Babelomlandu kuphela ngokukhanya okwakubehlele ngesikhathi sabo, thina silomlandu ngalokho okukhanyisa esikhathini sethu. Nxa siphambuka ebufakazini obuselizwini likaNkulunkulu, njalo samukele imfundiso zamanga ngoba okhokho bethu babezifundisa, siwela ngaphansi kwecala elibekwa phezu kweBhabhiloni, njalo sinatha iwayini lesinengiso sakhe. {GC 536.3}

Kuxuku elikhulu elabantu abangamukeliyo imfundiso yokutshiswa okungapheliyo baholelwa ukuthi bamukele eyinye imfundiso yamanga. Bayananzelela ukuthi iBhayibhili liveza uNkulunkulu njengoMdali olothando njalo olesihawu, njalo kunzima ukuthi bakholwe ukuthi uzaphosela izidalwa zakhe emlilweni ongapheliyo wegehena. Kodwa ngenxa yokuthi bakholwa ukuthi umphefumulo uphila impilo engapheliyo, ababoni elinye iqiniso ngaphandle kokuthi wonke umuntu ekucineni uzasindiswa. Abanengi bakholwa ukuthi izixwayiso zeBhayibhili zinikelwe ukuthi zethusele abantu ukuthi benze okuhle, njalo azisoke zigcwaliseke. Ngale indlela isoni singaphila impilo yokuzithokozisa, singalandeli imilayo kaNkulunkulu, kodwa sibelethemba lokuthi uNkulunkulu uzasamukela embusweni wakhe. Imfundiso enje, eyenza sengathi yamukela umusa kaNkulunkulu, kodwa yona iphika ukulunga kwakhe, yenza ukuthi inhliziyo yenyama ijabule njalo iqinisa ababi ezonweni zabo. {GC 537.1}

Ukwenzela ukuthi siveze indlela labo abakholwa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzasindiswa baphendulela njani amazwi eBhayibhili bezama ukuthi basekele imfundiso zabo, kuqakathekile ukuthi sisebenzise kuphela amazwi aphuma emlonyeni wabo. Emngcwabeni wejaha elalingakholwa njalo elalife engozini, umfundisi webandla elikholwa imfundiso leyi wafunda ivesi ekhuluma ngoDavida ethi: “Ngoba wayeseduduzekile ngokufa kukaAmnoni.” 2 Samuweli 13:39. {GC 537.2}

“Ngihlala ngibuzwa,” watsho umtshumayeli, “ukuthi kuzakwenzakalani ngalabo abaphila emhlabeni phakathi kwesono, nxa besifa, phakathi kwempilo yobubi bengahlanjululwanga izembatho zabo, kumbe bafe ngendlela efana leyejaha leli esibuthene ngalo, bengazange bekholwe. Siyasuthiseka ngeBhayibhili, impendulo yalo izasixakululela inkinga leyi. UAmnoni wayeyisoni esikhulu, njalo wayengavumanga izono zakhe, wenzwa ukuthi anathe utshwala, njalo wathi esedakiwe wabulawa. UDavida wayengumprofethi kaNkulunkulu, kwakumele akwazi ukuthi kwakukubi kumbe kwakulungile ngoAmnoni embusweni ozayo. Kwaba yini akubonisayo? “Inhliziyo kaDavida yakhumbula uAbisalomu kakhulu, ngoba wayeseduduzekile ngokufa kukaAmnoni.” 2 Samuweli 13:39. {GC 537.3}

“Kuyini esikuthola emazwini lawa? Ayisikho yini ukuthi ukutshiswa kokuphela kwakungekho enkolweni yakhe na? Ngakhoke siyananzelela njalo sithola ubufakazi obusekela imfundiso elothando eveza ukuthi ekucineni wonke umuntu uzahlanzwa njalo athole ukuphila. Waduduzeka nxa wayebona indodana yakhe isifile. Kungani kwakunjalo? Ngoba ngelihlo lesiprofethi wayelamandla okukhangela phambili empilweni yenkazimulo njalo wabona indodana leyi isisusiwe ezilingweni, isikhululiwe ebugqilini njalo yahlanjwa ebubini besono, njalo ngemva kwalokho seyenziwe yaba ngcwele njalo yamukelwa phakathi kwexuku lemimoya ethokozayo. Into eyodwa eyamduduzayo yayiyikuthi, ngokususwa esimeni lesi sesono njalo lokuhlupheka, indodana yakhe ayithandayo yaseyihambe endaweni lapho umphefumulo ophakemeyo kaMoya oNgcwele owawuzathelwa phezu komphefumulo wakhe omnyama, lapho ingqondo zakhe ezazivulelwa ukuhlakanipha kwasezulwini, lobuhle bothando olungapheliyo, ngale indlela eselungiswe ngesimo esingcwelisiweyo ukuba akholise ukuthula lobudlelwano bokuba zindlalifa zezulu.” {GC 538.1}

“Emicabangweni leyi, siyabe sizwisiseka nxa sikholwa ukuthi ukusindiswa kwezulu akweyamanga ezenzweni esingazenza empilweni leyi, kumbe ekuguqulweni kwenhliziyo khathesi, kumbe kwesikukholwayo khathesi, kumbe enkolweni ethile emhlabeni.” {GC 538.2}

Ngale indlela umuntu obizwa ngokuthi ngumfundisi kaKrestu, uphinda phinda amanga akhulunywa yinyoka ensimini yaseEdeni athi: “Kawuyikufa.” “Ngosuku elizakudla khona, amehlo wenu azavuleka, njalo lizafana loNkulunkulu.” Ufundisa ukuthi isoni esibi okwedlula zonke, umbulali, lesela, njalo lesiphingi, ngemva kokufa uzabe elungele ukungena embusweni kaNkulunkulu. {GC 538.3}

Njalo lowu ophendulela amazwi eBhayibhili uyithatha ngaphi imfundiso leyi? Uyithatha emugceni owodwa obonisa ukwamukela kukaDavida intando yezulu. Inhliziyo yakhe “yamloyisa uAbisalomu kakhulu, ngoba wayeseduduzekile ngokufa kukaAmnoni kubhekeka wayesefile.” Ubuhlungu bokukhala kwakhe ngemva kokuthi sekwehlile ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi, imicabango yakhe yasuka endodaneni efileyo yaya kwephilayo, eyayibalekile ngenxa yokwesaba isigwebo secala laso. Njalo lokhu kuyibufakazi bokuthi isiphingi lesidakwa esingu Amnoni ngemva kokufa kwakhe wathwalelwa ebuhleni lapho ayezahlanjululwa njalo aphile lengilosi! Leyi yinganekwane ejabulisayo impela, elungiselwe ukujabulisa inhliziyo ethanda isono! Leyi yimfundiso kaSathane, njalo yenza umsebenzi wakhe kahle kakhulu. Kumele simangale yini ukuthi, ngenxa yemfundiso ezinje, ububi buyanda na? {GC 538.4}

Indlela ehanjwa ngumfundisi wamanga esimvezileyo yiyo elandelwa ngabanye abanengi. Amazwi amalutshwana weBhayibhili ayehlukaniswa lendikimba yendaba, ezikhathini ezinengi ebingabonisa ukuthi ingcazelo efundiswayo ayivumelani lokulotshiweyo, njalo imigca efana laleyi engaphelelanga iyaphendulelwa njalo isetshenziswe njengobufakazi bemfundiso ezingela sisekelo elizwini likaNkulunkulu. Amazwi afundwe njengobufakazi bokuthi uAmnoni usezulwini ayimfundiso ephikisana lamazwi weBhayibhili athi akulasidakwa esizaba yindlalifa yombuso kaNkulunkulu. (1 Korinte 6:10). Kwenzeka ngale indlela ukuthi abathandabuzayo labangakholwayo, baphendulela iqiniso libe ngamanga. Njalo izigidi zabantu sezabangelwa ukuthi zikhohliswe ngenxa yamanga abo njalo zenziwa ukuthi ziqhubeke empilweni yesono bona becabanga ukuthi baphephile. {GC 539.1}

Ngabe bekuyiqiniso ukuthi imphefumulo yabantu bonke ihle idlulele ezulwini ngemva kokufa, bekuzaba kuhle ukuthi sonke sifise ukufa kulokuphila. Abanengi sebakhokhelwa yimfundiso leyi ukuthi bazibulale. Nxa besindwa yikuhlupheka, lokudangala, njalo lobuhlungu, kubonakala sengathi yinto elula ukuthi bathathe impilo yabo badlulele ebuhleni bezulu. {GC 539.2}

UNkulunkulu usinikile elizwini lakhe ubufakazi obusobala bokuthi uzajezisa bonke abephula imilayo yakhe. Labo abaziyengayo abathi ulesihawu esikhulu ukuthi ehlulele isoni, kumele bakhangele esiphambanweni saseKhalivari kuphela. Ukufa kweNdodana kaNkulunkulu eyayingela sono kuyibufakazi bokuthi “inkokhelo yesono iyikufa,” ukuthi konke ukwephulwa kwemilayo kaNkulunkulu kumele kuthole umvuzo ofaneleyo. UKrestu owayengela sono waphenduka waba yisono endaweni yomuntu. Wathwala icala lokona, njalo lokusithwala lobuso bukaYise, inhliziyo yakhe yaze yadabuka impilo yakhe yaphela. Umnikelo lowo wenzelwa ukuthi izoni zisindiswe. Kwakungela eyinye indlela isoni esasingakhululwa ngayo esigwebeni sesono. Njalo wonke umuntu oyala ukwamukela umnikelo onikwe ngentengo enkulu kangaka kumele azithwalele icala njalo lemfanelo yaso. {GC 539.3}

Asikhangeleni okunye okufundiswa liBhayibhili mayelana labantu ababi njalo abangavumiyo izono zabo, labo ababekwa ngabafundisi bamanga njengokuthi basezulwini njengabantu abangcwele asebezingilosi ezithokozayo. {GC 540.1}

“Owomileyo ngizakumnathisa ngesihle emthonjeni wamanzi okuphila.” Sambulo 21:6. Isithembiso lesi ngesalabo kuphela abomileyo. Akula omunye kodwa labo kuphela abananzelela ukuthi bomile, njalo abadinga amanzi lawa ngokudela konke, yibo kuphela abazanathiswa. “Onqobayo uzakudla ilifa lalezizinto, ngizakuba nguNkulunkulu wakhe, yena abe yindodana yami.” (Sambulo 21:7). Lapha futhi, kulemigomo ebekiweyo. Ukwenzela ukuthi sibe zindlalifa kumele silahle njalo sinqobe isono. {GC 540.2}

INkosi nxa ikhuluma ngomprofethi uIsaya ithi: “Tshelani abalungileyo ukuthi kuzabakuhle kubo, ngoba bazakudla umvuzo wezenzo zabo.” “Maye komubi, kuzakuba kubi kuye, ngoba lokho okwenziwe ngezandla zakhe kuzakwenziwa lakuye.” Isaya 3:10,11. “Lanxa isoni sisenza okubi izikhathi ezilikhulu siphile isikhathi eside, kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi kuzabalungela labo abemesabayo uNkulunkulu ngoba bayamesaba, kodwa ababi kakuyikubalungela.” Mtshumayeli 8:12,13. Njalo uPhawuli uyafakaza ukuthi isoni sizibekela “ulaka ngosuku lolaka, mhla kusambulwa ukuthonisisa okulungileyo kukaNkulunkulu, ozakunika lowo lalowo ngokwemisebenzi yakhe,” “usizi lokubandezeka kuzakwehlela abantu bonke abenza okubi.” Roma 2:5,6,9. {GC 540.3}

“Yazini lokhu, likuqedisise ukuthi oyisifebe, longcolileyo lolomhawu, okutsho lowo okhonza izithombe, kalalifa embusweni kaKrestu lokaNkulunkulu.” Efesu 5:5. “Nxwanelani ukuhlala ngokuthula labantu bonke, linxwanele lobungcwele, ongelabo bona angeyibone iNkosi.” Amaheberu 12:14. “Babusisiswe labo abenza imilayo yakhe, ukuba babe lelungelo esihlahleni sokuphila, bangene emzini ngamasango. Ngaphandle kukhona izinja, labathakathi, leziphingi, lababulali, labakhonza izithombe, labo bonke abathanda inkohliso beyenza.” Sambulo 22:14,15. {GC 541.1}

UNkulunkulu unike abantu amazwi achaza isimo sakhe, njalo lendlela azaqeda ngayo isono. “YiNkosi, nguNkulunkulu olesihawu lomusa, ophuza ukuthukuthela, ogcwele uthando olungapheliyo lobuqotho, ohawukela abayizigidi, othethelela ububi leziphambeko lezono, kodwa ongayikubayekela abalecala.” Eksodusi 34:6,7. “Bonke ababi uzababhubhisa.” “Kodwa abaphambukayo bazakubhujiswa bonke, inzalo yababi izakuchithwa.” Amahubo 145:20; 37:38. Amandla njalo lobukhosi bombuso wasezulwini azasetshenziswa ukuqeda ukuhlamuka, kodwa loba kunjalo konke ukujezisa kuzabe kuhambelana lesimo sikaNkulunkulu olesihawu, lozwelo njalo olothando. {GC 541.2}

UNkulunkulu kabambi ngamandla intando kumbe ukwahlulela komuntu. Kathokozeleli ukumlalela okungaveli enhliziyweni. Ufisa ukuthi izidalwa zezandla zakhe zingamthanda ngoba efanele ukuthandwa. Ufuna kuphela ukuthi bamkhonze ngoba befuna ukubonga ukuhlakanipha kwakhe, lokulunga njalo lothando alalo. Njalo bonke abananzelela ngokulunga zonke lezi izinto bazamthanda ngoba badonselwa kuye ngoba bekhangwa yibuhle bakhe. {GC 541.3}

Umusa lesihawu, lothando okwafundiswa njalo kwaboniswa nguMsindisi wethu, kungumfanekiso wentando yakhe njalo lesimo sikaNkulunkulu. UKrestu wakubeka sobala ukuthi kazange afundise okunye okuphambene lalokho ayekuphiwe nguYise. Isisekelo sombuso wezulu sihambelana lamazwi woMsindisi wokuthi, “Wothanda izitha zakho.” UNkulunkulu uyehlulela ababi, ngenxa yokuthi efuna ukuthi umhlaba wonke ubelokuthula, njalo kwesinye isikhathi esenzela ukuthi labo abamukela ukwahlulela kwakhe balimukiswe. Engabenza bajabule nxa ebengakwenza lokhu elandela imithetho yombuso wakhe njalo lokulunga kwakhe. Ubagombolozela ngezikhumbuzo zothando lwakhe, abanike ulwazi mayelana lemithetho yakhe, njalo abalandelele ngokubanika umusa wakhe, kodwa bayaphika uthando lwakhe, bephule imilayo yakhe, njalo baphike umusa wakhe. Loba behlala besamukela izibusiso zakhe, bayadelela onguye obaphayo, bazonda uNkulunkulu ngoba bayazi ukuthi izono zabo ziyisinengiso kuye. INkosi iyabekezelela ububi babo, kodwa ihola lokwahlulela lizafika ekucineni, lapho ikusasa labo elizapheleliswa khona. Uzababophela abahlamuki laba ehlangothini lwakhe na? Uzababamba ngamandla ukuthi benze intando yakhe yini? {GC 541.4}

Labo abakhethe uSathane njengomholi wabo njalo abaholelwa ngamandla akhe abalungelanga ukuba phambi kaNkulunkulu. Ukuziphakamisa, lokukhohlisa, lokwenza okubi, lochuku, sekungene kwakha ezimeni zabo. Bengangena yini ezulwini ukuthi bahlale lalowo abebekade bemzonda emhlabeni? Iqiniso alisoke livumelane lamanga, ukuzithoba akusoke kusuthise ukuziphakamisa lobumina, ukubamsulwa akuvumelani lobuqili, uthando oluqotho alujabulisi labo abazithandayo. Kuyini okuhle izulu elingakunika labo abazinikele entokozweni yalumhlaba njalo lasezintweni ezithokozisa bona kuphela na? {GC 542.1}

Ngabe bekungenzeka ukuthi labo abachithe impilo zabo zonke behlamukela uNkulunkulu bathwalelwe ezulwini njalo babone ukuphakama njalo lobungcwele obukhonangale, lapho zonke inhliziyo ezigcwele uthando, lobuso obukhazimula ngentokozo, lengoma eziphakama ziletha udumo kuNkulunkulu njalo leWundlu, njalo lemifula yokukhanya engapheliyo egelezela phezu kwabasindisiweyo evela ebusweni balowo ohleli esihlalweni, labo abalenhliziyo ezizonda uNkulunkulu, leqiniso lobungcwele, bengenelisa yini ukuhlanganyela lezidalwa zezulu behlabele ingoma zokudumisa? Bebengenelisa ukuphila phambi kwenkazimulo kaNkulunkulu leyeWundlu na? Ngeke, ngeke iminyaka yokulungiselela yanikwa bona, ukuthi benelise ukubumba izimilo zezulu, kodwa abazange bafundise ingqondo zabo ukuthi zithande ukulunga, abazange bafunde ulimi lwasezulwini, manje ithuba selidlulile. Impilo yokuhlamukela uNkulunkulu isibangele ukuthi bangalifaneli izulu. Ukubamsulwa kwalo, lobungcwele, njalo lokuthula bekuzaba buhlungu kibo, inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu ibizaba njengomlilo oqothulayo kibo. Bebezahlala befisa ukubalekela indawo leyi engcwele. Bebezakwamukela ukufa, ukwenzela ukuthi bacatshiswe phambi kobuso balowo owafela ukuthi abasindise. Isiphetho sababi sibekwe yikukhetha kwabo. Ukungabi khona kwabo ezulwini kungenxa yokukhetha kwabo, kulungile futhi kungomusa kuNkulunkulu. {GC 542.2}

Njengamanzi kazamcolo amalangabi wosuku lokwahlulela lukaNkulunkulu abonisa isigwebo sokuthi abantu ababi abasiliseki. Abalasifiso sokukhothamela amandla ezulu. Intando yabo bayisebenzise ukuhlamuka, njalo nxa impilo isiphelile, akwenzeki ukuthi imicabango yabo iguqulwe, akuselasikhathi sokusuka endleleni yokwephula imilayo besiya ekulungeni, lokusuka phakathi kwenzondo besiya ekuthandeni. {GC 543.1}

Ngokuvumela ukuthi uKhayini umbulali aphile, uNkulunkulu wanika umhlaba isibonelo sokuthi umphumela wokuvumela ukuthi isoni siqhubeke siphila impilo yokwenza okubi. Ngenxa yendosela yemfundiso kaKhayini lesibonelo sakhe, uquqaba lwenzalo yakhe lwakhokhelwa esonweni, kwazekwafika isikhathi lapho “ububi bomuntu basebubukhulu emhlabeni, lokuthi yonke imicabango yenhliziyo yakhe yeseyimibi kokuphela.” “Umhlaba wawonakele phambi kukaNkulunkulu, umhlaba wagcwala udlakela.” Genesisi 6:5,11. {GC 543.2}

Ngenxa yomusa wakhe phezu komhlaba, uNkulunkulu watshabalalisa abantu ababephila ngesikhathi sikaNowa. Ngenxa yomusa wakhe wabhubhisa abantu baseSodoma. Ngenxa yamandla kaSathane abantu abenza okubi bathola uzwelo lokubukwa, njalo ngale indlela baqhubeka bedukisa abanye ukuthi bahlamuke. Kwakunjalo ngensuku zikaKhayini njalo lezikaNowa, lasesikhathini sikaAbrahama lesika Lothi, kunjalo lasesikhathini sethu. Kungenxa yomusa ukuthi uNkulunkulu ekucineni uzabhubhisa bonke abaphika umusa wakhe. {GC 543.3}

“Ngoba inkokhelo yesono iyikufa, kodwa isiphiwo somusa sikaNkulunkulu siyikuphila okungapheliyo kuKrestu Jesu iNkosi yethu.” Roma 6:23. Loba impilo iyisipho sabalungileyo, ukufa kubekelwe labo ababi. UMose watshela isizwe sakoIsrayeli: “Khangelani, ngibekile phambi kwenu lamuhla ukuphila lokulunga, ukufa lobubi.” Duterenomi 30:15. Ukufa okuvezwe endimeni lezi lawa ayisikho lokho okwanikwa uAdamu, ngoba wonke umuntu uyamukela isigcebo sokwephula umthetho akwenzayo. “Kuyikufa kwesibili” okubekelwe ukuthi kuqathaniswe lempilo engapheliyo. {GC 544.1}

Ngenxa yesono sikaAdamu, ukufa kwehlela uluntu lonke. Bonke ngokufanayo bayangena emathuneni. Njalo ngenxa yokwenza kwecebo losindiso, bonke bazavuswa emathuneni wabo. “Kuzaba lovuko lwabafileyo, bonke abalungileyo labangalunganga;” “njengalokhu kuAdamu bonke bayafa, ngokunjalo futhi kuKrestu bonke bazakuvuswa baphile.” Imisebenzi 24:15; 1 Korinte 15:22. Kodwa umehluko uyavezwa phakathi kwamaqembu lawa womabili avuswayo. “Lingamangali ngalokhu, ngoba isikhathi siyeza, lapho bonke abasemalibeni bazakulizwa ilizwi layo, kuthi labo abenze okulungileyo baphumele ekuvukeni kokuphila, lalabo abenze okubi baphumele ekuvukeni kokulahlwa.” Johane 5:28,29. Labo “abatholakale befanele” uvuko lokuphila “babusisiwe njalo bangcwele.” “Kwabanjalo ukufa kwesibili akulamandla.” Sambulo 20:6. Kodwa labo abangavumanga izono zabo ngokukholwa, njalo bathola ukuthethelelwa, kumele bamukele isigwebo sokwephula imilayo, ngoba “inkokhelo yesono yikufa.” Bazathola izigwebo ezihlukeneyo ngobuhlungu njalo ngesikhathi, “ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo,” kodwa ekucineni lokhu kuzaphelela ekufeni kwesibili. Njengoba kungenzeki ukuthi uNkulunkulu asindise isoni ezonweni zaso engephulanga ukulunga njalo lomusa wakhe, akwenzayo kuphela yikumthathela impilo ephakade ayichithe ngenxa yokona kwakhe, njalo azibonise ukuthi kayifanelanga. “Kuseyisikhatshana nje ukuba omubi angabe esaba khona, loba uhlola indawo yakhe uzakuba engasekho.” Omunye uthi: “Zizakuba sengathi azizange zibekhona.” (Amahubo 37:10; Obadiya 16). Bembeswe ukungalungi bazakutshona befe ukufa kwesibili. {GC 544.2}

Ngale indlela isono sizakuqedwa, lakho konke ukuhlupheka lokufa okwalethwa yiso. “Uzikhuzile izizwe, wabhubhisa ababi, walesula ibizo labo kwaze kwaba nininini. Izitha zichitheke zaphela nya, imizi yazo uyidilizile, kazisayikukhunjulwa.” Amahubo 9:5,6. UJohane kuSambulo, nxa wayekhangela phambili empilweni engelamkhawulo, uzwa ingoma yodumo engelalizwi elilodwa elingahambelani labanye. Zonke izidalwa ezulwini lasemhlabeni zezwakala zinika lonke udumo kuNkulunkulu. (Sambulo 5:13). Ngaleso isikhathi kuzabe kungasela umphefumulo owodwa olahliweyo ozathuka uNkulunkulu ophakathi kobuhlungu obungapheliyo, akulazidalwa ezisegehena ezikhalayo ezizaphambanisa ingoma yabasindisiweyo. {GC 545.1}

Phezu kwemfundiso yamanga yokuthi umphefumulo wabantu awufi, kulapho okugxile khona imfundiso yokuthi abantu bayaqhubeka bebona okwenzakalayo ngemva kokufa kwabo, leyi yimfundiso efana laleyi eyokuthi abantu bayatshiswa kokuphela, ephikisana lobufakazi beBhayibhili, lemicabango yethu njalo lemizwa yethu njengabantu. Imfundiso leyi ejwayelekileyo, iletha ukuthi bonke abasindisiweyo abasezulwini bayabona konke okwenzakala emhlabeni ikakhulu empilweni zabangane ababatshiye emuva. Kodwa kungenzeka njani ukuthi kube yinto ethokozisa abafileyo ukuthi bazi inhlupheko zabaphilayo, lokuthi babone izono ezenziwa yilabo ababathandayo, njalo lokubabona bedlula enhluphekweni, lasekudangaleni njalo lasensizini zempilo? Bungakanani ubuhle bezulu obuzakholiswa yilabo abahlala bendiza phezu kwabangane babo emhlabeni na? Njalo iphambene kangakanani imfundiso yokuthi labo abangalunganga nxa beqeda ukuphefumula umphefumulo wabo wokucina badlulela emalangabini wegehena! Beluzaba ngakanani usizi lwalabo ababona abangane babo besiya emathuneni bengazilungiselanga, besiyangena empilweni yobuhlungu lesono kokuphela! Abantu abanengi sebalahlekelwa zingqondo zabo ngenxa yemicabango leyi ehlukuluzayo. {GC 545.2}

IBhayibhili lifundisani mayelana lezinto lezi? UDavida waloba ukuthi umuntu kalamcabango ngemva kokufa kwakhe. “Lapho esifa, uyabuyela emhlabathini, langalolosuku amacebo akhe ayaphela.” Amahubo 146:4. USolomoni laye uyengeza ngokuthi: “Ngoba abaphilayo bayazi ukuthi bazakufa, kodwa abafileyo abazi lutho, kabaselawo umvuzo, kabasakhunjulwa” “Uthando lwabo lenzondo yabo lomona wabo sekubhubhile, kabasayikuba khona kulokho okwenziwayo ngaphansi kwelanga.” “Kawukho umsebenzi lomcabango, lolwazi, lokuhlakanipha endaweni yabafileyo lapho uya khona.” Mtshumayeli 9:5,6,10. {GC 545.3}

Nxa umthandazo wakhe wasewuphenduliwe, njalo impilo kaHezekiya yaseyengezelelwe ngeminyaka elitshumi lanhlanu, inkosi yabonga uNkulunkulu ngokudumisa isihawu sakhe. Wasebenzisa ingoma leyi ukunika isisatho sokujabula kwakhe: “Indawo yabafileyo ingeke ikubonge, lokufa kungeke kukudumise, labo abehlela emgodini bangethembe ubuqotho bakho. Abaphilayo yibo abakudumisayo, njengoba ngikudumisa lamuhla.” Isaya 38:18,19. Imfundiso ejwayelekileyo ithi abantu bonke abalungileyo abafileyo basezulwini, njalo bangene enjabulweni yokudumisa uNkulunkulu ngolimi olungafiyo, kodwa uHezekiya kazange abone injabulo enjalo phakathi kokufa. Amazwi akhe avumelana lobufakazi bukamahubo: “Ngoba kakukho ukukukhumbula wena ekufeni, ngubani ongakubonga endaweni yabafileyo na?” “Abafileyo kabayidumisi iNkosi, kakho loyedwa wabo abehlela elizweni labafileyo oyidumisayo.” Amahubo 6:5; 115:17. {GC 546.1}

UPetro ngosuku lwePentecosti waveza ukuthi uDavida “wafa, wambelwa, leliba lakhe lisekhona kithi kuze kube lamuhla.” “Ngoba uDavida kenyukelanga ezulwini.” Imisebenzi 2:29,34. Ngesizatho sokuthi uDavida uzahlala ethuneni lakhe kuzekuyefika usuku lokuvuka kuyibufakazi bokuthi abalungileyo abayi ezulwini ngemva kokufa kwabo. Kungenxa yokuvuka kuphela njalo ngesizatho sokuthi uKrestu wavuka, okuzakwenza ukuthi uDavida laye ekucineni ahlale esandleni sokunene sikaNkulunkulu. {GC 546.2}

UPhawuli laye wathi: “Ngoba uba abafileyo bengavuswa, kavuswanga laye uKrestu. Uba uKrestu engavuswanga, ukukholwa kwenu kuyize, lisesezonweni zenu. Lalabo asebafa bekuKrestu sebatshabalala.” 1 Korinte 15:16-18. Ngabe okweminyaka eyinkulungwane ezine abalungileyo babekade besiya ezulwini, uPhawuli wayezakutsho njani ukuthi nxa kungelavuko, “lalabo asebafa bekuKrestu sebabhubha”? Bekungeke kube lesidingo sokuthi kube lovuko. {GC 546.3}

UTyndale omunye wabavuseleli abafela iqiniso, nxa wayekhuluma ngesimo salabo abafileyo, wathi: “Ngiyavuma phambi komuntu wonke, ukuthi angivumi ukuthi manje baphakathi kwenkazimulo uKrestu akuyo, kumbe lapho okukhona ingilosi zikaNkulunkulu ezikhethekileyo.
