Kuzozonke indawo lapho imilayo kaNkulunkulu ephikwa khona, isono siyama ukubonakala ngendlela esibi ngayo njalo lokulunga kuyama ukuba yinto abantu abayithakazelelayo. Bonke abayala ukulawulwa nguNkulunkulu balahlekelwa ngamandla okulawula impilo zabo. Ngenxa yemfundiso zabo ezimbi kangaka umoya wokudelela lokuqholoza uyahlanyelwa enhliziyweni zabantu abatsha njalo labantwana, bona abangakuthandiyo ukulawulwa, njalo ngenxa yalokho kubakhona ubukliwi emphakathini. Ngesikhathi bechothoza ukwethembeka kwalabo abagcina iziqondiso zikaNkulunkulu, uquqaba lwabantu lwamukela ngenjabulo imfundiso zamanga ezivela kuSathane. Bavumela imizwa njalo benza izono ezabangela ukuthi ukujezisa kukaNkulunkulu kwehlele abahedeni. {GC 584.3}

Labo abafundisa abantu ukuthi bangaqakathekisi imilayo kaNkulunkulu bahlanyela ukungalaleli njalo bazavuna ukungalaleli. Akususwe uthango lokuvikela olubekwe yimilayo engcwele, okuzalandela yikuthi imithetho efakwe ngabantu layo masinyane izaqala ukwephulwa. Ngenxa yokuthi uNkulunkulu kavuMmeli empilweni zabantu ukungathembeki, lokunxwanela, lokuqamba amanga, lokuqilibezela, abantu bazimisele ukuvoxa phansi iziqondiso zakhe ngoba zivimbela ukuphumelela kwabo, kodwa impumela yokususa imithetho leyi izakuba ngabangayikhangelelanga. Kambe nxa bekuyikuthi umthetho awuselamandla empilweni yethu bekungaba lesizatho sokuthi abantu besabe ukuwephula na? Izindlu kanye lenotho yabantu ibingeke ibe iphephile. Abantu bebezathatha inotho yabomakhelwane ngodlakela, njalo labo abalamandla yibo abebekade bezanotha kakhulu. Impilo ngokwayo beyingeke isahlonitshwa. Isivumelwano somtshado besingeke sisaba luthango oluvikela izimuli. Lowo olamandla nxa ethanda ubezathatha umfazi kamakhelwane wakhe ngodlakela. Umlayo wesihlanu ubuzakwephulwa ndawonye lowesine. Abantwana bebengeke bathikaze ukuthatha impilo zabazali babo, nxa ngokwenza njalo bebezazuza lokho okufiswa zinhliziyo zabo ezikhohlakeleyo. Umhlaba wonke ubuzaba luquqaba lwezigangi njalo lababulali; njalo ukuthula, lokuphumula, kanye lentokozo bekuzatshabalaliswa emhlabeni. {GC 585.1}

Lakathesi imfundiso yokuthi abantu sebakhululwa njalo akusadingeki ukuba balandele iziqondiso zikaNkulunkulu seyabangela ukuba amandla okukhetha okuhle aphungulwe njalo lokhu yikho osekwabangela ukuba ububi bande emhlabeni. Ubudlova, lobubi, njalo lenkohlakalo sekungene emhlabeni njengesikhukhula esikhulu. Ezimulini uSathane, lakho uhlala esemsebenzini. Ibhakane lakhe limisiwe ngitsho lasemulini zamaKrestu. Kukhona ukunxwanela, lomona, lokuba ngabazenzisi, lokungazwani, lokulungisela, lengxabano, lokuthengisana, lokulandela inkanuko zenyama. Zonke iziqondiso zesiKrestu ezidalelwe ukuba zibe yinsika njalo lothango olubumba zonke izinto eziphathelene lokuphila kwabantu, zibonakala njengamazwi angelamsebenzi alindele ukulahlelwa khatshana. Izigebenga ezimbi okwedlula zonke, ngemva kokuphoselwa entolwengweni ngenxa yamacala abawenzileyo, esikhathini bamukela izipho eziligugu kakhulu njalo lokulandelelwa sengathi bayenze into ebukekayo. Kubakhona ukusakazwa kwezenzo zabo njalo lamacala abo okukhulu kakhulu. Abezindaba labo bayaloba konke mayelana lobubi ababenzileyo, ngale indlela abanye bayaholelwa ukuba bayenze amacala afana lokugqekeza, lokuqilibezela, njalo lukubulala, njalo uSathane uyajabula ngenxa yokusebenza kwamaqhinga akhe amabi. Indlela abantu abathanda ngayo ububi, lokubulawa kwabantu mahlayana okwenzakalayo, lokwanda kokungazithibi kanye lububi obehlukeneyo, kumele kuvuse bonke abesaba uNkulunkulu, kubenze bazibuze ukuba kuyini okungenziwa ukwenzela ukuthi isikhukhula sobubi lobu simiswe. {GC 585.2}

Endaweni lapho okuthethwa khona amacala lakho sekwangena inkohlakalo. Ababusayo labo baholwa yinhloso yokuthola inotho njalo lesifiso sokusuthisa inkanuko zomzimba. Ukungazithibi sekwafiphalisa inhliziyo zabantu abanengi osekubangele ukuba uSathane ayenelise ukuba hudulela lapho athanda khona. Omantshi labo abalakho ukuzithiba, bayavumela ukuthengwa njalo bakhohlisiwe. Ukudakwa lokuthanda ukuzithokozisa, lokuvumela imizwa, lokunxwanela, lokungathembeki okwehlukeneyo, kuyatholakala kulabo okumele baqinise umthetho elizweni. “Ukulunga kubiselwa emuva, lokulunga kumi khatshana, ngoba iqiniso liyawa emigwaqweni lobuqotho kabulandawo yokungena.” Isaya 59:14. {GC 586.1}

Ububi njalo lobumnyama kwezenkolo okwabakhona ngaphansi kokubusa kwebandla leRoma kwaba yizithelo zokuncindezela kwabo iBhayibhili; kodwa khathesi ingatholakala ngaphi imbangela yokumemetheka kobubi, lokwala umthetho kaNkulunkulu, njalo lenkohlakalo elandela isenzo lesi, ngaphansi kokukhanya kwevangeli njali ngaphansi kwenkululeko ekhona kwezenkolo na? Khathesi njengoba uSathane engasenelisi ukugcina umhlaba ungaphansi kwamaphiko wakhe ngokubafihlela iBhayibhili, khathesi usesebenzisa amanye amaqhinga okufeza injengo efanayo. Ukwenza ukuthi abantu bangalikholwa ngokuphelela iBhayibhili kufeza injongo yakhe efanana lokutshabalalisa iBhayibhili ngokwalo. Ngokuletha imfundiso yokuthi umthetho kaNkulunkulu awuselamsebenzi, uhola abantu ukuthi bawephule sengathi bebengabantu abangakaze bezizwe iziqondiso zawo empilweni yabo. Njalo khathesi njengasendulo, usebenzise ibandla ukufeza injongo zakhe. Amabandla amaKrestu alamuhlanje ayakwala ukulalela amaqiniso angahambelani labo loba nje evezwe sobala eBhayibhili, njalo ukwenzela ukuthi bawaphikise basebenzisa indlela yokuchasisa uMbhalo osuhlanyele ukuthandabuza iBhayibhili emhlabeni wonke. Ngokugagadlela imfundiso yamanga eyalethwa ngabopapa eyokuthi umuntu ofileyo uqhubeka esazi okwenzakala emhlabeni, sebalahlela khatshana ihawu elilodwa ebelingabavikela ekuduhisweni kwenkolo yemimoya. Imfundiso yokuthi abantu bazakutshiswa egehena kokuphela seyabangela ukuthi abantu abanengi baphike inkolo yeBhayibhili. Njalo nxa amaqiniso omlayo wesine elethwa phambi kwabantu, kubasobala ukuthi ukugcina usuku lwesikhombisa njengeSabatha kugoqelwe kuwo, njengendlela yokuzikhulula emlandweni abangafuni ukuwenza, abafundisi abanengi bakhetha ukufundisa ukuthi umlayo awuselamsebenzi ngoba wabethelwa esiphambanweni. Ngale indlela balahlela khatshana imithetho elitshumi leSabatha ndawonye. Nxa umsebenzi wokuvuselela iSabatha ulokhe uqhubeka, ukuphika umlayo lokhu ukwenzela ukuthi bengamukeli usuku lweSabatha kuzaqhubeka kukhula kuze kufinyelele umhlaba wonke. Imfundiso zabaholi bamabandla sezavula umnyango wokuthi kungene ukungakholwa konke, lenkolo yemimoya njalo lokufulathelwa komlayo kaNkulunkulu, njalo phezu kwamahlombe abafundisi laba kulomlandu wamacala wonke akhona emhlabeni ozibiza ngokuthi ukholwa inkolo yesiKrestu. {GC 586.2}

Ngesikhathi sinye iqula labantu abafananayo lifundisa ukuthi isizatho sokwanda kwenkohlakalo yikwephulwa kwesabatha lamanga amaKrestu azibekela lona njalo lokuthi ukufakwa komthetho oqinisa ukukhonza ngosuku lwangeSonto yikho ozabangela ukuthi kubelenguquko ekuziphatheni kwabantu. Imfundiso leyi ivame kakhulu elizweni laseAmerica, endaweni lapho imfundiso mayelana leSabatha leqiniso etshunyayelwe khona kakhulu. Elizweni leli umsebenzi wokufundisa abantu ukuba bazithibe emzimbeni yabo, ongomunye wemfundiso eziqakatheke kakhulu mayelana lokuziphatha kwabantu, wandise ukuhlanganiswa lemfundiso yokufuna ukuqakathekisa usuku lwangeSonto, njalo labo abasekela usuku lolu baziveza phambi komphakathi njengabantu abalenhloso yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, njalo labo abayala ukubambana labo bayachothozwa njengezitha zemfundiso yokuzithiba njalo lemizamo yokuletha inguquko emphakathini. Kodwa iqiniso lokuthi inhlanganiso efisa ukuqinisa imfundiso zamanga ilobudlelwano lenhlanganiso eyenza umsebenzi omuhle, akumelanga kwenze ukuthi imfundiso yamanga yamukeleke. Singafihla itshefu ngokulihlanganisa lokudla okwakha umzimba, kodwa ngokwenza njalo ngeke ziguqule isimo sayo. Isenzo leso senza ukuthi ibe yingozi kakhulu, ngoba lokhu kungenza ukuthi abantu bayidle bengananzelelanga. Kungamanye wamaqhinga kaSathane awokuhlanganisa imfundiso zamanga leqiniso elincinyane ukwenzela ukuthi amukeleke phambi kwabantu. Abaholi bamabandla aqinisa ukukhonza ngosuku lwangeSonto bengasekela imfundiso lenhlanganiso ezigcwalisa indingeko zabantu, lamaqiniso amanye asekelwa liBhayibhili, kodwa nxa konke lokhu kuhlangene lemfundiso yabo ephikisana lomlayo kaNkulunkulu, izinceku zakhe akwenzeki ukuba zihlanganyele labo. Akukho abangakutsho okungabavumela ukuthi babeke eceleni imilayo kaNkulunkulu bebeke imfundiso zabantu endaweni yawo. {GC 587.1}

Ngokusebenzisa imfundiso zamanga ezimbili ezinkulu kulazo zonke, okuyimfundiso yokuthi umoya womuntu uyaqhubeka ulesabelo kwabaphilayo ngemva kokufa njalo laleyo eyokungcwelisa usuku lwangeSonto, uSathane uzabuthela abantu abanengi ngaphansi kokudukisa kwakhe. Nxa imfundiso yakuqala ibeka isisekelo sokuthi abantu bamukele imfundiso yemimoya, eyesibili yakhona ibumba ubudlelwano lebandla leRoma. Amabandla asungulwa ngabavuseleli atholakala elizweni laseAmerica yiwo azahola ngokwelula izandla zawo ukuba abambe inkolo yemimoya, bazakwelula njalo izandla zabo ukwenzela ukuba babambane lamandla ebandla leRoma, njalo ngaphansi kwenhlanganiso lezi zontathu, ilizwe laseAmerica lizalandela amanyathelo ebebadla leRoma ngokunyathezela amalungelo abantu awokulandela umzwangedwa wabo. {GC 588.1}

Nxa inkolo yokukhonza imimoya ilokhe iqhubeka ithatha isimo esifanana lenkolo yamaKrestu alamuhla, ilamandla angezelelweyo awokudukisa njalo lokugola abanengi. USathane ngokwakhe laye uselandela indlela izinto ezimi ngakhona khathesi. Uzakuza esesimeni sengilosi yokukhanya. Uzakusebenzisa inkolo yemimoya ukwenza izibonakaliso eziyisimanga, abagulayo bazakusiliswa, njalo izimanga ezinengi ezingaphikisekiyo zizakwenziwa. Imimoya leyi izavela njengabantu abakholwa iBhayibhili, njalo izabonisa isimo sokuhlonipha ingqubo zebandla, okuyikho okuzabangela ukuthi umsebenzi lowu wamukeleke njengamandla avela ezulwini. {GC 588.2}

Umzila wokwehlukanisa phakathi kwabantu abazibiza ngokuthi bangamaKrestu lalabo abangakholwayo lokhe usiya uncipha kancane kancane. Amalunga ebandla athanda lokho okuthandwa ngumhlaba njalo bazimisele ukuhlanganyela labo, njalo uSathane uzimisela ukubahlanganisa ukuba bebemzimba munye ngaleyo ndlela aqinise umsebenzi wakhe ngokuthanyelela bonke ngaphansi kokukhonzwa kwemimoya. Abaholi bebandla leRoma bona abaqakathekisa izibonakaliso, bazadukiswa kalula ngamandla lawa azabe esenza izibonakaliso, njalo lamabandla amaKrestu, ngenxa yokulahla kwabo ihawu leqiniso, labo bazadukiswa kalula. Abaholi bebandla leRoma, lamabandla amaKrestu asungulwa ngabavuseleli kanye labantu abangakhonziyo bonke bazakwamukela isimo sokulunga okungelawo amandla, njalo bazabona ekubambaneni lokhu inhlanganiso enkulu eyokuphendula umhlaba wonke okuyikho abazacabanga ukuthi kuzaletha iminyaka eyinkulungwane yokuthula osekukade beyilindele. {GC 588.3}

Ngaphansi kwenkolo yemimoya uSathane uvezwa njengomuntu omele ukuphumelelisa abantu, uzasilisa abagulayo, njalo uzafundisa ukuthi uselande ukusungula inkolo entsha, kodwa ngesikhathi esifanayo uzakusebenza njengombulali. Izilingo zakhe zizakuhola abantu abanengi ekulahlweni. Ukungazithibi kutshabalalisa amandla wokwenza izinqumo, ukulandela imizwa yomzimba, ukulwa, njalo lokuchitheka kwegazi kuyalandela. USathane uyathokoza nxa kulezimpi, ngoba uyazi ukuthi zivusa imizwa emibi kakhulu ebantwini njalo zibangela ukuthi abantu abanengi bafele ezonweni zabo. Kuyinhloso yakhe ukufuqa amazwe ukuthi angene phakathi kwezimpi, ngoba uyazi ukuba ngokwenza njalo uyasusa ingqondo zabantu emsebenzini wokulungiselela ukuma ngosuku lukaNkulunkulu. {GC 589.1}

USathane usebenzisa njalo izehlakalo zemvelo ukuvuna imphefumulo yabantu abangazilungiselelanga. Usethethe isikhathi esinengi efunda imfihlo yamandla emvelo, njalo uyenelisa ukusebenzisa amandla emvelo ngendlela athanda ngayo aze ayefika ebangeni uNkulunkulu amvumela ukuba afike kulo. Nxa wayesevunyelwe ukuhlukumeza uJobe, kachithanga isikhathi ukutshabalalisa imihlambi, lenceku, lezindlu, labantwana, konke wakutshabalalisa, inhlupho zalandelana ngobuthumuthumu. UNkulunkulu nguye kuphela ovikelayo njalo lobiyela izidalwa zakhe ukuze zingafinyelelwa ngamandla ombulali. Kodwa amaKrestu abonise ukudelela umlayo kaNkulunkulu, njalo iNkosi izakwenza lokho ethembise ukukwenza, uzakususa izibusiso zakhe emhlabeni njalo abuye asuse uthango lwakhe kulabo abahlamukela umlayo wakhe labaqhubeka befundisa labanye ukuba benze ngokufanayo. USathane ulamandla phezu kwabo bonke labo abangalakho ukuvikela kukaNkulunkulu. USathane uzaletha izibusiso kwabanye ukwenzela ukuthi afeze injongo yakhe, aphinde njalo ahlukumeze abanye abesabahola ukuthi bakholwe ukuba uNkulunkulu nguye obahlukumezayo. {GC 589.2}

Ngesikhathi ebonakala khona phambi kwabantu njengenyanga enkulu eyenelisa ukusilisa yonke imikhuhlane, uzaletha imikhuhlane kanye lengozi ezehlukeneyo, kuze kufike lapho amadolobho alodumo azakuba ngamanxiwa. Ngitsho lakhathesi usemsebenzini. Engozini kanye laseziphithiphithini zasolwandle kanye lasemhlabathini, lasemililweni etshisa iganga, lasezivunguzaneni ezinkulu njalo lezulu lesiqhotho, emagagasini, lakuzikhukhula zamanzi, njalo lokuzamazama komhlaba, endaweni zonke ngohlobo olwehlukeneyo, uSathane ubonisa amandla akhe. Uyakhukhula isivuno esesilungele ukubuthwa, kube sekulandela indlala njalo lokukhathazeka. Uyenelisa njalo ukungcolisa umhlaba kulandele izifo ezesabakayo. Ukubonakala kwamandla akhe lokhu, kuzaqhubeka kukhula nxa izikhathi zidlula. Ukufa kuzakwehlela abantu ndawonye lezinyamazana. “Umhlaba uyabubula njalo uyadlula,” “labantu ababi…bayabhubha. Umhlaba lawo ungcolile ngaphansi kwabahlali bawo, ngoba bephulile imilayo, baguqula lemithetho, babuya bephula lesivumelwano.” Isaya 24:4,5. {GC 589.3}

Nxa kusenzakala konke lokhu umkhohlisi omkhulu uzakwenza ukuthi abantu bakholwe ukuba labo abalandela intando kaNkulunkulu yibo ababangela bonke ububi lobu. Iqula lalabo bantu laba abenze lokho okungathandwa lizulu lizabeka icala lenhlupho ezizabe zikhona phambi kwabo phezu kwequla leli elithe ngokulandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu labangela ukuba ababi bahlale bekhunjuzwa ngezono zabo. Kuzachasiswa ukuthi abantu bazondisa uNkulunkulu ngokwephula isabatha abazalibeka ngosuku lwangeSonto, bazakutsho njalo ukuthi isono lesi yiso esibangele inhlupho lezi ezingasoke ziphunguke ngaphandle kokuthi kubekwe umthetho oqinileyo owokuthi abantu bakhonze ngosuku lwangeSonto, njalo lokuthi labo abafundisa ukuba kulandelwe umlayo wesine, ngokwenza njalo abaphikisa ukugcinwa kosuku lwangeSonto, yibo abayizitha zomphakathi, njalo bavimbela ukuba abantu babuyiselwe esimeni sokuthandwa nguNkulunkulu njalo bathole futhi inotho esibalahlekele. Ngale indlela ukunindela icala okwenziwa endulo encekwini kaNkulunkulu kuzaphindwa, kusetshenziswa izizatho ezibonakala zilesisindo: “Kwasekusithi uAhabi ebona uElija, uAhabi wathi kuye: Nguwe yini ohlupha uIsrayeli? Wasesithi: Kangihluphanga uIsrayeli, kodwa nguwe lendlu kayihlo, ngokuyitshiya kwenu imilayo yeNkosi, lalandela oBhali. 1 Amakhosi 18:17, 18. Nxa ulaka lwabantu luqhubeka lubaselwa ngenxa yamacala okuzibumbela afana lalawa, bazakhetha ukwenza lokho endulo abakwenza phezu kwabameli bakaNkulunkulu okwenziwa nguIsrayeli owayesehlamukele iqiniso kuElija. {GC 590.1}

Amandla okwenza izibonakaliso azakwenziwa ngenxa yenkolo yemimoya azaba lendonsela enkulu ekuhlukunyezweni kwalabo abazakhetha ukulandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu kulokuhlonipha imithetho yabantu. Kuzabakhona imbiko evela emimoyeni ezakutsho ukuthi uNkulunkulu ubathumele ukuzolimukisa labo abaphikisana lomthetho wokuphakamisa usuku lwangeSonto ukuba benza iphutha, beqinisa ukuba imithetho yelizwe kufanele ihlonitshwe njengemilayo kaNkulunkulu. Bazakhonona ngenxa yobubi obuzabe sebandile emhlabeni njalo basekele amazwi abaholi bamabandla awokuthi ukwehla kwezinga lokulunga ebantwini kubangelwa yikungahloniphi usuku lwangeSonto. Luzaba lukhuni ulaka oluzaqondiswa phezu kwalabo abazakwala ukwamukela ubufakazi babo. {GC 590.2}

Amaqhinga uSathane azawasebenzisa empikiswaneni yokucina ayafanana lalawa awasebenzisa ekuqaleni kwempi ezulwini. Wathembisa izithunywa ezulu ukuba wayesebenzela ukuqinisa amandla kahulumende wasezulwini, yena ensitha esenza yonke imizamo yokuwugenqula. Njalo umsebenzi yena ayezama ukuwenza wabeka icala phezu kwengilosi ezazizama ukumphikisa. Amaqhinga afananayo enkohliso abonakala sobala embalini yebandla leRoma. Lizwakale lifundisa ukuba yilo elimele izulu emhlabeni, khona ensitha lizama ukuziphakamisa phezu kaNkulunkulu njalo lokuguqula imilayo yakhe. Ngaphansi kokubusa kweRoma, labo ababulawela ukumela ivangeli babebekwa icala lokuba ngabenzi bokubi, babevezwa njengabantu abasebenzelana loSathane, njalo yonke imizamo yenziwa eyokungcolisa amabizo wabo, besenzela ukuba phambi kwabantu bebonakale njengenyamazana ngitsho lesemehlweni abo ngokwabo. Kuzaba njalo lasesikhathini lesi. Nxa uSathane ezama ukubulala labo abahlonipha imilayo kaNkulunkulu, uzabangela ukuba babekwe icala lokuba yizephula mthetho, njengabantu abadelela uNkulunkulu njalo abayimbangela yezijeziso ezizabe zisemhlabeni. {GC 591.1}

UNkulunkulu kabambi ngamandla umzwangedwa wabantu, kodwa uSathane ngazo zonke izikhathi ukwenzela ukuba alawule labo ayehluleka ukuba khohlisa, usebenzisa udlakela. Ngokusebenzisa ukwesaba kumbe ukubamba ngamandla, uyazama ukubusa umzwangedwa njalo lokuzitholela abangamkhonza. Ukwenzela ukuthi akufeze lokhu, usebenzisa abaholi bamabandla njalo lababusi bamazwe, ngokubafuqa ukuba bafake imithetho ephikisana lemilayo kaNkulunkulu. {GC 591.2}

Labo abazahlonipha usuku lweSabatha oluvezwe eBhayibhilini bazabekwa icala lokuba yizitha zokuziphatha njalo lezomthetho wezizwe, njengabantu abaphambanisa ukuziphatha kwabantu emphakathini, njengabantu ababangela ukuba abantu bazenzele umathanda njalo bakhohlakale, njalo bazachazwa njengembangela yezijeziso zikaNkulunkulu ezizabe zisemhlabeni. Ukumela kwabo iqiniso kuzathathwa njengokuqholoza, lokudelela, njalo lokweyisa amandla abaholi. Bazabekwa icala lokungahloniphi uhulumende obusayo. Abafundisi abazabe bephikisana lomlayo kaNkulunkulu bazafundisa phambi kwamabandla ukuba abantu kumele bahloniphe imithetho yelizwe ngendlela okwagcotshwa ngayo nguNkulunkulu. Emthethwandaba njalo lasephalamende, labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu bazavezwa ngendlela engayisiyo njalo babekwe amacala amakhulu. Amazwi abo azavezwa ngendlela engayisilo iqiniso, inhloso zabo zichasiswe ngendlela ezakwenza ukuba babonakale njengezikliwi. {GC 592.1}

Nxa amabandla wonke ahlonipha usuku lwangeSonto eqhubeka ephika amazwi asobala atholakala eBhayibhilini aqinisa umlayo kaNkulunkulu, bazafisa ukuthulisa labo abazabe sebeyehlulekile ukuba nqoba ngeBhayibhili. Loba nje bekhetha ukuvala amehlo wabo mayelana leqiniso leli, bazathatha inyathelo elizabangela ukuhlukunyeza kwalabo abazakwala ukwenza lokho amaKrestu wonke azabe esekwenza ngokwamukela isabatha lokuzibumbela elafakwa ngopapa beRoma. {GC 592.2}

Abaholi bebandla njalo labelizwe bazakubambana ukuthenga, lokufuqela, kumbe ukubamba ngamandla bonke abantu ukuba bahloniphe usuku lwangeSonto. Ukuswela kwabo usekelo oluvela eBhayibhilini, kuzathathelwa indawo yimizamo yabo yokubamba abaphikisayo ngamandla. Inkohlakalo kwezombangazwe isibangele ukuba abantu bangathandi ukulunga njalo leqiniso, njalo ngitsho laselizweni laseAmerica lapho okukhona inkululeko khona, ababusi njalo lamalunga edale lephalamende, ukwenzela ukuba bathandwe ngumphakathi, bazavumela lokho okuzabe kufunwa nguzulu ukuba bafake umthetho ozabamba abantu ngamandla ukuba bahloniphe usuku lwangeSonto. Ukukhuluka komzwangedwa okwabuya ngemva kwentengo yokuzidela okungaka, akusoke kuhlonitshwe futhi. Empikiswaneni enkulu ezayo masinyane sizabona umzwekeliso wamazwi womprofethi athi: “Umgobho wamthukuthelela owesifazane, njalo wahamba ukuba uyekulwa lensali yenzalo yakhe, labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu, njalo labalobufakazi bukaKrestu.” Sambulo 12:17. {GC 592.3}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 37 — IBhayibhili Yilo Isiviko Sethu

“Emthethweni lasebufakazini belizwi, uma bengakhulumi ngokalelilizwi kutsho ukuthi akukho ukukhanya kibo.” (Isaya 8:20). Abantwana beNkosi bakhonjwa eBhayibhilini eliyilo isiviko sabo lapho behlangana lendonsela yabafundisi bamanga kanye lamandla adukisayo abomoya ababi. USathane usebenzisa amaqhinga onke ukwenqabela abantu ukuba babale iBhayibhili ngoba uyazi ukuthi konke ukukhohlisa kwakhe kuvezwe sobala eBhayibhilini. Lapho okulemvuselelo khona eyomsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, uSathane ubalamadlabuzane wokusebenza ngamandla ngoba uselungiselela impi yakhe yakocina lapho azamelana khona loKrestu kanye labalandeli bakhe emhlabeni. Inkohliso yakhe yokucina izabonakala phambi kwethu masinyazana nje. Umphikukrestu uzakwenza izimanga phambi kwethu. Zizakufana xathu lalezo ezenziwa ngamandla kaJesu okokuthi kuzaba nzima ukuzehlukanisa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa iMbhalo eNgcwele. Izibonakaliso lamazwi abo onke kumele ahlolisiswe ngoMbhalo. {GC 593.1}

Bonke labo abazakwenza imizamo yokugcina imthetho kaNkulunkulu bazakuphikiswa njalo bahlekwe ulunya. Bazakuma eqinisweni kuphela ngamandla avela kuNkulunkulu. Ukuze benelise ukuma phakathi kokuvivinywa okuphambi kwabo, kuzadinga ukuthi bazi intando kaNkulunkulu njengoba ivezwe eBhayibhilini, bazaphakamisa ibizo lakhe kuphela nxa beqedisisa isimilo, lombuso kanye lamacebo akhe njalo ngokungaphambuki kiwo. Akukho abanye ngaphandle kuphela kwalabo abagcwalise ingqondo zabo ngelizwi likaNkulunkulu abazakwenelisa ukunqoba empini enkulu ezayo. Emuntwini wonke kuzakuza umhloliso omkhulu oyikuthi, “Ngilandele intando kaNkulunkulu kumbe eyomuntu na?” Ihola leli elibaluleke kangaka selisondele. Umbuzo ofikayo ngothi, “Ngabe inyawo zethu zihlanyelwe elizwini likaNkulunkulu elingaguqukiyo na?” Sikulungele na ukuma ngesibindi sivikele imithetho kaNkulunkulu njalo lokholo lukaJesu? {GC 593.2}

Ngaphambi kokubethelwa kwakhe esiphambanweni uJesu wachazela abafundi bakhe ukuthi wayezabulawa njalo abuye avuke ethuneni njalo lengilosi zazikhona ukuba zigcizelele amazwi akhe engqondweni lasenhliziyweni zabo. Kodwa abafundi bona babekhangelele ukukhululwa ejogweni lombuso wamaRoma, njalo kwabanzima kibo ukwamukela ukuthi lowo owayelithemba labo wayezakufa ukufa okulihlazo kangaka. Amazwi okwakumele bewakhumbule aphuma engqondweni zabo, kwathi lapho kufika isikhathi sokuhlolisiswa kwabo, batholakala bengasilungiselelanga. Ukufa kukaJesu kwatshabalalisa ithemba labo kwaze kwangathi wayengabazisanga ngakho ngaphambilini. Ngokufanayo emazwini esiprofethi konke okuzakwenzakala ensukwini eziphambi kwethu kuvezwe ngokucaca okufana lalokho okwavezelwa abafundi ngamazwi kaKrestu. Zonke izehlakalo eziphathelane lokuvalwa komusa njalo lomsebenzi wokulungiselela isikhathi sokuhlukuluzwa kwamakrestu agcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu esizayo ziveziwe sobala. Kodwa njengasendulo abanengi abaphila ngensuku zokucina abawaqedisisi amaqiniso amqoka kangaka sengathi awazange avezwe. USathane uhlala ekhangelele ukuvimba yonke imizamo ebizabenza ukuthi babelokuhlakanipha okuletha usindiso, njalo isikhathi sokuhlukunyezwa kwamakrestu sizabathola bengasilungelanga. {GC 594.1}

Nxa uNkulunkulu eletha izixwayiso ezibalulekileyo kangaka ezizezaqathaniswa lengilosi ezingcwele ezindiza emkhathini, udinga ukuthi wonke umuntu onikwe ingqondo zokucabanga alalele loludaba oluqakatheke kangaka. Izijeziso ezesabekayo eziqondane lalabo abakhothamela isilo lomfanekiso waso (Sambulo 14:9-11), zifanele ukuthi zithungamele wonke umuntu ukuthi ahlolisise incwadi zesiprofethi ukuze bakwazi ukuthi uphawu lwesilo kuyini, njalo lokuthi bengenza njani ukuze bengalamukeli. Kulusizi ukuthi abantu abanengi abafuni ukuzwa iqiniso ngendaba lezi ezimqoka njalo iqiniso liphendulwa lifane lenganekwane. Nxa umpostoli uPhawuli wayeloba ngensuku zokucina uthi:” Ngoba siyeza isikhathi lapho bengayikuvuma ukufundisa okuqotho, kodwa ngokwenkanuko zabo bazakuzibuthela abafundisi abakhohlisa indlebe zabo.” 2 Timothi 4:3. Yiso lesi isikhathi esphila kiso esichazwa nguPhawuli. Inengi labantu alisafuni ukuzwa iqiniso leBhayibhili ngoba iqiniso liphikisana lenkanuko zenhliziyo zabo zesono ezithanda umhlaba, njalo uSathane ubalethela izilingo abazithandayo. {GC 594.2}

Khepha uNkulunkulu uzabalabo abantu abazaphakamisa iBhayibhili, njalo iBhayibhili kuphela njengomgomo wemfundiso zonke kanye yenguquko zonke emabandleni. Imicabango yezikhwicamfundo, lemfundiso yezesayensi, lemithetho kumbe izinqumo zemihlangano ethile, laloba iminengi njengamabandla abayabe bewamele emihlaganweni leyi, lamazwi alabo ababonakala bebanengi, konke lokhu ngitsho lokukodwa kwakho akumelanga kwamukewe njengobufakazi obusekela kumbe obuphikisa loba yiphi imfundiso ephathelene lezenkolo. Singakamukeli loba yiphi imfundiso, kumele sifune kuqala. ” itsho kanje inkosi ngokucacileyo”. {GC 595.1}

USathane uhlala ezama ukuphambula amehlo abantu ukuba asuke kuNkulunkulu aye emuntwini wenyama. Uhola abantu ukuba bakhangele kumabhishopi, lakubafundisi, lekuzikhwicamfundo kwezenkolo, abenze ukuthi babeyibo ababaholayo kulokuthi bazihlolele iMbhalo ukuze bafumane umlandu wabo otholakala kiwo. Nxa eseyenelisile ukukhokhela ingqondo zabaholi laba uyazi ukuthi kuyabe sekulula ukwenza ukuthi izigidi zabalandeli babo benze intando yakhe. {GC 595.2}

Nxa uJesu wayeze ukukhuluma amazwi okuphila, abantukazana bamuzwa ngentokozo, njalo abanengi ngitsho labapristi njalo lababusi bakholwa kuye. Kodwa abapristi abakhulu njalo lamadoda ayehola isizwe bazimisela ukuphikisa njalo lokulwisa konke ayekufundisa. Loba nje imizamo yabo yonke eyokuthola amaphutha ngaye yeseyehlulekile, kwakungekho okunye ngaphandle kokuthi bananzelele amandla njalo lenhlakanipho yezulu eyayisingatha amazwi wakhe, loba kwakunjalo bazigoqela ngengubo yokusola, baphika ubufakazi obabusobala obokuthi uJesu wayenguMesiya, ngoba bengafuni ukuthi bebanjwe ngamandla ngenxa yobufakazi lobu ukuthi babengabafundi bakhe. Abantu laba ababephikisa uJesu kwakungamadoda esizweni njalo abantu bonke babefundiswe kusukela ebuntwaneni babo ukuthi babahloniphe, njalo okwakumele bakhothame ngaphansi kwamandla wabo. Babelombuzo owodwa othi: “Kwenzeka njani ukuthi abaholi bethu lababhali abaqeqetshileyo, bengamkholwa uJesu na? Kambe amadoda lawa alungileyo ebengeke amamukele yini ngabe ubenguKrestu na?” Kwakungenxa yendonsela yababalisi abanjengabo okwahola isizwe samaJuda ukuba siphike uMsindisi wabo. {GC 595.3}

Umoya ofanayo owadukisa abapristi labaphathi endulo lokhe usaphila phakathi kwabanengi abaphetheyo lalamhlanje. Abafuni ukucubungula ubufakazi boMbhalo mayelana lamaqiniso esikhathi esiphilakuso. Bakhangela inani labo, lenotho yabo kanye lodumo abalalo njalo besebekhangela labo abamela iqiniso bebabone bebalutshwane, bengabayanga, njalo bengabantu abangaladumo emphakathini, futhi abalenkolo ebahlukanisa lomhlaba. {GC 596.1}

UJesu nxa wayekhangela indlela abafarisi lababhali ababezinika ngayo amandla phezu kwabantu bonke wabona ukuthi isenzo lesi sasingasoke siphelele embusweni wamaJuda kuphela. Wabona ngelihlo lesiprofethi umphumela wokuphakanyiswa kwamandla omuntu ukuba abeyiwo alawula umzwangedwa wabantu ebandleni osekube yisiqalekiso kuzizukulwane zonke ebandleni lesiKrestu. Njalo nxa uJesu wayekhuza ngamazwi ayesabekayo ababhali labaFarisi, njalo lamazwi wokuxwayisa abantu ukuba bangalandeli abaholi laba ababeyiziphofu kokwakomoya, abhalwa eBhayibhilini njengesixwayiso kuzizukulwane zonke ezazizalandela. {GC 596.2}

Ibandla leRoma lifundisa ukuthi abaholi yibo abalelungelo lokuchaza lokho okulotshwe eMbalweni. Ngenxa yesizatho sokuthi bafundisa ukuthi abaholi yibo kuphela abenelisa ukuchasisa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantukazana behlale bengalazi. Loba nje umsebenzi weMvuselelo endulo wawulethe iBhayibhili ebantwini bonke, kuyisimanga ukuthi isizatho esifanayo esasisetshenziswa libandla leRoma lokhe sisetshenziswa ukwenqabela izigidi zamalunga atholakala emabandleni akhona lamuhla. Bafundiswa ukuba bamukele lokho okuseBhayibhilini kuphela ngendlela abaholi bebandla labo abalichasisa ngayo, njalo kulenkulungwane ezingafuniyo ukwamukela loba yini, loba ivezwe sobala kangakanani eBhayibhilini, nxa iphikisana leziqondiso kumbe lemfundiso yebandla labo. {GC 596.3}

Loba nje iBhayibhili ligcwele izixwayiso zokulimukisa abantu ngabaprofethi bamanga abazungeze umhlaba kodwa abantu abanengi bazimisele ngale indlela ukubeka impilo zabo ezandleni zabaholi. Lamhlanje kulenkulungwane abantu abazibiza ngokuthi bangamakholwa abangenelisiyo ukunika isizatho sokukholwa kwabo ngaphandle kwalokho abakufunzwa ngabaholi bamabandla abo. Bayeqa lokho okwafundiswa nguJesu sengathi abakuboni, bafake lonke ithemba labo emazwini wabafundisi babo. Kambe abafundisi bona abenzi amaphutha na? Singabeka njani impilo zethu ezandleni zabo ngaphandle nxa sisazi ngokusebenzisa ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ukuthi basekukhanyeni na? Ukuswela isibindi sokuphuma endleleni ebanzi eyomhlaba yikho okubangela abanengi ukuthi balandele emanyathelweni abaholi, njalo ngenxa yokuvilapha kwabo ukuzihlolisisela lokho okufundiswayo, baqhubeka bezibophela eketaneni yemfundiso zamanga. Bayananzelela ukuba amaqiniso esikhathi esiphila kiso avezwe sobala eBhayibhilini, njalo bayananzelela ukuthi uMoya oyiNgcwele yiwo osingatha ukutshunyayelwa kwawo, kodwa loba kunjalo bayavumela ukuba ukuphikisa kwabaholi kubaphambukise ekukhanyeni abekade bengakwamukela. Loba nje ingqondo ndawonye lomzwangedwa sewamukele iqiniso, abantu laba abakhohlisiweyo abaqali ukuvumela ukuthi ingqondo zabo zicabange okunye okwehlukane lamazwi abafundisi babo, njalo ngokwenza njalo amandla wabo wokuzicabangela, lokusindiswa kwabo, kuyalahlwa bamukele ukungakholwa, lokuziphakamisa njalo lokuphika iqiniso kwabanye abantu. {GC 596.4}

Manengi amaqhinga uSathane awasebenzisayo ukukhohlisa abantu esebenzisa indonsela evela kwabanye abantu abaphila labo emhlabeni. Ubuthela amaxuku abantu ngaphansi kombuso wakhe esebenzisa uthando ababalalo kulabo abayizitha zesiphambano sikaKrestu. Akukhathalekile ukuthi uthando lolu lwakhelwe phezu kobuhlobo, lobungane, kumbe ukujwayelana ngenxa yokwazana, umphumela wakhona uyafanana, labo abaphikisa iqiniso basebenzisa amandla wabo awokulawula umzwangedwa, njalo labo abangaphansi kulabo abalaso isibindi loba ukuzibusa okungabangela ukuthi balandele lokho inhliziyo zabo ezikubona kuqondile. {GC 597.1}

Iqiniso njalo lenkazimulo kaNkulunkulu kuhamba ndawonye akuhlukaniseki, akwenzeki ukuthi sithi sileBhayibhili eduze kwethu, simdumise uNkulunkulu ngemicabango ephikisana lentando yakhe. Abanengi bathi akubalulekanga ukuthi umuntu ukholwani kuphela nxa impilo yakhe ilungile. Abangakwaziyo yikuthi impilo ibunjwa yikukholwa. Nxa sisenelisa ukufinyelela ukukhanya, njalo sikhethe ukungawasebenzisi amathuba wokukuzwa njalo lokukubona, kufana lokuthi sikwalile, sikhetha ubunyama endaweni yokukhanya. {GC 597.2}

“Kukhona indlela ebonakala ilungile emuntwini, kodwa isiphetho sayo sizindlela zokufa.” (Izaga 16:25). Ukuthi besingazi asoke kwamukeleke njengesizatho sokona phambi kukaJehova lapho amathuba okwazi intando kaNkulunkulu ebekhona. Nxa umuntu ehamba endleleni abasefika lapho ezehlukana khona njalo kulebhakani elibhalwe indawo zonke indlela lezi eziyakhona. Nxa ekhetha ukungalaleli lokho okulotshwe kilo, njalo athathe indlela yena abona iqondile kuye, sengabe ekhethe ngenhliziyo emsulwa kodwa esikhathini esinengi uzazithola esendleni engayisiyo. {GC 597.3}

UJehova wasinika ilizwi lakhe ukuze sazi imfundiso yakhe kanye lendlela afuna siziphathe ngayo. Nxa igqwetha lalisiza kuJesu lilombuzo othi: “Kudingeka ngenzeni ukuze ngithole ukuphila okunaphakade na?”, uJesu wamphendula ngokumkhomba eMbhalweni oyiNgcwele wathi kuye,” Kulotshweni emthethweni, ufunda njani?” Ukungazi akusoze kusize muntu omdala loba omncinyane, kumbe kubakhulule ekujezisweni okuzanikwa bonke abephula imilayo kaNkulunkulu; ngoba ezandleni zabo kulogwalo lapho imilayo leyi evezwe khona sobala. Akwanelanga ukuba lokunxwanela okuhle, akwanelanga ukuthi umuntu enze lokho acabanga ukuthi kuqondile, kumbe umfundisi wakhe athi kuqondile. Ukusindiswa kwakhe kulenga emoyeni, ngakho kufanele azifundele iBhayibhili ngokwakhe. Loba engabe ekholwa kangakanani ukuthi usendleleni eqondileyo, laloba engabe ethembele kangakanani ukuthi umfundisi wakhe uyakwazi ukuthi kuyini okuliqiniso, lokhu akumelanga kube yikho ayakhele phezu kwakho. Ulombhalo oyiwo oveza ngokucaca lapho indlela eyezulwini ehamba khona, akudingeki ukuthi acabangele lapho okumele ahambe khona. {GC 598.1}

Kumele kube ngumlandu wakuqala njalo omkhulu kulayo yonke emuntwini wonke ocabangayo owokufunda eBhayibhilini ukuba liyini iqiniso, lokulandela ngemva kwalokho ekukhanyeni njalo lokukhuthaza abanye ukuba balandele umzekeliso wakhe. Kumele sibale iBhayibhili ngokuzimisela nsuku zonke, sihluze yonke imicabango njalo siqathanise amavesi ngamanye amavesi aseBhayibhilini. Ngokuphathiswa yiNkosi kumele sizibumbele ukuzwisisa kwethu sisodwa njengoba kuzamele siziphendulele phambi kaNkulunkulu. {GC 598.2}

Amaqiniso avezwe sobala eBhayibhilini asenziwe ukuthi athandabuzwe njalo abesemnyameni ngamadoda aqeqetshileyo kwezemfundo, abathi ngokuzenza bona abakhaliphileyo, bafundisa ukuthi amazwi eBhayibhili alengcazelo engazwisisekiyo, efihlakeleyo njalo engekho sobala nxa kusetshenziswa amazwi alotshiweyo. Amadoda lawa angababalisi bamanga abalenjongo yokudukisa. Yibo uJesu ayekhuluma ngabo nxa wayesithi, “Aliwazi uMbhalo kanye lamandla kaNkulunkulu”. (Marko 12:24) Ulimi lweBhayibhili kumele luchasiswe ngendlela okulotshwe ngayo ngaphandle nxa kusobala ukuthi yisiprofethi kumbe ngumfanekiso. UKrestu wanika isithembiso, “Nxa kukhona umuntu owenza intando yakhe, uzakulazi iqiniso.’ (Johane 7:17). Nxa abantu bebezamukela amazwi eBhayibhili ngendlela alotshwe ngayo, ngabe abafundisi bamanga bebengekho ukuba bakhohlise abantu, bekungenziwa umsebenzi obuzathokozisa ingilosi, njalo obuzaletha esibayeni sikaKrestu inkulungwane lenkulungwane zabantu khathesi abazula phakathi kwemfundiso zamanga. {GC 598.3}

Kumele sisebenzise onke amandla engqondo zethu ukubala iBhayibhili njalo sifune ukuqedisisa konke ngokwenyama esenelisa ukukuthola ngamaqiniso kaNkulunkulu, kodwa loba kunjalo kumele singakhohlwa ukuthi ukuzehlisa okufana lokomntwana omncane yiwo umoya weqiniso okumele utholakale kulabo abangabafundi. Ubunzima obutholakala ekufundeni iBhayibhili akwenzeki ukuthi buxazululelwe kusetshenziswa amaqhinga wokuxazulula ubunzima obutholakala ezifundweni zasemhlabeni. Akumelanga singene ekubalweni kweBhayibhili ngokuzithemba okufanana lalokho abafunda ezesayensi abakwenzayo, kodwa ngomthandazo othembele kuphela emandleni kaNkulunkulu njalo lesifiso sokuqedisisa intando yakhe. Kumele size ngomoya wokuzehlisa njalo ofundisekayo ukuze sithole ulwazi oluvela kuSimakade. Nxa singakwenzanga lokho ingilosi zikaSathane zizafiphalisa ingqondo zethu njalo ziyenze ukuthi inhliziyo zethu zibelukhuni okuzabangela ukuthi iqiniso lingabi lamandla enhliziyweni zethu. {GC 599.1}

Imigca eminengi yeBhayibhili abantu abafundileyo ngokwemhlabeni abayibiza ngokuthi ayizwisiseki kumbe abayeqayo ngoba besithi ayibalulekanga, igcwele amazwi wenduduzo lawokuqondisa kulowo oseke wafundiswa esikolweni sikaKrestu. Isizatho esisodwa esibangela ukuthi izifundiswa zeBhayibhili zingazwisisi ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, yikuthi bayavala amehlo abo lapho behlangana lamaqiniso abangafuni ukuwaphila. Ukuqedisisa iBhayibhili akweyamanga kangako ekukhalipheni kwengqondo kodwa enhlosweni eqotho njalo lasekulangazeleleni ukulunga kwezulu. {GC 599.2}

IBhayibhili akumelanga libalwe kungakhulekwanga kuqala. UMoya oyiNgcwele kuphela nguye osenza ukuthi siqedisise ukuqakatheka kwezinto lezo ezilula ukuzizwisisa, kumbe osivikelayo ukuba singayenzi amaphutha ekuzwisisni imigca yalo enzima ukuzwisiseka. Kungumsebenzi wengilosi zezulu owokulungiselela inhliziyo ukuba iqedisise ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ukuze sithathekiswe yibuhle balo, sinqandwe yizixwayiso zalo, kumbe siqiniswe yizithembiso zalo. Kumele senze ukuthi isicelo sikaDavida sibe ngesethu: ‘’Vula amehlo ami ukuba ngibone izimangliso ezivela emlayweni wakho.” (Amahubo 119:18). Izilingo ezikhathini ezinengi zibonakala sengathi azinqobeki ngoba ngenxa yokungathandazi njalo lokungabali iBhayibhili, lowo olingwayo kayenelisi ukukhumbula izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu njalo amelane loSathane esebenzisa izikhali zoMbhalo. Kodwa ingilosi zihlala zizungeze labo balesifiso sokufundiswa ngezinto zezulu, njalo ngezikhathi zendingeko enkulu zizakwenza ukuthi bakhumbule amaqiniso ayabe edingeka ngaleso isikhathi. Ngakho ke “lapho isitha sizakuza njengomfula okhukhulayo, uMoya kaNkulunkulu uzaphakama ulethe ukunqoba.” (Isaya 59:19). {GC 599.3}

UJesu wathembisa abafundi wathi,” Kodwa uMsizi, uMoya oyiNgcwele, azakumthumela uBaba ebizweni lami, yena uzakulifundisa zonke izinto, alikhumbuze konke engakutshoyo kini.” (Johane 14:26). Kodwa lokho uJesu akufundisayo kumele kuqale kungene njalo kugcinwe engqondweni ukwenzela ukuthi uMoya kaNkulunkulu asikhumbuze ngezikhathi zenhlupheko. UDavida uthi nxa ebhala kumahubo, “Ilizwi lakho ngilifihlile enhliziyweni yami ukuze ngingoni phambi kwakho.” Amahubo 119:11. {GC 600.1}

Labo abaqakathekisa impilo ephakade kumele behlale beqaphele ukuze indonsela yokuthandabuza ingangeni enhliziyweni zabo. Insika zeqiniso ngokwazo zizakuqutshulwa. Kunzima khathesi ukuthi umuntu aphile engazange agudlane lemfundiso ezingalunganga ensukwini zalamuhla. USathane uletha izilingo ezidalelwe ukudukisa bonke abantu ngezigaba zempilo abakuzo. Ulinga abangafundanga ngokuthi badelele njalo baphike iqiniso, kuthi labo abafundileyo ubalinga ngokusebenzisa izizatho zesayensi lemfundo yasemhlabeni, elenhloso yokwenza ukuthi abantu bangathembi lokho okuseBhayibhilini. Ngitsho labantu abatsha bayathatheka ukuba balethe izizatho zokuthandabuza mayelana lemfundiso ezimqoka ezibumba inkolo yesiKrestu. Njalo lokuhlamuka lokhu okulethwa ngabantu abatsha loba kungajulanga kangako lakho kulendonsela ebantwini. Abanengi bacina beholwa ukuthi bayenze inkolo yabokhokho babo inhlekisa. (Amaheberu 10:29). Impilo zabantu abanengi ezazithembisa ukuba zazizaletha udumo kuNkulunkulu njalo zibeyisibusiso emhlabeni sezangcoliswa ngumoya omubi ophuma ekuhlamukeleni iqiniso. Bonke abakholwa izinqumo zokuzikhukhumeza ezidabuka emicabangweni yabantu njalo abanakana ukuthi bengachasisa imfihlo zezulu njalo bafinyelele eqinisweni bengaholelwanga yinhlakanipho evela kuNkuunkulu baphakathi komjibila kaSathane. {GC 600.2}

Siphila esikhathini esicolekileyo kakhulu okwedlula zonke embalini yalumhlaba. Isiphetho sezigidi zabantu emhlabeni sesizabekwa. Ukuphila kwethu kwelizayo njalo lokusindiswa kwabanye kweyame phezu kwendlela esihamba ngayo khathesi. Kumele sihlale siholelwa nguMoya weqiniso. Wonke umlandeli kaKrestu kumele abuze umbuzo othi: “Nkosi uthanda ukuthi ngikwenzeleni?” Kumele sizehlise phambi kweNkosi, ngemithandazo njalo lokuzila ukudla njalo sihlale sicabangisisa ngelizwi lakhe, ikakhulu ngezahluko eziphathelene lodaba lokwahlulelwa. Kumele khathesi sidinge ukuba lenkambo ejulileyo njalo ephilayo ezintweni zikaNkulunkulu. Akumelanga sidlalise ngitsho lomzuzu owodwa. Izehlakalo ezimqoka ziyenzakala emehlweni wethu, siphila ngaphansi kwamandla kaSathane. Lingalali balindi bakaNkulunkulu, isitha sihambela eduzane, silindele ithuba lokuhlasela lapho seliyekethesa njalo selijumeka. {GC 601.1}

Abanengi bayazikhohlisa ngoba benakana ukuthi bami kahle phambi kaNkulunkulu. Bayazincoma ngoba kukhona izono abangazenziyo, bakhohlwe izenzo ezinhle abangazenziyo uNkulunkulu akhangelele ukuba bazenze kodwa abangazenzanga. Akuphelelanga ukuthi bayizihlahla esivandeni sikaNkulunkulu. Kumele bagwalise ukukhangelela kwakhe ngokuba bathele izithelo. Ubabeka icala lokwehluleka ukwenza konke okuhle obekumele bekwenze, beqiniswa ngumusa wakhe. Encwadini zezulu babhalwe njengezihlahla ezidlalisa umhlabathi. Loba kunjalo abantu abafana lalaba labo akumelanga balahle imbeleko. Labo abatshaphaze isihawu njalo lomusa kaNkulunkulu, amazwi okuncenga lokhe ebancenga. “Ngakho uthi: “Phaphama wena oleleyo, uvuke kwabafileyo njalo uKrestu uzakukukhanyisela. Ngakho qaphelani ukuthi lihamba njani ngonanzelelo, kungabi njengezithutha, kodwa njengabahlakaniphileyo, lihlenga isikhathi ngoba insuku zimbi.” Kwabase-Efesu 5:14-16. {GC 601.2}

Nxa isikhathi sokuhlolwa sesifikile kuzaba sobala ukuthi ngobani abenze ilizwi likaJehova laba yinsika yempilo zabo. Ngesikhathi sehlobo kunzima ukwehlukanisa phakathi kwezihlahla ezihlala zilamahlamvu ngoba zonke ziluhlaza kodwa ebusika nxa umoya lomqando ufika lezo ezihlala ziluhlaza zisala zifanana, nxa ezinye izihlahla zithintitheka amahlamvu azo. Ngokunjalo labo abazibiza ngokuthi bayakholwa kodwa kungaveli enhliziyweni eguquliweyo khathesi sekungabanzima ukuthi behlukaniswe lamaKrestu aqotho, kodwa isikhathi sesisondele lapho umehluko ozaba sobala khona. Akubekhona ukuphikiswa, kubekhona njalo ukubandlulula, kuqalwe futhi ukuhlukunyezwa, bonke abangabazenzinsi labangakholwayo ngokweqiniso bazahlehlela emuva baphike ukholo lwabo, kodwa amaKrestu eqiniso azakuma eqinile njengedwala, lethemba lakhe lizakhazimula ngamandla, okwedlula ngezikhathi zokuthula. {GC 602.1}

Nxa uDavida eloba uthi,” Ilizwi lakho liyingoma yami yansuku zonke. Ngayo imithetho yakho ngizuza ukuqedisisa, ngakho ngiyazizonda indlela zamanga. Amahubo 119:99,104. {GC 602.2}

“Ubusisiwe umuntu ofumana ukuhlakanipha lozuza ukuqedisisa” Izaga 3:13. “Unjengesihlahla esihlanyelwe ngasemanzini esinabisela impande zaso ngasemfuleni, esingesabi lapho kufika ukutshisa, lamahlamvu aso ahlala eluhlaza, kasethuki loba kufika indlala ngoba asiyekeli ukuthela izithelo.” Jeremiya 17:8. {GC 602.3}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 38 — Isixwayiso Sokucina

“Emva kwalezizinto, ngabona enye ingilosi isehla ivela ezulwini, ilamandla amakhulu; lomhlaba wakhanyiswa yikukhazimula kwayo. Yasimemeza ngamandla, ngelizwi elikhulu isithi: liwile liwile iBhabhiloni elikhulu, seliyindawo yokuhlala amadimoni, lentolongo yawo wonke umoya ongcolileyo, lezongo layo yonke inyoni engcolileyo lezondekayo.” “Ngasengisizwa elinye ilizwi livela ezulwini, lisithi: Phumani kulo, bantu bami, ukuze lingahlanganyeli kanye lezono zawo, lokuze lingemukeli okwezinhlupho zayo.” Sambulo 18:1, 2, 4. {GC 603.1}

Amavesi lawa akhomba phambili esikhathini lapho umbiko wokuwa kweBhabhiloni, ovezwe yingilosi yesibili kuSambulo 14:8, ozaphindwa khona ngokwesibili, sekwengezwe inkohlakalo ezithile esezingene kunhlanganiso ezinengi ezibumba iBhabhiloni, kusukela emnyakeni ka1844 lapho udaba lolu olwatshunyayelwa khona ngokwakuqala. Lapha kuvezwe isimo esibi kakhulu esizakuba khona emhlabeni kwezenkolo. Ngakho konke ukuphika iqiniso abantu abakwenzayo, ingqondo zabo zizabe zilokhe zisiba semnyameni, lenhliziyo zabo zizabe zilokhe zisiba lukhuni ngamandla, kuzekufike lapho abazabe sebefike ebangeni lokuba ngabahedeni abangasaguqulekiyo. Ngokwala kwabo izixwayiso uNkulunkulu azinikileyo, bazaqhubeka besephula omunye wemithetho elitshumi, bezebefike ezingeni lokuthi bahlukumeze labo abagcina umthetho lowu ngcwele. UKrestu uyaphikwa ngabantu abaphikisa ilizwi lakhe njalo labantu bakhe. Nxa imfundiso zemimoya zisamukelwa emabandleni, amandla alwisana lenhliziyo ethanda isono ayasuswa, njalo ukuzibiza amakrestu kuzaphenduka kube yingubo nje eyokuvala ububi obesabekayo. Ukukholwa imimoya kuvulela imimoya emibi njalo lemfundiso zikaSathane umnyango wokungena, ngenxa yalokho indonsela yengilosi ezimbi izabonakala emabandleni amanengi. {GC 603.2}

Nxa kukhulunywa ngeBhabhiloni ngesikhathi esivezwe emazwini esiprofethi lesi kuthiwa: “Ngoba izono zayo sezifinyelele ezulwini, loNkulunkulu ukhumbule ukungalungi kwayo.” Sambulo 18:5. Seligcwalise isilinganiso samacala alo, njalo ukubhujiswa sekuseduzane ukuthi kulehlele iBhabiloni. Kodwa uNkulunkulu lokhe elabantwana bakhe eBhabiloni, njalo lingakaze lamukele izijeziso zalo laba abathembekileyo kumele babizwe baphume kilo, ukwenzela ukuthi bengabi lesabelo ezonweni zalo njalo bangamukeli inhlupho eilungiselwe lona. Yikho kulequla labantu elifanekiswe lengilosi eyehla ivela ezulwini, ekhanyisa umhlaba wonke ngenkazimulo yayo njalo ememeza ngelizwi elikhulu lokuchaza izono zeBhabhiloni. Ndawonye lodaba lolu kuzwakala amazwi athi: “Phumani kilo bantu bami.” Izimemezelo lezi, nxa zibambana lodaba lwengilosi yesithathu, zibumba amazwi ayisixwayiso sokucina azanikwa bonke abakhileyo emhlabeni. {GC 604.1}

Siyesabeka isimo umhlaba ozazithola usukiso. Amandla asemhlabeni nxa ebambana ukuba alwisane lemithetho kaNkulunkulu, azabeka umthetho othi “bonke abancane labakhulu labanothileyo, njalo labayanga, labakhululekileyo lezigqili” (Sambulo 13:16), kuzamele balandele imithetho yebandla ngokugcina ngcwele usuku lwamanga njengosuku lwesabatha. Bonke abazakwala ukukwenza lokhu bazajeziswa ngokuthathelwa amalungelo abo, njalo ekucineni kuzabekwa umthetho wokuthi bafanele ukubulawa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umlayo kaNkulunkulu ophathelene lokuphumula koMdali udinga ukuthi abantu bawuhloniphe njalo uthembisa ulaka phezu kwabo bonke abawephulayo. {GC 604.2}

Nxa indaba leyi isivewe ngokucaca okunje phambi komuntu wonke, wonke umuntu ozakhetha ukwephula umthetho kaNkulunkulu ukwenzela ukuthi alandele umthetho womuntu uzakwamukela uphawu lwesilo, wamukela uphawu lokukhothamela amandla akhethe ukuwahlonipha endaweni kaNkulunkulu. Isixwayiso esivela ezulwini sithi: “Uba kukhona okhonza isilo lomfanekiso waso, njalo wemukela uphawu ebunzini lakhe, kumbe esandleni sakhe, laye uzanatha okwewayini lolaka lukaNkulunkulu, elithululelwe enkezweni yolaka lwakhe lingaxutshaniswanga.” Sambulo 14:9,10. {GC 604.3}

Kodwa kakho ngitsho loyedwa ozakwamukela ulaka lukaNkulunkulu engakamukeli iqiniso elithinta ingqondo njalo lomzwangedwa wakhe, njalo yena waliphika. Banengi kakhulu abangakatholi amathuba okuzwa amaqiniso aphathelene lensuku zalamuhla. Umlandu ophathelene lomthetho wesine awukaze uchazwe ngendlela efaneleyo kibo. Yena ofunda ingqondo zabantu bonke njalo lohlola inhloso yenhliziyo zabantu kasoke atshiye ngitsho loyedwa umuntu olesifiso sokuqedisisa iqiniso, ukuba akhohliswe mayelana lezinto ezibumba impikiswano enkulu phakathi kobuhle lobubi emhlabeni. Umthetho lowu awusoke ufikele abantu besemnyameni ngokuyabe kusenzakala. Wonke umuntu uzakwamukela ukukhanya okwaneleyo ukuba ayenze isinqumo afisa ukusenza. {GC 605.1}

Umthetho weSabatha yiwo ozaba ngumhloliso omkhulu ozabonisa ukuthi abantu bakhonza bani ngokweqiniso, ngoba umele iqiniso eliphikiswa kakhulu emhlabeni. Nxa umhloliso wokucina usulethwe phezu kwabantu, yikho lapho okuzakubalomehluko khona phakathi kwabantu abakhonza uNkulunkulu lalabo abangamkhonziyo. Ngesikhathi lapho ukulandela umthetho wokugcina ngcwele isabatha lamanga kuzabe kuyikuhlonipha umthetho welizwe, wona ozabe uphikisana lomthetho wesine, ukwenza lokhu kuzabe kusitsho ukukhothamela amandla aphikisana loNkulunkulu, ngakolunye uhlangothi ukugcina usuku lweSabatha lweqiniso, okuzabe kutshengisa ukuhlonipha umthetho kaNkulunkulu, kuzabe kuyibufakazi bokukhothamela uMdali. Nxa olunye uhlangothi ngokuvumela ukukhothamela amandla asemhlabeni, luzakwamukela uphawu lwesilo, olunye uhlangothi ngenxa yokukhetha ukulandela amandla ezulu lizakwamukela uphawu lukaNkulunkulu. {GC 605.2}

Kungakafiki isikhathi lesi bonke abantu ababekade betshumayela amaqiniso odaba lwengilosi yesithathu, bebethathwa njengabantu abalenjongo yokwethusela abantu kuphela. Amazwi abo awokuthi siyeza isikhathi lapho okuzakhula khona umkhuba wokuncindezela amalungelo abantu elizweni laseMelika, lokuthi ibandla ndawonye lombuso kuzabambana emsebenzini wokuhlukumeza labo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu, athathwa njengamazwi wamanga njalo angelasisindo. Kuhlala kukhulunywa ngegunya ukuthi ilizwe leli ngeke laba ngesinye isimo ngaphandle kwalokho ebeliyikho, okuyikuvikela inkululeko kwezokukholwa. Kodwa nxa umbuzo wokubeka umthetho wokuthi kukhonzwe ngosuku lwangeSonto ulokhe uphathwa emlonyeni yabantu, isehlakalo esithandabuzwe ngabanengi okwebanga elide sesibonakala sisondela, njalo udaba lwengilosi yesithathu luzaletha umphumela obelukade lungeke lawuletha ngaphambilini. { GC 605.3}

Kuzizukwalane zonke uNkulunkulu uthumele inceku zakhe ukuba zikhuze isono, emhlabeni kanye lasebandleni. Kodwa abantu bathanda ukuzwa indaba ezibuthakathaka njalo iqiniso elingaxutshaniswanga abafuni ukulamukela. Abavuseleli abanengi nxa babesungula imisebenzi yabo, bazimisela ukusebenzisa ukunanzelela okukhulu nxa babeveza izono zebandla kanye lezelizwe. Babelethemba lokuthi ngenxa yomzekeliso wokuphila impilo emsulwa yesiKrestu, babezaholela abantu ukuba babuyele emfundisweni zeBhayibhili. Kodwa uMoya kaNkulunkulu wangena kibo ngendlela owangena kuyo kuElija, nxa wawuholela ukuba akhuze izono zenkosi njalo labantu ababephila esonweni, labo abazange benelise ukwekela ukutshumayela amaqiniso eBhayibhili ababeqale bevilapha ukuwaveza phambi kwabantu. Bazithola sebeveza ngokuzimisela amaqiniso ndawonye lengozi eyayizakwehlela labo ababephila esonweni. Bakhuluma wonke amazwi iNkosi eyayibanike wona, bengelakho ukwesaba umphumela wokuwatsho, njalo abantu baphoqelwa ukuba bezwe izixwayiso lezi. {GC 606.1}

Udaba lwengilosi yesithathu luzakutshunyayelwa ngale indlela. Nxa isikhathi sesifikile esokuthi lutshunyayelwe ngamandla amakhulu, uNkulunkulu uzasebenza ngezitsha ezilokuzehlisa, ehola ingqondo zalabo abazinikele emsebenzini wakhe. Izisebenzi lezi zizabe zihlonyiswe nguMoya wakhe hatshi ngokufunda kwezikolo zasemhlabeni. Amadoda okukholwa njalo lomthandazo azaholelwa ukuthi ahambe elomfutho wezulu, betshumayela amazwi uNkulunkulu azabanika wona. Izono zeBhabhiloni zizavezwa egcekeni. Umphumela owesabakayo owokubeka umthetho wokulawula indlela ibandla okuzamele likhonze ngayo ngababusi belizwe, lokhula kwenkolo yemimoya, njalo lokukhula ngasese kwamandla kapapa, konke kuzavezwa sobala. Ngenxa yezixwayiso lezi ezizatshunyayelwa abantu abanengi bazavuswa ekulaleni kwabo. Inkulungwane phezu kwenkulungwane zizakulalela ezingakaze zizwe amazwi afana lalawa. Ngokumangala bazakuzwa ukuthi iBhabhiloni limele ibandla eliwileyo ngenxa yamaphutha njalo lezono zalo, ngenxa yokuphika kwalo iqiniso elithunyelwe kilo livela ezulwini. Nxa abantu begijimela kubafundisi babo bebuza, ukuba ngabe lezi izinto ziliqiniso na? Abafundisi babo bazakubanika amazwi ayinganekwane nje, bazabanika amazwi abuthakathaka ukwenzela ukuthi ukwesaba kwabo kumbambathwe njalo lomzwangedwa ulaliswe. Kodwa ngenxa yokuba abanengi bazakwala ukwamukela amazwi aphuma engqondweni zabo, bazadinga ukuthi baphendule ngamazwi avela eBhayibhilini, abafundisi laba, njengabafarisi endulo, sebegcwele intukuthelo ngenxa yokuphikiswa kwamandla wabo, bazathuka udaba lolu belwenze amazwi avela kuSathane ngokwakhe, njalo benze ukuba bonke abathanda impilo yesono bahlukumeze njalo babulale labo abatshumayela iqiniso. {GC606.2}

Nxa impi leyi ilokhe ikhula isiya kwezinye indawo, njalo lemicabango yabantu isondezwa eqinisweni elimayelana lokwephulwa komthetho kaNkulunkulu, uSathane uzathukuthela kakhulu. Amandla azabe ehola ukutshunyayelwa kodaba lolu azathukuthelisa labo abaluphikisayo. Abaholi bamabandla bazakwenza konke okusemandleni wabo ukuvimba ukukhanya lokhu, hlezi kukhanyisele amalunga amabandla wabo. Bazasebenzisa wonke amaqhinga abawenelisayo ukuvimba ngitsho lengxoxo eziphathelene lodaba lolu. Ibandla lizacela usekelo kwabazombusazwe, njalo emsebenzini lowu upapa ndawonye lamabandla esiKrestu bazabambana. Nxa amazwi aphathelene lokubekwa komthetho wokuthi kukhonzwe ngosuku lwangeSonto elokhe ekhula, kuzabekwa umthetho ozancindezela bonke abagcina imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Bazakwethuselwa ngokubotshwa njalo lokuhlawuliswa, abanye bazathenjiswa izikhundla eziphezulu, njalo abanye izipho kuyimizamo yokuba baphike ukholo lwabo. Kodwa impendulo yabo engaguqukiyo izaba ngethi: “sitshengiseni elizwini likaNkulunkulu amaphutha ethu”, khona okuyisicelo esifana laleso esalethwa nguLuther nxa wayedlula ngaphansi kwesehlakalo esifananayo. Labo abazadonselwa emthethwandaba bazaphakamisa iqiniso, njalo kuzabangela ukuthi labo ababalaleleyo labo baphenduke baqale ukulandela imithetho kaNkulunkulu. Ngale indlela iqiniso lizalethwa phambi kwezinkulungwane zabantu ebezingeke zilizwe kungenzekanga ngale indlela. {GC 607.1}

Ukulandela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu ngenxa yokukholwa ukuthi liqinisekile kuzathathwa njengokuhlamuka. Ngenxa yokufiphaliswa nguSathane, umzali uzahlukumeza umntwana okholwayo, umqhatshi uzahlukumeza isisebenzi esigcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Uthando luzatshabalala, abantwana bazaxotshwa emakhaya. Amazwi kaPhawuli azagcwaliseka njengoba enjalo: “Bonke abazaphila impilo yokulunga kuKrestu Jesu bazadlula phakathi kukuhlukunyezwa.” 2 Timothi 3:12. Nxa labo abamela iqiniso bezakwala ukulandela isabatha elizabe seliguqulelwe osukwini lwangeSonto, abanye babo bazajikelwa entolongweni, abanye bazakuba yiziphepheli, njalo abanye bazakwenziwa izigqili. Phambi kwenhlakanipho yabantu khathesi konke lokhu kubonakala njengento engeke yenzakala, kodwa nxa uMoya kaNkulunkulu oyiwo ovimba ububi usususiwe ebantwini, njalo sebengaphansi kwamandla kaSathane, yena ozonda konke ukulunga, kuzabonakala izinto ezingajwayelekanga. Inhliziyo yomuntu ilakho ukuba lochuku nxa ukwesaba uNkulunkulu njalo lokumthanda sekususiwe. {GC 608.1}

Nxa isiphepho sisondela, inengi labantu abekade besithi bayakholwa udaba lwengilosi yesithathu, kodwa abangazange baguqulwa izimilo zabo ngenxa yokulandela iqiniso, bazakutshiya inkolo yeqiniso balandele isitha. Ngenxa yokubambana lomhlaba njalo lokwamukela umoya wawo lokhu sekubenze ukuba babone izinto ngelihlo elifanana lelomhlaba, njalo nxa umhloliso usufika, sebezilungiselele ukukhetha lokhu okulula njalo okwamukelwa ngumuntu wonke. Amadoda alezipho njalo atshumayela kuzwakale, abake bathokoza eqinisweni, bazasebenzisa izipho njalo lamandla wabo ukudukisa abantu abanengi. Bazaphenduka babeyizitha ezinkulu belwise labo abake bakhonza labo ngesikhathi belandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Nxa labo abagcina usuku lweSabatha belethwa phambi kwemithethwandaba ukuze bazomela ukholo lwabo, labo asebehlamukile yibo uSathane azabasebenzisa kakhulu ukulwisa njalo lokubabeka icala, bazasebenzisa amanga ukudonsela ababusi ukuba babajikele. {GC 608.2}

Ngesikhathi lesi esokuhlukunyezwa ukholo lwenceku zikaNkulunkulu luzavivinywa kakhulu. Bazabe sebetshumayelile amazwi wokuxwayisa izizwe zonke ngokwethembeka, njalo bazakhangela kuNkulunkulu laselizwini lakhe kuphela. Ngalesi isikhathi ukugcwala kukaMoya oyiNgcwele enhliziyweni zabo yikho okuyabe kubafuqe ukuba bakhulume. Ngenxa yokufuqwa ngamandla ezulu, njalo lokuzimisela okukhulu, bayabe bengene emsebenzini lowu bengazange baqala bafuna ukwazi umphumela wokutshumayela ebantwini amazwi uNkulunkulu abanike wona. Abazange baqala bafuna ukwazi ukuthi lokhu bekuzaphambanisa njalo inzuzo zabo kumbe bazame ukuvikela amabizo njalo lempilo zabo. Loba kunjalo nxa isiphepho sokuphikiswa sesifika, abanye ngenxa yokudideka engqondweni bazaphumisela amazwi athi: “Ngabe besibonile umphumela wamazwi wethu, besizazithulela.” Bazabe sebegonjolozelwe yibunzima. USathane uzabahlasela ngezilingo ezesabekayo. Umsebenzi abayabe sebewuqalile uzabonakala sengathi awukho emandleni wabo ukuba bawuphelelise. Ngalesi isikhathi kuzabonakala sengathi isabelo sabo sizabe sesiyikutshabaliliswa emhlabeni. Amadlabuzane abekade belawo azabe engasekho, kodwa loba kunjalo ngeke besabuyela emuva. Ngenxa yokunanzelela ubuthakathaka babo, bazabalekela kuBaba ukuba bayethola amandla. Bazakhumbula ukuba amazwi abawakhulumileyo ayisiwo wabo, kodwa ngawakhe yena obathume ukuba bawakhulume. UNkulunkulu nguye ofake iqiniso enhliziyweni zabo, njalo bebengeke bale ukulitshumayela. {GC 608.3}

Ubunzima obufananayo sebuke babonwa ngamadoda ayemele uNkulunkulu endulo. UWycliffe, loHuss, loLuther, loTyndale, loBaxter, loWesley, labo bafundisa ukuba zonke imfundiso kumele zihlolwe ngeBhayibhili njalo bakhuma ukuthi babezaphikisa konke elalingakuvumi. Lakuwo amadoda lawa ukuhlukunyezwa kweza ngolaka olukhulu, kodwa loba kwakunjalo abazange bame ukutshumayela iqiniso. Izigaba ezehlukeneyo embalini yebandla bezilamaqiniso athile esigaba sinye ngasinye, abekade elungiselwe abantu bakaNkulunkulu ngasenaleso isikhathi. Wonke amaqiniso amatsha ahlangane lenzondo kanye lokuphikiswa, njalo labo ababusiswa yikukhanya kwawo bahlangana lezilingo njalo lokuvivinywa. INkosi inika iqiniso elibalulekileyo abantu abaphakathi kwesimo esiphuthumayo. Ngubani olesibindi sokwala ukulihambisa na? Uthumele inceku zakhe ukuba zihambise ubizo lokucina lomusa njalo lesihawu sakhe kwabakhileyo emhlabeni. Ngeke bathule, ngaphandle nxa befuna ukulahlekelwa yimphefumulo yabo. Abameli bakaKrestu abalani lomphumela wokutshumayela kwabo. Kufanele benze umsebenzi wabo batshiye umphumela ezandleni zikaNkulunkulu. {GC 609.1}

Nxa ukuhlukunyezwa kuqhubeka kukhula kusiya ezingeni eliphezulu, inceku zikaNkulunkulu zizadideka ingqondo futhi, ngoba kuzabonakala kibo sengathi yibo abazilethele uhlupho lolu. Kodwa umzwangedwa njalo lelizwi likaNkulunkulu lizabanika isiqiniselo sokuthi basendleleni eqondileyo, njalo loba ukuvivinywa kwabo kuqhubeka, bazakuqiniswa ukwenzela ukuthi bamelane lakho. Nxa impi leyi ilokhe iqhubeka ikhula isibindi sabo laso sizakhula kakhulu simelane layo. Amazwi wabo azakuba ngathi: “Asingeke sizame ukuguqula ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, sidabule phakathi umthetho wakhe ongcwele, ngeke siqakathekise eyinye ingxenye sehlise eyinye, ngoba sifuna ukwamukelwa ngumhlaba. INkosi esiyikhonzayo ilamandla wokusikhulula. UKrestu wanqoba kudala amandla akulo umhlaba, njalo singesaba njani umhlaba osunqotshiwe na?” {GC 610.1}

Ukuhlukunyezwa ngezigaba zakho ezehlukeneyo kuyisenzo esizaqhubeka sikhona nxa uSathane esaphila njalo lanxa inkolo yesiKrestu ilokhe ilamandla. Akulamuntu ongakhonza uNkulunkulu ayekele ukuhlangana lempikiswano evela kuSathane lengilosi zakhe. Ingilosi zikaSathane zizamhlasela, ngoba sezisethuswa yikuthi uzabathathela labo abayizigqili zabo. Abantu abathanda ububi bazahlanganyela lengilosi ezimbi emsebenzini wokuzama ukumehlukanisa loNkulunkulu ngokusebenzisa izilingo ezihugayo. Nxa izilingo lezi zisehluleka ukuphumelela, bayaqala ukusebenzisa udlame ukwenzela ukuthi babambe ngamandla umzwangedwa wakhe. {GC 610.2}

Kodwa nxa uKrestu elokhe eqhubeka ngomsebenzi wakhe wokuncengela abantu ethempelini lasezulwini, indonsela kaMoya oNgcwele eyokubamba imimoya emibi iyabonakala emehlweni wababusi kanye labantu. Indonsela leyi lokhe isahola eminye imithetho efakwa emazweni atshiyeneyo. Ngabe imithetho leyi ibingekho, isimo esisemhlabeni besizabe sesisibi okwedlula esiyikho khona khathesi. Loba nje ababusi bethu abanengi bezinceku ezisebenzela umbuso kaSathane, uNkulunkulu laye ulabantu bakhe abamsebenzelayo abalezikhundla eziphezulu emazweni ahlukeneyo. Isitha siyafunqa inceku zaso ukuthi zithathe amanyathelo athile alakho ukuphambanisa ukuhamba komsebenzi kaNkulunkulu, kodwa ababusi abathile abayesabayo iNkosi bayaholelwa zingilosi zezulu ukumisa amacebo lawa besebenzisa amazwi angaphikisekiyo. Ngale indlela amadoda amalutshwana azayenelisa ukuvimba isiphepho sobubi esilamandla. Ukuphikisa kwezitha zeqiniso kuzavinjwa ukwenzela ukuthi udaba lwengilosi yesithathu lwenze umsebenzi walo. Nxa udaba oluyisixwayiso sokucina selutshunyayelwe, luzathinta inhliziyo zalabo ababusayo uNkulunkulu abasebenzisayo khathesi, njalo abanye babo bazalamukela iqiniso, njalo bame ndawonye labantwana bakaNkulunkulu ngesikhathi sokuhlukunyezwa. {GC 610.3}

Ingilosi ebambanisa ukutshunyayelwa kodaba lwengilosi yesithathu izakhanyisa umhlaba wonke ngenkazimulo yayo. Lapha kuvezwe umsebenzi ozazungeza umhlaba wonke njalo ngamandla amakhulu. Iqula labantu elalilindele ukuza kukaJesu kusukela ngomnyaka ka1840 kusiya ku1844 labonisa ukubakhona kwamandla kaNkulunkulu emsebenzini wakhe, ukutshunyayelwa kodaba lwengilosi yakuqala kwafinyelela ezizweni zonke, njalo kwamanye amazwe kwaba lemvuselelo enkulu kakhulu eyayingakaze ibonakale kusukela ngesikhathi semvuselelo yasendulo, kodwa konke lokhu kuzakwedlulwa yilokho okuzabonakala nxa sekutshunyayelwa udaba lwengilosi yesithathu oluzaba yisixwayiso sokucina emhlabeni. {GC 611.1}

Umsebenzi lowu uzafana lalowo owenzakala ngosuku lwePentecosti eBhayibhilini. (Msebenzi 2). Nxa “imvula yakuqala” yayisehliswa, ekuthululweni koMoya oyiNgcwele nxa umsebenzi wokuhambisa ivangeli wawusungulwa, ngenjongo yokumilisa inhlanyelo, ngokunjalo “imvula yokucina” izathelwa ekucineni komsebenzi lowu ukwenzela ukuthi ivuthise isivuno. “Ngakho sizabakwazi, nxa siphikelela sifuna ukuyazi iNkosi; ukuthi ukuphuma kwakhe kulungisiwe njengokusa, njalo uzakuza kithi njengezulu, njengezulu lokucina emhlabeni.” Hosiya 6:3. “Thabani lina beZiyoni, lithokoze ngeNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, ngoba ilinikile izulu lensewula ukuze ilibusise, yalinisela izulu elinengi, lensewula lelamuva njengakuqala.” Joweli 2:23. “Njalo kuzakuthi ensukwini zokucina, utsho uNkulunkulu, ngizakuthulula okoMoya wami phezu kwayo yonke inyama.” “Kuzakuthi wonke obiza ibizo leNkosi uzasindiswa.” Imisebenzi 2:17,21. {GC 611.2}

Umsebenzi omkhulu wevangeli awusoke ufike emaphethelweni ngamandla amancane okwedlula lawo abonakaliswa ekuvulweni kwawo. Amazwi esiprofethi agcwaliseka ngesikhathi kuthelwa imvula yakuqala nxa umsebenzi wokuhanjiswa kwevangeli wawusungulwa, azagcwaliseka njalo ngokuthelwa kwevula yokucina ekuphethweni kwawo. Yizo izikhathi zokuvuselelwa umpostoli uPetro ayekhuluma ngazo nxa wayesithi: “Ngakho phendukani, liguquke futhi, ukuze kwesulwe izono zenu, kuze kufike izikhathi zokuvuselelwa ezivela ebusweni beNkosi, njalo izathuma lo owamenyezelwa kini phambili, uJesu Krestu.” Imisebenzi 3:19, 20. {GC 611.3}

Inceku zikaNkulunkulu, ngobuso obukhazimulayo ngenxa yokuzinikela okungcwele, zizagcwala iganga lonke zitshumayela udaba oluvela ezulwini. Intshumayelo yokuxwayisa umhlaba wonke izaphuma emlonyeni yezinkulungwane zabantu. Izibonakaliso zizakwenziwa, abagulayo bazasiliswa, izimanga njalo lezibonakaliso zizalandela inceku zikaNkulunkulu. Ngesikhathi esifanayo uSathane laye uzasebenza ngezibonakaliso zokudukisa, aze alethe umlilo ovela ezulwini phambi kwabantu. Sambulo 13:13. Ngale indlela bonke abakhileyo emhlabeni bazaba lethuba lokukhetha uhlangothi abazabakilo. {GC 612.1}

Ukutshunyayelwa kwevangeli kuzahanjiswa hatshi ngempikiswano kodwa ngamandla kaMoya oyiNgcwele awokuthinta inhliziyo zabantu. Imicijo yonke yevangeli izabe isiveziwe. Inhlanyelo lawo izabe sihlanyeliwe, khathesi kuzabe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi imile njalo ithele izithelo. Izingwalo eziyabe zihanjiswe ngabatshumayeli bevangeli zizabe sezibonisile umthelela wazo, loba kunjalo abanengi ababefinyelelwe liqiniso bebelokhe bevinjiwe ukuba balizwisise njalo balamukele ngokulilandela. Ngalesi isikhathi imisebe yokukhanya izafinyelela indawo zonke, iqiniso lizabonakala ngokucaca kwalo, njalo abantwana bakaNkulunkulu abathembekileyo bazaqamula amaketane wonke akade ebabophile. Ubuhlobo, lobudlelwane basemabandleni, konke lokhu kuzabe sekungasela mandla okubenqabela ukuba bamukele iqiniso. Iqiniso lizabe seliligugu eledlula konke. kungakhathalekile kuzabe kulezitha ezinengi ezilwisa iqiniso, iqula labantu elikhulu lizakwamukela iqiniso lime ngasohlangothini likaNkulunkulu. {GC 612.2}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 39 — Isikhathi sokuhlupheka

“Ngalesosikhathi uMikhayeli uzakusukuma, umbusi omkhulu omela abantu bakini: njalo kuzakubakhona isikhathi sokuhlupheka esingazange sibe khona kusukela ekuqaleni kwezizwe kuze kube ngaleso sikhathi, kodwa ngaleso sikhathi bazakukhululwa abantu bakini, bonke abazatholakala bebhaliwe egwalweni.” Danyeli 12.1. {GC 613.1}

Nxa ukutshunyayelwa kodaba lwengilosi yesithathu sekugqitshiwe, umusa wokuncengela izoni emhlabeni lawo uzabe usuvaliwe. Abantwana bakaNkulunkulu bazabe sebewuqedile umsebenzi wabo emhlabeni. Bazabe sebeyamukele “imvula yokucina,” yona “eyikuvuselelwa okuvela kuNkulunkulu,” njalo bazabe sebelungiselelwe ithuba lokuhlolwa elizabe liphambi kwabo. Ingilosi zizabe ziphambana ezinye zinyuka zisiya ezulwini ezinye zisiza emhlabeni. Ingilosi evela emhlabeni izamemezela ukuthi umsebenzi wayo usuphelile, umhloliso wokucina sulethiwe kubo bonke abaphila emhlabeni, njalo bonke ababonise uthando lokulandela intando kaNkulunkulu sebamukele “uphawu lukaNkulunkulu ophilayo.” Ngaleso isikhathi uJesu uzakuma umsebenzi wakhe wokuncengela abantu ethempelini elisezulwini. Uzakuphakamisa izandla zakhe amemeze ngelizwi elikhulu ethi: “Kuphelile” njalo zonke ingilosi zizakubeka imiqhele yazo nxa esenza isimemezelo esilandelayo: “Owenza okungalunganga kahlale esenza okungalunganga; longcolileyo ahlale engcolile, lolungileyo ahlale elungisisiwe; longcwele ahlale engcwelisiwe.” Sambulo 22:11. Impilo zabantu bonke ziyabe sezihlolisisiwe, abanye besiya ekuphileni njalo abanye besiya ekufeni. UKrestu uzabe seyenzile umsebenzi wokubuyisa abantu bakhe njalo wesula izono zabo. Inani lombuso wakhe lizabe seliphelelisiwe; “umbuso njalo lamandla, lobukhulu bawo ngaphansi kwezulu lonke,” uzabe usumelele ukunikwa indlalifa zosindiso, njalo uJesu uqobo lwakhe nguye ozakubusa njengeNkosi yamaKhosi njalo loMbusi wabaBusi. {GC 613.2}

Nxa uJesu ephuma ethempelini, umnyama uzakwembesa bonke abaphila emhlabeni. Esikhathini lesi esesabekayo abalungileyo kuzamele baphile phambi kaNkulunkulu ongcwele bengaselayo uMmeli obancengelayo. Amandla abekade enqanda ababi azakuzuswa emhlabeni, njalo uSathane uzabe eselamandla okulawula bonke abangamukelanga iqiniso. Umusa kaNkulunkulu obukade uncenga abantu okwebanga elide kangaka uzabe usuphelile. Umhlaba wonke uzabe ususalile isihawu sakhe, waphika uthando lwakhe, njalo wavoxa phezu komthetho wakhe. Bonke ababi bazabe sebedlulile umngcele womusa, uMoya kaNkulunkulu, abawuphike okwesikhathi eside, ngalesi sikhathi uzabe usususiwe. Ngenxa yokuthi bazabe sebengelamthunzi womusa ukuthi ubasithele, bazabe sebengasavikelekanga emandleni omubi. USathane uzaphosela bonke abazabe bephila emhlabeni phakathi kobunzima obukhulu obuzaba ngobokucina emhlabeni. Nxa ingilosi zikaNkulunklu zisima ukubamba imimoya emibi eqhamuka enkanukweni zabantu, bonke ububi buzayekelelwa emhlabeni. Umhlaba wonke uzabaphakathi kokubhidlizwa okubi kakhulu okwedlula lokho okwehlela idolobho laseJerusalema endulo. {GC 614.1}

Ingilosi eyodwa endulo yenelisa ukubhubhisa wonke amazibulo elizweni laseGibhithe okwabangela ukuthi ilizwe lonke ligcwale ukububula. Nxa uDavida wayeseyenze isenzo esasiphambene lentando kaNkulunkulu esokubala abantu, ingilosi eyodwa yaletha isifo esikhulu kakhulu esaba yisijeziso sokona kwakhe. Amandla okubhubhisa afananayo ingilosi ezingcwele ezenelisa ukuwabonakalisa nxa uNkulunkulu ezithumile, azasetshenziswa zingilosi zikaSathane ngesikhathi lapho uNkulunkulu evumile. Kulemimoya khathesi elungeleyo ukuzibonakalisa emhlabeni, emelele kuphela imvumo yokuletha ukubhidlizwa emhlabeni wonke. {GC 614.2}

Labo abalandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu ngesikhathi lesi bazabekwa icala lokuletha izijeziso lezi emhlabeni, njalo bazabekwa icala lokubangela inguquko yonke ezabonakala endalweni njalo lokuphithizela lokuchitheka kwegazi okuzaletha usizi emhlabeni wonke. Amandla abekade eholela ukutshunyayelwa kwesixwayiso sokucina azabe esezondise abenzi bobubi, njalo ulaka lwabo luzaqondiswa kibo bonke abazabe sebeyamukele udaba lolu, njalo uSathane uzaletha inzondo enkulu ezabangela umoya wokuhlukumeza. {GC 614.3}

Nxa ubukhona bukaNkulunkulu basebususiwe ngokokucina esizweni samaJuda, abapristi ndawonye labantu abazange bakwazi lokhu. Loba nje babengaphansi kwamandla kaSathane, njalo babekhokhelwa yimizwa emibi njalo leyesabekayo, babelokhe bezibiza abakhethekileyo bakaNkulunkulu. Inkozo zonke ezazisenziwa ethempelini zaqhubeka njengenjwayelo, iminikelo yenziwa elathini elaselingcolile, njalo izibususo zansuku zonke zazinikwa abantu ababelecala lokubulala iNdodana kaNkulunkulu ayithanda kangaka njalo babelokhe besenza imizamo yokubulala abafundi njalo labapostoli. Ngokufanayo nxa isinqumo esingaguqulekiyo sesiyenziwe ethempelini lasezulwini, njalo lesiphetho somhlaba wonke sesibekiwe labo abasemhlabeni abasoke bakwazi lokhu. Inkonzo zonke ezenziwayo zizaqhubeka zisenziwa ngabantu uMoya kaNkulunulu ozabe usubatshiye kudala, njalo lamadlabuzane avelela kuSathane azabafuqela ukuthi bafeze injongo zakhe ezobubi, kodwa kuzabonakala sengathi ngumsebenzi abawenzela uNkulunkulu. {GC 615.1}

Njengoba usuku lweSabatha luzabe selwenziwe lube yindikimba yempikiswano phakathi kwamaKrestu, abaholi bamabandla ndawonye lababusi bamazwe bazabe sebebambene ukufaka umthetho wokuthi kukhonzwe ngosuku lwangeSonto, labo abalutshwane abazaqhubeka besala ukulandela umthetho lowu bazamukelwa njengezitha zomhlaba wonke ezifanele ukutshabalilswa. Kuzafuqwa ukuba iqula leli elilabantu abalutshwane eliphikisa umthetho webandla njalo lowelizwe akumelanga bavunyelwe, ukuthi bakwenze lokhu, lokuthi kungcono ukuthi bahlukunyezwe bona kulokuthi umhlaba wonke ungene phakathi kwesiphithiphithi njalo lasesimeni sokungalandelwa kwemithetho. Isizatho esifananayo sasetshenziswa eminyakeni eminengi eyadlulayo kuKrestu, silethwa ngabaholi bebandla. “Kungcono kithi,” watsho uKhefasi, “ukuthi kufe umuntu oyedwa afele abantu, ukwenzela ukuthi isizwe sonke singabhubhi.” Johane 11:50. Amazwi lawa azabonakala sengathi alesisindo njalo ekucineni umthetho uzafakwa ozamelana lalabo abazabe begcina usuku lweSabatha ngcwele olutholakala emthethweni wesine, njalo umthetho lowu uzatsho ukuthi bafanele ukujeziswa kalukhuni, njalo uzanika abantu imvumo ngemva kwesikhathi esithileyo ukubabulala. Lokho okwenziwa libandla leRoma endulo kuzakwenziwa kulabo abalandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu kukhokhelwa ngamabandla alamuhla azabe esihlamukele iqiniso leBhayibhili. {GC 615.2}

Abantu bakaNkulunkulu bazadlula phakathi kokuhlupheka okukhulu njalo lensizi ezesabekayo, okuyisikhathi esichazwa ngumprofethi uDaniyeli njengesikhathi sokuhlupheka kukaJakobe. “INkosi ithi: Sizwile ilizwi lokwethuka, lelokwesaba, lelokuswela ukuthula...kungani ubuso bonke bunyukubele. Maye! Lukhulu lolosuku, kalukho olunye olunjalo, kuyisikhathi sokuhlupheka kukaJacobe, kodwa uzakhululwa kikho.” Jeremiya 30:5-7. {GC 661.1}

Ubusuku bokuhlupheka uJakobe adlula kibo, nxa wayekhulekela ukukhululwa esandleni sika Esawu (Genesisi 32:24-30), bumele isehlakalo abantu bakaNkulunkulu abazadlula kiso ngesikhathi senhlupheko. Ngenxa yobuqili abenzayo ngesikhathi ethatha izibusiso zikayise, ezazifanele ukuba ziphiwe uIsawu, uJakobe ngemva kwalokho wabalekela ukusinda impilo yakhe, ngoba esesaba lokho umfowabo ayezamenza khona. Ngemva kokuhlala komalumakhe okweminyaka eminengi, wayeselubhekise ekhaya ngemva kokuthola ilizwi elalivela kuNkulunkulu elokuthi ayenze njalo, ndawonye labomkakhe kanye lezifuyo zakhe. Nxa wayefika emngceleni welizwe, wafikelwa yikwesaba ngemva kokuthola umbiko wokuthi uIsawu wayemhlangabeza lexuku lebutho njalo wayengalakho ukuthandabuza ukuthi wayelenhloso yokuphindisela. Abantu ababehamba loJakobe ngenxa yokuthi babengahlomanga, njalo bengelandlela yokuzivikela, kwasekubonakala sengathi basebezakuba yikudla kwenyoni zasendle. Njalo phezu komhedehede lokwesaba kwangezelelwa umthwalo wokuzisola, ngoba kwakungenxa yesono sakhe esasibangele ingozi leyi. Ithemba lakhe elilodwa lalisemuseni kaNkulunkulu, isiviko sakhe esisodwa sasingumkhuleko kuphela. Loba kwakunjalo kazange ayekela ukwenza konke okwakusemandleni akhe ukuvuma njalo lokuxolisa umfowabo ngenxa yesono amenza sona njalo lokuzama ukususa ingozi eyayiphambi kwakhe. Kuzamele kubenjalo lakubalandeli bakaKrestu, nxa belanda isikhathi senhlupheko, kuzamele benze yonke imizamo yokuziveza phambi kwabantu ngendlela eqondileyo, basuse wonke amehlo ensolo abantu abangabakhangela ngawo ngoba bengabazwisisi, njalo lokuthi bazame ukususa ingozi efuna ukulwisana lokukhululeka kwemzangedwa yabantu. {GC 616.2}

Nxa uJakobe wayesethumele imuli yakhe khatshana ukwenzela ukuthi bangaboni usizi lwakhe, wasala yedwa ukuba ancenge uNkulunkulu. Waqala ngokuvuma isono sakhe njalo waphakamisa umusa uNkulunkulu ayewubonise kuye, njalo ngokuzehlisa wancenga esebenzisa isivumelwano saboyise njalo lezithembiso uNkulunkulu amenzela zona embonweni abalawo eBetheli njalo laselizweni lokuphephela kwakhe. Manje kwasekufike isikhathi esinzima empilweni yakhe lapho konke kuye okwasekulenga emoyeni. Ebunyameni lobu obabugcwele ukuthula waqhubeka ekhuleka njalo ezehlisa phambi kaNkulunkulu. Khonokho nje wezwa isandla simbamba emahlombe. Umcabango owafika kuye wabangowokuthi lesi kwakuyisitha, ngamandla akhe onke waqala ukulwisana lomuntu lowu. Ilanga lathi selizaphuma, umuntu lowu wasebenzisa amandla akhe ezulu, wathi esemthintile wazizwa esephele amandla wawela phansi njalo wakhala wancenga lowu ayecabanga ukuthi wayeyisitha. UJakobe wabakwazi sobala ukuthi leyi kwakuyingilosi yesivumelwano ayekade elwisana layo. Loba nje wayesekhubazekile njalo esebuhlungwini, kazange alahle injongo yakhe. Kwasekukudala edlule phakathi kobuhlungu lokuzisola ngenxa yesono sakhe khathesi kwasekumele athole isiqiniseko sokuthethelelwa kwakhe. Isithunywa sezulu sasesibonakala sengathi sasesilungele ukusuka kodwa uJakobe wasinamathela, wancenga ukuthi simbusise. Ingilosi yathi: “Ngekela ngihambe ngoba ilanga selizaphuma,” kodwa uJakobe waphendula wathi, “angisoke ngikwekele, ngaphandle kokuthi ungibusise.” Khepha isibindi esingaka, lokuzithemba akubonisa lapha! Ngabe wayekwenze lokhu ngokuzikhukhumeza, lokuziphakamisa, uJakobe wayezahle afe khonaphana, kodwa okwakhe kwakuyisiqiniseko salowo ovuma ubuthakathaka bakhe njalo lokungafaneli kwakhe, kodwa loba kunjalo othemba isihawu sikaNkulunkulu ogcina isivumelwano sakhe. {GC 616.3}

“Wabalamandla phezu kwengilosi njalo wanqoba.” Hosiya 12:4. Ngenxa yokuzehlisa, lokuvuma izono zakhe njalo lokuzinikela, isoni lesi senelisa ukumelana lesithunywa sezulu. Wenelisa ukugagadlela izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu, njalo inhliziyo egcwele uthando olungapheliyo yayingeke ifulathele ukuncenga kwesoni lesi. Njengobufakazi bokunqoba kwakhe njalo lesibonelo sokunika abanye isibindi sokuthi balandele umzekeliso wakhe, ibizo lakhe laguqulwa lasuka kulowo owayehlala ekhunjuzwa isono sakhe, laba yilelo elaliyisikhumbuzo okunqoba kwakhe. Njalo njengoba kwakusobala kuthi uJakobe wayelwisane njalo wanqoba phambi kaNkulunkulu lokhu kwaba yisiqiniseko sokuthi wayezanqoba phambi kwabantu. Wayengasabi ukuhlangana lolaka lomfowabo, ngoba iNkosi yayiyisiviko sakhe. {GC 617.1}

USathane wayevezile isono sikaJakobe phambi kwengilosi zikaNkulunkulu, njalo wayetshilo ukuthi wayelalo ilungelo lokumbulala ngenxa yesono sakhe; njalo wayefuqe uIsawu ukuthi amhlangabeze ngenhloso yokumlimaza, njalo nxa uJakobe wayedlula phakathi kobusuku obude ethandaza, uSathane wazama ukumnyathezela ngokuletha umthwalo wamacala akhe ngenhloso yokuthi amenze alahle ithemba ayekele ukwethembela kuNkulunkulu. Kwasala kancane ukuthi uJakobe alahle ithemba, kodwa wayesazi ukuba ngaphandle kokuba athole usizo oluvela ezulwini kwakufanele abulawe. Wayesesivumile isono sakhe ngenhliziyo yakhe yokhe, njalo wancenga isihawu sikaNkulunkulu. Wayengeke ephanjulwe yilutho kule injongo ayelayo, kodwa wayibamba ingilosi njalo waletha amazwi wakhe okuncenga, esehlisa izinyembezi waze wathola ukunqoba. {GC 618.1}

Njengoba uSathane wafuqa uIsawu ukuthi ahlangabeze umfowabo ngenhloso yokuphindisela, ngokufanayo uzafuqa ababi ukuthi babulale abantu bakaNkulunkulu ngesikhathi sokuhlupheka. Njalo ngendlela azama ngayo ukubeka icala uJacobe phambi kwezulu, uzaletha njalo amacala ngabantu bakaNkulunkulu phambi kwezulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukholwa ukuba bonke abasemhlabeni ngabakhe, kodwa iqula leli elincane elizabe ligcina imiyo kaNkulunkulu yilo kuphela elizabe lisala ukukhothamela amandla akhe. Ngabe bekungenzeka abacitshe embalini yomhlaba, ukunqoba kwakhe bekuzabe sekuphelele. Uyananzelela ukuba ingilosi zezulu zibelusile, njalo uyacabangela ukuba izono zabo sezithethelelwe; kodwa kakwazi ukuthi isiphetho sabo sesilungisiwe ethempelini eliphezulu. Uyazazi ngokuphelela zonke izono abalinga ukuba bazenze njalo uzaziletha phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngoba efuna ukuveza abantwana bakaNkulunkulu njengabantu abafanele njengaye ukulehlekelwa luthando lukaNkulunkulu. Uzakutsho ukuthi uNkulunkulu ngeke abe elungile nxa engabathethelela izono zabo kodwa abulale yena kanye lengilosi zakhe. Uzakutsho ukuthi abantu laba bangabakhe njalo bafanele ukuba banikelwe ezandleni zakhe ukuze ababulale. {GC 618.2}

Ngesikhathi uSathane ebeka icala abantu beNkosi phambi kwayo ngenxa yezono zabo, iNkosi izamvumela ukuba abalinge ngazozonke izilingo alazo. Ukumthemba kwabo uNkulunkulu njalo lokuqina kokukholwa kwabo, kuzahlolwa ngendlela elukhuni. Nxa bekhangela imbali, amathemba wabo azatshona, ngoba empilweni zabo bazabona ubuhle obuncane kakhulu ababenzileyo. Bazabe besazi ubuthakathaka babo njalo lokungafaneli kwabo izulu. USathane uzazama ukubethusa ngokuletha imicabango yokuthi isimo sabo asilathemba, njalo lokuthi ukungcola kwabo ngeke kuhlambululeke. Uzabe elethemba lokutshabalalisa ukukholwa kwabo ukwenzela ukuthi bawele ngaphansi kwezilingo zakhe baphambuke ekulandeleni intando kaNkulunkulu. {GC 618.3}

Loba nje abantu bakaNkulunkulu bazabe begonjolezelwe yizitha ezifuna ukubabulala, kodwa usizi abazadlula kilo ayisilo lokwesaba ukubulawelwa iqiniso; bazabe besesaba ukuthi kambe kungabe kukhona isono abangasivumanga, njalo lokuthi ngenxa yokwehluleka kwabo bazakwehluleka ukwamukela isithembiso soMsindisi esithi: “ngizakulondoloza eholeni lokulingwa okuzafika emhlabeni wonke.” Sambulo 3:10. Ngabe kuphela bebengaba lesiqiniseko sokuthethelelwa bebengeke besabe ukuhlukunyezwa loba ukufa, kodwa nxa kungenzeka bahluleke ukutholakala befanele, njalo balahlekelwe yimphefumulo yabo ngenxa yamaphutha ezimilweni zabo, ibizo likaNkulunkulu belingatshaphazwa. {GC 619.1}

Ngakunxazonke abantwana beNkosi bazakuzwa amacala amakhulu azabekwa phezukwabo njalo bazabona umphumela wokuhlamukela iqiniso endaweni zonke, njalo bazafikelwa yisifiso esikhulu esivelela emoyeni wabo, esokuthi sengathi ukuhlamuka lokhu kungaqedwa njalo lobubi obenziwa ngabantu ababi bungafika emaphethelweni. Kodwa nxa belokhe bencenga uNkulunkulu ukuthi aqede ukuhlamuka lokhu, bazasindwa ngumthwalo wokuthi labo abalamandla okulwisana lesikhukhula sobubi obuzabe bukhona emhlabeni. Bazacabanga ukuthi ngabe babesebenzise wonke amandla wabo ekusebenzeleni uKrestu, baqhubeka bethola amandla kuselokuthula emhlabeni, uSathane lequla lakhe bebengeke benelisa ukubehlula ngalesi isikhathi. {GC 619.2}

Bazabubula phambi kaNkulunkulu, bekhomba ukuvuma kwabo izono abakwenze emuva, njalo bazancenga ukuthi bamukeliswe isithembiso soMsindisi esithi: “kabambelele emandleni ami, ukuze enze ukuthula lami njalo uzakwenza ukuthula. Isaya 27.5. Ukukholwa kwabo akusoke kwehluleke loba nje imithandazo yabo izabonakala sengathi ayiphendulwa khonapho. Loba nje bedlula phakathi kobuhlungu obunzima, lokwesaba, lokudangala, abasoke bame ukuncenga phambi kwezulu. Bazagagadlela amandla kaNkulunkulu njengoJakobe agagadlela ngayo ingilosi, njalo amazwi enhliziyo zabo azabe ngathi: “angisoke ngikwekele ngaphandle kokuthi ungibusise.” {GC 619.3}

Ngabe uJakobe wayengavumanga isono sakhe sokweba izibusiso zobuzibulo, uNkulunkulu wayengasoke awuzwe umthandazo wakhe futhi wayengeke wayihlenga impilo yakhe. Ngokunjalo ngesikhathi senhlupheko, ngabe abantu bakaNkulunkulu bebengatholakala belezono abangazivumanga ebezizahlangana labo ngesikhathi bedlula ebuhlungwini bokwesaba, bebezakwehlulwa, ukudangala bekungaqamula ukukholwa kwabo, njalo bebengeke babelesibindi sokububula phambi kaNkulunkulu ukuthi abahlenge. Kodwa loba nje besazi ukuthi akukho okubenza bafanele ukwamukelwa ezulwini, abalazo izono abangaziveza abazifihlileyo. Izono zabo kudala zahamba phambi komthethwandaba njalo sezayesulwa, futhi abasenelisi ukuziletha emkhumbulweni yabo. {GC 620.1}
