USathane khathesi uholela abantu abanengi ukuthi bacabange ukuthi uNkulunkulu kalandaba lokungathembeki kwabo ezintweni ezincane zempilo, kodwa iNkosi iyabonisa ngendlela eyaphatha ngayo indaba kaJakobe ukuthi ayisoke loba nini yamukela ububi. Bonke abenza imizamo yokuvikela loba eyokufihla izono zabo, njalo abazavumela ukuthi izono zabo zihlale encwadini zezulu zingavunywanga njalo zingathethelelwanga, bazanqotshwa nguSathane. Ukukhula kwezikhundla zabo njalo lokuhlonipheka kwazo, kwenza ukuthi izono zabo zibenkulu phambi kukaNkulunkulu njalo kwenza ukuthi ukunqoba kwesitha kube kukhulu. Labo abadlulisela phambili ukulungiselela usuku lweNkosi akwenzeki ukuthi bathole ukulungiselela lokhu ngesikhathi sokuhlupheka kumbe loba ngasiphi isikhathi ngemva kwalesi. Indaba yabantu abanjalo ayilangitsho ithemba. {GC 620.2}

Bonke abazibiza amaKrestu abazafika esikhathini lesi bengazilungiselelanga, bazavuma izono zabo phakathi kokudangala besebenzisa amazwi okudabuka, ngesikhathi ababi bejabula ngenxa yobuhlungu abazabe bedlula kibo. Ukuvuma kwabo izono kuzabe kufana lalokho okwenziwa nguIsawu kumbe uJadasi. Labo abavuma izono ngale indlela, bayabe bekhalela umphumela wokona kwabo, hatshi ububi besono sabo. Abalayo imizwa eqotho eyokuzisola, njalo abalayo inzondo yesono edingekayo. Bayavuma isono sabo, ngenxa yokwesaba ukujeziswa, kodwa njengoFaro wasendulo, bebengabuyela esimeni sokumelana loNkulunkulu ngabe izijeziso lezi bezingasuswa. {GC 620.3}

Imbali kaJakobe iphinde njalo ibe yisiqiniseko sokuthi uNkulunkulu kasoke alahle labo abathe ngenxa yokulingwa nguSathane bakhetha ukuwela esonweni, kodwa ababuye njalo bakhetha ukuphendukela kuye bevuma izono zabo ngokweqiniso. Ngesikhathi uSathane ezama ukubhubhisa iqula leli, uNkulunkulu uzathumela ingilosi zakhe ukuba zibaduduze njalo zibavikele ngesikhathi sokuhlupheka kwabo. Izikhali zikaSathane zizakuza ngamandla njalo langolaka, lokudukisa kwakhe kuzabe kulukhuni, kodwa loba kunjalo ilihlo likaNkulunkulu lizabe liphezu kwabantu bakhe, njalo lendlebe zakhe zizahlala zilindele ukuzwa ukukhala kwabo. Ubuhlungu babo buzabe bubukhulu kakhulu, lamalangabi omlilo azabonakala sengathi asezabaqeda, kodwa umnini wegolide uzabakhipha belungisisiwe njengendlela igolide eliphuma lihlambuluke ngayo emlilweni. Uthando uNkulunkulu alalo ngabantwana bakhe ngesikhathi lesi sokuvivinywa kwabo okukhulu luzabe lulokhe luqinile njalo lujulile njengasezikhathini zokuphumelela kwabo, kodwa kuzabe kudingeka ukuthi badlule phakathi kwamalangabi omlilo, konke okwasemhlabeni okukibo kumele kutshiswe, ukwenzela ukuthi umfanekiso kaKrestu ubonakale ngokuphelela. {GC 621.1}

Isikhathi sokudangala lokukhathazeka esiphambi kwethu sizadinga ukukholwa okwenelisa ukumelana lokudinwa, lokuphuza, njalo lendlala — ukukholwa okungasoke kuphele amandla laloba sekuvivinywe kangakanani. Isikhathi sokuthula esikhona khathesi sinikwe wonke umuntu ukuba alungiselele isikhathi lesi esizayo. UJakobe waphumelela ngoba kazange alahle ithemba njalo wayelokuzimisela. Ukunqoba kwakhe kuyibufakazi bamandla omthandazo ophikelelayo. Bonke abazagagadlela izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu, ngendlela uJakobe ayenza ngayo, njalo abazazimisela njalo baphikelele njengaye bazaphumelela ngendlela aphumelela ngayo laye. Labo abangazimiselanga ukuzidela, ukwenzela ukuthi babubule phambi kaNkulunkulu, lokuba bathandaze bengaphumuli becela izibusiso zakhe, abasoke bazifumane. Ukulwisana loNkulunkulu, yeka ukuthi balutshwane kangakanani abakwaziyo ukuthi kuyini! Balutshwane kangakanani asebeke bezwa umoya wabo udinga uNkulunkulu ngamandla amakhulu kangaka okwaze kwabangela ukuthi baphelelwe ngamandla enyama. Nxa amagagasi okudangala okungela mazwi okuwachasisa esethanyela lowo ozincengelayo, balutshwane kangakanani ababambelela ngokukholwa ezithembisweni zikaNkulunkulu. {GC 621.2}

Labo abasebenzisa ukukholwa okuncane khathesi, basengozini enkulu yokuwela ngaphansi kwamandla okudukisa kukaSathane njalo lokuzithola bengaphansi komthetho ozabekwa ukuba ubambe ngamandla umzwangedwa. Njalo laloba bengenelisa ukumelana lokuvivinywa lokhu bangena ngaphansi kobuhlungu lokudangala okukhulu ngesikhathi sokuhlupheka, ngoba bangazange bakwenza injwayelo ukwethemba uNkulunkulu. Izifundo zokukholwa abayekele ukuziqakathekisa bazabanjwa ngamandla ukuthi bazifunde ngaphansi kubunzima bokudangala. {GC 622.1}

Kumele khathesi sijwayele ukubumba ubudlelwane loNkulunkulu ngokuhlola izithembiso zakhe. Ingilosi ziyaloba yonke imithandazo eqinisekileyo njalo lephuma enhliziyweni. Kungangcono sitshiyane lezinto zokuzithokozisa kulokuthi siyekele ukuchitha isikhathi loNkulunkulu. Ukuswela okwedlula konke, lokuzidela okwedlula konke, nxa kulesandla sikaNkulunkulu kungcono kulenotho, lezikhundla, njalo lobungane yena engekho. Kumele sibeke izikhathi zokukhuleka. Uba sivumela ingqondo zethu ukuba zigcwale inkanuko zomhlaba, uNkulunkulu sengasinika isikhathi ngokusithathela izithixo zethu zegolide, lezindlu ngitsho lezemihlabathi evundileyo. {GC 622.2}

Abantu abatsha bebengeke bawela ezilingweni ngabe bebengazifundisa ukwala ukungena endleleni lapho abangenelisi khona ukucela izibusiso zikaNkulunkulu. Ngabe izithunywa ezithwele udaba lokucina olucolekileyo okumele lunikwe umhlaba wonke bezingathandazela izibusiso zikaNkulunkulu, hatshi ngendlela eqandayo, leyokunganaki njalo loyobuvila, kodwa ngokuzimisela njalo lokukholwa, ngendlela uJakobe akhuleka ngayo, bebengathola indawo ezinengi lapho abebezakuthi: “Ngiyibonile iNkosi manqamu, njalo angizange ngilahlekelwe yimpilo yami.” Genesisi 32:30. Ezulwini bebezakwaziwa njengamakhosana, njengabantu abalamandla okubindana loNkulunkulu njalo labantu. {GC 622.3}

“Isikhathi sokuhlupheka esingakaze sibekhona,” sizabonakala phambi kwethu masinyazana, njalo sizadinga inkambo esingakabi layo khathesi njalo abanengi abalobuvila bokuyidinga. Kujwayelekile ukuthi uhlupho lubonakale lulukhulu nxa abantu becabanga ngalo lungakafiki kulanxa selufikile, kodwa lokhu akusilo iqiniso nxa sikhangele isikhathi senhlupheko esiphambi kwethu. Ukuchasisa okulobunono obukhulu okungenziwa ngeke kuveze lokhu okuzayo. Ngesikhathi lesi sokuvivinywa, wonke umuntu kuzamele azimele yedwa phambi kaNkulunkulu. “Loba uNowa loDanyeli loJobe bebekhona, ngiyazifunga kutsho iNkosi uJehova, bebengayikukhulula indodana loba indodakazi, kodwa bebezazikhulula bona kuphela ngokulunga kwabo.” Hezekeli 14:20. {GC 622.4}

Khathesi ngesikhathi uMpristi wethu omkhulu esincengela, kumele sidinge ukubamsulwa kuKrestu. Ngitsho langemicabango, uKrestu kazange avumele ukuwa ngenxa yokulingwa nguSathane. USathane uyafumana enhliziyweni zabantu into eyodwa angangena ngayo, nxa kulenkanuko yesono ethile ethandwa ngumuntu, uyayisebenzisa ukuba izilingo zakhe ziqinise amandla wakhe emuntwini onjalo. Kodwa uKrestu nxa wayezitsho yena wathi: “Ngoba umbusi walumhlaba uyeza, kodwa kalalutho kimi.” Johane 14:30. USathane kazange afumane lutho eNdodaneni kaNkulunkulu eyayingamsiza ukuthi amnqobe. UKrestu wayeyenze konke ayengakwenza ukugcina imilayo kaYise, njalo kwakungelasono kuye uSathane ayengasisebenzisa ekumlwiseni kwakhe. Lesi yiso isimo okumele batholakale bekuso labo abazakuma ngesikhathi senhlupheko. {GC 623.1}

Kusempilweni leyi esiyiphila khathesi okumele senze imizamo yokwehlukana lesono, ngokukholwa egazini likaKrestu elisusa izono. Umsindisi wethu omuhle uyasincenga ukuba sizihlanganise laye, ukuba sibambanise ubuthakathaka bethu lamandla akhe, ukungazi kwethu lokuhlakanipha kwakhe, ukungafaneli kwethu lemisebenzi yakhe emihle. Ukukhokhela kukaNkulunkulu kuyiso isikolo okumele sifunde kiso ubumnene lokuzehlisa kukaKrestu. INkosi ihlala ibeka phambi kwethu, hatshi indlela ebesizayikhetha, ekhangeleka ilula njalo imnandi kithi, kodwa inhloso zeqiniso zempilo. Kweyeme kithi ukuba sisebenzisane ndawonye lamacebo asetshenziswa lizulu awokulungisisa izimilo zethu ukuba zifane lalezo ezisezulwini. Akulamuntu ongavika kumbe adlulisele phambili umsebenzi lowu ngaphandle kokuthi alahlekelwe ngumphefumulo wakhe. {GC 623.2}

Umphostoli uJohane wezwa ilizwi elikhulu ngesikhathi esembonweni lisithi: “Maye kulabo abakhileyo emhlabeni lasolwandle, ngoba uSathane wehlele kini elolaka olukhulu ngoba esazi ukuthi ulesikhathi esifitshane.” Sambulo 12:12. Ziyesabeka izehlakalo ezibangela ukuthi ilizwi leli liphume ezulwini. Ulaka lukaSathane luya lukhula nxa isikhathi sakhe silokhe sincipha, njalo umsebenzi wakhe wokudukisa njalo lokubhidliza uzafika esiqongweni sawo ngesikhathi senhlupheko. {GC 623.3}

Izibonakaliso ezesabekayo ezingajwayelekanga zizabonakala masinyazana emkhathini, lokhu kuzabe kuyibufakazi bamandla amadimoni okwenza izibonakaliso. Omoya ababi bazathunyelwa emakhosini wonke omhlaba njalo lasemhlabeni wonke, besiyabadukisa, njalo bazabakhuthaza ukuba babambane loSathane empini yakhe yokucina lohulumende wezulu. Ngenxa yokusebenzisa ingilosi zakhe, ababusi njalo labalandeli babo bazadukiswa ngokufanayo. Kuzavela amadoda athile azazibiza ngokuthi anguKrestu ngokwakhe, njalo bazafuna inhlonipho njalo lokukhonzwa okufanele uMsindisi womhlaba kuphela. Bazakwenza izibonakaliso ezimangalisayo ezokusilisa abagulayo njalo bazaveza ukuthi balembono evela ezulwini kodwa ezabe iphikisana lamazwi eBhayibhili. {GC 624.1}

Njengesicoco emdlalweni omkhulu wokudukisa abantu esiqongweni, uSathane uqobo lwakhe uzakwehla azenze uKrestu. Ibandla sekukade litshumayela ngokuza kukaKrestu njengesiqongo samathemba walo. Khathesi umkhohlisi omkhulu uzakwenza kubonakale sengathi uKrestu sebuyile. Endaweni ezitshiyeneyo emhlabeni, uSathane uzazibonakalisa phambi kwabantu njengesidalwa esilenkazimulo enkulu, efana lendlela uKrestu achazwa ngayo eyanikwa nguJohane encwadini kaSambulo. Sambulo 1:13-15. Inkazimulo ezabe imgombolozele ayikho eyidlulayo eseyake yabonakala emhlabeni. Kuzezwakala amazwi okunqoba endaweni zonke athi: “UKrestu sebuyile! uKrestu sebuyile!” Abantu bazazilahlela phambi kwakhe bemdumisa, yena uzaphakamisa izandla zakhe akhulume amazwi ayisibusiso phezu kwabo, ngendlela efanana laleyo uKrestu abusisa ngayo abafundi bakhe nxa wayeseselapha emhlabeni. Ilizwi lakhe lizabe lipholile njalo lizothile, kodwa lizwakala njengengoma emnandi. Uzasebenzisa amazwi alozwelo, ukuchaza amanye amaqiniso ezulu akhulunywa nguKrestu, uzasilisa abagulayo, njalo ngemva kokwenza lokhu uzakhuluma amazwi okuthi useguqule usuku lweSabatha walubeka ngosuku lwangeSonto, njalo uzalaya wonke umuntu ukuthi ahloniphe usuku lolu alubusisileyo. Uzakutsho njalo ukuba labo abaqhubeka begcina usuku lwesikhombisa ngcwele bahlambaza ibizo lakhe ngenxa yokwala ukulalela ingilosi ezithunyelwe kibo zilokukhanya njalo leqiniso. Leyi yiyo inkohliso enkulu, njalo lokudukisa okulamandla phose angeke amelwe ngumuntu. Njengabantu baseSamariya ababedukiswe nguSimon Magus, amaxuku abantu, kusukela kwabakhulu kusiya kwabancane, bazakwamukela amanga lawa besithi: “Lawa ngamandla amakhulu, kaNkulunkulu.” Imisebenzi 8:10. {GC 624.2}

Kodwa abantwana bakaNkulunkulu abasoke bakhohliswe. Imfundiso zikaKrestu lowu owamanga zizabe ziphambene lamaqiniso eBhayibhili. Izibusiso zakhe zizanikwa labo abakhonza isilo njalo lomfanekiso waso, bona okuliqula leli iBhayibhili elifundisa ukuthi uluka lukaNkulunkulu olungaxutshaniswanga uthelwa phezu kwabo. {GC 625.1}

Okunye njalo yikuthi uSathane kasoke avunyelwe ukulingisela indlela uKrestu azakuza ngayo lapha emhlabeni. UKrestu waxwayisa abantu ukuba bangadukiswa mayelana lendaba leyi, njalo wakuveza sobala indlela ukuza kwakhe kwesibili okuzakwenzeka ngayo. “Ngoba kuzavuka okristu bamanga labaprofethi bamanga, benze izibonakaliso, ukuze kuthi, nxa kungenzeka badukise labakhethekileyo...Ngakho uba bengathi kini; khangelani usenkangala, lingaphumi, khangelani usendlini yensitha, lingakholwa. Ngoba njengalokhu umbane ubaneka empumalanga ukhanye lentshonalanga, kuzakuba njalo lokufika kweNdodana yomuntu. Mathewu 24:24-27, 31; 25:31; Sambulo 1:7; 1 Thesalonika 4:16,17. Ukuza lokhu akulandlela yokukulungisela. Kuzakwazakala njalo kubonwe emhlabeni wonke jikelele. {GC 625.2}

Kuphela labo abakade bengabafundi beBhayibhili abaqotho njalo asebeyamukele uthando lweqiniso bazakuvikelwa ekudukisweni okulamandla amakhulu okuzathumba umhlaba wonke. Ngokusebenzisa ubufakazi beBhayibhili laba bazakwenelisa ukumbona umkhohlisi loba nje ezabe ezamile ukuzifihla. Kubo bonke abantu isikhathi sokuhlolwa sizafika. Ngenxa yokuhlungula okuzalethwa yizilingo wonke amaKrestu eqiniso azavezwa. Kambe abantu bakhe khathesi sebejulile ngokweqiniso elizwini lakhe kangaka okokuthi abasoke bamukele inkohliso ngenxa yobufakazi balokho abakubonayo kumbe abakuzwayo na? Bazakwenelisa yini phakathi kwesiphithiphithi lesi ukubambelela eBhayibhili, njalo eBhayibhilini kuphela na? USathane uzazama nxa kusenzeka ukubanqabela ukuba benze amalungiselelo okuba benelise ukuma ngalolo suku. Uzahlela izehlakalo ngendlela yokuba abiyele indlela yabo ngothango, abafake phakathi kwezilingo zokuthanda inotho yomhlaba, abenze ukuba bathwale umthwalo onzima, lodinisayo, ukwenzela ukuthi inhliziyo zabo zikhathalele inkanuko zalumhlaba ukwenzela ukuthi usuku lokuhlolwa lubafikele njengesela. {GC 625.3}

Nxa umthetho ozafakwa ngababusi abehlukeneyo emazweni atshiyeneyo ozabe uphikisana lalabo abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu, uzakwenza ukuthi kususwe wonke amalungelo abo okuthi bavikelwe yilizwe njalo ozakwenza ukuthi balahlelwe ezandleni zalabo abafuna ukubabhidliza abantwana bakaNkulunkulu bazabaleka emadolobheni lasemaphandleni babuthane ndawonye bebengamaxuku atshiyeneyo, behlale endaweni ezilugwadule njalo lezisithakeleyo. Abanengi bazathola ukuphephela ezintabeni. NjengamaKrestu asesigodini lasePiedmont, bazakwenza ukuthi indawo eziphakemeyo zasemhlabeni zibengamakhayo abo, njalo bazabonga uNkulunkulu ngenxa “yokudalwa kwamadwala” Isaya 33:16. Kodwa abantu abanengi emazweni wonke ngokutshiyana kwezigaba zabo zempilo, abakhulu labancane, abaswelayo lezinothi, abansundu labamhlophe, bazakufakwa phakathi kochuku njalo lokugqilazwa okubuhlungu kakhulu. Abathandekayo bakaNkulunkulu bazadlula phakathi kwensuku ezilukhuni, bebotshwe ngamaketane, bevalelwe entolongweni, begwetshelwe ukubulawa, abanye batshiywe lapho ngenhloso yokuthi bafele khona ngenxa yendlala phakathi kwemigodi emnyama njalo engcole okumangalisayo. Kuzabe kungekho indlebe yomuntu ezabe ivulelwe ukuzwa ukububula kwabo, njalo sizabe singekho isandla somuntu esizabe silungele ukubanika usizo. {GC 626.1}

Kambe uNkulunkulu uzabakhohlwa yini abantwana bakhe ngalelihola lokuvivinywa na? Wamkhohlwa uNowa othembekileyo nxa izijeziso zazisehliselwa abantu ayephila labo na? Wamkhohlwa yini uLothi nxa umlilo wawusehla uzotshisa amadolobho asemagcekeni na? Wamkhohlwa na uJosefa nxa wayephila phakathi kwabahedeni baseGibhithe? Wamkhohlwa na uElija nxa ukufunga kukaJezebheli kwasekungathi kwakuzabangela ukubulawa kwakhe njengalokho akwakuyehlele abaprofethi bakaBhali. Wamkhohlwa yini uJeremiya nxa wayesephoselwe emgodini wentolongo omnyama na? Wabakhohlwa yini abafana bamaHebheru abathathu nxa basebephoselwe emlilweni ovuthayo na? kumbe uDanyeli emgodini wezilwane? {GC 626.2}

“IZion ithe iNkosi ingilahlile, njalo leNkosi yami isingikhohliwe. Kambe owesifazane engamkhohlwa umtanakhe omunyayo, okungenza ukuthi angazweli indodana ayizeleyo na? yebo sebengayikhohlwa, kodwa mina angisoke ngilikhohlwe lina. Bhekani ngilibhale ngaphakathi kwezandla zami.” Isaya 49:14-16. INkosi yamabandla isikhulumile yathi: “Lowo othinta lina uthinte intanga yelihlo lakhe.” Zakhariya 2:8. {GC 626.3}

Loba izitha zingabaphosela entolongweni, kodwa loba kunjalo imiduli yemigodi ngeke iqume ukukhulumisana kwenhliziyo zabo loKrestu. Yena obona ubuthakathaka babo, owazi konke ukuvivinywa kwabo, ungaphezu kwamandla wonke asemhlabeni, njalo ingilosi zizabathekelela ezitokisini zabo, ziletha ukukhanya njalo lokuthula kwasezulwini. Antolongweni lawa azafana lezigodlo zamakhosi, ngoba labo abanothileyo ekukholweni bazabe behlala lapho, njalo imiduli leyi emnyama izakhanyiswa yikukhanya kwasezulwini ngendlela efananayo okwakhanyiswa ngayo nxa uPhawuli loSilasi babekhuleka njalo behlabela ingoma zokudumisa phakathi kobusuku entolongweni yasePhiliphi. {GC 627.1}

Izijeziso zikaNkulunkulu zizakwehliselwa phezu kwalabo abazabe bezama ukuhlukumeza njalo lokubhubhisa abantu bakhe. Ukubekezelela kwakhe izoni kwenza ukuthi zone ngamandla, kodwa ukujeziswa kwabo loba kunjalo kubalindele njalo kuzabalukhuni ngenxa yokuthi kumiswe kwaze kwadlula isikhathi eside kungalethwanga. “Ngoba iNkosi izavuka njengentabeni yasePerazimi, ithukuthele njengesigodini seGibeyoni, ukuze yenze umsebenzi wayo, umsebenzi wayo ongejwayelekanga, yenze isenzo sayo, esingejwayelekanga.” Isaya 28:21. KuNkulunkulu wethu olesihawu isenzo sokujezisa abantu, yisenzo esingajwayelekanga kuye. “Tshono kibo uthi: INkosi ithi: Ngiyazifunga mina, kangithokozi ngokufa komubi. Hezekeli 33:11. UNkulunkulu uyiNkosi “elesihawu elomusa, ephuza ukuthukuthela, levame ububele lobuqotho, egcinela abayizinkulungwane umusa, ethethelela ububi lesiphambeko lesono, engayikuyekela lokuyekela olecala.” Exodusi 34:6,7. “INkosi iyaphuza ukuthukuthela, kodwa ilamandla amakhulu, kayiyikumyekela ngitsho olecala.” Nahume 1:3. Uzakwenza izenzo ezesabakayo ekulungeni kwakhe, ukwenzela ukuthi aphindisele amandla omthetho wakhe osuvoxelwe phansi emhlabeni. Ubukhulu besijeziso esilindele bonke abephula imilayo yakhe singahlolwa ngokukhangela indlela uNkulunkulu abukeka ethikaza ngayo ukwehlisa izijeziso zakhe. Isizwe asibonisa umusa ngokusibekezelela, njalo angasoke asitshaye ngoswazi ngaphandle kokuthi sigcwalise inkezo yobubi baso phambi kwakhe, ekucineni sizanatha inkezo yolaka lwakhe engaxutshaniswanga lesihawu sakhe. {GC 627.2}

Ngesikhathi lapho uKrestu azakuma khona umsebenzi wakhe wokusincengela ethempelini lasezulwini, ulaka olungaxutshaniswanga oluthenjiswe labo abakhonza isilo njalo lomfanekiso waso njalo labamukela uphawu lwaso (Sambulo 14:9,10), luzakuthelwa. Izijeziso zolaka lukaNkulunkulu ezehliselwa phezu kwelizwe laseGibhithe ngesikhathi lapho uNkulunkulu ayeselungiselela ukukhulula abantwana bakoIsrayeli ziyafanana lalezo kodwa zizabe zisesaka kakhulu ezizathelwa phezu komhlaba ngesikhathi lapho uNkulunkulu azabe eselungiselela ukukhulula abantu bakhe emhlabeni. Nxa umlobi kaSambulo echaza isimo lesi esesabekayo uthi: “Kwasekuvela isilonda esibi esibuhlungu ebantwini abalophawu lwesilo, labakhonza umfanekiso waso.” Lolwandle “lwaselusiba ligazi njengelofileyo, lawo wonke umphefumulo ophilayo wafa olwandle. Njalo “lemifula njalo lemithombo yamanzi yaphenduka yaba ligazi.” Laloba izijeziso lezi zizimbi kangaka, ukulunga kukaNkulunkulu kuzabonakaliswa emehlweni womuntu wonke. Ingilosi kaNkulunkulu ithi: “Ulungile Nkosi, okhona lowayekhona lozakuba khona, ngoba wahlulela lezizinto; ngoba bachitha igazi labangcwele lelabaprofethi, ubanike labo igazi ukulinatha, ngoba balifanele.” Sambulo 16:2-6. Ngenxa yesenzo sabo sokugwebela abangcwele ukufa, sebethole icala legazi labo sengathi bababulele ngezandla zabo. Ngendlela efanayo uKrestu wabeka icala phezu kwamaJuda ayephila ngesikhathi sakhe lokuchitha igazi lamadoda angcwele elalichithiwe kusukela ensukwini zika Abela, ngenxa yokuthi labo babelomoya ofanayo njalo babefuna ukwenza umsebenzi ofanayo owenziwa yilabo ababulala abaprofethi. {GC 627.3}

Esijezisweni esilandelayo, amandla azanikwa ilanga ukuba “litshise abantu ngomlilo. Abantu baqothulwa yikutshisa okukhulu.” Sambulo 16:8,9. Abaprofethi bachaza isimo somhlaba ngesikhathi lesi esesabekayo ngale indlela: “Umhlabathi uyakhala; ...ngoba isivuno semasimini siphelile...zonke izihlahla zeganga sezomile, lentokozo iphelile ebantwini.” “Inhlanyelo iyabola ngaphansi kwamagade, iziphala zamabele azilalutho...Yeka ukukhala kwezifuyo! Imihlambi yenkomo ididekile ngoba kayilalo idlelo,imifula yamanzi itshile, lomlilo utshisile amadlelo eganga.” Joweli 1: 10-12, 17-20. “Izingoma zethempelini zizaphenduka zibe yikukhala mhlalokho, kutsho iNkosi uJehova, izidumbu zizagcwala yonke indawo, zikhutshelwe phandle ngokuthula.” Amos 8:3. {GC 628.1}

Izijeziso lezi azisoke ziyehlele umhlaba wonke jikelele ndawonye kumbe ngokulandelana kwazo, ngoba ngabe bekungaba njalo bonke abantu abakhileyo emhlabeni bebezakufa ngenxa yazo. Loba kunjalo zizaba yizijeziso ezesabekayo esezike zehlela abantu selokhe umhlaba wadalwayo. Zonke izijeziso esezike zehlela abantu ngaphambi kokuvalwa komusa, zazisiza zixutshaniswe lomusa. Ukuncenga kwegazi likaKrestu yikho obekuvikela isoni ukuthi singamukeli isilinganiso esigcweleyo esifanele amacala aso, kodwa ekwahlulelweni kokucina, ulaka lukaNkulunkulu luzakuthelwa lungaxutshaniswanga lomusa. {GC 628.2}

Ngalolosuku amaxuku abantu azafisa ukuvikela kwesihawu sikaNkulunkulu abasiphikileyo okwesikhathi eside ekuphileni kwabo. “Khangelani insuku ziyeza, kutsho iNkosi uJehova, lapho ngizathumela indlala elizweni, kungabi yindlala yokudla, kungabi ngeyokomela amanzi, kodwa kube ngeyokuzwa amazwi eNkosi. Abantu bazazula kusukela elwandle kuze kube selwandle, kusukela enyakatho kuze kube sempumalanga bagijimele le lale, bedinga ilizwi leNkosi bangalitholi.” Amosi 8:11,12. {GC 629.1}

Abantu bakaNkulunkulu labo ayisikho ukuthi bazabe bengalazo labo inhlupho zabo, kodwa loba nje bezabe bezingelwa njalo bephakathi kobuhlungu benhliziyo, ngesikhathi bedlula phakathi kwendlala kodwa uNkulunkulu kasoke avumele ukuthi balambe baze bafe. UNkulunkulu ofanayo owanakekela uElijah kasoke adlule ngitsho loyedwa umntanakhe ozabe ephila impilo yokuzidela. Yena owenelisa ukubala inani lenwele ezisemakhanda wabo uzabanakekela, njalo ngesikhathi sendlala bazakusuthiswa. Ngesikhathi ababi besifa ngendlala njalo langezifo, ingilosi zizavikela abangcwele njalo zibanike konke abakudingayo. Kulowo ohamba ngokulunga nansi isithembiso: “Isinkwa sakhe uzasiphiwa, lamanzi wakhe azabakhona.” “Abayanga labaswelayo badinga amanzi, kodwa engekho, ulimi lwabo lome ngokoma, mina Nkosi ngizabaphendula; mina Nkulunkulu kaIsrayeli kangiyikubadela.” Isaya 33:15,16; 41:17. {GC 629.2}

“Loba umkhiwa ungavezi impoko, loba kungekho izithelo evinini lomhlwathi liphuthe ukuthela, amasimu angavezi ukudla, izimvu ziqunywe zisuka esibayeni, kungabi khona inkomo esibayeni, kanti mina ngizathokoza ngeNkosi, ngijabule ngoNkulunkulu wokukhululwa kwami.” Habhakhukhi 3:17,18. {GC 629.3}

“INkosi ingumlondolozi wakho; iNkosi ingumthunzi wakho esandleni sakho sokunene. Ilanga kaliyikukutshaya emini, lenyanga ebusuku. INkosi izakulondoloza kukho konke okubi; izalondoloza umphefumulo wakho.” “Sibili yena uzakukhulula emjibileni womthiyi, kuye umatshayabhuqe wesifo obhubhisayo. Uzakusibekela ngensiba zakhe, uzathembela langaphansi kwempiko zakhe, iqiniso lakhe liyisihlangu lehawu. Kawuyikwesaba isesabiso sebusuku, umtshoko ophaphayo emini, umatshayabhuqe wesifo ohambayo emnyameni, incithakalo ebhubhisayo emini enkulu. Bazakuwa abayinkulungwane eceleni kwakho, labayizinkulungwane ezilitshumi ngakwesokunene sakho, kuwe kakuyikusondela. Uzakhangela nje ngamehlo akho, ubone impindiselo kwababi. Ngoba wena, Nkosi uyisiphephelo sami, imenzile oPhezukonke waba yindawo yakho yokuhlala. Kakulabubi obuzakwehlela, lenhlupheko kayiyikusondela ethenteni lakho.” Amahubo 121:5-7; 91:3-10. {GC 629.4}

Kodwa emehlweni abantu kuzabonakala sengathi abantu bakaNkulunkulu sekuzamele babophe ubufakazi bokukholwa kwabo ngegazi labo njengalokho okwenziwa yilabo abafela eqiniso abaphila phambi kwabo. Labo bazaqala ukwesaba ukuthi mhlawumbe uNkulunkulu sebatshiyile ukuba bawele ezandleni zezitha zabo. Lesi kuzaba yisikhathi sobuhlungu obesabekayo. Ebusuku lemini bazakhala eNkosini becela ukukhululwa. Abantu ababi bazathokoza, njalo kuzezwakala amazwi okukloloda athi: “Kungaphi manje ukukholwa kwenu? Kungani uNkulunkulu engalikhululi ezandleni zethu nxa kuyikuthi lingabantu bakhe na?” Kodwa laba abalindileyo bazakukhumbula uJesu esifa esiphambanweni saseKhalivari njalo labapristi abakhulu lababusi bememeza besithi: “Wasindisa abanye; kodwa kenelisi ukuzukhulula yena. Nxa eyiNkosi yakoIsrayeli, akehle esiphambanweni khathesi, njalo sizakumkholwa.” Mathewu 27:42. NjengoJakhobe endulo, bonke bazabe belwisana loNkulunkulu. Ubuso babo buzabe bubonisa ukulwisana okuzabe kuphakathi kwenhliziyo zabo. Ukubuna kuzabonakala ebusweni babo. Kodwa loba kunjalo abasoke bame ukuncenga abazabe bekwenza phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi. {GC 630.1}

Ngabe abantu bebengavulwa amehlo babone ngelihle lezulu, bebezabona amaxuku engilosi ezilamandla amakhulu ezizabe zihanqe labo abazabe begcine ilizwi lokubekezela kukaKrestu. Ngenhliziyo ezilozwelo ingilosi lezi zizabe zikhangele ukuhlukumezeka kwabo njalo zezwa lemithandazo yabo. Zizabe zilindele kuphela ilizwi elivela eNduneni yebutho ukuba zibahluthune phakathi kobunzima abazabe bekibo. Kodwa kuzabe kusafanele ukuba balinde okwesikhatshana. Abantu bakaNkulunkulu kusafanele ukuba banathe inkezo leyi njalo babhabhathizwe ngombhabhathizo lowu. Ukudlula kwezikhathi lokuphuza emehlweni wabo, okuzabe kubuhlungu kangaka, kuzabe kuyimpendulo engcono kakhulu yemithandazo yabo. Nxa belokhe bezama ukulinda bethembele ukuba iNkosi isebenze baholelwa ukuba babonise ukukholwa, lethemba, njalo lokubekezela, abakusebenzise kancane enkambeni yabo yokukholwa. Loba kunjalo ngenxa yabakhethekileyo isikhathi sokuhlupheka sizakufinyezwa. “Kanti uNkulunkulu kayikwenza impindiselo yabakhethiweyo bakhe abakhalayo kuye emini lebusuku?... Ngithi kini uzakwenza impindiselo yabo masinyane.” Lukha 18:7,8. Ukuphela kuzakuza masinyane okwedlula lokho abantu abakukhangeleleyo. Amabele azakubuthwa abeyizithungo ezizafakwa esiphaleni sikaNkulunkulu, kuthi umfaba ubuthelwe emlilweni ukuze utshiswe. {GC 630.2}

Abalindi bezulu, ngokwethembeka emsebenzini wabo, baqhubeka bekhangele okwenzakalayo emhlabeni. Loba nje kuzabe sekubekiwe umthetho ozaphawula isikhathi esithile sokuba bonke abagcina imilayo kaNkulunkulu bengabulawa, izitha zabo ezikhathini ezitshiyeneyo zizazama ukuhambela phambili umthetho lowu, zizame ukuthatha imphefumulo yabo. Kodwa kakho ngitsho loyedwa ongenelisa ukudlula abalindi laba bazabe behanqe abalungileyo. Abanye bazahlaselwa nxa bezama ukubaleka besuka emadolobheni lasemaphandleni, kodwa inkemba ezizabe ziphakamiselwe bona zizaqamuka ziswele amandla njalo ziwele phansi njengotshani obuwomileyo. Abanye bazavikelwa zingilosi ezizabe zithethe izimo zamadoda empi. {GC 631.1}

Kusukela endulo uNkulunkulu ukewasebenzisa ingilosi ezingcwele emsebenzini wokukhulula abantu bakhe. Ingilosi zezulu sezike zaphatheka endabeni zabantu benyama emhlabeni lowu. Sezike zabonakala zigqoke izembatho ezikhazimula njengombani, futhi sezike zabonakala zigqoke izembatho zezihambi. Ingilosi sezike zabonaka zisesimeni sabantu phambi kwamadoda angcwele kaNkulunkulu. Sezike zaphumula sengathi bezikhathele, ngaphansi kwemithunzi yezihlahla emini. Sezike zamukela uthando lokwamukelwa emizini ethile. Sezike zenza njalo imisebenzi yokuphelekezela abantu abathile ohambeni lwabo. Sezike zasebenzisa izandla zazo ukubasa umlilo ealthareni. Sezike zavula iminyango yentolongweni njalo zakhulula inceku zikaNkulunkulu. Zathi zigqoke izembatho zezulu, zabuya zagiqela khatshana ilitshe elalivale ithuna loMsindisi. {GC 631.2}

Ingilosi zezulu zandise ukubakhona emhlanganweni yabangcwele zembethe izimo zabantu benyama, njalo ziyethekelela imihlangano yababi, ngendlela ezahamba ngayo eSodoma, ukuyahlolisisa izenzo zabo, ngenhloso yokuqedisisa ukuba basebedlulile na umngcele womusa kaNkulunkulu. INkosi iyathokoza ngomusa wayo, njalo ngenxa yabantu abalutshwana abamkhonza ngeqiniso, uyamisa izehlakalo ezingachitha imphefumulo yabantu njalo uyaqhubekisa ukuthula ebantwini abanengi. Izoni ezonela uNkulunkulu azinanzeleli ukuthi kumele zibonge abalungileyo ngenxa yokuphila kwabo laloba nje beqhubeka bebahlukumeza njalo bebazonda. {GC 631.3}

Laloba nje ababusi balumhlaba bengakwazi, kodwa ezikhathini ezinengi ingilosi zezulu zilokuba khona emihlanganweni yabo njengezikhulumi. Amehlo abantu ake azibona, njalo lendlebe zabo zike zezwa amazwi azo awokuncenga, lendebe zabo zike zaphikisana lemibono yazo njalo benza amazwi wazo inhlekisa, lezandla zabantu sezike zasetshenziswa ukuzihlukumeza lokuzithuka. Emhlanganweni yekhansilini lasemthethwandabeni yelizwe izithunywa zezulu sezike zabonisa ulwazi lwazo mayelana lembali yoluntu, sezike zazibonisa ukuthi yizo ezilobungcitshi abokhulu bokwenelisa ukumela labo abahlukunyeziweyo okwedlula ingcitshi zonke ebezingabamela. Ingilosi sezenelise ukumisa injongo ezithile njalo zenqabela ububi obabungaphambanisa ukuhamba komsebenzi kaNkulunkulu njalo obabungabangela ukuhlupheka okukhulu ebantwini bakhe. Ngehola lobunzima njalo lokulwiswa “ingilosi yeNkosi izingelezela labo abayesabayo iNkosi, njalo ibakhulule.” Amahubo 34:7. {GC 632.1}

Ngokulangazelela okukhulu abantwana bakaNkulunkulu bazalinda izibonakaliso zokuza kweNkosi yabo. Nxa abalindi bebuzwa ukuthi, “mlindi uthini ngobusuku?” impendulo izaphiwa ngamazwi angelakuthandabuza, “Kuyeza ukusa, lobusuku futhi.’ Isaya 21:11,12. Ukukhanya kuzaqala ukubonakala phezu kwezintaba. Masinyazana nje inkazimulo yakhe izabonakaliswa. Ilanga loKulunga lizabe selilungele ukukhanyisa umhlaba wonke. Ukusa ndawonye lobusuku kuzabe sekusondele kokubili, kwabalungileyo kuzavulwa imini engayikuphela, kwababi kuzabe sekufike ukutshona kwelanga okungayikuphela.” {GC 632.2}

Nxa laba abazabe bedlula phakathi kokulwisana lezulu beqhubeka beletha izicelo zabo phambi kaNkulunkulu, iveyili ebelikade libahlukanisa lalokho okungabonwayo lizabonakala sengathi selisuswa. Izulu lizaqala ukukhanya ngenxa yokuza kokusa okungapheliyo, njalo njengengoma ephuma endebeni zezingilosi kuzazwakala endlebeni zabo amazwi athi: “Bambelelani ebuqothweni benu. Usizo luyeza” UKrestu yena onguMnqobi omkhulu, uzaphakamisela amasotsha akhe azabe esebonakala edinwe kakhulu umqhele onaphakade, njalo ilizwi lakhe lizazwakala liphuma emasangweni avulekileyo lisithi: “Bhekani ngilani. Lingesabi. Ngikwazi konke ukudabuka kwenu; ngibuthwalile bonke ubuhlungu benu. Alilwisani lezitha ezingakaze zilwiswe. Ngiyilwile impi leyi endaweni yenu, njalo ngegama lami ledlula abanqobi.” {GC 632.3}

Umsindisi wethu omuhle uzathumela usizo kithi ngesikhathi lapho sesiludinga. Indlela eyokuya ezulwini iphambwe ngamanyathelo wakhe. Wonke ameva alimaza inyawo zethu alimaza inyawo zakhe ngaphambilini. Zonke iziphambano esibizelwa ukuthi sizithwale wazithwala laye phambi kwethu. INkosi iyavumela izikhathi zokulwiswa, ukwenzela ukuthi alungiselele inhliziyo zethu ukuthula. Isikhathi senhlupheko siyisehlakalo esesabekayo ebantwini bakaNkulunkulu, kodwa siyisikhathi sokuthi bonke abakholwa ngeqiniso bekhangele phezulu, njalo ngokukholwa munye ngamunye bazabona umkhumbi wezithembiso ozabe ubasibakele. {GC 633.1}

“Ngakho abahlengiweyo beNkosi bazabuya, beze eZiyoni behlabela, lentokozo elaphakade phezu kwekhanda labo, bazazuza intokozo lenjabulo, usizi lokulila kuzabaleka. Mina, mina uqobo nginguye oliduduzayo, ungubani wena ozakwesaba umuntu ozakufa, lendodana yomuntu ezakwenziwa ibe njengotshani, ubusukhohlwa iNkosi umenzi wakho...uqhubeka usesaba insuku zonke ngenxa yokuvutha kwentukuthelo yomncindezeli, kungathi uzimisele ukuchitha? Ingaphi-ke intukuthelo yomncindezeli? Isibotshwa esithunjiweyo siyaphangisa ukuze sikhululwe, lokuthi singafeli emgodini, njalo ukuthi ukudla kwaso kungasweleki. Ngoba ngiyi Nkosi uNkulunkulu wakho eyadabula ulwandle, amagagasi alo ahlokoma, iNkosi yamabandla libizo layo. Ngifakile amazwi ami emlonyeni wakho, ngakusibekela emthunzini wesandla sami.” Isaya 51:11-16. {GC 633.2}

“Ngakho khathesi zwana lokhu wena ohluphekayo lodakiweyo, kodwa hatshi ngewayini: Itsho njalo iNkosi yakho, uJehova uNkulunkulu wakho oncengela udaba lwabantu bakhe: Khangela ngisusile esandleni sakho inkezo yokuthuthumela, inzece zenkezo yolaka lwami, kawusayikuyinatha futhi; kodwa ngizayibeka esandleni salabo abakuhluphayo, abathe emphefumulweni wakho: Khothama ukuze sedlule phezulu; usubeke umzimba wakho njengomhlabathi, lanjengomgwaqo kwabadlula phezulu.” Isaya 51:21-23. {GC 633.3}

Ilihlo likaNkulunkulu nxa lalikhangele esikhathini sokucina, laliphezu kwenhlupheko abantu bakhe abazahlangana layo, lapho amandla asemhlabeni azabambana ukuba alwisane labo. Njengesigqili esithunjiweyo, bazabe besesaba ukubulawa yindlala kumbe ngodlame. Kodwa yena oNgcwele owahlukanisa ulwandle olubomvu phambi kwesizwe sakoIsrayeli, uzabonisa amandla wakhe aguqule ukuthunjwa kwabo. “Bazakuba ngabami, itsho iNkosi yamabandla, ngalolosuku engizakwenza ngalo okuligugu kwami, njalo ngizabagcina njengendoda egcina indodana yayo eyisebenzelayo.” Malaki 3:17. Ngabe igazi labalandleli bakaKrestu abathembekileyo belingachithwa ngalesi isikhathi, belingeke libe yinhlanyelo njengelalabo abafela iqiniso endulo ebizaletha isivuno kuNkulunkulu. Ukwethembeka kwabo ngalesi isikhathi lasekufeni ngeke kusaphendulela abanye eqinisweni, ngoba inhliziyo ezilikhuni zizabe sezikhahlelele khatshana amagagasi omusa kwazekwafika isikhathi lapho angabuyanga aphenduka futhi khona. Ngabe abangcwele bebengayekelwa ukuba babulawe yizitha zabo, bekuzaletha ukunqoba lentokozo enkosini yobunyama. UDavida nxa eloba uthi: “Ngoba izangifihla edumbeni layo ngosuku lobubi, ingifihle ekusithekeni kwethente layo, ingiphakamisele edwaleni.” Amahubo 27:5. UKrestu laye wakhuluma wathi: “Hambani bantu bami, lingene emakamelweni enu, livale iminyango yenu ngemva kwenu, licatshe okwesikhatshana, luze ludlule ulaka. Ngoba khangelani, iNkosi iyaphuma endaweni yayo ukuthi ijezise abahlali bomhlaba ngenxa yobubi babo; lomhlaba uzaveza igazi lawo, ungabe usabafihla ababuleweyo bawo. Isaya 26:20,21. Kuzaba ligugu elimangalisayo ukukhululwa kwalabo abazabe belindele ukuza kwakhe ngokubekezela njalo abalamabizo abo alotshwe encwadini yokuphila. {GC 634.1}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 40 — Ukukhululwa Kwabantu BakaNkulunkulu

Ngesikhathi lapho ukuvikela okuvela emthethweni yelizwe sekususiwe kulabo abalandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu, kuzakuba khona endaweni ezehlukeneyo, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu abazabe besenza imizamo yokuthi babulawe. Nxa isikhathi esibekelwe ukubulawa kwabo silokhe sisondela, abantu bazabuya lamacebo wokuthi babulale iqula labantu laba abazabe belenkolo engajwayelekanga emehlweni abo. Kuzahlelwa ukuthi bahlaselwe ngobusuku obubodwa, ukwenzela ukuthi kuthuliswe amazwi abantu laba abangavumelani lozulu wonke njalo abahlala belamazwi okukhuza isono. {GC 635.1}

Abantu bakaNkulunkulu, abanye abazabe besentolongweni, abanye becatshile ezihotsheni njalo lasezintabeni, bazabe belokhe bencenga ukuthi bavikelwe lizulu, ngesikhathi esifananayo endaweni zonke kuzabe kulamaqembu amadoda ahlomileyo, azabe efuqwa ngamadimoni, belungiselela umsebenzi wokubulala. Kungaphansi kwesikhathi lesi esinzima kangaka, lapho iNkosi yakoIsrayeli ezangenela khona ekukhululweni kwabakhethekileyo bayo. INkosi ithi: “Lizakuba lengoma, njengeyobusuku bokwehlukaniswa komkhosi, lokuthokoza kwenhliziyo njengohamba...esiya entabeni yeNkosi, eDwaleni lakoIsrayeli. INkosi izazwakalisa-ke ilizwi layo elilodumo, ibonakalise ukwehla kwengalo yayo, ngentukuthelo yolaka, lelangabi lomlilo oqothulayo, isivunguvungu, lezulu lesiphepho, langesiqhotho. Isaya 30:29,30. {GC 635.2}

Ngokumemeza kokunqoba, langamazwi enhlamba njalo lawentukuthelo, amaxuku amadoda azabe eselungiselela ukubahlasela, lapho okuzaqubuka khona emhlabeni wonke umnyama, ojule okwedlula ubunyama obujwayele ukubonakala ebusuku kuphela. Ngemva kwalokho kuzabonakala umchilo wamakhosikazi, ozabe ukhazimula ngenkazimulo ephuma esihlalweni sikaNkulunkulu, uzagcwala indawo yonke kubonakale sengathi usibekela bonke abakhulekela ukukhululwa. Amaxuku abantu laba abalentukuthelo azakuma khonapho khonapho. Amazwi abo awokuhleka ulunya azahle aphele. Bazakhohlwa ngalabo abekade befuna ukubabulala. Ngamehlo agcwele ukwesaba bazakhangela isibonelo sesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu njalo bazafisa ukuba bafihlwe phambi kwenkazimulo yaso ezabe ingakhangeleki. {GC 635.3}

Abantwana bakaNkulunkulu bazakuzwa ilizwi, elingathi yingoma lisithi, “Khangelani phezulu,” njalo bazathi bekhangelisa amehlo abo ezulwini, babone umkhumbi wesithembiso. Amayezi abekade evale isibhakabhaka azasuswa, njalo njengoStefani bazakhangela phezulu babone inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu njalo leNdodana yomuntu ihleli esihlalweni sayo. Esimeni sakhe sobuNkulunkulu bazabona amanxeba okuhlazwa kwakhe, njalo endebeni zakhe bazakuzwa isicelo azasenza phambi kukaYise njalo laphambi kwezingilosi esokuthi: “Ngiyafisa ukuba labo, onginike bona, bebelami lapho engikhona.” Johane 17:24. Ngokwesibili ilizwi elingathi yingoma njalo elilokunqoba lizezwakala lisithi: “Bayeza! Bayeza! Bangcwele, balungile, njalo abalasici. Baligcinile ilizwi lokubekezela kwami; bazakuhamba phakathi kwezingilosi;” njalo indebe ezomileyo, njalo leziqhaqhazelayo ezalabo ababambelele ekukholweni kwabo zizamemeza amazwi okunqoba. {GC 636.1}

Kuphakathi kobusuku lapho uNkulunkulu azabonakalisa khona amandla akhe okukhulula abantu bakhe. Ilanga liyaphuma, likhanyisa ngamandla alo wonke. Izibonakaliso zilandelana ngesiphangiphangi. Ababi bakhangela isehlakalo lesi ngokwesaba njalo langokumangala, kuthi ngakolunye uhlangothi abangcwele bakhangela ngentokozo ecolekileyo izibonakaliso zokukhululwa kwabo. Zonke izinto zemvelo zizabonakala sengathi sezisuke emgwaqweni wazo. Imifula iyama ukugeleza. Amayezi amnyama kakhulu aqala ukutshayana. Phakathi kwesibhakabhaka esibonakala sizondile kukhona isikhexe esilenkazimulo engachasisekiyo, lapho okuphuma khona ilizwi likaNkulunkulu elizwakala sengathi ngamanzi amanengi lisithi: “Sekuphelile.” Sambulo 16:17. {GC 636.2}

Ilizwi lelo lizamazamisa izulu lomhlaba. Kubakhona ukuzamazama okukhulu, “kwasekusiba lokuzamazama komhlaba okulamandla kangaka, okukhula kangaka.” Sambulo 16:17,18. Isibhakabhaka sibonakala sengathi siyavuleka njalo sibuye sivaleke. Inkazimulo evelela esihlalweni sikaNkulunkulu ibonakala nxa isibhakabhaka silokhe sivuleka. Izintaba ziqhaqhazela njengomhlanga uvunguzwa ngumoya, njalo lamadwala awela endaweni zonke ngolaka. Kuzwakala umdumo ongathi ngowezulu elikhulu elizayo. Ulwandle luphenduka lube lolaka olwesabekayo. Kuzwakala ukukhala kwesivunguvungu sengathi ngamazwi amadimoni asemsebenzini wokubulala. Umhlaba wonke uyazula njalo uzamazame njengamagagasi olwandle. Umhlaba uqala ukudabuka. Kubonakale sengathi isisekelo sawo sesisiwa. Intaba ziqala ukutshona phansi. Izihlenge zonke ezihlala abantu ziyatshabalala. Indawo lapho okuma khona izikepe eseziphenduke zafana leSodoma ngenxa yobubi obukuzo ziginywa ngamagagasi olwandle. IBhabhiloni elikhulu selikhunjuliwe phambi kaNkulunkulu, “ukuba linikwe inkezo yewayini yolaka lwakhe olwesabekayo.” Amatshe esiqhotho esikhulu alesilinganiso sethalenta (34 kg) lawo azabe esenza umsebenzi wawo wokubhidliza. Sambulo 16:17,21. Amadolobho abekade elokuziqhenya emhlabeni atshabalaliswa alingane lenhlabathi. Izindlu ezifana lezamakhosi lapho abantu abachithe khona imali yabo ukwenzela ukuba basuthise inkanuko zabo, ziyaqephuka zibe ngamanxuwa phambi kwamehlo abo. Imiduli yentolongweni idabuka phakathi, njalo abantu bakaNkulunkulu, asebekade begcinwe lapha njengezibotshwa ngenxa yokholo lwabo, bayakukhululwa. {GC 636.3}

Amangcwaba ayakuvuleka, njalo “abanengi babo abalele othulini lomhlaba...bazakuvuka, abanye besiya ekuphileni okunaphakade, njalo abanye bavukele ihlazo lokuhlekwa okunaphakade. Danyeli 12:2. Bonke abafe bekholwa udaba lwengilosi yesithathu baphuma emathuneni bekhazimulisiwe, ukuze bazwe isivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu sokuthula azasenza lalabo abagcine imilayo yakhe. “Ngitsho lalabo abamgwazayo” (Sambulo 1:7), labo abahleka ulunya njalo beyisa ubuhlungu uKrestu adlula kibo, labo bonke abaphikisa iqiniso ngodlakela, bayavuswa labo ukuze bambone uKrestu ebukhosini bakhe lokuthi babone inhlonipho ezanikwa labo abathembekileyo labalandela imilayo kaNkulunkulu. {GC 637:1}

Amayezi amnyama alokhe evale isibhakabhaka, kodwa loba kunjalo ilanga lilokhe lithutsha phakathi kwamayezi, libonakala njengelihlo likaJehova elokuphindisela. Imbane eyesabekayo ilokhe itshaya emhlabeni wonke ize yembese umhlaba wonke ngengubo yomlilo. Phezu komdumo wezulu, amazwi angajwayelekanga njalo amabi azezwakala esitsho lokho okumele kwehlele abenzi bokubi. Amazwi lawa akhulunywayo awazwisiswa ngumuntu wonke, kodwa ezwakala ngokucaca endlebeni zabafundisi bamanga. Labo esikhathini esifitshane esiqeda kwedlula abebekade beziqhenya njalo belokuzithemba, ngenxa yodlakela abalwenze ebantwini bakaNkulunkulu abagcina imiyalo yakhe, ngalesi isikhathi sebegcwele ukumangala njalo lokwesaba okukhulu. Ukukhala kwabo kuzwakala phezu komsindo ozabe uvela emidumeni ezabe isenzakala. Amadimoni lawo azakwamukela ubuNkulunkulu bukaKrestu njalo aqhaqhazele phambi kwamandla akhe, ngesikhathi esifananayo abantu bazabe bebubula becela uzwelo ngaphansi kokwesaba okukhulu. {GC 637.2}

Abaprofethi basendulo nxa babekhangele embonweni usuku lukaNkulunkulu bathi: “Qhinqani isililo, ngoba usuku lweNkosi lusondele; njengokuchitheka okuvela kuSomandla luzafika.” Isaya 13:6. “Ngena edwaleni, ucatshe othulini, ngenxa yokwesaba kweNkosi, langenxa yodumo lokuphakama kwayo. Amehlo aziqhenyayo omuntu azakwehliselwa phansi, lokuzikhukhumeza kwabantu kuzakhothanyiswa, leNkosi kuphela izaphakanyiswa ngalolosuku. Ngoba usuku lweNkosi yamabandla luzakuba phezu kwakhe wonke ozigqajayo lozikhukhumezayo, lumelane laye wonke ozophakamisayo, njalo athotshiswe.” “Ngalolosuku umuntu uzalahlela emagundwaneni lakubolulwane izithombe zakhe zesiliva lezithombe zakhe zegolide abazenzela yena ukuzikhonza, ukungena emifantwini yamadwala lezingoxweni zamawa, ngenxa yokwesabeka kweNkosi langenxa yodumo lokuphakama kwayo, lapho izavuka ukuqhaqhazelisa umhlaba. Isaya 2:10 -12,20,21. {GC 638.1}

Phakathi laphakathi kwamayezi kubonakala insaba zenkanyezi ezabe ikhanyisa phose okuphindwe kane nxa kuqathaniswa lobumnyama obuzabe bukhona. Ukukhanya lokhe kuzakuza njengamazwi aletha ithemba njalo lentokozo ebantwaneni bakaNkulunkulu abathembekileyo, kodwa kuzaba ngamazwi alukhuni njalo lawolaka kulabo abephule imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Labo abadele konke ngenxa kaKrestu ngalesi isikhathi bazabe sebephephile, sengathi bacatshe endlini yeNkosi esithekileyo. Sebedlule phakathi kokuhlolwa, njalo phambi komhlaba laphambi kwabo bonke abaphike iqiniso bazabe bebonisile ukwethembeka kulowo owabafelayo. Sekulenguquko emangalisayo kulabo abazabe bekhethe ukubambelela ekwenzeni okuhle ngitsho laphambi kokufa. Ngesikhathi bengakhangelelanga bazabe sebekhululiwe ebunyameni njalo lasebubini babantu abekade sebephenduke baba ngamadimoni. Ubuso babo obukade bubunile njalo butshaziwe, khathesi buzabe sebucwebezela ngentokozo, lokumangala, lokukholwa njalo langothando. Amazwi abo aphakama ngengoma yokunqoba: “UNkulunkulu uyisiphephelo sethu lamandla ethu, ufumaniswa elusizo kakhulu ekuhluphekeni. Ngenxa yalokhu kasiyikwesaba ekuguqukeni komhlaba, lanxa izintaba zithwalelwa phakathi kolwandle, amanzi alo ehlokoma, ekhaphazela, izintaba zizamazama ngokukhukhumala kwalo.” Amahubo 46:1-3. {GC 638.2}

Nxa amazwi lawa abonisa ukwethemba uNkulunkulu okungcwele esenyukela ezulwini, amayezi abuyela emuva, kubonakale isibhakabhaka esilezinkanyezi, ezikhazimula ngendlela emangalisayo nxa kuqathaniswa lesibhakabhaka esibonisa ubunyama lentukuthelo ngakolunye uhlangothi. Inkazimulo yomuzi ongcwele ibonakala iphuma emasangweni avuliweyo. Ngemva kwalokho kubonakala esibhakabhakeni isandla esithwele amatshe amabili azabe ephethwe elinye laba phezu kwelinye. Umprofethi uthi: “Lamazulu azatshumayela ukulunga kwakhe, ngoba uNkulunkulu ngokwakhe ungumahluleli.” Amahubo 50:6. Umthetho lowana ongcwele, oyikulunga kukaNkulunkulu, awakhulunywa phakathi kokuphazima njalo lemidumo entabeni yaseSinai njengomqondisi wempilo, khathesi uzaboniswa phambi kwabantu njengomthetho wokwahlulela. Isandla lesi sizavula amatshe lawa amabili, njalo kuzabonakala kiwo imilayo elitshumi, ezabe ingathi ibhalwe ngomlilo. Amazwi akhona acacile okokuthi wonke umuntu uyenelisa ukuwabala. Imikhumbulo izavuselelwa, bonke ubunyama bokukholwa amasiko njalo lemfundiso zamanga kuzasuswa engqondweni yomuntu wonke, njalo amazwi kaNkulunkulu alitshumi, angekho manengi, agoqela konke njalo alamandla, azabonakaliswa ukuze abonwe yibo bonke abakhileyo emhlabeni. {GC 639.1}

Kunzima ukuchaza ukwesaba njalo lokudangala kwalabo abakade bephila impilo yokwephula imilayo kaNkulunkulu. UNkulunkulu wabanika umlayo wakhe, babelalo ithuba lokuqathanisa izimilo zabo lawo njalo babezafunda amaphutha wabo ithuba lisesekhona elokuthi bavume izono zabo njalo baguquke, kodwa ukwenzela ukuthi bathole uthando lomhlaba, babeka eceleni imfundiso yawo njalo bafundisa abanye ukuba bawephule. Benzile imizamo yokuthi babambe ngamandla abantwana bakaNkulunkulu ukuba bephule usuku lweSabatha. Khathesi babona amacala abo ngenxa yomthetho yena lo abawuphikileyo. Ngokucaca okukhulu bayazibonela ukuthi ngeke benze izaba. Bakhethile lowo abakade befuna ukumhlonipha njalo lokumkhonza. “Beselibuya libona umehluko phakathi kolungileyo lomubi, phakathi kokhonza uNkulunkulu lalowo ongamkhonziyo.” Malaki 3:18. {GC 639.2}

Izitha zomlayo kaNkulunkulu, kusukela kubafundisi kusiya emalungeni ebandla, ngalesi isikhathi bazwisisa ngendlela entsha lokho okuliqiniso ndawonye lomsebenzi okwakumele bawenze. Babona sekungasela sikhathi sokulungisa amaphutha abo ukuthi iSabatha lomthetho wesine liluphawu lukaNkulunkulu ophilayo. Babona isikhathi sesiphelile iqiniso mayelana losuku lwabo abekade belenza isabatha njalo lokuthi bebesakhela phezu kwetshebetshebe. Bazananzelela ukuthi bebelwisana loNkulunkulu. Abaholi bamabandla bakhokhelele abantu ekulwahlweni ngesikhathi bona bebesithi babaholela eParadayisi. Kuphela ngosuku lokwahlulelwa kuzakwazakala ubukhulu bomlandu ophezu kwamahlombe alabo abanikwe izikhundla emabandleni njalo lobukhulu bomphumela wokungathembeki kwabo. Kuphela nxa sesisezulwini yikho esizananzelela khona intengo yokulahlekelwa ngumphefumulo owodwa. Kuzakwesabeka ukuhlulukelwa kwalowo uNkulunkulu azakuthi kuye: Suka phambi kwami wena sisebenzi esibi. {GC 640.1}

Ilizwi likaNkulunkulu lizezwakala liphuma ezulwini, liveza usuku njalo lehola lokuza kukaJesu, njalo lizaphawula isivumelwano esiphakade phambi kwabantu bakhe. Njengomsindo womdumo wezulu omkhulu amazwi akhe azezwakala emhlabeni wonke. UIsrayeli kaNkulunkulu uzabe elalele, ebhekise amehlo akhe ezulwini. Ubuso babo buzakhazimuliswa yinkazimulo yakhe, njalo buzacwebezela njengobuso bukaMose nxa wayesehla entabeni yaseSinai. Abantu ababi abasoke benelise ukubakhangela ebusweni. Njalo ngesikhathi lapho isibusiso silethwa kulabo abahloniphe uNkulunkulu ngokugcina iSabatha lakhe ngcwele, kuzezwakala amazwi amakhulu okunqoba. {GC 640.2}

Ngemva kwesikhatshana kubonakala iyezi elimnyama elincinyane, elizabe lingathi lilingana lengxenye yesandla somuntu. Leli kuliyezi eligombolozele uMsindisi nxa lisesekhatshana elizabonakala sengathi lembeswe yibunyama. Abantu bakaNkulunkulu bayabakwazi ukuthi lesi yisibonakaliso sokuza kweNdodana yomuntu. Ngokuthula okucolekileyo bayalikhangela nxa lilokhe lisondela emhlabeni, lilokhe likhula njalo likhazimula kakhulu nxa lisondela, lizelibonakale njengeyezi elikhulu elimhlophe, ngaphansi kwalo kulenkazimulo enjengomlilo ovuthayo, njalo phezu kwalo kulomchilo wamakhosikazi owesivumelwano. UJesu uphakathi kwalo iyezi leli njengomnqobi. Khathesi, kaseyiyo “iNdoda yensizi,” ukuba aphuze inkezo emunyu yokubuhlungu njalo lokuyangeka, uza njengomnqobi ezulwini njalo lasemhlabeni, ukuzokwahlulela abaphilayo labafileyo. “Uthembekile njalo ulungile,” “ngokulunga uyehlulela njalo ulwa impi.” Njalo “lamabutho ayesezulwini” (Sambulo 19:11,14) amlandela. Ngezingoma ezilobunandi basezulwini ingilosi, ngobunengi bazo obungelakubalwa, zihamba laye. Isibhakabhaka sibonakala sengathi sigcwele izidalwa ezicwebezelayo- “izinkulungwane ezilitshumi, lezinkulunkungwane zezinkulungwane.” Akukho usiba lomuntu olungenelisa ukuchaza isehlakalo lesi, ayikho lengqondo yenyama engaqedisisa ubuhle baso. “Inkazimulo yakhe yasibekela amazulu, umhlaba wagcwala indumiso yakhe. Ukucwazimula kwakhe kwakunjengokukhanya, imisebe yavela esandleni sakhe.” Habhakhukhi 3:3,4. Nxa amayezi lawa aphilayo elokhe esondela, wonke amehlo ayayibona iNkosi yokuphila. Awusekho umqhele wameva ukulimaza ikhanda lakhe elingcwele, kodwa kukhona umqhele wobukhosi ekhanda lakhe. Ubuso bakhe bukhanya okwedlula ukukhanya kwelanga emini enkulu. “Njalo esembhathweni lethangazini lakhe ulebizo elibhalwe ukuthi: INKOSI YAMAKHOSI LOMBUSI WABABUSI.” Sambulo 19:16. {GC 640.3}

Phambi kwakhe “ubuso bonke buzaguquka bubune;” kulabo abaphika umusa wakhe kwehla ukwesaba okungapheliyo. “Inhliziyo izakuncibilika, njalo lamadolo atshayane ngokwesaba...njalo lobuso babo bonke buzaphenduka bube mnyama. Jeremiya 30:6, Nahume 2:10. Abalungileyo bazakhala ngokuqhaqhazela besithi: “Ngubani ozakwenelisa ukuma na?” Ingoma ebikade ihlatshelwa zingilosi izakuma, kubekhona isikhathi lapho kuthule kuthe cwaka. Ngemva kwalokho kube sekuzwakala ilizwi likaJesu lisithi: “Umusa wami ulifanele lina.” Ubuso babo bonke abangcwele buzakhazimula, njalo intokozo igcwale enhliziyweni zabo bonke. Ingilosi zizakhweza ingoma yazo zihlabele kakhulu nxa zilokhe zisondela emhlabeni. {GC 641.1}

INkosi yamakhosi izakuza ngeyezi, igonjolezelwe ngumlilo ovuthayo. Isibhakabhaka sizagoqwa njengomqulu, lomhlaba uzaqhaqhazela phambi kwakhe, njalo lazo zoke intaba lezihlenge zizasuswa endaweni yazo. “UNkulunkulu wethu uzakuza, kayikuthula; umlilo phambi kwakhe uzaqothula, enhlangothini zonke zakhe kuzakuba lesiphepho esikhulu. Uzabiza amazulu ephezulu, lomhlaba, ukwahlulela abantu bakhe.” Amahubo 50:3,4. {GC 641.2}

“Lamakhosi omhlaba lezikhulu, labanothileyo, lenduna ezinkulu, labalamandla, lazo zonke izigqili, labo bonke abakhululekileyo, bacatsha ezimbalwini lemadwaleni ezintaba, besithi ezintabeni lemadwaleni: Welani phezu kwethu, lisifihle ebusweni bakhe ohlezi esihlalweni sobukhosi, lelakeni lweWundlu; ngoba usuku olukhulu lolaka lwakhe selufikile; njalo ngubani olamandla okuma?” Sambulo 6:15-17. {GC 642.1}

Konke ukuhleka ulunya lokuchothoza kuzabe sekumile. Zonke indebe ebezithanda ukukhuluma amanga zizathula cwaka. Konke ukulwa ngezikhali, lomsindo wempi, “olomsindo wokudideka, njalo lezembatho ezigcwele igazi” (Isaya 9:5), uzathula. Akukho okunye okuzezwakala ngalesi isikhathi ngaphandle kwamazwi omthandazo lamazwi okukhala lokububula. Ukukhala lokhu kuzaphuma emilonyeni ebikade ihleka ulunya: “Usuku lolaka lwakhe olukhulu selufikile, ngubani ozakwenelisa ukuma na?” Bonke ababi bazakhulekela ukuthi bagqitshelwe ngaphansi kwamadwala ezintaba kulokuthi bahlangane lobuso balowo abamphikileyo njalo bala ukumamukela. {GC 642.2}

Ilizwi leliyana elifinyelela ngitsho lendlebe zabafileyo bazabe belazi. Bekukangaki ilizwi leli libancenga ukuthi baphenduke. Balizwe kangaki libathinta livela ekuncengeni komngane, lokomfowabo, lokoMsindisi. Kulabo abaphika umusa wakhe akukho elinye eliletha icala, eliletha njalo ukuqondiswa, njengalelo lizwi ebelikade labancenga lisithi: “Tshiyani ke, tshiyani indlela zenu ezimbi, ngoba lizafelani, lina ndlu kaIsrayeli.” Hezekeli 33:11. Maye kibo, sengathi ilizwi leli bekulilizwi lomuntu abangamaziyo! UJesu wathi: “Ngoba ngibizile, kodwa layala, ngelulile isandla sami, kodwa kakho onanzayo, ladelela zonke izeluleko zami, kalivumanga ukukhuza kwami.” Zaga 1:24,25. Ilizwi leli lizavusa imikhumbulo abafisa ukuthi ngabe bayayicitsha engqondweni, bazakhumbula izixwayiso abazeyisileyo, unxuso abaluphikileyo, lamathuba abawatshaye indiva. {GC 642.3}

Kuzabe kulalabo njalo abachothoza uKrestu ngesikhathi nxa wayedlula phakathi kokuyangiswa kwakhe. Ngamandla amakhulu kuzafika emikhumbulweni yabo amazwi akhe nxa wayedlula ekuhluphekeni, nxa wayebuzwa ngumpristi omkhulu, waphendula wathi: “Kusukela khathesi lizabona iNdodana yomuntu ihlezi ngakwesokunene samandla isiza phezu kwamayezi ezulu.” Mathewu 26:64. Khathesi bazabe sebembona enkazimulweni yakhe, njalo bazabe besazakumbona ehleli ngakwesokunene samandla. {GC 643.1}

Bonke abachothoza amazwi akhe okuthi yena wayeyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu bazakutsha amathe khathesi. Uzabe ekhona uHerodi owahleka ulunya isikhundla sakhe sobukhosi njalo watshela abebutho ababemchothoza ukuthi bamfake umqhele njengenkosi. Azabe ekhona amadoda asebenzisa izandla zawo ukuba amgqokise isembatho esiyibubende, njalo ekhanda lakhe afaka umqhele wameva, njalo ezandleni zakhe ezingazange zibalwise ababeka intonga yobukhosi eyayingeyokumchothoza, labo abamkhothamelayo ngendlela eyayingeyokuchothoza izulu ngokwalo. Amadoda amatshayayo njalo bakhafulela iNkosi yokuphila, ngalesi isikhathi bazafulathela ilihlo lakhe elizabe lingathi liyahlaba, njalo bazazama ukumbalekela. Labo ababethela izipikili ezandleni njalo lasenyaweni zakhe, lebutho elamgwaza ehlangothini, bazabona amanxeba lawa ngokwesaba njalo lokuzisola. {GC 643.2}

Ngokucaca okukhulu abapristi njalo lababusi bazakhumbula izehlakalo zaseKhalivari. Ngokwethuka lokwesaba okukhulu bazakhumbula indlela abanikina amakhanda abo ngentokozo eyayiholelwa nguSathane besithi: “Wasindisa abanye yena angezisindise. Uba eyiNkosi yakoIsrayeli kehle khathesi esiphambanweni futhi sizakumkholwa. Wathemba kuNkulunkulu; kamkhulule khathesi uba emthanda. Ngoba wathi: NgiyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu.” Mathewu 27:42,43. {GC 643.3}

Bazakhumbula ngokucaca okukhulu amazwi oMsindisi awakhuluma mayelana lendatshana yamadoda ayengabagcini besivini abayala ukunika umnikazi izithelo zesivini sakhe, baphinda njalo baphatha ngochuku izithunywa ayezithumile njalo ekucineni babulala indodana yakhe. Bazakhumbula njalo lesigwebo abasiphawulayo bona ngokwabo nxa babesithi: Inkosi yesivini “izabulala wonke amadoda lawa amabi kangaka.” Esonweni njalo lasekujezisweni kwamadoda lawa ayengathembekanga abapristi ndawonye labaholi bazabona indlela yabo njalo lesiphetho sabo esifaneleyo. Njalo ngalesi isikhathi kuzezwakala ukukhala kobuhlungu okungelamkhawulo. Ukukhala lokhu kuzabe kukukhulu okwedlula amazwi abawatsho nxa babesithi, “Akabethelwe, akabethelwe,” azwakala emigwaqeni yaseJerusalema, ngalesi isikhathi kuzezwakala ukukhala kwamazwi athi, “UyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu! UnguMesiya weqiniso!” Bazazama ukubaleka phambi kweNkosi yaMakhosi. Phakathi kwembalu ezizabe zisemhlabeni ngenxa yokuzamazama okuzabe kusanda kwenzakala, bazazama ukuzifihla ngeze. {GC 643.4}

Empilweni zabantu bonke abakhetha ukuphika iqiniso kubakhona izikhathi lapho umzwangedwa ovuka khona, lapho imikhumbulo yabo ebadlulisa phakathi kokuzisola ngenxa yokuphila impilo ephambene leqiniso. Kodwa konke lokhu kuyini nxa kuqathaniswa lokuzisola okuzakwenzeka ngosuku lolu olukhulu lapho “ukwesaba ukuzakhona njengokutshabalala,” lapho ukubhidliza okuzakuza khona njengesavunguzane!” Zaga 1:27. Labo abekade belungiselela ukubulala uKrestu njalo labantu bakhe abathembekileyo khathesi bazabona inkazimulo ezabe isiphezu kwabo. Phakathi kokwesaba kwabo bazakuzwa amazwi abasindisiweyo eqala ingoma emnandi esithi: “Khepha lowu nguNkulunkulu wethu; kade simlindele, njalo uzasikhulula.” Isaya 25:9. {GC 644.1}

Phakathi kokuzamazama komhlaba, lokuphazima kombani, njalo lomdumo wezulu, ilizwi leNdodana kaNkulunkulu lizabiza bonke abangcwele abaleleyo othulini lomhlaba. Uzakhangela wonke amangcwaba abangcwele, njalo aphakamisele ezulwini izandla zakhe amemeze athi: “Vukani, vukani, vukani, lina elilele othulini, njalo phakamani!” Kuzozonke indawo emhlabeni bonke abafileyo bazakulizwa ilizwi lakhe, njalo labo abazakulizwa bazakuphila. Njalo wonke umhlaba uzaduma ngenxa yezisindo zebutho leli elikhulu kangaka elizabe libunjwe ngabantu abavela kuwo wonke amazwe, lemihlobo njalo lezindimi zonke. Bazaphuma entolongweni yokufa, begqoke inkazimulo ephakade, bememeza besithi: “Kufa lungaphi udonsi lwakho? Ngcwaba kungaphi ukunqoba kwakho na?” 1 Korinte 15:55. Njalo abangcwele abaphilayo labangcwele abazabe sebevusiwe bazalumbanisa amazwi abo bememeza amazwi okunqoba. {GC 644.2}

Bonke baphuma emangcwabeni belesimo sokubunjwa esifana laleso abangena emathuneni belaso. UAdamu laye umile ndawonye lexuku leli elivusiweyo, usesimeni sakhe esihlukileyo ngoba umude njalo ulesimo sobukhosi kodwa umfitshane kancane kuleNdodana kaNkulunkulu. Ubonisa umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwakhe lezizukulwane ezaphila ngemva kwakhe, esibonelweni lesi esisodwa kuzabonakala ukuwa kwesimo okwenzeka ebantwini ngenxa yesono. Kodwa bonke bavuka belobutsha njalo lamandla okuba mutsha okunaphakade. Ekuqaleni umuntu wayedalwe ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu, hatshi ngokwesimo kuphela, kodwa langokubunjwa njalo langesimo. Isono saphambanisa umfanekiso lowu saze saphosa sasusa umfanekiso kaNkulunkulu, kodwa uKrestu wabuya ukuba avuselele lokho okwasekulahlekile. Uzaguqula imizimba yethu yobubi njalo ayenze ukuba ifane lomzimba wakhe ongcwelisiweyo. Isimo esibolayo, lesilesono, esingelakho ukuzotha, esaphanjaniswa yisono, sizaguqulwa sibemsulwa, sibesihle, njalo sibe lokuphila okuphakade. Konke ukugogeka lokukhubezeka kuzasala ethuneni. Nxa sebefinyelele esihlahleni sokuphila ensimini yaseEdeni eyalahlekela umuntu kudala, bonke abahlengiweyo “bazakhula” (Malaki 4:2) babelesimo esigcweleyo umuntu ayelaso ngesikhathi esaphila ebukhosini bakhe. Bonke ubufakazi bokucina besiqalekiso sesono buzasuswa, njalo abathembekileyo bakaKrestu bazabonakala “ebuhleni beNkosi yethu uNkulunkulu,” engqondweni njalo lasemoyeni njalo lasemzimbeni beveza isimo esipheleleyo seNkosi yabo. Yeka ubuhle bokuhlengwa! Osekukade kwakhulunywa ngakho, osekukade kwamelelwa, kwakhulunywa ngakho ngokulangazelela okukhulu, kodwa okungazange kwazwisiswa ngokuphelela. {GC 644.3}

Bonke abangcwele abaphilayo bazakuguqulwa “ngesikhatshane lasekucwayizeni kwelihlo.” Ngenxa yelizwi elaphuma kuNkulunkulu bazabe sebengcwelisiwe njalo khathesi bazamukela imizimba engelakubola njalo ndawonye labangcwele abazabe sebevusiwe bazakwenyukela ezulwini ukuba bahlangane leNkosi emkhathini. Ingilosi “zizabuthela ndawonye bonke abakhethiweyo bakhe emagumbini amane omhlaba, kusukela ekucineni ngasentshonalanga komhlaba kusiya empumalanga.” Abantwana abancane bazathwalwa zingilosi zibasa ezandleni zabo nina. Abangane asebekade bahlukana ngenxa yokufa bazahlangana njalo, bengasayikwehlukana njalo, njalo ngengoma zokujabula bazakwenyuka ndawonye besiya eDolobheni likaNkulunkulu. {GC 645.1}

Ngakuzo zonke inhlangothi zenqola yamayezi kulamaphiko, njalo ngaphansi kwayo kulamavili, njalo nxa inqola leyi isenyuka, amavili lawa akhala esithi, “Ngcwele,” njalo lamaphiko nxa ephapha akhala lawo athi, “Ngcwele’” lexuku lezingilosi lizakhala lithi, “Ngcwele, ngcwele, ngcwele, Nkosi Nkulunkulu Simakade.” Abasindisiweyo bamemeza bethi, “Aleluya!” nxa inqola leyi isenyuka isiya eJerusalema elitsha. {GC 645.2}

Bengakangeni eDolobheni likaNkulunkulu, uMsindisi uzabeka emakhanda abalandeli bakhe izicoco zokunqoba njalo uzabanika izembatho ezibonisa ubukhosi babo. Ibutho leli elicwebezelayo lizakuma kunxa zonke iNkosi yabo ibe phakathi kwabo, yena ulesimo esiphezu kwabo bonke ngitsho lezingilosi njalo ubuso bakhe bukhanyisa ubuso babo bonke bugcwele uthando. Amehlo wonke exuku leli elisindisiweyo ajolozela ubuso bakhe, bonke babona inkazimulo yakhe yena “ubuso bakhe obalinyazwa okwedlula wonke umuntu, njalo lesimo sakhe okwedlula wonke amadodana oluntu.” Emakhanda abanqobi, uJesu ngokwakhe usebenzisa isandla sakhe sokunene ukubeka imiqhele yobukhosi. Wonke umuntu uzakwamukela umqhele wakhe, ozabe ubhalwe “ibizo lakhe elitsha.” (Sambulo 2:17), njalo kuzabe kubhalwe amazwi athi, “Ubungcwele eNkosini.” Ezandleni zabo kuzabekwa ilala njalo lechacho elikhazimulayo. Kuzathi nxa ingilosi eziholayo ziqala ingoma, izandla zonke ziqala ukutshaya amachacho, kuzwakale ingoma emnandi kakhulu. Ingoma leyi izathokozisa inhliziyo zabo bonke, amazwi abo onke aphakanyiswe ngengoma yokubonga: “Kuye owasithandayo, wasigezisa ezonweni zethu egazini lakhe; owasenza saba ngamakhosi labapristi kuNkulunkulu uYise, kakube kuye ubukhosi lamandla kuze kube nini lanini.” Sambulo 1:5,6. {GC 645.3}

Phambi kwexuku labasindisiweyo kubonakala uMuzi oNgcwele. UJesu uzavula amasango ezulu, njalo z izizwe ezigcine iqiniso zizakungena. Lapho bazakubona iParadayisi kaNkulunkulu, indawo eyayingumuzi kaAdamu engakoni. Ngemva kwalokho ilizwi leliyana elimnandi okwedlula ingoma eseke yawela endlebeni zoluntu, lizezwakala lisithi: “Impi yenu isiphelile.” “Wozani lina elibusisiweyo bakaBaba, yibani zindlalifa zombuso elawulungiselwayo kusukela ekudabukeni komhlaba.” {GC 646.1}

Khathesi kuzagcwaliseka umthandazo kaKrestu awenzela abafundi bakhe: “Ngiyafisa njalo, ukuba labo onginike bona, labo babelami lapho engikhona.” “Bengelasici phambi kwenkazimulo yakhe belenjabulo engelakubalwa” (Juda 24), uKrestu uzaletha phambi kukaBaba isipho asithenga ngegazi lakhe, esithi: “Ngilapha ndawonye labantwana owangipha bona.” “Labo onginike bona ngibagcinile.” Yeka izimangaliso zothando olusindisayo! Ukuhlokoma kwehola lelo lapho uBaba, ozathi ekhangela ixuku labasindisiweyo, azabona khona umfanekiso wakhe, ukungcolisa kwesono sekususiwe, lobubi baso sebungasekho, njalo izidalwa zakhe ezizabe sezibuyele esimeni sokufana laye! {GC 646.2}

Ngothando olungabalisekiyo, uJesu uzakwamukela abathembekileyo bakhe entokozweni yeNkosi. Intokozo yoMsindisi izaba ngeyokubona, embusweni wenkazimulo, imphefumulo ezabe ihlengiwe ngenxa yobuhlungu njalo lokuyangiswa kwakhe. Njalo laba abasindisiweyo bazaba lengxenye entokozweni yakhe, nxa bekhangela, phakathi kwababusisiweyo, bazabona labo abanqotshelwe kuKrestu ngenxa yemithandazo yabo, lokusebenza kwabo, njalo lokuzidela abakwenza ngenxa yothando. Nxa bebuthana phambi kwesihlalo esimhlophe esikhulu, injabulo engalakubalwa izagcwala enhliziyweni zabo, nxa bebona labo ababanqobele embusweni kaKrestu, njalo nxa bebona ukuthi labo bazuza abanye, lalabo bazuza njalo abanye, bonke bazabe belethwe ekuphumuleni kwasezulwini, lapho abazabeka khona imiqhele yabo ezinyaweni zikaKrestu njalo bamdumise empilweni yonke ephakade abazaphila kuyo. {GC 647.1}

Nxa abasindisiweyo besamukelwa emzini kaNkulunkulu, kuzezwakala ukukhala kwentokozo endaweni yonke. OAdamu ababili bazabe sebelungiselela ukuhlangana. INdodana kaNkulunkulu izabe imile ngezandla ezivuliweyo ukwamukela uyise wezizukulwane zonke, isidalwa asidalayo, sahlamukela uMdali waso, njalo ngenxa yezono zakhe uMsindisi uzabe elamanxeba okubethelwa esiphambanweni. Nxa uAdamu enanzelela amanxeba ezandleni lasenyaweni zikaJesu, kasoze awele esifubeni seNkosi yakhe, kodwa ngokuzehlisa uzawela enyaweni zakhe, ekhala esithi: “Lifanele, lifanele iWundlu elahlatshwayo!” Ngothando uMsindisi uzakumphakamisa amtshele ukuba akhangele njalo insimu yase Edeni eyayingumuzi wakhe osekukade wahlukana lawo. {GC 647.2}

Ngemva kokuxotshwa kwakhe ensimini yase Edeni, impilo kaAdamu yayingeyosizi. Wonke amahlamvu ayesifa, zonke izinyamazana ezazibulawa, konke ukubuna okwakubonakala phezu kwendalo, bonke ububi obabubonakala ebantwini, kwakusiba yisikhumbuzo esitsha sokona kwakhe. Babunzima ubuhlungu njalo lokuzisola okwakufika enhliziyweni yakhe nxa wayebona ububi bulokhe busanda, njalo lempendulo ayeyithola emsebenzini wakhe wokukhuza isono. Impendulo ayeyithola yayingeyokuthi nguye owayeyimbangela yesono. Ngokuzehlisa njalo lokubekezela wathwala phose okweminyaka eyinkulungwane, isijeziso sokona kwakhe. Ngokwethembeka wavuma isono sakhe njalo wathembela emandleni oMsindisi owayethenjisiwe, njalo wafa elethemba lokuthi wayezaba lengxenye ekuvukeni. INdodana kaNkulunkulu yahlenga ukwehluleka njalo lokuwa komuntu, njalo khathesi ngenxa yomsebenzi wokubuyisana, uAdamu uzabiselwa esikhundleni sakhe sakuqala. {GC 647.3}

Phakathi kwentokozo uzabona izihlahla ezazimthokozisa endulo, zona kanye izihlahla ayesikha kuzo izithelo ngezinsuku zokulunga kwakhe njalo lezenjabulo. Uzabona izivini azinakekela ngezandla zakhe, njalo lamaluba ayethanda ukuwanakekela. Ingqondo yakhe izananzelela ukuqiniseka kwalokho okuzabe kuphambi kwakhe, uzananzelela ukuthi ngeqiniso leyi kuyinsimu yase Edeni esivuseleliwe yanikwa yena, njalo izabe isilobuhle obedlula ngesikhathi exotshwa kuyo. UMsindisi uzamholela esihlahleni sokuphila njalo uzakukha isithelo saso amnike ukuba asidle. Uzakhangela emuva kwakhe njalo abone ixuku lemuli yakhe esindisiweyo, bemile eParadayisi kaNkulunkulu. Uzabeka umqhele wakhe ocwebezelayo enyaweni zikaJesu njalo nxa ewela esifubeni sakhe, uzakwanga uMsindisi. Uzabamba ichacho legolide, njalo izulu lonke lizaqhunsa ingoma yokunqoba: “Lifanele, lifanele, lifanele iWundlu elahlatshwayo, njalo eliphilayo futhi!” Usendo luka Adamu lalo luzathatha amachacho alo babeke imiqhele yabo ezinyaweni zoMsindisi nxa bekhothama phambi kwakhe. {GC 648.1}

Ukuhlangana lokhu kuzabe kuphambi kwezingilosi ezakhala kakhulu ngosuku uAdamu awa ngalo njalo zabuya zathokoza lapho uJesu ngemva kokuvuka kwakhe, enyukela khona ezulwini, esevulile ingcwaba ukuba bonke abazamkholwa ngolunye usuku benelise ukuphuma kulo. Khathesi bazabe sebebona umsebenzi wokusindisa abantu usuphelile, njalo bazahlanganela ekuhlatshelweni kwengoma yokudumisa. {GC 648.2}

Elwandle lwezibuko phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi, lona okululwandle lwesibuko okungathi luxutshaniswe lomlilo, olugcwele inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu, kuzabuthana iqula “elanqoba isilo, njalo lomfanekiso waso, njalo lophawu lwaso, njalo lenombolo yebizo lakhe.” Ndawonye leWundlu entabeni yaseZiyoni, “belamachacho kaNkulunkulu,” bazakuma, inani labo lizinkulungwane ezilikhulu lamatshumi amane lane, okungabantu abahlengwa phakathi kwabantu njalo kuzawakala ilizwi elingathi ngamanzi amanengi, njalo okungathi ngumdumo omkhulu, “ilizwi labahlabeleli abatshaya amachacho abo.” Njalo bazahlabela: “ingoma entsha” phambi kwesihlalo, ingoma engeke yafundwa ngabanye abantu ngaphandle kwequla leli. Leyi yingoma kaMose njalo leyeWundlu, eyingoma yokuhlengwa. Akukho abanye ngaphandle kwequla leli elabantu abazinkulungwane ezilikhulu, lamatshumi amane lane, abangayifunda ingoma leyi ngoba iyingoma yenkambo abadlula kuyo, okuluhambo okungekho omunye umuntu ake aluhamba. “Laba yibo abalandela iWundlu kuzo zonke indawo ayakuzo.” Laba abathathwa emhlabeni phakathi kwabaphilayo, bazabalwa “njengezithelo zakuqala kuNkulunkulu laseWundlwini.” Sambulo 15:2,3: 14:1-5. “Laba yibo abadlula phakathi kokuhlupheka okukhulu;” bazabe sebedlule phakathi kwesikhathi senhlupheko esikhulu esingazange sibonakale selokhu kwadalwa izizwe, njalo bazabe benelise ukumelana lobuhlungu besikhathi sokuhlupheka kukaJakhobe, bazabe benelisile ukuma ngesikhathi kungekho oncengelayo ethempelini ngesikhathi lapho okwathelwa khona inkezo yolaka lukaNkulunkulu emhlabeni. Kodwa bazabe sebehlengiwe, ngoba “bazabe begezile izembatho zabo bazenza zabamhlophe egazini leWundlu.” “Emlonyeni wabo akutholakalanga isici, ngoba abalacala phambi kaNkulunkulu.” “Ngakho baphambi kwesihlalo sikaNkulunkulu, njalo bazakumkhonza emini lebusuku ethempelini lakhe: njalo lowo ahlala esihlalweni uzahlala phakathi kwabo.” Bazabe bebonile umhlaba uguga ngenxa yendlala njalo lemikhuhlane, lelanga liphiwa amandla okutshisa abantu, njalo bona ngokwabo bazabe bedlule phakathi kwendlala njalo lokomela amanzi. Kodwa khathesi “abasayikulamba futhi, kumbe bome futhi, lelanga alisayi kubatshisa kumbe loba yikuphi ukutshisa. Ngoba iWundlu eliphakathi laphakathi kwesihlalo lizabanika ukudla, njalo uzabahola emithonjeni ephilayo yamanzi; njalo uNkulunkulu uzakwesula inyembezi zonke emehlweni wabo.” Sambulo 7;14-17. {GC 648.3}

Kuzo zonke izizukulwane abakhethiweyo boMsindisi bafundisiwe njalo baqeqetshwa ngaphansi kwesikolo senhlupheko. Bahamba endleleni ezincane emhlabeni, bahlanjululwa phakathi komlilo wokuhlupheka. Ngenxa yegama likaJesu bamelana lokuphikiswa, lenzondo njalo lokuqanjelwa amanga. Bamlandela phakathi kokulwiswa okukhulu, bamelana lokuzidela njalo badlula phakathi kokudangala okukhulu. Ngenxa yenkambo zabo ezibuhlungu bafunda ukuthi isono sibi kangakanani, lamandla aso, lokuba lecala ngenxa yaso, lomphumela waso omubi njalo bazasikhangela njengento okumele yenyanywe. Ukuzinikela okwenziwa nguJesu ukwenzela ukuthi aqede isono kuzabenza babe lokuzehlisa njalo kuzagcwalisa inhliziyo zabo ngesibongo esikhulu njalo lokudumisa okungeke kuzwisiswe njalo kuqathaniswe lalabo abangazange bawele esonweni. Bazathanda kakhulu ngoba bethethelelwe kakhulu. Ngenxa yokuthi bazabe beke baphatheka ekuhluphekeni kukaKrestu, bazabe befanele ukuba baphatheke enkazimulweni yakhe. {GC 649.1}

Indlalifa zikaNkulunkulu zizabe ziphuma emilindini, lasemigodini, lasekulengisweni, lasezintabeni, lasenkangala, lasembalwini zomhlaba njalo lasembalwini zasolwandle. Emhlabeni “babengumhambuma, behlukumezekile njalo behlutshwa.” Izigidi zangena engcwabeni zisazakala njengezikliwi ngoba babezimisele ukwala ukwamukela amanga kaSathane. Emthethwandabeni yasemhlabeni bagwetshwa njengezephulamthetho ezesabekayo. Kodwa “khathesi uNkulunkulu uzabe esengumahluleli ngokwakhe.” Amahubo 50.6. Khathesi izinqumo ezenziwa emhlabeni zizaguqulwa. “Uzasusa ihlazo labantu bakhe.” Isaya 25:8. “Bazabizwa ngokuthi ngabantu abangcwele, abahlengiweyo beNkosi.” “Nginike labo abalilayo eZiyoni imiqhele endaweni yomlotha, lamafutha enjabulo endaweni yokulila, indumiso endaweni yomoya odanileyo.” Isaya 62:12, 61:3. Khathesi kuzabe sekudlulile ukuba buthakathaka, lokuhlukunyezwa, lokuhlakazwa njalo lokuncindezelwa. Kusukela khathesi bazahlala beleNkosi yabo kokuphela. Bazakuma phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi begqoke izembatho ezibonisa inotho eyedlula zonke esezike zagqokwa ngamakhosi alumhlaba. Bazabe begqoke imiqhele ekhazimula okwedlula yonke eseke yagqokiswa amakhosi alumhlaba. Izinsuku zobuhlungu njalo lokububula sezidlule kokuphela. INkosi yenkazimulo seyesulile inyembezi ebusweni babo, zonke imbangela zokulila sezisusiwe. Phakathi kokuzunguzwa kwengatsha zamalala, bazahlabela ingoma yokudumisa, emnandi njalo elolongiweyo, wonke umuntu uzangena ngelakhe ilizwi ize izwakale kulo lonke izulu: “Usindiso kuNkulunkulu wethu ohlezi phezu kwesihlalo, njalo lakulo iWundlu.” Njalo bonke abahlali bezulu bazaphendula labo ngamazwi athi: “Ameni, isibusiso, lenkazimulo, njalo lenhlakanipho, njalo lokubonga njalo lodumo, njalo lamandla, makube kuNkulunkulu wethu kuze kube nini lanini.” Sambulo 7:10,12. {GC 650.1}

Empilweni yalapha emhlabeni siyenelisa nje kuphela, ukuqala ukuzwisisa udaba lolu oluhle kangaka oluphathelene losindiso. Ngokuzwisisa kwethu okufipheleyo singakhangelisisa ihlazo njalo lenkazimulo, impilo njalo lokufa, ukufanela njalo lesihawu, okuhlangana esiphambanweni, kodwa loba kunjalo, loba singazama ukusebenzisa bonke ubungcitshi bengqondo zethu asenelisi ukuzwisisa ngokujulileyo ukuqakatheka kwesiphambano. Ubude lobubanzi, lokudepha kothando lokuhlenga kuzwisiseka nje kancane engqondweni zethu. Icebo losindiso alisoke lizwisiseke ngokuphelela kwalo, ngitsho lanxa abasindisiweyo bebona ngendlela ababonwa ngayo njalo besibakwazi ngendlela abazakala ngayo, kodwa eminyakeni eminengi ezakuza ezulwini amaqiniso amatsha azaqhubeka evezwa engqondweni ezizahlala zilokumangala njalo lentokozo. Loba nje inhlupho lobuhlungu njalo lezilingo zasemhlabeni zizabe zingasekho njalo lembangela yazo izabe isisusiwe, abantu bakaNkulunkulu bazahlala belolwazi olucacileyo mayelana lentengo yokusindiswa kwabo. {GC 651.1}

Isiphambano sikaKrestu sizahlala siyisifundo njalo lengoma yamasindisiweyo empilweni yonke ephakade. Ebukhosini bukaKrestu bazabona uKrestu ekubethelweni kwakhe. Akusoke kukhohlakale ukuthi yena ngamandla akhe owadala njalo wasekela imihlaba yonke, yena othandekayo kaNkulunkulu, iNkosi yasezulwini, yena izingilosi ezikhazimulayo ezazithanda ukumbuka, wakhetha ukuzehlisa ukwenzela ukuba aphakamise umuntu owayesewile, njalo lokuthi wathwala amacala njalo lehlazo lesono, njalo lokufihlwa kobuso bukaYise, kwazekwafika esikhathini lapho inhlupho zasemhlabeni ezephula khona inhliziyo yakhe njalo zacobodisa impilo yakhe yaze yaphuma esiphambanweni saseKhalivari. Ukuthi uMdali wezulu lomhlaba, uMlawuli wezinto zonke, wakhetha ukutshiya ubukhosi bakhe njalo wazifaka ihlazo ngenxa yokuthanda umuntu kuzahlala kuletha ukumangala njalo lokuthandwa ezidalweni zonke. Nxa izizwe zonke zabahlengiweyo zikhangela uMsindisi wazo njalo nxa zikhangela inkazimulo kaBaba ezabe ikhazimula ebusweni bakhe, nxa bekhangela isihlalo sakhe, esizabe sisuka ekungaphelini sisiya ekungaphelini, njalo nxa besibakwazi ukuthi umbuso wakhe awusayi kuba lesiphetho, bazaqala ingoma ethi: “Lifanele, lifanele iWundlu elahlatshwayo, njalo elisihlengele kuNkulunkulu ngenxa yegazi lakhe eliligugu!” {GC 651.2}

Imfihlo yesiphambano yiyo elamandla okuchasisa zonke imfihlo. Ekukhanyeni okuphuma eKhalivari zonke izinto ezimayelana loNkulunkulu ezazijwayele ukusesabisa zizaqala ukubonakala ebuhleni lasekuthathekiseni kwazo. Isihawu, lesineke njalo lothando lomzali konke kuzabonakala kubambana lobungcwele, lokulunga njalo lamandla. Nxa sikhangela ubukhosi besihlalo sakhe, esizabe siphakeme, sizabona isimilo sakhe emuseni ozabe ubonisiwe, njalo sizazwisisa okwedlula zonke izikhathi, ukuqakatheka kwebizo elithi, “Baba wethu.” {GC 652.1}

Kuzabonakala ukuthi lowo olenhlakanipho engapheliyo wayengeke asungule elinye icebo lokusisindisa ngaphandle kokunikela iNdodana yakhe. Isithelo sokuzinikela lokhu sizaba yinjabulo yokugcwalisa umhlaba ngabantu abahlengiweyo, abazabe belobungcwele, bethabile njalo bengasayi kwamukela ukufa. Impumela yokulwisana lamandla obunyama okwenziwa nguMsindisi izaba yinjabulo yabahlengiweyo, abazahlala enkazimulweni kaNkulunkulu okweminyaka engelakubalwa. Njalo lesi yiso isisindo somphefumulo okuzakwenza ukuthi uBaba asuthiseke ngentengo ayibhadalayo, njalo loKrestu uqobo lwakhe, nxa ekhangela izithelo sokuzidela kwakhe, uzaba lokusuthiseka. {GC 652.2}

@@CHAPTER@@ Isahluko 41 — Ukubhidlizwa komhlaba

“Ngoba izono zayo zixhumene zaze zafika ezulwini, loNkulunkulu ukhumbulile ukungalungi kwayo...Phindiselani kuyo inkezo njengokuphindisela kwayo kini, liphinde kabili kuyo njengokwemisebenzi yayo, enkezweni eyigcwalisileyo, gcwalisani kiyo ngesilinganiso esiphindwe kabili. Njengokuzidumisa okungaka, ezitika enothweni ngokunjalo ubuhlungu lokulila kupheni yona, ngoba ithi enhliziyweni yayo: Ngihlezi ngiyindlovukazi njalo kangisuye umfelokazi, futhi kangisoze ngabona ukulila. Ngakho zizafika ngosuku lunye izinhlupheko zayo, ukufa lokulila lendlala, futhi izatshiswa ngomlilo, ngoba ilamandla iNkosi uNkulunkulu eyigwebayo. Lamakhosi omhlaba aphinga layo ezitika enothweni azayikhalela alile ngenxa yayo, lapho ebona intuthu yokutsha kwayo, esima khatshana ngokwesaba kobuhlungu bayo esithi: Maye maye, umuzi omkhulu iBhabhiloni, umuzi olamandla, ngoba ngehola elilodwa isigwebo sakho sifikile!” Sambulo 18:5-10. {GC 653.1}

“Labathengisi bomhlaba,” abazuze “inotho ngamandla okuzitika ngenotho yayo,” “bazakuma khatshana ngokwesabeka kobuhlungu bayo, bekhala belila, njalo besithi: Maye maye, lomuzi omkhulu owawembathiswe ngelembu elicolekileyo kakhulu lokuyibubende lokubomvu ucecisiwe ngegolide lelitshe eliligugu lamapharele! Ngoba ngehola elilodwa inotho engaka ichithiwe.” Sambulo 18:11, 3, 15-17. {GC 653.2}

Zinjalo izijeziso ezehlela phezu kweBhabhiloni ngosuku lapho ezakwethekelelwa khona lulaka lukaNkulunkulu. Ngaleso isikhathi izabe isigcwalisile isilinganiso sokona kwayo, njalo isikhathi salo sizabe sesifikile, izabe isilungele ukubhidlizwa. {GC 653.3}

Lapho ilizwi likaNkulunkulu seliguqula ukuthunjwa kwabantu bakhe, kuzaba lokuvuka phakathi kwalabo abazabe sebelahlekelwe yikho konke okubalulekileyo empini yempilo. Ngesikhathi umusa usavuliwe bavumela ukuthi uSathane abavale amehlo ngenxa yokudukisa kwakhe, njalo benza imizamo yokuvikela indlela yabo yokona. Izinothi zazilokuzikhukhumeza ngenxa yokuthi babengcono kulabaswelayo, kodwa babethole inotho yabo ngokwephula imilayo kaNkulunkulu. Babeyekelile ukunakekela abalambileyo, lokwembesa labo abahamba ze, lokuphatha kahle abanye njalo lokuthanda isihawu. Ekuphileni kwabo babehlala bezikhukhumeza befuna ukuba bakhothanyelwe ngabantu ababengaphansi kwabo. Ngalesi isikhathi bazabe sebelahlekelwe yikho konke obekubenza bazibone bengcono njalo bazabe sebengasela lutho njalo bengaselakho ukuzivikela. Bazakhangela ngokwesaba nxa bebona ukubhidlizwa kwezithixo lezi abaziphakamisa okwedlula uMdali wabo. Bazabona ukuthi bathengisile imphefumulo yabo enothweni yasemhlabeni njalo lokuzithokozisa kwawo, njalo bayekelile ukudinga inotho eholela kuNkulunkulu. Impumela yakhona yikuthi impilo zabo zizabonisa ukuthi behlulekile, konke obekubajabulisa sekuphenduke kwaba munyu, lenotho yabo isiyize. Konke abakuzuze ngenxa yokusebenza okwempilo yabo yonke kuzatshabalala ngomzuzu owodwa. Bonke abanothileyo bazakhalela ukubhidlizwa kwezindlu zabo ezinhle kakhulu, lokuhlakazeka kwegolide njalo lesiliva sabo. Kodwa ukukhala kwabo kuzathuliswa yikwesaba ukuthi labo bazabhujiswa ndawonye lezithombe zabo. {GC 654.1}

Ababi bafikelwa yikuzisola, hatshi ngenxa yokuthi abazange banake uNkulunkulu labantu abakade bephila labo, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi uNkulunkulu esenqobile. Bakhala ukuthi impumela yakho konke iyilokho esiyikho khona, kodwa abasoke baphenduke ezonweni zabo. Bebengeke bayekele ngitsho lokukodwa abekade bengakwenza ukunqoba ngabe bebengaba lalo ithuba lokukwenza lokhu. {GC 654.2}

Umhlaba ubona iqula leli abebekade belihlukumeza, belichothoza njalo befuna ukulesula embalini yomhlaba, bedlula phakathi kwenhlupho, lezikhukhula njalo lokuzamazama komhlaba bengalimali. Lowo ongumlilo oqothulayo kulabo abephula imilayo yakhe uyindawo yokuphepha ebantwini bakhe. {GC 654.3}

Bonke abafundisi abakhethe ukuba bathandwe ngabantu kulokuthi batshumayele iqiniso ngalesi isikhathi babona isimo njalo lendonsela yokufundisa kwabo. Kusobala ukuthi ilihlo likaNkulunkulu elingafiphaliyo lalimlandela nxa wayetshumayela phambi kwabantu, lanxa wayehamba emigwaqweni, njalo lalapho wayehlangana labantu ekuphileni kwakhe. Konke akwenzayo evusa imizwa yabantu, lakuwo wonke amabala awalobayo, lawo wonke amazwi awakhulumayo, lazo zonke izenzo ezaholela ukuthi abantu bazizwe bephephile ngaphansi kwemfundiso zamanga, konke lokhu bekuhlanyela inhlanyelo, njalo khathesi ebantwini abalahliweyo phambi kwakhe, ubona isivuno sakhona. {GC 654.4}

INkosi ithi: “Kabawelaphisisi amanxeba abantu bami, bathi: Konke kulungile, khona kungalunganga.” Jeremiya 8:11. “Ngoba libadukisile abalungileyo ngamanga, lapho ngingabadukisanga mina, lakhuthaza ababi ukuze bangaphenduki endleleni zabo ezimbi, basile.” Hezekheli 13:22. {GC 655.1}

“Maye kubo abelusi abachitha behlakaza izimvu zomhlambi wami! …Khangelani ngizakwehlisa phezu kwenu umvuzo wezenzo zenu ezimbi, kutsho iNkosi.” “Lilani lina belusi, likhale, zibhuqeni emlotheni lina ziphathamandla zomhlambi, ngoba insuku zokuhlatshwa kwenu lezokuhlakazeka sezifikile...abelusi kabayikuba lesiphephelo, leziphathamandla zomhlambi kaziyikuphunyuka. Jeremiya 23:1,2; 25:34,35. {GC 655.2}

Abafundisi ndawonye labantu bonke bananzelela ukuba abazange bagcine ubudlelwane obuqondileyo phakathi kwabo loNkulunkulu. Bananzelela ukuthi bamhlamukele uMlobi womthetho olungileyo njalo longcwele. Ukubeka eceleni imilayo yakhe yikho okwabangela ububi, lenzondo, lokuxabana, kwaze kwafika isikhathi lapho umhlaba owaphenduka khona waba yinsimu enkulu yengxabano njalo lechibi lenkohlakalo. Lokhu yikho okuzaba sobala engqondweni zalabo abakhetha ukuphika iqiniso njalo labakhetha ukuthokoziswa ngamanga. Awakho amazwi angachaza ukulangazelela abantu abakhetha ukwephula imilayo abazaba lakho ngenxa yokufisa lokho okuzabe sekubalahlekele kokuphela, khona okuyimpilo ephakade. Amadoda abekade ekhonzwa njalo ebabazwa emhlabeni ngenxa yobungcitshi babo khathesi babona zonke izinto ekukhanyeni kwazo. Bananzelela konke okubalahlekeleyo ngenxa yempilo yokona, njalo bawela ezinyaweni zalabo abekade bebachothoza ngenxa yokwethembeka kwabo njalo bayavuma ukuba uNkulunkulu ubathandile. {GC 655.3}
